verses.sanskrit: पतिं हित्वाऽपकृष्टं स्वमुत्कृष्टं या निषेवते । हित्वाऽवकृष्टं निन्द्यैव सा भवेल्लोके परपूर्वैति चौच्यते
verses.transliteration: patiṃ hitvā'pakṛṣṭaṃ svamutkṛṣṭaṃ yā niṣevate | hitvā'vakṛṣṭaṃ nindyaiva sā bhavelloke parapūrvaiti caucyate
verses.translation: She who cohabits with a man of higher caste, forsaking her own husband who belongs to a lower one, will become contemptible in this world, and is called a remarried woman (parapurva).
verses.commentary: Sense: She who cohabits with a man of higher caste, forsaking her own husband who belongs to a lower one, will become contemptible in this world, and is called a remarried woman (parapurva).
verses.hindi: जव गहरु्थ अपने शरीर की खाल ढीली, चाल पका, और पुत्र. के.  आहार और घर का. सामान: छोड़कर, स्री को. पुत्रों के. पास छोड़े.   साथ रके और जितेन्द्रिय होकर निवास करे। नानाभाँति के. - किया करे ॥ ६-शक

verses.sanskrit: व्यभिचारात्तु भर्तुः स्त्री लोके प्राप्नोति निन्द्यताम् । व्यभिचारे तु शृगालयोनिं प्राप्नोति पापरोगैश्च पीड्यते
verses.transliteration: vyabhicārāttu bhartuḥ strī loke prāpnoti nindyatām | vyabhicāre tu śṛgālayoniṃ prāpnoti pāparogaiśca pīḍyate
verses.translation: By violating her duty towards her husband, a wife is disgraced in this world, (after death) she enters the womb of a jackal, and is tormented by diseases (the punishment of) her sin.
verses.commentary: Sense: By violating her duty towards her husband, a wife is disgraced in this world, (after death) she enters the womb of a jackal, and is tormented by diseases (the punishment of) her sin.

verses.sanskrit: पतिं या नाभिचरति मनोवाग्देहसंयुता । देहसंयता सा भर्तृलोकमाप्नोति सद्भिः साध्वीति चोच्यते
verses.transliteration: patiṃ yā nābhicarati manovāgdehasaṃyutā | dehasaṃyatā sā bhartṛlokamāpnoti sadbhiḥ sādhvīti cocyate
verses.translation: She who, controlling her thoughts, words, and deeds, never slights her lord, resides (after death) with her husband (in heaven), and is called a virtuous (wife).
verses.commentary: Sense: She who, controlling her thoughts, words, and deeds, never slights her lord, resides (after death) with her husband (in heaven), and is called a virtuous (wife).

verses.sanskrit: अनेन नारी वृत्तेन मनोवाग्देहसंयता । इहाग्र्यां कीर्तिमाप्नोति पतिलोकं परत्र च
verses.transliteration: anena nārī vṛttena manovāgdehasaṃyatā | ihāgryāṃ kīrtimāpnoti patilokaṃ paratra ca
verses.translation: In reward of such conduct, a female who controls her thoughts, speech, and actions, gains in this (life) highest renown, and in the next (world) a place near her husband.
verses.commentary: Sense: In reward of such conduct, a female who controls her thoughts, speech, and actions, gains in this (life) highest renown, and in the next (world) a place near her husband.

verses.sanskrit: एवं वृत्तां सवर्णां स्त्रीं द्विजातिः पूर्वमारिणीम् । दाहयेदग्निहोत्रेण यज्ञपात्रैश्च धर्मवित्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ vṛttāṃ savarṇāṃ strīṃ dvijātiḥ pūrvamāriṇīm | dāhayedagnihotreṇa yajñapātraiśca dharmavit
verses.translation: A twice-born man, versed in the sacred law, shall burn a wife of equal caste who conducts herself thus and dies before him, with (the sacred fires used for) the Agnihotra, and with the sacrificial implements.
verses.commentary: Sense: A twice-born man, versed in the sacred law, shall burn a wife of equal caste who conducts herself thus and dies before him, with (the sacred fires used for) the Agnihotra, and with the sacrificial implements.

verses.sanskrit: भार्यायै पूर्वमारिण्यै दत्त्वाऽग्नीनन्त्यकर्मणि । पुनर्दारक्रियां कुर्यात्पुनराधानमेव च
verses.transliteration: bhāryāyai pūrvamāriṇyai dattvā'gnīnantyakarmaṇi | punardārakriyāṃ kuryātpunarādhānameva ca
verses.translation: Having thus, at the funeral, given the sacred fires to his wife who dies before him, he may marry again, and again kindle (the fires).
verses.commentary: Sense: Having thus, at the funeral, given the sacred fires to his wife who dies before him, he may marry again, and again kindle (the fires).
verses.hindi: जव गहरु्थ अपने शरीर की खाल ढीली, चाल पका, और पुत्र. के.  आहार और घर का. सामान: छोड़कर, स्री को. पुत्रों के. पास छोड़े.   साथ रके और जितेन्द्रिय होकर निवास करे। नानाभाँति के. - किया करे ॥ ६-शक
verses.science: जव गहरु्थ अपने शरीर की खाल ढीली, चाल पका, और पुत्र. के. आहार और घर का. सामान: छोड़कर, स्री को. पुत्रों के. पास छोड़े. साथ रके और जितेन्द्रिय होकर निवास करे। आहार, निद्रा और इंद्रिय-भार शरीर की स्थिति को सीधे बदलते हैं। यह पंक्ति उस शारीरिक आधार को छोड़कर नहीं चलती।

verses.sanskrit: अनेन विधिना नित्यं पञ्चयज्ञान्न हापयेत् । द्वितीयमायुषो भागं कृतदारो गृहे वसेत्
verses.transliteration: anena vidhinā nityaṃ pañcayajñānna hāpayet | dvitīyamāyuṣo bhāgaṃ kṛtadāro gṛhe vaset
verses.translation: (Living) according to the (preceding) rules, he must never neglect the five (great) sacrifices, and, having taken a wife, he must dwell in (his own) house during the second period of his life.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Living) according to the (preceding) rules, he must never neglect the five (great) sacrifices, and, having taken a wife, he must dwell in (his own) house during the second period of his life.
verses.hindi: जव गहरु्थ अपने शरीर की खाल ढीली, चाल पका, और पुत्र. के.  आहार और घर का. सामान: छोड़कर, स्री को. पुत्रों के. पास छोड़े.   साथ रके और जितेन्द्रिय होकर निवास करे। नानाभाँति के. - किया करे ॥ ६-शक
verses.science: जव गहरु्थ अपने शरीर की खाल ढीली, चाल पका, और पुत्र. के. आहार और घर का. सामान: छोड़कर, स्री को. पुत्रों के. पास छोड़े. साथ रके और जितेन्द्रिय होकर निवास करे। आहार, निद्रा और इंद्रिय-भार शरीर की स्थिति को सीधे बदलते हैं। यह पंक्ति उस शारीरिक आधार को छोड़कर नहीं चलती।

verses.sanskrit: एवं गृहाश्रमे स्थित्वा विधिवत्स्नातको द्विजः । वने वसेत्तु नियतो यथावद्विजितैन्द्रियः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ gṛhāśrame sthitvā vidhivatsnātako dvijaḥ | vane vasettu niyato yathāvadvijitaindriyaḥ
verses.translation: A twice-born Snataka, who has thus lived according to the law in the order of householders, may, taking a firm resolution and keeping his organs in subjection, dwell in the forest, duly (observing the rules given below).
verses.hindi: है खुगचर्म या धल्कल धारण करे और आतःकालसायकाल दोनों समय स्नान करे। जरा, दाढ़ी मूछ, लोम और नख का सदा धारण करे! अपने भोजनार्थ जो कुछ हो उसमें से बलि और भिक्षा देवे और आशम मैं आए मह॒ुष्यों का जल, कन्द, फल और
verses.commentary: Sense: A twice-born Snataka, who has thus lived according to the law in the order of householders, may, taking a firm resolution and keeping his organs in subjection, dwell in the forest, duly (observing the rules given below).
verses.science: है खुगचर्म या धल्कल धारण करे और आतःकालसायकाल दोनों समय स्नान करे। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: गृहस्थस्तु यथा पश्येद्वलीपलितमात्मनः । अपत्यस्यैव चापत्यं तदाऽरण्यं समाश्रयेत्
verses.transliteration: gṛhasthastu yathā paśyedvalīpalitamātmanaḥ | apatyasyaiva cāpatyaṃ tadā'raṇyaṃ samāśrayet
verses.translation: When a householder sees his (skin) wrinkled, and (his hair) white, and. the sons of his sons, then he may resort to the forest.
verses.hindi: ससुपोढेणु कासए निरपेक्षः परिज्रजेत्
verses.commentary: Sense: When a householder sees his (skin) wrinkled, and (his hair) white, and. the sons of his sons, then he may resort to the forest.
verses.science: ससुपोढेणु कासए निरपेक्षः परिज्रजेत्। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: संत्यज्य ग्राम्यमाहारं सर्वं चैव परिच्छदम् । पुत्रेषु भार्यां निक्षिप्य वनं गच्छेत्सहैव वा
verses.transliteration: saṃtyajya grāmyamāhāraṃ sarvaṃ caiva paricchadam | putreṣu bhāryāṃ nikṣipya vanaṃ gacchetsahaiva vā
verses.translation: Abandoning all food raised by cultivation, and all his belongings, he may depart into the forest, either committing his wife to his sons, or accompanied by her.
verses.hindi: ५, 2 सी को ममि में जीवों को बचाकर पैर दिन या रात में, संन्यास का भूम में जीवो को रखना चाहिए चाहे शरीर को छुम्ख भा मिले । जो यति चलता फिरता अनजान में, जीवों की दिला करता है; उस पाप
verses.commentary: Sense: Abandoning all food raised by cultivation, and all his belongings, he may depart into the forest, either committing his wife to his sons, or accompanied by her.
verses.science: ५, 2 सी को ममि में जीवों को बचाकर पैर दिन या रात में, संन्यास का भूम में जीवो को रखना चाहिए चाहे शरीर को छुम्ख भा मिले। आहार, निद्रा और इंद्रिय-भार शरीर की स्थिति को सीधे बदलते हैं। यह पंक्ति उस शारीरिक आधार को छोड़कर नहीं चलती।

verses.sanskrit: अग्निहोत्रं समादाय गृह्यं चाग्निपरिच्छदम् । ग्रामादरण्यं निःसृत्य निवसेन्नियतेन्द्रियः
verses.transliteration: agnihotraṃ samādāya gṛhyaṃ cāgniparicchadam | grāmādaraṇyaṃ niḥsṛtya nivasenniyatendriyaḥ
verses.translation: Taking with him the sacred fire and the implements required for domestic (sacrifices), he may go forth from the village into the forest and reside there, duly controlling his senses.
verses.commentary: Sense: Taking with him the sacred fire and the implements required for domestic (sacrifices), he may go forth from the village into the forest and reside there, duly controlling his senses.
verses.hindi: पुष्पमूलफलेवापे केवलैवेतयेत्सदा । कालपक्केःस्वयंशीरॉबेानससते स्थितः
verses.science: पुष्पमूलफलेवापे केवलैवेतयेत्सदा। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: निष्क्रम्य मुन्यन्नैर्विविधैर्मेध्यैः शाकमूलफलेन वा । एतानेव महायज्ञान्निर्वपेद्विधिपूर्वकम्
verses.transliteration: niṣkramya munyannairvividhairmedhyaiḥ śākamūlaphalena vā | etāneva mahāyajñānnirvapedvidhipūrvakam
verses.translation: Let him offer those five great sacrifices according to the rule, with various kinds of pure food fit for ascetics, or with herbs, roots, and fruit.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let him offer those five great sacrifices according to the rule, with various kinds of pure food fit for ascetics, or with herbs, roots, and fruit.
verses.hindi: भूमो वियारिवतेत हिड्दा प्रपहैविनम्।
verses.science: भूमो वियारिवतेत हिड्दा प्रपहैविनम्। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वसीत चर्म चीरं वा सायं स्नायात्प्रगे तथा । जटाश्च बिभृयान्नित्यं श्मश्रुलोमनखानि च
verses.transliteration: vasīta carma cīraṃ vā sāyaṃ snāyātprage tathā | jaṭāśca bibhṛyānnityaṃ śmaśrulomanakhāni ca
verses.translation: Let him wear a skin or a tattered garment; let him bathe in the evening or in the morning; and let him always wear (his hair in) braids, the hair on his body, his beard, and his nails (being unclipped).
verses.commentary: Sense: Let him wear a skin or a tattered garment; let him bathe in the evening or in the morning; and let him always wear (his hair in) braids, the hair on his body, his beard, and his nails (being unclipped).
verses.hindi: श्रथवा पूर्णा और अमा को एक चार उचाली हुई यवागू खाय! अथवा ऋतु में एके और स्वयं गिरे फल, मुल, फूलों से ही नि चा करे! भूमि पर चैठा रहे या दिनभर पैसों से खड़ा रहे, अपने स्थान और आसन मै बिहार करे। तीनों काल में स्नान किया करे।
verses.science: श्रथवा पूर्णा और अमा को एक चार उचाली हुई यवागू खाय! अथवा ऋतु में एके और स्वयं गिरे फल, मुल, फूलों से ही नि चा करे! भूमि पर चैठा रहे या दिनभर पैसों से खड़ा रह…। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: यद्भक्ष्यं स्याद्ततो दद्याद्बलिं भिक्षां च शक्तितः । यद्भक्षः अब्मूलफलभिक्षाभिरर्चयेदाश्रमागतान्
verses.transliteration: yadbhakṣyaṃ syādtato dadyādbaliṃ bhikṣāṃ ca śaktitaḥ | yadbhakṣaḥ abmūlaphalabhikṣābhirarcayedāśramāgatān
verses.translation: Let him perform the Bali-offering with such food as he eats, and give alms according to his ability; let him honour those who come to his hermitage with alms consisting of water, roots, and fruit.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let him perform the Bali-offering with such food as he eats, and give alms according to his ability; let him honour those who come to his hermitage with alms consisting of water, roots, and fruit.
verses.hindi: अनग्निरनिकेतः स्यान्सुनिमतफलाशनः
verses.science: अनग्निरनिकेतः स्यान्सुनिमतफलाशनः। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: :आश्रमागतं स्वाध्याये नित्ययुक्तः स्याद्दान्तो मैत्रः समाहितः । दाता नित्यमनादाता सर्वभूतानुकम्पकः
verses.transliteration: :āśramāgataṃ svādhyāye nityayuktaḥ syāddānto maitraḥ samāhitaḥ | dātā nityamanādātā sarvabhūtānukampakaḥ
verses.translation: Let him be always industrious in privately reciting the Veda; let him be patient of hardships, friendly (towards all), of collected mind, ever liberal and never a receiver of gifts, and compassionate towards all living creatures.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let him be always industrious in privately reciting the Veda; let him be patient of hardships, friendly (towards all), of collected mind, ever liberal and never a receiver of gifts, and compassionate towards all living creatures.
verses.hindi: 'वावेथाश्चोपानेषदोरास्मलासेछय श्चताः
verses.science: 'वावेथाश्चोपानेषदोरास्मलासेछय श्चताः। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वैतानिकं च जुहुयादग्निहोत्रं यथाविधि । दर्शमस्कन्दयन् पर्व पौर्णमासं च योगतः
verses.transliteration: vaitānikaṃ ca juhuyādagnihotraṃ yathāvidhi | darśamaskandayan parva paurṇamāsaṃ ca yogataḥ
verses.translation: Let him offer, according to the law, the Agnihotra with three sacred fires, never omitting the new-moon and full-moon sacrifices at the proper time.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let him offer, according to the law, the Agnihotra with three sacred fires, never omitting the new-moon and full-moon sacrifices at the proper time.
verses.hindi: तीनोंकाल स्नान करे, देवता और पितरों को तृप्त करे आर. उग्र तपस्या करके अपना शरीर, खुखाया करे। शाख्रचिधि के अचुसार रहें, भूमि पर सोवे, सुख के पदार्थों का उपाय च करे और निवास स्थान में ममता छोड़कर वृक्ष के नीचे रहाकरे । चनवाखी ब्राडाणा ,
verses.science: तीनोंकाल स्नान करे, देवता और पितरों को तृप्त करे आर. उग्र तपस्या करके अपना शरीर, खुखाया करे। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ऋक्षेष्ट्य्।आग्रयणं चैव चातुर्मास्यानि चाहरेत् । दर्शेष्ट्य्।आग्रयणं तुरायणं च क्रमशो दक्षस्यायनमेव च
verses.transliteration: ṛkṣeṣṭy|āgrayaṇaṃ caiva cāturmāsyāni cāharet | darśeṣṭy|āgrayaṇaṃ turāyaṇaṃ ca kramaśo dakṣasyāyanameva ca
verses.translation: Let him also offer the Nakshatreshti, the Agrayana, and the Katurmasya (sacrifices), as well as the Turayana and likewise the Dakshayana, in due order.
verses.hindi: स्थलजौदकशाकानि पुष्पमूलफतान च। .
verses.commentary: Sense: Let him also offer the Nakshatreshti, the Agrayana, and the Katurmasya (sacrifices), as well as the Turayana and likewise the Dakshayana, in due order.
verses.science: स्थलजौदकशाकानि पुष्पमूलफतान च। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दाक्षस्यायनं वासन्तशारदैर्मेध्यैर्मुन्यन्नैः स्वयमाहृतैः । पुरोडाशांश्चरूंश्चैव विधिवत्निर्वपेत्पृथक्
verses.transliteration: dākṣasyāyanaṃ vāsantaśāradairmedhyairmunyannaiḥ svayamāhṛtaiḥ | puroḍāśāṃścarūṃścaiva vidhivatnirvapetpṛthak
verses.translation: With pure grains, fit for ascetics, which grow in spring and in autumn, and which he himself has collected, let him severally prepare the sacrificial cakes (purodasa) and the boiled messes (karu), as the law directs.
verses.hindi: वर्जयेन्मधुमांसे च भो सदा वेदपाठ में: लगा रहे, इन्टिया वश मे रक्खे; सव से मित्रतां रखे, मनको स्थिर रक्खे, सदा दान देवे; किसीका दाने न लेव, सन्त और शरद ऋतु के मन अन्ना को खुद लाकर, विधि से चर
verses.commentary: Sense: With pure grains, fit for ascetics, which grow in spring and in autumn, and which he himself has collected, let him severally prepare the sacrificial cakes (purodasa) and the boiled messes (karu), as the law directs.
verses.science: वर्जयेन्मधुमांसे च भो सदा वेदपाठ में: लगा रहे, इन्टिया वश मे रक्खे; सव से मित्रतां रखे, मनको स्थिर रक्खे, सदा दान देवे; किसीका दाने न लेव, सन्त और शरद ऋतु के…। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: देवताभ्यस्तु तधुत्वा वन्यं मेध्यतरं हविः । शेषमात्मनि युञ्जीत लवणं च स्वयं कृतम्
verses.transliteration: devatābhyastu tadhutvā vanyaṃ medhyataraṃ haviḥ | śeṣamātmani yuñjīta lavaṇaṃ ca svayaṃ kṛtam
verses.translation: Having offered those most pure sacrificial viands, consisting of the produce of the forest, he may use the remainder for himself, (mixed with) salt prepared by himself.
verses.hindi: पुष्पमूलफलेवापे केवलैवेतयेत्सदा । कालपक्केःस्वयंशीरॉबेानससते स्थितः
verses.commentary: Sense: Having offered those most pure sacrificial viands, consisting of the produce of the forest, he may use the remainder for himself, (mixed with) salt prepared by himself.
verses.science: पुष्पमूलफलेवापे केवलैवेतयेत्सदा। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: स्थलजौदकशाकानि पुष्पमूलफलानि च । मेध्यवृक्षोद्भवान्यद्यात्स्नेहांश्च फलसम्भवान्
verses.transliteration: sthalajaudakaśākāni puṣpamūlaphalāni ca | medhyavṛkṣodbhavānyadyātsnehāṃśca phalasambhavān
verses.translation: Let him eat vegetables that grow on dry land or in water, flowers, roots, and fruits, the productions of pure trees, and oils extracted from forest-fruits.
verses.hindi: भूमो वियारिवतेत हिड्दा प्रपहैविनम्।
verses.commentary: Sense: Let him eat vegetables that grow on dry land or in water, flowers, roots, and fruits, the productions of pure trees, and oils extracted from forest-fruits.
verses.science: भूमो वियारिवतेत हिड्दा प्रपहैविनम्। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वर्जयेन् मधु मांसं च भौमानि कवकानि च । भूस्तृणं शिग्रुकं चैव श्लेश्मातकफलानि च
verses.transliteration: varjayen madhu māṃsaṃ ca bhaumāni kavakāni ca | bhūstṛṇaṃ śigrukaṃ caiva śleśmātakaphalāni ca
verses.translation: Let him avoid honey, flesh, and mushrooms growing on the ground (or elsewhere, the vegetables called) Bhustrina, and Sigruka, and the Sleshmantaka fruit.
verses.hindi: श्रथवा पूर्णा और अमा को एक चार उचाली हुई यवागू खाय! अथवा ऋतु में एके और स्वयं गिरे फल, मुल, फूलों से ही नि चा करे! भूमि पर चैठा रहे या दिनभर पैसों से खड़ा रहे, अपने स्थान और आसन मै बिहार करे। तीनों काल में स्नान किया करे।
verses.commentary: Sense: Let him avoid honey, flesh, and mushrooms growing on the ground (or elsewhere, the vegetables called) Bhustrina, and Sigruka, and the Sleshmantaka fruit.
verses.science: श्रथवा पूर्णा और अमा को एक चार उचाली हुई यवागू खाय! अथवा ऋतु में एके और स्वयं गिरे फल, मुल, फूलों से ही नि चा करे! भूमि पर चैठा रहे या दिनभर पैसों से खड़ा रह…। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: त्यजेदाश्वयुजे मासि मुन्यन्नं पूर्वसञ्चितम् । जीर्णानि चैव वासांसि शाकमूलफलानि च
verses.transliteration: tyajedāśvayuje māsi munyannaṃ pūrvasañcitam | jīrṇāni caiva vāsāṃsi śākamūlaphalāni ca
verses.translation: Let him throw away in the month of Asvina the food of ascetics, which he formerly collected, likewise his worn-out clothes and his vegetables, roots, and fruit.
verses.hindi: अनग्निरनिकेतः स्यान्सुनिमतफलाशनः
verses.commentary: Sense: Let him throw away in the month of Asvina the food of ascetics, which he formerly collected, likewise his worn-out clothes and his vegetables, roots, and fruit.
verses.science: अनग्निरनिकेतः स्यान्सुनिमतफलाशनः। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: न फालकृष्टमश्नीयादुत्सृष्टमपि केन चित् । न ग्रामजातान्यार्तोऽपि मूलाणि च फलानि च
verses.transliteration: na phālakṛṣṭamaśnīyādutsṛṣṭamapi kena cit | na grāmajātānyārto'pi mūlāṇi ca phalāni ca
verses.translation: Let him not eat anything (grown on) ploughed (land), though it may have been thrown away by somebody, nor roots and fruit grown in a village, though (he may be) tormented (by hunger).
verses.hindi: 'वावेथाश्चोपानेषदोरास्मलासेछय श्चताः
verses.commentary: Sense: Let him not eat anything (grown on) ploughed (land), though it may have been thrown away by somebody, nor roots and fruit grown in a village, though (he may be) tormented (by hunger).
verses.science: 'वावेथाश्चोपानेषदोरास्मलासेछय श्चताः। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पुष्पानि च फलानि च अग्निपक्वाशनो वा स्यात्कालपक्वभुजेव वा । अश्मकुट्टो भवेद्वाऽपि दन्तोलूखलिकोऽपि वा
verses.transliteration: puṣpāni ca phalāni ca agnipakvāśano vā syātkālapakvabhujeva vā | aśmakuṭṭo bhavedvā'pi dantolūkhaliko'pi vā
verses.translation: He may eat either what has been cooked with fire, or what has been ripened by time; he either may use a stone for grinding, or his teeth may be his mortar.
verses.hindi: तीनोंकाल स्नान करे, देवता और पितरों को तृप्त करे आर. उग्र तपस्या करके अपना शरीर, खुखाया करे। शाख्रचिधि के अचुसार रहें, भूमि पर सोवे, सुख के पदार्थों का उपाय च करे और निवास स्थान में ममता छोड़कर वृक्ष के नीचे रहाकरे । चनवाखी ब्राडाणा ,
verses.commentary: Sense: He may eat either what has been cooked with fire, or what has been ripened by time; he either may use a stone for grinding, or his teeth may be his mortar.
verses.science: तीनोंकाल स्नान करे, देवता और पितरों को तृप्त करे आर. उग्र तपस्या करके अपना शरीर, खुखाया करे। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सद्यः प्रक्षालको वा स्यान् माससञ्चयिकोऽपि वा । षण्मासनिचयो वा स्यात्समानिचय एव वा
verses.transliteration: sadyaḥ prakṣālako vā syān māsasañcayiko'pi vā | ṣaṇmāsanicayo vā syātsamānicaya eva vā
verses.translation: He may either at once (after his daily meal) cleanse (his vessel for collecting food), or lay up a store sufficient for a month, or gather what suffices for six months or for a year.
verses.hindi: इन महर्षियों फे आनुएानो मे से कोई अञजुष्टान करके चिप्र शरीर को छोड़कर शोक, भय खे रहित, नह्मालोक में महिमा पाता है। इस प्रकार आयुके तीसरे भाग को बन में विताकर, चौथे भाग में चिपयाएँ वासना छोड़ कर, सन्यास आश्रम को घारणुकरे॥३२-३४॥
verses.commentary: Sense: He may either at once (after his daily meal) cleanse (his vessel for collecting food), or lay up a store sufficient for a month, or gather what suffices for six months or for a year.
verses.science: इन महर्षियों फे आनुएानो मे से कोई अञजुष्टान करके चिप्र शरीर को छोड़कर शोक, भय खे रहित, नह्मालोक में महिमा पाता है। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: नक्तं चान्नं समश्नीयाद्दिवा वाऽहृत्य शक्तितः । चतुर्थकालिको वा स्यात्स्याद्वाऽप्यष्टमकालिकः
verses.transliteration: naktaṃ cānnaṃ samaśnīyāddivā vā'hṛtya śaktitaḥ | caturthakāliko vā syātsyādvā'pyaṣṭamakālikaḥ
verses.translation: Having collected food according to his ability, he may either eat at night (only), or in the day-time (only), or at every fourth meal-time, or at every eighth.
verses.hindi: भे जाकर और हवन, सिक्षा, चलि आदि से थका हुआ, सन्यास लेनेवाला पुरुप देहत्याग करने पर सोक्ष पाता हे। ऋषिऋ, दून ऋण झार पितऋण इन तीचा ख छटकारा पांच पर, सचका मात अम म लगावे अन्यथा करने से सनरकगार्सा हाता है  गवाश ल
verses.commentary: Sense: Having collected food according to his ability, he may either eat at night (only), or in the day-time (only), or at every fourth meal-time, or at every eighth.
verses.science: भे जाकर और हवन, सिक्षा, चलि आदि से थका हुआ, सन्यास लेनेवाला पुरुप देहत्याग करने पर सोक्ष पाता हे। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: चान्द्रायणविधानैर्वा शुक्लकृष्णे च वर्तयेत् । पक्षान्तयोर्वाऽप्यश्नीयाद्यवागूं क्वथितां सकृत्
verses.transliteration: cāndrāyaṇavidhānairvā śuklakṛṣṇe ca vartayet | pakṣāntayorvā'pyaśnīyādyavāgūṃ kvathitāṃ sakṛt
verses.translation: Or he may live according to the rule of the lunar penance (Kandrayana, daily diminishing the quantity of his food) in the bright (half of the month) and (increasing it) in the dark (half); or he may eat on the last days of each fortnight, once (a day only), boiled barley-gruel.
verses.hindi: उपश्षक्कशइसुका मानसोवससाहतः ॥ ४४ प जो पुरुष सव प्राणियों को अभय देकर, घर से चौथे आशम फो जाता है उसको तेजोमय लोक प्राप्त होते हैं । जिस द्विज से प्राणियों को ज़रा भी भय नहीं होता, उसको देह त्यागने पर कहो
verses.commentary: Sense: Or he may live according to the rule of the lunar penance (Kandrayana, daily diminishing the quantity of his food) in the bright (half of the month) and (increasing it) in the dark (half); or he may eat on the last days of each fortnight, once (a day only), boiled barley-gruel.
verses.science: उपश्षक्कशइसुका मानसोवससाहतः ॥ ४४ प जो पुरुष सव प्राणियों को अभय देकर, घर से चौथे आशम फो जाता है उसको तेजोमय लोक प्राप्त होते हैं। धीमी श्वास वेगस तंत्रिका को सक्रिय कर भय-प्रतिक्रिया को शांत करती है। यह पंक्ति उसी श्वास और मन के संबंध को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: पुष्पमूलफलैर्वाऽपि केवलैर्वर्तयेत्सदा । कालपक्वैः स्वयं शीर्णैर्वैखानसमते स्थितः
verses.transliteration: puṣpamūlaphalairvā'pi kevalairvartayetsadā | kālapakvaiḥ svayaṃ śīrṇairvaikhānasamate sthitaḥ
verses.translation: Or he may constantly subsist on flowers, roots, and fruit alone, which have been ripened by time and have fallen spontaneously, following the rule of the (Institutes) of Vikhanas.
verses.hindi: भिक्षापात्र, वृक्ष के नीचे निवास, फरे टूटे वख, किसी की मदद न लेना और सब के ऊपर समान भाव रखना, ये सब झुक पुरुप के ॐ  न मरने की और न जीने की ही इच्छा करे पुरुप के लक्षण हैं! : नीक की अतीक्षा
verses.commentary: Sense: Or he may constantly subsist on flowers, roots, and fruit alone, which have been ripened by time and have fallen spontaneously, following the rule of the (Institutes) of Vikhanas.
verses.science: भिक्षापात्र, वृक्ष के नीचे निवास, फरे टूटे वख, किसी की मदद न लेना और सब के ऊपर समान भाव रखना, ये सब झुक पुरुप के ॐ न मरने की और न जीने की ही इच्छा करे पुरुप…। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: भूमौ विपरिवर्तेत तिष्ठेद्वा प्रपदैर्दिनम् । स्थानासनाभ्यां विहरेत्सवनेषूपयन्नपः
verses.transliteration: bhūmau viparivarteta tiṣṭhedvā prapadairdinam | sthānāsanābhyāṃ viharetsavaneṣūpayannapaḥ
verses.translation: Let him either roll about on the ground, or stand during the day on tiptoe, (or) let him alternately stand and sit down; going at the Savanas (at sunrise, at midday, and at sunset) to water in the forest (in order to bathe).
verses.hindi: श्ध्य . - मनुस्खति। . सघङ्गारावकोणा च ने वाचमदृतां वदत् ४८
verses.commentary: Sense: Let him either roll about on the ground, or stand during the day on tiptoe, (or) let him alternately stand and sit down; going at the Savanas (at sunrise, at midday, and at sunset) to water in the forest (in order to bathe).
verses.science: श्ध्य . - मनुस्खति। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ग्रीष्मे पञ्चतपास्तु स्याद्वर्षास्वभ्रावकाशिकः । आर्द्रवासास्तु हेमन्ते क्रमशो वर्धयंस्तपः
verses.transliteration: grīṣme pañcatapāstu syādvarṣāsvabhrāvakāśikaḥ | ārdravāsāstu hemante kramaśo vardhayaṃstapaḥ
verses.translation: In summer let him expose himself to the heat of five fires, during the rainy season live under the open sky, and in winter be dressed in wet clothes, (thus) gradually increasing (the rigour of) his austerities.
verses.hindi: कोइ व्यथ झगडा करें तो उसको सहन करे, किसाका अपमानच व न करे। और इस देह से किसी से चेर करना भी अच्छा नहीं है। कर, केवल अपची सहायता से ही मोक्षखख चाहता. हुआ इस. ' जगत् में विचरे ॥ ४७-७६ ॥ 5
verses.commentary: Sense: In summer let him expose himself to the heat of five fires, during the rainy season live under the open sky, and in winter be dressed in wet clothes, (thus) gradually increasing (the rigour of) his austerities.
verses.science: कोइ व्यथ झगडा करें तो उसको सहन करे, किसाका अपमानच व न करे। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: उपस्पृशंस्त्रिषवणं पितॄन् देवांश्च तर्पयेत् । तपस्चरंश्चोग्रतरं शोषयेद्देहमात्मनः
verses.transliteration: upaspṛśaṃstriṣavaṇaṃ pitṝn devāṃśca tarpayet | tapascaraṃścogrataraṃ śoṣayeddehamātmanaḥ
verses.translation: When he bathes at the three Savanas (sunrise, midday, and sunset), let him offer libations of water to the manes and the gods, and practising harsher and harsher austerities, let him dry up his bodily frame.
verses.hindi: दसर काइ चालण, पक्षी, कुत्ता या.सिखारियों ले घिरे स्थान में भिक्षा को न जावे । केश, नख और दाढ़ी सुँछाँ को मुडाकर, भिक्षा- पात्र, दर्ड, कमरडलु और रंगे वखों के सहित, किसी को दुःख न देकर, नियम से विचरा करे । संन्यासी के पात्र, सोना, चांदी
verses.commentary: Sense: When he bathes at the three Savanas (sunrise, midday, and sunset), let him offer libations of water to the manes and the gods, and practising harsher and harsher austerities, let him dry up his bodily frame.
verses.science: दसर काइ चालण, पक्षी, कुत्ता या.सिखारियों ले घिरे स्थान में भिक्षा को न जावे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अग्नीनात्मनि वैतानान् समारोप्य यथाविधि । अनग्निरनिकेतः स्यान् मुनिर्मूलफलाशनः
verses.transliteration: agnīnātmani vaitānān samāropya yathāvidhi | anagniraniketaḥ syān munirmūlaphalāśanaḥ
verses.translation: Having reposited the three sacred fires in himself, according to the prescribed rule, let him live without a fire, without a house, wholly silent, subsisting on roots and fruit,
verses.hindi: अभिपूजितलाभेशच यतिुकोऽपि बध्यते
verses.commentary: Sense: Having reposited the three sacred fires in himself, according to the prescribed rule, let him live without a fire, without a house, wholly silent, subsisting on roots and fruit,
verses.science: अभिपूजितलाभेशच यतिुकोऽपि बध्यते। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अप्रयत्नः सुखार्थेषु ब्रह्मचारी धराऽऽशयः । शरणेष्वममश्चैव वृक्षमूलनिकेतनः
verses.transliteration: aprayatnaḥ sukhārtheṣu brahmacārī dharā''śayaḥ | śaraṇeṣvamamaścaiva vṛkṣamūlaniketanaḥ
verses.translation: Making no effort (to procure) things that give pleasure, chaste, sleeping on the bare ground, not caring for any shelter, dwelling at the roots of trees.
verses.hindi: अधिक भिक्षा से कामादि विषया में मन लग जाता है । रखोई कां युऱा निकल गया हो, कूटना वंद हो चुका हो, आग बुझादी हि चाहिए। भिक्षा न मिलने पर खेद और मिलने पर आल न माले, होवे । सत्कार के साथ मिली भिक्षाओं से पुणा करे यकि
verses.commentary: Sense: Making no effort (to procure) things that give pleasure, chaste, sleeping on the bare ground, not caring for any shelter, dwelling at the roots of trees.
verses.science: अधिक भिक्षा से कामादि विषया में मन लग जाता है। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तापसेष्वेव विप्रेषु यात्रिकं भैक्षमाहरेत् । गृहमेधिषु चान्येषु द्विजेषु वनवासिषु
verses.transliteration: tāpaseṣveva vipreṣu yātrikaṃ bhaikṣamāharet | gṛhamedhiṣu cānyeṣu dvijeṣu vanavāsiṣu
verses.translation: From Brahmanas (who live as) ascetics, let him receive alms, (barely sufficient) to support life, or from other householders of the twice-born (castes) who reside in the forest.
verses.hindi: " थोडा भोजन से, निर्जन मै निवास खे, विषयों में खिची हुई, णियाँ की हिंसा न करने से पुरुष मोक्ष के योग्य होता है। महुप्य , के कमे दोषों से दुर्गति, नरक में पड़ना और यमयातना. आदि -: यह सब निषिद्ध कर्मों का फल समभना चाहिए -॥'५६-६२॥ पत .
verses.commentary: Sense: From Brahmanas (who live as) ascetics, let him receive alms, (barely sufficient) to support life, or from other householders of the twice-born (castes) who reside in the forest.
verses.science: " थोडा भोजन से, निर्जन मै निवास खे, विषयों में खिची हुई, णियाँ की हिंसा न करने से पुरुष मोक्ष के योग्य होता है। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: ग्रामादाहृत्य वाऽश्नीयादष्टौ ग्रासान् वने वसन् । प्रतिगृह्य पुटेनैव पाणिना शकलेन वा
verses.transliteration: grāmādāhṛtya vā'śnīyādaṣṭau grāsān vane vasan | pratigṛhya puṭenaiva pāṇinā śakalena vā
verses.translation: Or (the hermit) who dwells in the forest may bring (food) from a village, receiving it either in a hollow dish (of leaves), in (his naked) hand, or in a broken earthen dish, and may eat eight mouthfuls.
verses.hindi: समः सर्वेषु भूतेष न लिङ्ग धमेकारणम् ॥ ६ ६ ॥
verses.commentary: Sense: Or (the hermit) who dwells in the forest may bring (food) from a village, receiving it either in a hollow dish (of leaves), in (his naked) hand, or in a broken earthen dish, and may eat eight mouthfuls.
verses.science: समः सर्वेषु भूतेष न लिङ्ग धमेकारणम् ॥ ६ ६ ॥। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एताश्चान्याश्च सेवेत दीक्षा विप्रो वने वसन् । विविधाश्चौपनिषदीरात्मसंसिद्धये श्रुतीः
verses.transliteration: etāścānyāśca seveta dīkṣā vipro vane vasan | vividhāścaupaniṣadīrātmasaṃsiddhaye śrutīḥ
verses.translation: These and other observances must a Brahmana who dwells in the forest diligently practise, and in order to attain complete (union with) the (supreme) Soul, (he must study) the various sacred texts contained in the Upanishads,
verses.hindi: इस देह से निकलता, फिर गर्म में उत्पत्ति और लाखों योनियों का विचार करे । आश्रम के चियद्ध कोई दोष भी लगे, सोभी जीवो पर समभाव रखकर, धर्माचरण करता रहे । क्योंकि दरड-कम- रडलु चिद्व धारण करना ही धर्माचरण नहीं कहलाता । निर्मली
verses.commentary: Sense: These and other observances must a Brahmana who dwells in the forest diligently practise, and in order to attain complete (union with) the (supreme) Soul, (he must study) the various sacred texts contained in the Upanishads,
verses.science: इस देह से निकलता, फिर गर्म में उत्पत्ति और लाखों योनियों का विचार करे। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: ऋषिभिर्ब्राह्मणैश्चैव गृहस्थैरेव सेविताः । विद्यातपोविवृद्ध्यर्थं शरीरस्य च शुद्धये
verses.transliteration: ṛṣibhirbrāhmaṇaiścaiva gṛhasthaireva sevitāḥ | vidyātapovivṛddhyarthaṃ śarīrasya ca śuddhaye
verses.translation: (As well as those rites and texts) which have been practised and studied by the sages (Rishis), and by Brahmana householders, in order to increase their knowledge (of Brahman), and their austerity, and in order to sanctify their bodies;
verses.hindi: दशनेन विहीनस्तु संसारं प्रतिपद्यते
verses.commentary: Sense: (As well as those rites and texts) which have been practised and studied by the sages (Rishis), and by Brahmana householders, in order to increase their knowledge (of Brahman), and their austerity, and in order to sanctify their bodies;
verses.science: दशनेन विहीनस्तु संसारं प्रतिपद्यते। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अपराजितां वाऽस्थाय व्रजेद्दिशमजिह्मगः । आ निपातात्शरीरस्य युक्तो वार्यनिलाशनः
verses.transliteration: aparājitāṃ vā'sthāya vrajeddiśamajihmagaḥ | ā nipātātśarīrasya yukto vāryanilāśanaḥ
verses.translation: Or let him walk, fully determined and going straight on, in a north-easterly direction, subsisting on water and air, until his body sinks to rest.
verses.hindi: जसे सुवणं आदि घातुओं का मेल अग्नि में घोकने से जल याम से दोषों को, बह्म में मनकी चारणा से पाए को, इा्रियसंयम ले विषयों को और ध्यान से कास, क्रोध, मोह आदि को जलावे। से विचार करे, क्योंकि, जीवयति सच को ज्ञात नहीं होती । ब्रहम
verses.commentary: Sense: Or let him walk, fully determined and going straight on, in a north-easterly direction, subsisting on water and air, until his body sinks to rest.
verses.science: जसे सुवणं आदि घातुओं का मेल अग्नि में घोकने से जल याम से दोषों को, बह्म में मनकी चारणा से पाए को, इा्रियसंयम ले विषयों को और ध्यान से कास, क्रोध, मोह आदि को…। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: आसां महर्षिचर्याणां त्यक्त्वाऽन्यतमया तनुम् । वीतशोकभयो विप्रो ब्रह्मलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: āsāṃ maharṣicaryāṇāṃ tyaktvā'nyatamayā tanum | vītaśokabhayo vipro brahmaloke mahīyate
verses.translation: A Brahmana, having got rid of his body by one of those modes practised by the great sages, is exalted in the world of Brahman, free from sorrow and fear.
verses.hindi: नदकूल यथा इक्षा वृक्ष वा शकानयथा।
verses.commentary: Sense: A Brahmana, having got rid of his body by one of those modes practised by the great sages, is exalted in the world of Brahman, free from sorrow and fear.
verses.science: नदकूल यथा इक्षा वृक्ष वा शकानयथा। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वनेषु च विहृत्यैवं तृतीयं भागमायुषः । चतुर्थमायुषो भागं त्यक्वा सङ्गान् परिव्रजेत्
verses.transliteration: vaneṣu ca vihṛtyaivaṃ tṛtīyaṃ bhāgamāyuṣaḥ | caturthamāyuṣo bhāgaṃ tyakvā saṅgān parivrajet
verses.translation: But having thus passed the third part of (a man's natural term of) life in the forest, he may live as an ascetic during the fourth part of his existence, after abandoning all attachment to worldly objects.
verses.hindi: से इल लोक में ब्रह्मपद का साधन होता है । यह शरीर हड्डी रूप खेमा में स्नायुरूप डोरियों से बॅधा, मांस और रुधिर रूप बुढ़ापा शोक, रोग, दुःख का घर हैं, रजोगुणी है, अनित्य है, पांच महाभूतो का निवासस्थान है, इससे ममता छोड़देनी चा
verses.commentary: Sense: But having thus passed the third part of (a man's natural term of) life in the forest, he may live as an ascetic during the fourth part of his existence, after abandoning all attachment to worldly objects.
verses.science: से इल लोक में ब्रह्मपद का साधन होता है। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: आश्रमादाश्रमं गत्वा हुतहोमो जितेन्द्रियः । भिक्षाबलिपरिश्रान्तः प्रव्रजन् प्रेत्य वर्धते
verses.transliteration: āśramādāśramaṃ gatvā hutahomo jitendriyaḥ | bhikṣābalipariśrāntaḥ pravrajan pretya vardhate
verses.translation: He who after passing from order to order, after offering sacrifices and subduing his senses, becomes, tired with (giving) alms and offerings of food, an ascetic, gains bliss after death.
verses.hindi: प्रिय पुरुषों के ऊपर पुण्य झौर अग्रियं ब्रह्मज्ञानी पुरुष अपने फे ऊपर पाप त्यागकर, भ्या होता-हे। जब सन्यासी सब भाँति निःस्ट्ह
verses.commentary: Sense: He who after passing from order to order, after offering sacrifices and subduing his senses, becomes, tired with (giving) alms and offerings of food, an ascetic, gains bliss after death.
verses.science: प्रिय पुरुषों के ऊपर पुण्य झौर अग्रियं ब्रह्मज्ञानी पुरुष अपने फे ऊपर पाप त्यागकर, भ्या होता-हे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ऋणानि त्रीण्यपाकृत्य मनो मोक्षे निवेशयेत् । अनपाकृत्य मोक्षं तु सेवमानो व्रजत्यधः
verses.transliteration: ṛṇāni trīṇyapākṛtya mano mokṣe niveśayet | anapākṛtya mokṣaṃ tu sevamāno vrajatyadhaḥ
verses.translation: When he has paid the three debts, let him apply his mind to (the attainment of) final liberation; he who seeks it without having paid (his debts) sinks downwards.
verses.hindi: एष धर्मोऽनुशिष्टो वो यतीनां नियतारमनाम्। वेदसेन्यासिकानां त कर्मयोगं निबोधत
verses.commentary: Sense: When he has paid the three debts, let him apply his mind to (the attainment of) final liberation; he who seeks it without having paid (his debts) sinks downwards.
verses.science: एष धर्मोऽनुशिष्टो वो यतीनां नियतारमनाम्। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अधीत्य विधिवद्वेदान् पुत्रांश्चोत्पाद्य धर्मतः । इष्ट्वा च शक्तितो यज्ञैर्मनो मोक्षे निवेशयेत्
verses.transliteration: adhītya vidhivadvedān putrāṃścotpādya dharmataḥ | iṣṭvā ca śaktito yajñairmano mokṣe niveśayet
verses.translation: Having studied the Vedas in accordance with the rule, having begat sons according to the sacred law, and having offered sacrifices according to his ability, he may direct his mind to (the attainment of) final liberation.
verses.hindi: से जो हिज संन्यास धारण करता है, चह सूच, पापों से छूटकर। यतियो का कहा गया है अब वेद संच्यासी, अथीत् जो चिई चारण गृहत्याग न करके शान सही संन्यासी है उनका कमयमिं
verses.commentary: Sense: Having studied the Vedas in accordance with the rule, having begat sons according to the sacred law, and having offered sacrifices according to his ability, he may direct his mind to (the attainment of) final liberation.
verses.science: से जो हिज संन्यास धारण करता है, चह सूच, पापों से छूटकर। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अनधीत्य द्विजो वेदाननुत्पाद्य तथा सुतान् । तथा प्रजां अनिष्ट्वा चैव यज्ञैश्च मोक्षमिच्छन् व्रजत्यधः
verses.transliteration: anadhītya dvijo vedānanutpādya tathā sutān | tathā prajāṃ aniṣṭvā caiva yajñaiśca mokṣamicchan vrajatyadhaḥ
verses.translation: A twice-born man who seeks final liberation, without having studied the Vedas, without having begotten sons, and without having offered sacrifices, sinks downwards.
verses.hindi: तो उत्तमगति देनेवाले हैं । इन सब आश्रमां मै वेद और स्सृतियों के सन करता है। जैसे सव नदी और नद समुद्र में अकर ठरते हैं, पैसे सघ आश्रमी गृहस्थ में आश्रम रखते हैं ॥ ८७-६० ॥ .
verses.commentary: Sense: A twice-born man who seeks final liberation, without having studied the Vedas, without having begotten sons, and without having offered sacrifices, sinks downwards.
verses.science: तो उत्तमगति देनेवाले हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्राजापत्यं निरुप्येष्टिं सर्ववेदसदक्षिणाम् । सार्ववेदसदक्षिणाम् आत्मन्यग्नीन् समारोप्य ब्राह्मणः प्रव्रजेद्गृहात्
verses.transliteration: prājāpatyaṃ nirupyeṣṭiṃ sarvavedasadakṣiṇām | sārvavedasadakṣiṇām ātmanyagnīn samāropya brāhmaṇaḥ pravrajedgṛhāt
verses.translation: Having performed the Ishti, sacred to the Lord of creatures (Pragapati), where (he gives) all his property as the sacrificial fee, having reposited the sacred fires in himself, a Brahmana may depart from his house (as an ascetic).
verses.hindi: का सेवन यक्ष से करना चाहिए  उनके लक्षण इस प्रकार हैं- १-बैसे, २-क्षमा, २-दम-मनको रोकना, ४-अस्तेय-चोरी व करना । ओ विप्र घर्मे/के दशलक्षणो को पढ़ते है और उसके अजु सा ते हैं, वे परमगति को पातेई॥ ६१-६३ ॥
verses.commentary: Sense: Having performed the Ishti, sacred to the Lord of creatures (Pragapati), where (he gives) all his property as the sacrificial fee, having reposited the sacred fires in himself, a Brahmana may depart from his house (as an ascetic).
verses.science: का सेवन यक्ष से करना चाहिए उनके लक्षण इस प्रकार हैं- १-बैसे, २-क्षमा, २-दम-मनको रोकना, ४-अस्तेय-चोरी व करना। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यो दत्त्वा सर्वभूतेभ्यः प्रव्रजत्यभयं गृहात् । तस्य तेजोमया लोका भवन्ति ब्रह्मवादिनः
verses.transliteration: yo dattvā sarvabhūtebhyaḥ pravrajatyabhayaṃ gṛhāt | tasya tejomayā lokā bhavanti brahmavādinaḥ
verses.translation: Worlds, radiant in brilliancy, become (the portion) of him who recites (the texts regarding) Brahman and departs from his house (as an ascetic), after giving a promise of safety to all created beings.

verses.sanskrit: यस्मादण्वपि भूतानां द्विजान्नोत्पद्यते भयम् । तस्य देहाद्विमुक्तस्य भयं नास्ति कुतश्चन
verses.transliteration: yasmādaṇvapi bhūtānāṃ dvijānnotpadyate bhayam | tasya dehādvimuktasya bhayaṃ nāsti kutaścana
verses.translation: For that twice-born man, by whom not the smallest danger even is caused to created beings, there will be no danger from any (quarter), after he is freed from his body.
verses.commentary: Sense: For that twice-born man, by whom not the smallest danger even is caused to created beings, there will be no danger from any (quarter), after he is freed from his body.

verses.sanskrit: अगारादभिनिष्क्रान्तः पवित्रोपचितो मुनिः । समुपोढेषु कामेषु निरपेक्षः परिव्रजेत्
verses.transliteration: agārādabhiniṣkrāntaḥ pavitropacito muniḥ | samupoḍheṣu kāmeṣu nirapekṣaḥ parivrajet
verses.translation: Departing from his house fully provided with the means of purification (Pavitra), let him wander about absolutely silent, and caring nothing for enjoyments that may be offered (to him).
verses.commentary: Sense: Departing from his house fully provided with the means of purification (Pavitra), let him wander about absolutely silent, and caring nothing for enjoyments that may be offered (to him).

verses.sanskrit: एक एव चरेन्नित्यं सिद्ध्यर्थमसहायवान् । सिद्धिमेकस्य सम्पश्यन्न जहाति न हीयते
verses.transliteration: eka eva carennityaṃ siddhyarthamasahāyavān | siddhimekasya sampaśyanna jahāti na hīyate
verses.translation: Let him always wander alone, without any companion, in order to attain (final liberation), fully understanding that the solitary (man, who) neither forsakes nor is forsaken, gains his end.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let him always wander alone, without any companion, in order to attain (final liberation), fully understanding that the solitary (man, who) neither forsakes nor is forsaken, gains his end.

verses.sanskrit: सिद्धम् अनग्निरनिकेतः स्याद्ग्राममन्नार्थमाश्रयेत् । उपेक्षकोऽसङ्कुसुको मुनिर्भावसमाहितः
verses.transliteration: siddham anagniraniketaḥ syādgrāmamannārthamāśrayet | upekṣako'saṅkusuko munirbhāvasamāhitaḥ
verses.translation: He shall neither possess a fire, nor a dwelling, he may go to a village for his food, (he shall be) indifferent to everything, firm of purpose, meditating (and) concentrating his mind on Brahman.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall neither possess a fire, nor a dwelling, he may go to a village for his food, (he shall be) indifferent to everything, firm of purpose, meditating (and) concentrating his mind on Brahman.

verses.sanskrit: ऽसाङ्कुसुको कपालं वृक्षमूलानि कुचेलमसहायता । कुचैलं समता चैव सर्वस्मिन्नेतत्मुक्तस्य लक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: 'sāṅkusuko kapālaṃ vṛkṣamūlāni kucelamasahāyatā | kucailaṃ samatā caiva sarvasminnetatmuktasya lakṣaṇam
verses.translation: A potsherd (instead of an alms-bowl), the roots of trees (for a dwelling), coarse worn-out garments, life in solitude and indifference towards everything, are the marks of one who has attained liberation.
verses.commentary: Sense: A potsherd (instead of an alms-bowl), the roots of trees (for a dwelling), coarse worn-out garments, life in solitude and indifference towards everything, are the marks of one who has attained liberation.

verses.sanskrit: नाभिनन्देत मरणं नाभिनन्देत जीवितम् । कालमेव प्रतीक्षेत निर्वेशं भृतको यथा
verses.transliteration: nābhinandeta maraṇaṃ nābhinandeta jīvitam | kālameva pratīkṣeta nirveśaṃ bhṛtako yathā
verses.translation: Let him not desire to die, let him not desire to live; let him wait for (his appointed) time, as a servant (waits) for the payment of his wages.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let him not desire to die, let him not desire to live; let him wait for (his appointed) time, as a servant (waits) for the payment of his wages.
verses.hindi: ऋषि, देव ओर पितरों के ऋण से सुक्त होकर, दशलक्षण भर्म का सचन करता हुआ द्विज वेदान्त को खुनकर संन्यास धारण करे । सव अस्निदोत्रादि कमो को छोड़कर, पापों का प्राणायाम से नाश करके, जितेन्द्रिय होकर वेद का अध्ययन करे आरे बुझा

verses.sanskrit: दृष्टिपूतं न्यसेत्पादं वस्त्रपूतं जलं पिबेत् । सत्यपूतां वदेद्वाचं मनःपूतं समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭipūtaṃ nyasetpādaṃ vastrapūtaṃ jalaṃ pibet | satyapūtāṃ vadedvācaṃ manaḥpūtaṃ samācaret
verses.translation: Let him put down his foot purified by his sight, let him drink water purified by (straining with) a cloth, let him utter speech purified by truth, let him keep his heart pure.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let him put down his foot purified by his sight, let him drink water purified by (straining with) a cloth, let him utter speech purified by truth, let him keep his heart pure.

verses.sanskrit: अतिवादांस्तितिक्षेत नावमन्येत कं चन । न चैमं देहमाश्रित्य वैरं कुर्वीत केन चित्
verses.transliteration: ativādāṃstitikṣeta nāvamanyeta kaṃ cana | na caimaṃ dehamāśritya vairaṃ kurvīta kena cit
verses.translation: Let him patiently bear hard words, let him not insult anybody, and let him not become anybody's enemy for the sake of this (perishable) body.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let him patiently bear hard words, let him not insult anybody, and let him not become anybody's enemy for the sake of this (perishable) body.

verses.sanskrit: क्रुद्ध्यन्तं न प्रतिक्रुध्येदाक्रुष्टः कुशलं वदेत् । सप्तद्वारावकीर्णां च न वाचमनृतां वदेत्
verses.transliteration: kruddhyantaṃ na pratikrudhyedākruṣṭaḥ kuśalaṃ vadet | saptadvārāvakīrṇāṃ ca na vācamanṛtāṃ vadet
verses.translation: Against an angry man let him not in return show anger, let him bless when he is cursed, and let him not utter speech, devoid of truth, scattered at the seven gates.
verses.commentary: Sense: Against an angry man let him not in return show anger, let him bless when he is cursed, and let him not utter speech, devoid of truth, scattered at the seven gates.

verses.sanskrit: अध्यात्मरतिरासीनो निरपेक्षो निरामिषः । आत्मनैव सहायेन सुखार्थी विचरेदिह
verses.transliteration: adhyātmaratirāsīno nirapekṣo nirāmiṣaḥ | ātmanaiva sahāyena sukhārthī vicarediha
verses.translation: Delighting in what refers to the Soul, sitting (in the postures prescribed by the Yoga), independent (of external help), entirely abstaining from sensual enjoyments, with himself for his only companion, he shall live in this world, desiring the bliss (of final liberation).
verses.commentary: Sense: Delighting in what refers to the Soul, sitting (in the postures prescribed by the Yoga), independent (of external help), entirely abstaining from sensual enjoyments, with himself for his only companion, he shall live in this world, desiring the bliss (of final liberation).

verses.sanskrit: न चोत्पातनिमित्ताभ्यां न नक्षत्राङ्गविद्यया । नानुशासनवादाभ्यां भिक्षां लिप्सेत कर्हि चित्
verses.transliteration: na cotpātanimittābhyāṃ na nakṣatrāṅgavidyayā | nānuśāsanavādābhyāṃ bhikṣāṃ lipseta karhi cit
verses.translation: Neither by (explaining) prodigies and omens, nor by skill in astrology and palmistry, nor by giving advice and by the exposition (of the Sastras), let him ever seek to obtain alms.
verses.commentary: Sense: Neither by (explaining) prodigies and omens, nor by skill in astrology and palmistry, nor by giving advice and by the exposition (of the Sastras), let him ever seek to obtain alms.

verses.sanskrit: न तापसैर्ब्राह्मणैर्वा वयोभिरपि वा श्वभिः । आकीर्णं भिक्षुकैर्वाऽन्यैरगारमुपसंव्रजेत्
verses.transliteration: na tāpasairbrāhmaṇairvā vayobhirapi vā śvabhiḥ | ākīrṇaṃ bhikṣukairvā'nyairagāramupasaṃvrajet
verses.translation: Let him not (in order to beg) go near a house filled with hermits, Brahmanas, birds, dogs, or other mendicants.

verses.transliteration: kḷptakeśanakhaśmaśruḥ pātrī daṇḍī kusumbhavān | vicarenniyato nityaṃ sarvabhūtānyapīḍayan
verses.translation: His hair, nails, and beard being clipped, carrying an alms-bowl, a staff, and a water-pot, let him continually wander about, controlling himself and not hurting any creature.
verses.commentary: Sense: His hair, nails, and beard being clipped, carrying an alms-bowl, a staff, and a water-pot, let him continually wander about, controlling himself and not hurting any creature.

verses.sanskrit: अतैजसानि पात्राणि तस्य स्युर्निर्व्रणानि च । तेषामद्भिः स्मृतं शौचं चमसानामिवाध्वरे
verses.transliteration: ataijasāni pātrāṇi tasya syurnirvraṇāni ca | teṣāmadbhiḥ smṛtaṃ śaucaṃ camasānāmivādhvare
verses.translation: His vessels shall not be made of metal, they shall be free from fractures; it is ordained that they shall be cleansed with water, like (the cups, called) Kamasa, at a sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: His vessels shall not be made of metal, they shall be free from fractures; it is ordained that they shall be cleansed with water, like (the cups, called) Kamasa, at a sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: अलाबुं दारुपात्रं च मृण्मयं वैदलं तथा । एताणि यतिपात्राणि मनुः स्वायम्भुवोऽब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: alābuṃ dārupātraṃ ca mṛṇmayaṃ vaidalaṃ tathā | etāṇi yatipātrāṇi manuḥ svāyambhuvo'bravīt
verses.translation: A gourd, a wooden bowl, an earthen (dish), or one made of split cane, Manu, the son of Svayambhu, has declared (to be) vessels (suitable) for an ascetic.
verses.commentary: Sense: A gourd, a wooden bowl, an earthen (dish), or one made of split cane, Manu, the son of Svayambhu, has declared (to be) vessels (suitable) for an ascetic.

verses.sanskrit: एककालं चरेद्भैक्षं न प्रसज्जेत विस्तरे । भैक्षे प्रसक्तो हि यतिर्विषयेष्वपि सज्जति
verses.transliteration: ekakālaṃ caredbhaikṣaṃ na prasajjeta vistare | bhaikṣe prasakto hi yatirviṣayeṣvapi sajjati
verses.translation: Let him go to beg once (a day), let him not be eager to obtain a large quantity (of alms); for an ascetic who eagerly seeks alms, attaches himself also to sensual enjoyments.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let him go to beg once (a day), let him not be eager to obtain a large quantity (of alms); for an ascetic who eagerly seeks alms, attaches himself also to sensual enjoyments.

verses.sanskrit: विधूमे सन्नमुसले व्यङ्गारे भुक्तवज्जने । वृत्ते शरावसम्पाते भिक्षां नित्यं यतिश्चरेत्
verses.transliteration: vidhūme sannamusale vyaṅgāre bhuktavajjane | vṛtte śarāvasampāte bhikṣāṃ nityaṃ yatiścaret
verses.translation: When no smoke ascends from (the kitchen), when the pestle lies motionless, when the embers have been extinguished, when the people have finished their meal, when the remnants in the dishes have been removed, let the ascetic always go to beg.
verses.commentary: Sense: When no smoke ascends from (the kitchen), when the pestle lies motionless, when the embers have been extinguished, when the people have finished their meal, when the remnants in the dishes have been removed, let the ascetic always go to beg.

verses.sanskrit: अलाभे न विषदी स्यात्लाभे चैव न हर्षयेत् । प्राणयात्रिकमात्रः स्यात्मात्रासङ्गाद्विनिर्गतः
verses.transliteration: alābhe na viṣadī syātlābhe caiva na harṣayet | prāṇayātrikamātraḥ syātmātrāsaṅgādvinirgataḥ
verses.translation: Let him not be sorry when he obtains nothing, nor rejoice when he obtains (something), let him (accept) so much only as will sustain life, let him not care about the (quality of his) utensils.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let him not be sorry when he obtains nothing, nor rejoice when he obtains (something), let him (accept) so much only as will sustain life, let him not care about the (quality of his) utensils.

verses.sanskrit: अभिपूजितलाभांस्तु जुगुप्सेतैव सर्वशः । अभिपूजितलाभैश्च यतिर्मुक्तोऽपि बध्यते
verses.transliteration: abhipūjitalābhāṃstu jugupsetaiva sarvaśaḥ | abhipūjitalābhaiśca yatirmukto'pi badhyate
verses.translation: Let him disdain all (food) obtained in consequence of humble salutations, (for) even an ascetic who has attained final liberation, is bound (with the fetters of the Samsara) by accepting (food given) in consequence of humble salutations.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let him disdain all (food) obtained in consequence of humble salutations, (for) even an ascetic who has attained final liberation, is bound (with the fetters of the Samsara) by accepting (food given) in consequence of humble salutations.

verses.sanskrit: अल्पान्नाभ्यवहारेण रहःस्थानासनेन च । ह्रियमाणानि विषयैरिन्द्रियाणि निवर्तयेत्
verses.transliteration: alpānnābhyavahāreṇa rahaḥsthānāsanena ca | hriyamāṇāni viṣayairindriyāṇi nivartayet
verses.translation: By eating little, and by standing and sitting in solitude, let him restrain his senses, if they are attracted by sensual objects.
verses.commentary: Sense: By eating little, and by standing and sitting in solitude, let him restrain his senses, if they are attracted by sensual objects.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रियाणां निरोधेन रागद्वेषक्षयेण च । अहिंसया च भूतानाममृतत्वाय कल्पते
verses.transliteration: indriyāṇāṃ nirodhena rāgadveṣakṣayeṇa ca | ahiṃsayā ca bhūtānāmamṛtatvāya kalpate
verses.translation: By the restraint of his senses, by the destruction of love and hatred, and by the abstention from injuring the creatures, he becomes fit for immortality.
verses.commentary: Sense: By the restraint of his senses, by the destruction of love and hatred, and by the abstention from injuring the creatures, he becomes fit for immortality.

verses.sanskrit: अवेक्षेत गतीर्नॄणां कर्मदोषसमुद्भवाः । निरये चैव पतनं यातनाश्च यमक्षये
verses.transliteration: avekṣeta gatīrnṝṇāṃ karmadoṣasamudbhavāḥ | niraye caiva patanaṃ yātanāśca yamakṣaye
verses.translation: Let him reflect on the transmigrations of men, caused by their sinful deeds, on their falling into hell, and on the torments in the world of Yama,
verses.commentary: Sense: Let him reflect on the transmigrations of men, caused by their sinful deeds, on their falling into hell, and on the torments in the world of Yama,

verses.transliteration: viprayogaṃ priyaiścaiva saṃyogaṃ ca tathā'priyaiḥ | jarayā cābhibhavanaṃ vyādhibhiścopapīḍanam
verses.translation: On the separation from their dear ones, on their union with hated men, on their being overpowered by age and being tormented with diseases,
verses.commentary: Sense: On the separation from their dear ones, on their union with hated men, on their being overpowered by age and being tormented with diseases,

verses.sanskrit: देहादुत्क्रमणं चास्मात्पुनर्गर्भे च सम्भवम् । योनिकोटिसहस्रेषु सृतीश्चास्यान्तरात्मनः
verses.transliteration: dehādutkramaṇaṃ cāsmātpunargarbhe ca sambhavam | yonikoṭisahasreṣu sṛtīścāsyāntarātmanaḥ
verses.translation: On the departure of the individual soul from this body and its new birth in (another) womb, and on its wanderings through ten thousand millions of existences,
verses.commentary: Sense: On the departure of the individual soul from this body and its new birth in (another) womb, and on its wanderings through ten thousand millions of existences,

verses.sanskrit: अधर्मप्रभवं चैव दुःखयोगं शरीरिणाम् । धर्मार्थप्रभवं चैव सुखसंयोगमक्षयम्
verses.transliteration: adharmaprabhavaṃ caiva duḥkhayogaṃ śarīriṇām | dharmārthaprabhavaṃ caiva sukhasaṃyogamakṣayam
verses.translation: On the infliction of pain on embodied (spirits), which is caused by demerit, and the gain of eternal bliss, which is caused by the attainment of their highest aim, (gained through) spiritual merit.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the infliction of pain on embodied (spirits), which is caused by demerit, and the gain of eternal bliss, which is caused by the attainment of their highest aim, (gained through) spiritual merit.

verses.sanskrit: सूक्ष्मतां चान्ववेक्षेत योगेन परमात्मनः । देहेषु च समुत्पत्तिमुत्तमेष्वधमेषु च
verses.transliteration: sūkṣmatāṃ cānvavekṣeta yogena paramātmanaḥ | deheṣu ca samutpattimuttameṣvadhameṣu ca
verses.translation: By deep meditation let him recognise the subtile nature of the supreme Soul, and its presence in all organisms, both the highest and the lowest.
verses.commentary: Sense: By deep meditation let him recognise the subtile nature of the supreme Soul, and its presence in all organisms, both the highest and the lowest.

verses.sanskrit: देहेषु चैवोपपत्तिम् दूषितोऽपि चरेद्धर्मं यत्र तत्राश्रमे रतः । भूषितोऽपि समः सर्वेषु भूतेषु न लिङ्गं धर्मकारणम्
verses.transliteration: deheṣu caivopapattim dūṣito'pi careddharmaṃ yatra tatrāśrame rataḥ | bhūṣito'pi samaḥ sarveṣu bhūteṣu na liṅgaṃ dharmakāraṇam
verses.translation: To whatever order he may be attached, let him, though blemished (by a want of the external marks), fulfil his duty, equal-minded towards all creatures; (for) the external mark (of the order) is not the cause of (the acquisition of) merit.
verses.commentary: Sense: To whatever order he may be attached, let him, though blemished (by a want of the external marks), fulfil his duty, equal-minded towards all creatures; (for) the external mark (of the order) is not the cause of (the acquisition of) merit.

verses.sanskrit: फलं कतकवृक्षस्य यद्यप्यम्बुप्रसादकम् । न नामग्रहणादेव तस्य वारि प्रसीदति
verses.transliteration: phalaṃ katakavṛkṣasya yadyapyambuprasādakam | na nāmagrahaṇādeva tasya vāri prasīdati
verses.translation: Though the fruit of the Kataka tree (the clearing-nut) makes water clear, yet the (latter) does not become limpid in consequence of the mention of the (fruit's) name.
verses.commentary: Sense: Though the fruit of the Kataka tree (the clearing-nut) makes water clear, yet the (latter) does not become limpid in consequence of the mention of the (fruit's) name.

verses.sanskrit: संरक्षणार्थं जन्तूनां रात्रावहनि वा सदा । शरीरस्यात्यये चैव समीक्ष्य वसुधां चरेत्
verses.transliteration: saṃrakṣaṇārthaṃ jantūnāṃ rātrāvahani vā sadā | śarīrasyātyaye caiva samīkṣya vasudhāṃ caret
verses.translation: In order to preserve living creatures, let him always by day and by night, even with pain to his body, walk, carefully scanning the ground.
verses.commentary: Sense: In order to preserve living creatures, let him always by day and by night, even with pain to his body, walk, carefully scanning the ground.

verses.sanskrit: अह्ना रात्र्या च याञ्जन्तून् हिनस्त्यज्ञानतो यतिः । तेषां स्नात्वा विशुद्ध्यर्थं प्राणायामान् षडाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: ahnā rātryā ca yāñjantūn hinastyajñānato yatiḥ | teṣāṃ snātvā viśuddhyarthaṃ prāṇāyāmān ṣaḍācaret
verses.translation: In order to expiate (the death) of those creatures which he unintentionally injures by day or by night, an ascetic shall bathe and perform six suppressions of the breath.
verses.commentary: Sense: In order to expiate (the death) of those creatures which he unintentionally injures by day or by night, an ascetic shall bathe and perform six suppressions of the breath.

verses.sanskrit: प्राणायामा ब्राह्मणस्य त्रयोऽपि विधिवत्कृताः । व्याहृतिप्रणवैर्युक्ता विज्ञेयं परमं तपः
verses.transliteration: prāṇāyāmā brāhmaṇasya trayo'pi vidhivatkṛtāḥ | vyāhṛtipraṇavairyuktā vijñeyaṃ paramaṃ tapaḥ
verses.translation: Three suppressions of the breath even, performed according to the rule, and accompanied with the (recitation of the) Vyahritis and of the syllable Om, one must know to be the highest (form of) austerity for every Brahmana.
verses.commentary: Sense: Three suppressions of the breath even, performed according to the rule, and accompanied with the (recitation of the) Vyahritis and of the syllable Om, one must know to be the highest (form of) austerity for every Brahmana.

verses.sanskrit: दह्यन्ते ध्मायमानानां धातूनां हि यथा मलाः । तथेन्द्रियाणां दह्यन्ते दोषाः प्राणस्य निग्रहात्
verses.transliteration: dahyante dhmāyamānānāṃ dhātūnāṃ hi yathā malāḥ | tathendriyāṇāṃ dahyante doṣāḥ prāṇasya nigrahāt
verses.translation: For as the impurities of metallic ores, melted in the blast (of a furnace), are consumed, even so the taints of the organs are destroyed through the suppression of the breath.
verses.commentary: Sense: For as the impurities of metallic ores, melted in the blast (of a furnace), are consumed, even so the taints of the organs are destroyed through the suppression of the breath.

verses.sanskrit: प्राणायामैर्दहेद्दोषान् धारणाभिश्च किल्बिषम् । प्रत्याहारेण संसर्गान् ध्यानेनानीश्वरान् गुणान्
verses.transliteration: prāṇāyāmairdaheddoṣān dhāraṇābhiśca kilbiṣam | pratyāhāreṇa saṃsargān dhyānenānīśvarān guṇān
verses.translation: Let him destroy the taints through suppressions of the breath, (the production of) sin by fixed attention, all sensual attachments by restraining (his senses and organs), and all qualities that are not lordly by meditation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let him destroy the taints through suppressions of the breath, (the production of) sin by fixed attention, all sensual attachments by restraining (his senses and organs), and all qualities that are not lordly by meditation.

verses.transliteration: uccāvaceṣu bhūteṣu durjñeyāmakṛtātmabhiḥ | dhyānayogena sampaśyedgatimasyāntarātmanaḥ
verses.translation: Let him recognise by the practice of meditation the progress of the individual soul through beings of various kinds, (a progress) hard to understand for unregenerate men.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let him recognise by the practice of meditation the progress of the individual soul through beings of various kinds, (a progress) hard to understand for unregenerate men.

verses.sanskrit: सम्यग्दर्शनसम्पन्नः कर्मभिर्न निबध्यते । दर्शनेन विहीनस्तु संसारं प्रतिपद्यते
verses.transliteration: samyagdarśanasampannaḥ karmabhirna nibadhyate | darśanena vihīnastu saṃsāraṃ pratipadyate
verses.translation: He who possesses the true insight (into the nature of the world), is not fettered by his deeds; but he who is destitute of that insight, is drawn into the circle of births and deaths.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who possesses the true insight (into the nature of the world), is not fettered by his deeds; but he who is destitute of that insight, is drawn into the circle of births and deaths.

verses.sanskrit: अहिंसयेन्द्रियासङ्गैर्वैदिकैश्चैव कर्मभिः । तपसश्चरणैश्चौग्रैः साधयन्तीह तत्पदम्
verses.transliteration: ahiṃsayendriyāsaṅgairvaidikaiścaiva karmabhiḥ | tapasaścaraṇaiścaugraiḥ sādhayantīha tatpadam
verses.translation: By not injuring any creatures, by detaching the senses (from objects of enjoyment), by the rites prescribed in the Veda, and by rigorously practising austerities, (men) gain that state (even) in this (world).
verses.commentary: Sense: By not injuring any creatures, by detaching the senses (from objects of enjoyment), by the rites prescribed in the Veda, and by rigorously practising austerities, (men) gain that state (even) in this (world).

verses.sanskrit: अस्थिस्थूणं स्नायुयुतं मांसशोणितलेपनम् । चर्मावनद्धं दुर्गन्धि पूर्णं मूत्रपुरीषयोः
verses.transliteration: asthisthūṇaṃ snāyuyutaṃ māṃsaśoṇitalepanam | carmāvanaddhaṃ durgandhi pūrṇaṃ mūtrapurīṣayoḥ
verses.translation: Let him quit this dwelling, composed of the five elements, where the bones are the beams, which is held together by tendons (instead of cords), where the flesh and the blood are the mortar, which is thatched with the skin, which is foul-smelling, filled with urine and ordure, infested by old age and sorrow, the seat of disease, harassed by pain, gloomy with passion, and perishable.

verses.sanskrit: जराशोकसमाविष्टं रोगायतनमातुरम् । रजस्वलमनित्यं च भूतावासमिमं त्यजेत्
verses.transliteration: jarāśokasamāviṣṭaṃ rogāyatanamāturam | rajasvalamanityaṃ ca bhūtāvāsamimaṃ tyajet
verses.translation: Let him quit this dwelling, composed of the five elements, where the bones are the beams, which is held together by tendons (instead of cords), where the flesh and the blood are the mortar, which is thatched with the skin, which is foul-smelling, filled with urine and ordure, infested by old age and sorrow, the seat of disease, harassed by pain, gloomy with passion, and perishable.

verses.sanskrit: नदीकूलं यथा वृक्षो वृक्षं वा शकुनिर्यथा । तथा त्यजन्निमं देहं कृच्छ्राद्ग्राहाद्विमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: nadīkūlaṃ yathā vṛkṣo vṛkṣaṃ vā śakuniryathā | tathā tyajannimaṃ dehaṃ kṛcchrādgrāhādvimucyate
verses.translation: He who leaves this body, (be it by necessity) as a tree (that is torn from) the river-bank, or (freely) like a bird (that) quits a tree, is freed from the misery (of this world, dreadful like) a shark.

verses.sanskrit: प्रियेषु स्वेषु सुकृतमप्रियेषु च दुष्कृतम् । विसृज्य ध्यानयोगेन ब्रह्माभ्येति सनातनम्
verses.transliteration: priyeṣu sveṣu sukṛtamapriyeṣu ca duṣkṛtam | visṛjya dhyānayogena brahmābhyeti sanātanam
verses.translation: Making over (the merit of his own) good actions to his friends and (the guilt of) his evil deeds to his enemies, he attains the eternal Brahman by the practice of meditation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Making over (the merit of his own) good actions to his friends and (the guilt of) his evil deeds to his enemies, he attains the eternal Brahman by the practice of meditation.

verses.sanskrit: यदा भावेन भवति सर्वभावेषु निःस्पृहः । तदा सुखमवाप्नोति प्रेत्य चैह च शाश्वतम्
verses.transliteration: yadā bhāvena bhavati sarvabhāveṣu niḥspṛhaḥ | tadā sukhamavāpnoti pretya caiha ca śāśvatam
verses.translation: When by the disposition (of his heart) he becomes indifferent to all objects, he obtains eternal happiness both in this world and after death.
verses.commentary: Sense: When by the disposition (of his heart) he becomes indifferent to all objects, he obtains eternal happiness both in this world and after death.

verses.sanskrit: अनेन विधिना सर्वांस्त्यक्त्वा सङ्गान् शनैः शनैः । सर्वद्वन्द्वविनिर्मुक्तो ब्रह्मण्येवावतिष्ठते
verses.transliteration: anena vidhinā sarvāṃstyaktvā saṅgān śanaiḥ śanaiḥ | sarvadvandvavinirmukto brahmaṇyevāvatiṣṭhate
verses.translation: He who has in this manner gradually given up all attachments and is freed from all the pairs (of opposites), reposes in Brahman alone.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who has in this manner gradually given up all attachments and is freed from all the pairs (of opposites), reposes in Brahman alone.

verses.sanskrit: ध्यानिकं सर्वमेवैतद्यदेतदभिशब्दितम् । न ह्यनध्यात्मवित्कश्चित्क्रियाफलमुपाश्नुते
verses.transliteration: dhyānikaṃ sarvamevaitadyadetadabhiśabditam | na hyanadhyātmavitkaścitkriyāphalamupāśnute
verses.translation: All that has been declared (above) depends on meditation; for he who is not proficient in the knowledge of that which refers to the Soul reaps not the full reward of the performance of rites.
verses.commentary: Sense: All that has been declared (above) depends on meditation; for he who is not proficient in the knowledge of that which refers to the Soul reaps not the full reward of the performance of rites.

verses.sanskrit: अधियज्ञं ब्रह्म जपेदाधिदैविकमेव च । आध्यात्मिकं च सततं वेदान्ताभिहितं च यत्
verses.transliteration: adhiyajñaṃ brahma japedādhidaivikameva ca | ādhyātmikaṃ ca satataṃ vedāntābhihitaṃ ca yat
verses.translation: Let him constantly recite (those texts of) the Veda which refer to the sacrifice, (those) referring to the deities, and (those) which treat of the Soul and are contained in the concluding portions of the Veda (Vedanta).
verses.commentary: Sense: Let him constantly recite (those texts of) the Veda which refer to the sacrifice, (those) referring to the deities, and (those) which treat of the Soul and are contained in the concluding portions of the Veda (Vedanta).

verses.sanskrit: इदं शरणमज्ञानामिदमेव विजानताम् । इदमन्विच्छतां स्वर्गमिदमानन्त्यमिच्छताम्
verses.transliteration: idaṃ śaraṇamajñānāmidameva vijānatām | idamanvicchatāṃ svargamidamānantyamicchatām
verses.translation: That is the refuge of the ignorant, and even that (the refuse) of those who know (the meaning of the Veda); that is (the protection) of those who seek (bliss in) heaven and of those who seek endless (beatitude).

verses.sanskrit: अनेन क्रमयोगेन परिव्रजति यो द्विजः । स विधूयैह पाप्मानं परं ब्रह्माधिगच्छति
verses.transliteration: anena kramayogena parivrajati yo dvijaḥ | sa vidhūyaiha pāpmānaṃ paraṃ brahmādhigacchati
verses.translation: A twice-born man who becomes an ascetic, after the successive performance of the above-mentioned acts, shakes off sin here below and reaches the highest Brahman.
verses.commentary: Sense: A twice-born man who becomes an ascetic, after the successive performance of the above-mentioned acts, shakes off sin here below and reaches the highest Brahman.

verses.sanskrit: एष धर्मोऽनुशिष्टो वो यतीनां नियतात्मनाम् । वेदसंन्यासिकानां तु कर्मयोगं निबोधत
verses.transliteration: eṣa dharmo'nuśiṣṭo vo yatīnāṃ niyatātmanām | vedasaṃnyāsikānāṃ tu karmayogaṃ nibodhata
verses.translation: Thus the law (valid) for self-restrained ascetics has been explained to you; now listen to the (particular) duties of those who give up (the rites prescribed by) the Veda.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the law (valid) for self-restrained ascetics has been explained to you; now listen to the (particular) duties of those who give up (the rites prescribed by) the Veda.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मचारी गृहस्थश्च वानप्रस्थो यतिस्तथा । एते गृहस्थप्रभवाश्चत्वारः पृथगाश्रमाः
verses.transliteration: brahmacārī gṛhasthaśca vānaprastho yatistathā | ete gṛhasthaprabhavāścatvāraḥ pṛthagāśramāḥ
verses.translation: The student, the householder, the hermit, and the ascetic, these (constitute) four separate orders, which all spring from (the order of) householders.
verses.commentary: Sense: The student, the householder, the hermit, and the ascetic, these (constitute) four separate orders, which all spring from (the order of) householders.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेऽपि क्रमशस्त्वेते यथाशास्त्रं निषेविताः । यथोक्तकारिणं विप्रं नयन्ति परमां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: sarve'pi kramaśastvete yathāśāstraṃ niṣevitāḥ | yathoktakāriṇaṃ vipraṃ nayanti paramāṃ gatim
verses.translation: But all (or) even (any of) these orders, assumed successively in accordance with the Institutes (of the sacred law), lead the Brahmana who acts by the preceding (rules) to the highest state.
verses.commentary: Sense: But all (or) even (any of) these orders, assumed successively in accordance with the Institutes (of the sacred law), lead the Brahmana who acts by the preceding (rules) to the highest state.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषामपि चैतेषां वेदस्मृतिविधानतः । वेदश्रुतिविधानतः गृहस्थ उच्यते श्रेष्ठः स त्रीनेतान् बिभर्ति हि
verses.transliteration: sarveṣāmapi caiteṣāṃ vedasmṛtividhānataḥ | vedaśrutividhānataḥ gṛhastha ucyate śreṣṭhaḥ sa trīnetān bibharti hi
verses.translation: And in accordance with the precepts of the Veda and of the Smriti, the housekeeper is declared to be superior to all of them; for he supports the other three.
verses.commentary: Sense: And in accordance with the precepts of the Veda and of the Smriti, the housekeeper is declared to be superior to all of them; for he supports the other three.

verses.sanskrit: यथा नदीनदाः सर्वे सागरे यान्ति संस्थितिम् । तथैवाश्रमिणः सर्वे गृहस्थे यान्ति संस्थितिम्
verses.transliteration: yathā nadīnadāḥ sarve sāgare yānti saṃsthitim | tathaivāśramiṇaḥ sarve gṛhasthe yānti saṃsthitim
verses.translation: As all rivers, both great and small, find a resting-place in the ocean, even so men of all orders find protection with householders
verses.commentary: Sense: As all rivers, both great and small, find a resting-place in the ocean, even so men of all orders find protection with householders

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्भिरपि चैवैतैर्नित्यमाश्रमिभिर्द्विजैः । दशलक्षणको धर्मः सेवितव्यः प्रयत्नतः
verses.transliteration: caturbhirapi caivaitairnityamāśramibhirdvijaiḥ | daśalakṣaṇako dharmaḥ sevitavyaḥ prayatnataḥ
verses.translation: By twice-born men belonging to (any of) these four orders, the tenfold law must be ever carefully obeyed.
verses.commentary: Sense: By twice-born men belonging to (any of) these four orders, the tenfold law must be ever carefully obeyed.

verses.sanskrit: धृतिः क्षमा दमोऽस्तेयं शौचमिन्द्रियनिग्रहः । धीर्विद्या सत्यमक्रोधो दशकं धर्मलक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: dhṛtiḥ kṣamā damo'steyaṃ śaucamindriyanigrahaḥ | dhīrvidyā satyamakrodho daśakaṃ dharmalakṣaṇam
verses.translation: Contentment, forgiveness, self-control, abstention from unrighteously appropriating anything, (obedience to the rules of) purification, coercion of the organs, wisdom, knowledge (of the supreme Soul), truthfulness, and abstention from anger, (form) the tenfold law.
verses.commentary: Sense: Contentment, forgiveness, self-control, abstention from unrighteously appropriating anything, (obedience to the rules of) purification, coercion of the organs, wisdom, knowledge (of the supreme Soul), truthfulness, and abstention from anger, (form) the tenfold law.

verses.sanskrit: दश लक्षणानि धर्मस्य ये विप्राः समधीयते । अधीत्य चानुवर्तन्ते ते यान्ति परमां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: daśa lakṣaṇāni dharmasya ye viprāḥ samadhīyate | adhītya cānuvartante te yānti paramāṃ gatim
verses.translation: Those Brahmanas who thoroughly study the tenfold law, and after studying obey it, enter the highest state.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those Brahmanas who thoroughly study the tenfold law, and after studying obey it, enter the highest state.
verses.hindi: ऋषि, देव ओर पितरों के ऋण से सुक्त होकर, दशलक्षण भर्म का सचन करता हुआ द्विज वेदान्त को खुनकर संन्यास धारण करे । सव अस्निदोत्रादि कमो को छोड़कर, पापों का प्राणायाम से नाश करके, जितेन्द्रिय होकर वेद का अध्ययन करे आरे बुझा

verses.sanskrit: दशलक्षणकं धर्ममनुतिष्ठन् समाहितः । वेदान्तं विधिवत्श्रुत्वा संन्यसेदनृणो द्विजः
verses.transliteration: daśalakṣaṇakaṃ dharmamanutiṣṭhan samāhitaḥ | vedāntaṃ vidhivatśrutvā saṃnyasedanṛṇo dvijaḥ
verses.translation: A twice-born man who, with collected mind, follows the tenfold law and has paid his (three) debts, may, after learning the Vedanta according to the prescribed rule, become an ascetic.
verses.commentary: Sense: A twice-born man who, with collected mind, follows the tenfold law and has paid his (three) debts, may, after learning the Vedanta according to the prescribed rule, become an ascetic.
verses.hindi: ऋषि, देव ओर पितरों के ऋण से सुक्त होकर, दशलक्षण भर्म का सचन करता हुआ द्विज वेदान्त को खुनकर संन्यास धारण करे । सव अस्निदोत्रादि कमो को छोड़कर, पापों का प्राणायाम से नाश करके, जितेन्द्रिय होकर वेद का अध्ययन करे आरे बुझा
verses.science: ऋषि, देव ओर पितरों के ऋण से सुक्त होकर, दशलक्षण भर्म का सचन करता हुआ द्विज वेदान्त को खुनकर संन्यास धारण करे। धीमी श्वास वेगस तंत्रिका को सक्रिय कर भय-प्रतिक्रिया को शांत करती है। यह पंक्ति उसी श्वास और मन के संबंध को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: संन्यस्य सर्वकर्माणि कर्मदोषानपानुदन् । नियतो वेदमभ्यस्य पुत्रैश्वर्ये सुखं वसेत्
verses.transliteration: saṃnyasya sarvakarmāṇi karmadoṣānapānudan | niyato vedamabhyasya putraiśvarye sukhaṃ vaset
verses.translation: Having given up (the performance of) all rites, throwing off the guilt of his (sinful) acts, subduing his organs and having studied the Veda, he may live at his ease under the protection of his son.
verses.commentary: Sense: Having given up (the performance of) all rites, throwing off the guilt of his (sinful) acts, subduing his organs and having studied the Veda, he may live at his ease under the protection of his son.
verses.hindi: ऋषि, देव ओर पितरों के ऋण से सुक्त होकर, दशलक्षण भर्म का सचन करता हुआ द्विज वेदान्त को खुनकर संन्यास धारण करे । सव अस्निदोत्रादि कमो को छोड़कर, पापों का प्राणायाम से नाश करके, जितेन्द्रिय होकर वेद का अध्ययन करे आरे बुझा
verses.science: ऋषि, देव ओर पितरों के ऋण से सुक्त होकर, दशलक्षण भर्म का सचन करता हुआ द्विज वेदान्त को खुनकर संन्यास धारण करे। धीमी श्वास वेगस तंत्रिका को सक्रिय कर भय-प्रतिक्रिया को शांत करती है। यह पंक्ति उसी श्वास और मन के संबंध को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं संन्यस्य कर्माणि स्वकार्यपरमोऽस्पृहः । संन्यासेनापहत्यैनः प्राप्नोति परमं गतिम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ saṃnyasya karmāṇi svakāryaparamo'spṛhaḥ | saṃnyāsenāpahatyainaḥ prāpnoti paramaṃ gatim
verses.translation: He who has thus given up (the performance of) all rites, who is solely intent on his own (particular) object, (and) free from desires, destroys his guilt by his renunciation and obtains the highest state.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who has thus given up (the performance of) all rites, who is solely intent on his own (particular) object, (and) free from desires, destroys his guilt by his renunciation and obtains the highest state.
verses.hindi: ऋषि, देव ओर पितरों के ऋण से सुक्त होकर, दशलक्षण भर्म का सचन करता हुआ द्विज वेदान्त को खुनकर संन्यास धारण करे । सव अस्निदोत्रादि कमो को छोड़कर, पापों का प्राणायाम से नाश करके, जितेन्द्रिय होकर वेद का अध्ययन करे आरे बुझा
verses.science: ऋषि, देव ओर पितरों के ऋण से सुक्त होकर, दशलक्षण भर्म का सचन करता हुआ द्विज वेदान्त को खुनकर संन्यास धारण करे। धीमी श्वास वेगस तंत्रिका को सक्रिय कर भय-प्रतिक्रिया को शांत करती है। यह पंक्ति उसी श्वास और मन के संबंध को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: एष वोऽभिहितो धर्मो ब्राह्मणस्य चतुर्विधः । पुण्योऽक्षयफलः प्रेत्य राज्ञां धर्मं निबोधत
verses.transliteration: eṣa vo'bhihito dharmo brāhmaṇasya caturvidhaḥ | puṇyo'kṣayaphalaḥ pretya rājñāṃ dharmaṃ nibodhata
verses.translation: Thus the fourfold holy law of Brahmanas, which after death (yields) imperishable rewards, has been declared to you; now learn the duty of kings.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the fourfold holy law of Brahmanas, which after death (yields) imperishable rewards, has been declared to you; now learn the duty of kings.
