verses.hindi: मागे में पशु या दूसरी गाडी से रुकने पर भी सारथी हॉकते चला जाय ओर किसीके चोट लग जाय तो राजा तुरंत नाचे लिखा दरड करेः--मजुप्य का प्राणुघात हुआ हो तो चोर के मुवाफ़िक़ दण्ड गो, हाथी, ऊंट, घोड़ा आदि बड़े पशुओं का घात
verses.commentary: Sense: Where possession is evident, but no title is perceived, there the title (shall be) a proof (of ownership), not possession; such is the settled rule.
verses.science: मागे में पशु या दूसरी गाडी से रुकने पर भी सारथी हॉकते चला जाय ओर किसीके चोट लग जाय तो राजा तुरंत नाचे लिखा दरड करेः--मजुप्य का प्राणुघात हुआ हो तो चोर के मुव…। धीमी श्वास वेगस तंत्रिका को सक्रिय कर भय-प्रतिक्रिया को शांत करती है। यह पंक्ति उसी श्वास और मन के संबंध को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: विक्रयाद्यो धनं किं चिद्गृह्णीयात्कुलसंनिधौ । क्रयेण स विशुद्धं हि न्यायतो लभते धनम्
verses.transliteration: vikrayādyo dhanaṃ kiṃ cidgṛhṇīyātkulasaṃnidhau | krayeṇa sa viśuddhaṃ hi nyāyato labhate dhanam
verses.translation: He who obtains a chattel in the market before a number (of witnesses), acquires that chattel with a clear legal title by purchase.
verses.hindi: राजा चोरों को दरड देने में सदा पूरा यल फरे । क्योंकि चोरों के निग्रह से राजा का यश और राज्य बृद्धि को
verses.commentary: Sense: He who obtains a chattel in the market before a number (of witnesses), acquires that chattel with a clear legal title by purchase.
verses.science: राजा चोरों को दरड देने में सदा पूरा यल फरे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अथ मूलमनाहार्यं प्रकाशक्रयशोधितः । अदण्ड्यो मुच्यते राज्ञा नाष्टिको लभते धनम्
verses.transliteration: atha mūlamanāhāryaṃ prakāśakrayaśodhitaḥ | adaṇḍyo mucyate rājñā nāṣṭiko labhate dhanam
verses.translation: If the original (seller) be not producible, (the buyer) being exculpated by a public sale, must be dismissed by the king without punishment, but (the former owner) who lost the chattel shall receive it (back from the buyer).
verses.hindi: यदधीते यद्यजते यहदाति यदर्थति। .. ....... ''
verses.commentary: Sense: If the original (seller) be not producible, (the buyer) being exculpated by a public sale, must be dismissed by the king without punishment, but (the former owner) who lost the chattel shall receive it (back from the buyer).
verses.science: यदधीते यद्यजते यहदाति यदर्थति। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नान्यदन्येन संसृष्टरूपं विक्रयमर्हति । न चासारं न च न्यूनं न दूरेण तिरोहितम्
verses.transliteration: nānyadanyena saṃsṛṣṭarūpaṃ vikrayamarhati | na cāsāraṃ na ca nyūnaṃ na dūreṇa tirohitam
verses.translation: One commodity mixed with another must not be sold (as pure), nor a bad one (as good), nor less (than the proper quantity or weight), nor anything that is not at hand or that is concealed.
verses.hindi: जो राजा अभय देता है वह सदा-पूज्य है। उस अभयदक्षिणा देनेचाले का राज्य खूब बढ्ता है । 'जो रक्षा करता है उस राजा का सत्र के अमे से छुठा भाय होता है और जो रक्षा नहीं करता उसका सवके अथम में स छुठा भाग होता” है। जी रक्षाशोल हें
verses.commentary: Sense: One commodity mixed with another must not be sold (as pure), nor a bad one (as good), nor less (than the proper quantity or weight), nor anything that is not at hand or that is concealed.
verses.science: जो राजा अभय देता है वह सदा-पूज्य है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: न सावद्यं न च न्यूनं न दूरे न तिरोहितं अन्यां चेद्दर्शयित्वाऽन्या वोढुः कन्या प्रदीयते । उभे त एकशुल्केन वहेदित्यब्रवीन् मनुः
verses.transliteration: na sāvadyaṃ na ca nyūnaṃ na dūre na tirohitaṃ anyāṃ ceddarśayitvā'nyā voḍhuḥ kanyā pradīyate | ubhe ta ekaśulkena vahedityabravīn manuḥ
verses.translation: If, after one damsel has been shown, another be given to the bridegroom, he may marry them both for the same price; that Manu ordained.
verses.hindi: घमेमयोदा से रदित, नास्तिक; प्रज्ञा घन ठगनेवाला और , विना प्रजापालन कर लेनेवोला राजा नरकगामी होता दे! अधर्मी को तीन उपायों से सदा घश में रक्‍घे-नज्ञरवंद, कैद और चत आदि से मारकर ॥ ३०६-३१० ॥
verses.commentary: Sense: If, after one damsel has been shown, another be given to the bridegroom, he may marry them both for the same price; that Manu ordained.
verses.science: घमेमयोदा से रदित, नास्तिक; प्रज्ञा घन ठगनेवाला और , विना प्रजापालन कर लेनेवोला राजा नरकगामी होता दे! अधर्मी को तीन उपायों से सदा घश में रक्‍घे-नज्ञरवंद, कैद…। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: नोन्मत्ताया न कुष्ठिन्या न च या स्पृष्टमैथुना । पूर्वं दोषानभिख्याप्य प्रदाता दण्डमर्हति
verses.transliteration: nonmattāyā na kuṣṭhinyā na ca yā spṛṣṭamaithunā | pūrvaṃ doṣānabhikhyāpya pradātā daṇḍamarhati
verses.translation: He who gives (a damsel in marriage), having first openly declared her blemishes, whether she be insane, or afflicted with leprosy, or have lost her virginity, is not liable to punishment.
verses.hindi: पापियों को दरड देने से ओर साधु पुरुषा का संग्रह करन से कोई वादी--प्रतिवाबी और बालक, बृद्ध और पीडित मडुष्य शपते दुःख से ढुखी होकर कोई कुषचन कद दे तो राजा उनका झमाकरे । जो आक्षेप बचन को सहककर लेता है बह राजा स्वर्ग
verses.commentary: Sense: He who gives (a damsel in marriage), having first openly declared her blemishes, whether she be insane, or afflicted with leprosy, or have lost her virginity, is not liable to punishment.
verses.science: पापियों को दरड देने से ओर साधु पुरुषा का संग्रह करन से कोई वादी--प्रतिवाबी और बालक, बृद्ध और पीडित मडुष्य शपते दुःख से ढुखी होकर कोई कुषचन कद दे तो राजा उनका…। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ऋत्विग्यदि वृतो यज्ञे स्वकर्म परिहापयेत् । तस्य कर्मानुरूपेण देयोंशः सहकर्तृभिः
verses.transliteration: ṛtvigyadi vṛto yajñe svakarma parihāpayet | tasya karmānurūpeṇa deyoṃśaḥ sahakartṛbhiḥ
verses.translation: If an officiating priest, chosen to perform a sacrifice, abandons his work, a share only (of the fee) in proportion to the work (done) shall be given to him by those who work with him.
verses.hindi: गर्सघाती का पाप उसके अन्न खानेवाले को, व्यभिचारिणी स्त्री का पाप उसके पति को, शिष्य का पाप गुरु को और यश करनेवाले का करानेवाले को क्षमा करनें से लगता है। पेसही छोड़ने स राजा को पाप होता इं। पाप करके भा राजदराड पाय
verses.commentary: Sense: If an officiating priest, chosen to perform a sacrifice, abandons his work, a share only (of the fee) in proportion to the work (done) shall be given to him by those who work with him.
verses.science: गर्सघाती का पाप उसके अन्न खानेवाले को, व्यभिचारिणी स्त्री का पाप उसके पति को, शिष्य का पाप गुरु को और यश करनेवाले का करानेवाले को क्षमा करनें से लगता है। आहार, निद्रा और इंद्रिय-भार शरीर की स्थिति को सीधे बदलते हैं। यह पंक्ति उस शारीरिक आधार को छोड़कर नहीं चलती।

verses.sanskrit: दक्षिणासु च दत्तासु स्वकर्म परिहापयन् । कृत्स्नमेव लभेतांशमन्येनैव च कारयेत्
verses.transliteration: dakṣiṇāsu ca dattāsu svakarma parihāpayan | kṛtsnameva labhetāṃśamanyenaiva ca kārayet
verses.translation: But he who abandons his work after the sacrificial fees have been given, shall obtain his full share and cause to be performed (what remains) by another (priest).
verses.hindi: तथा धरिममेयानां शतादभ्यविके वधः ।
verses.commentary: Sense: But he who abandons his work after the sacrificial fees have been given, shall obtain his full share and cause to be performed (what remains) by another (priest).
verses.science: तथा धरिममेयानां शतादभ्यविके वधः। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यस्मिन् कर्मणि यास्तु स्युरुक्ताः प्रत्यङ्गदक्षिणाः । स एव ता आददीत भजेरन् सर्व एव वा
verses.transliteration: yasmin karmaṇi yāstu syuruktāḥ pratyaṅgadakṣiṇāḥ | sa eva tā ādadīta bhajeran sarva eva vā
verses.translation: But if (specific) fees are ordained for the several parts of a rite, shall he (who performs the part) receive them, or shall they all share them?
verses.hindi: पुरुषाणां कुलीनानां नारीणां च विशेषतः ।
verses.commentary: Sense: But if (specific) fees are ordained for the several parts of a rite, shall he (who performs the part) receive them, or shall they all share them?
verses.science: पुरुषाणां कुलीनानां नारीणां च विशेषतः। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: रथं हरेत्चाध्वर्युर्ब्रह्माऽधाने च वाजिनम् । होता वाऽपि हरेदश्वमुद्गाता चाप्यनः क्रये
verses.transliteration: rathaṃ haretcādhvaryurbrahmā'dhāne ca vājinam | hotā vā'pi haredaśvamudgātā cāpyanaḥ kraye
verses.translation: The Adhvaryu priest shall take the chariot, and the Brahman at the kindling of the fires (Agnyadhana) a horse, the Hotri priest shall also take a horse, and the Udgatri the cart, (used) when (the Soma) is purchased.
verses.hindi: , जो पुरुष कूप पर से रस्सी और घडा चुरावे या जो पोशाला को तोड़े उसपर एकमासिक दरड करे और वह उस चीज़ को वहा धाले को खूब पीरे और इससे क्रम हो तो ग्यारहगुना जुर्भावा करें और चोरी का माल उसके मालिक को दिलावे । ऐसेही
verses.commentary: Sense: The Adhvaryu priest shall take the chariot, and the Brahman at the kindling of the fires (Agnyadhana) a horse, the Hotri priest shall also take a horse, and the Udgatri the cart, (used) when (the Soma) is purchased.
verses.science: , जो पुरुष कूप पर से रस्सी और घडा चुरावे या जो पोशाला को तोड़े उसपर एकमासिक दरड करे और वह उस चीज़ को वहा धाले को खूब पीरे और इससे क्रम हो तो ग्यारहगुना जुर्भ…। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषामर्धिनो मुख्यास्तदर्धेनार्धिनोऽपरे । तृतीयिनस्तृतीयांशाश्चतुर्थांशाश्च पादिनः
verses.transliteration: sarveṣāmardhino mukhyāstadardhenārdhino'pare | tṛtīyinastṛtīyāṃśāścaturthāṃśāśca pādinaḥ
verses.translation: The (four) chief priests among all (the sixteen), who are entitled to one half, shall receive a moiety (of the fee), the next (four) one half of that, the set entitled to a third share, one third, and those entitled to a fourth a quarter.
verses.hindi: के अनुसार राजा दण्ड करे। ब्राह्मणाँ की और गौ की चोरी या छुरी से मारने पर तुरन्त आधा पैर कटवा देना चाहिए। सूत, कपास, मदिरा की गाद,-योवर, गुड, वह, दूध, साठा, जल और वृण- घास चुराने पर मूल्य से दूना दरड करे॥ ३२४-३२६
verses.commentary: Sense: The (four) chief priests among all (the sixteen), who are entitled to one half, shall receive a moiety (of the fee), the next (four) one half of that, the set entitled to a third share, one third, and those entitled to a fourth a quarter.
verses.science: के अनुसार राजा दण्ड करे। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: सम्भूय स्वानि कर्माणि कुर्वद्भिरिह मानवैः । अनेन विधियोगेन कर्तव्यांशप्रकल्पना
verses.transliteration: sambhūya svāni karmāṇi kurvadbhiriha mānavaiḥ | anena vidhiyogena kartavyāṃśaprakalpanā
verses.translation: By the application of these principles the allotment of shares must be made among those men who here (below) perform their work conjointly.
verses.hindi: ड्या, तेल; घी, मांस, मधु, पशुओं के सींग आदि और पेसेही दुखरे पदार्थ, मदिरा, भात और सघ भांति के पक्ताच चुराने: पर माल के दाम से दूना दाम दरड करे। फूल, खत का हरा अन्न; दरड करे! सफा अन्न, शाक, 'मूल और फलो का चोर यदि
verses.commentary: Sense: By the application of these principles the allotment of shares must be made among those men who here (below) perform their work conjointly.
verses.science: ड्या, तेल; घी, मांस, मधु, पशुओं के सींग आदि और पेसेही दुखरे पदार्थ, मदिरा, भात और सघ भांति के पक्ताच चुराने: पर माल के दाम से दूना दाम दरड करे। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: धर्मार्थं येन दत्तं स्यात्कस्मै चिद्याचते धनम् । पश्चाच्च न तथा तत्स्यान्न देयं तस्य तद्भवेत्
verses.transliteration: dharmārthaṃ yena dattaṃ syātkasmai cidyācate dhanam | paścācca na tathā tatsyānna deyaṃ tasya tadbhavet
verses.translation: Should money be given (or promised) for a pious purpose by one man to another who asks for it, the gift shall be void, if the (money is) afterwards not (used) in the manner (stated).
verses.hindi: यदि अपने अमं स न चल- ता राजा इनका सी शशक्षा देवेन साधारणःमञुष्य-को जिल झपरर्र के लिए एक प्रण दरड करे; उस झपराध सं राजा अपने लप हजार पण दराड कर, यह मर्यादा है। चोरी 'करने'में शद को आठशुना, बैश्यःकोः सोलह
verses.commentary: Sense: Should money be given (or promised) for a pious purpose by one man to another who asks for it, the gift shall be void, if the (money is) afterwards not (used) in the manner (stated).
verses.science: यदि अपने अमं स न चल- ता राजा इनका सी शशक्षा देवेन साधारणःमञुष्य-को जिल झपरर्र के लिए एक प्रण दरड करे; उस झपराध सं राजा अपने लप हजार पण दराड कर, यह मर्यादा है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यदि संसाधयेत्तत्तु दर्पात्लोभेन वा पुनः । राज्ञा दाप्यः सुवर्णं स्यात्तस्य स्तेयस्य निष्कृतिः
verses.transliteration: yadi saṃsādhayettattu darpātlobhena vā punaḥ | rājñā dāpyaḥ suvarṇaṃ syāttasya steyasya niṣkṛtiḥ
verses.translation: But if the (recipient) through pride or greed tries to enforce (the fulfilment of the promise), he shall be compelled by the king to pay one suvarna as an expiation for his theft.
verses.hindi: आदेदानः परक्ेत्रान्न दणडं वातुंमहैति ॥ ३४१-॥  . चिना वाडा के खेतों से फल, सूल, अग्निहोत्र के लिए काष्ठ, शोगग्रों के लिए घाल कोई लेवे तो वह चोरी नहीं कहाती--मचुजी, कहते हैं । जो ब्राह्मण परधन हरण करनेवाले को यज्ञ कराकर ये :
verses.commentary: Sense: But if the (recipient) through pride or greed tries to enforce (the fulfilment of the promise), he shall be compelled by the king to pay one suvarna as an expiation for his theft.
verses.science: आदेदानः परक्ेत्रान्न दणडं वातुंमहैति ॥ ३४१-॥ . चिना वाडा के खेतों से फल, सूल, अग्निहोत्र के लिए काष्ठ, शोगग्रों के लिए घाल कोई लेवे तो वह चोरी नहीं कहाती--मच…। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: दत्तस्यैषौदिता धर्म्या यथावदनपक्रिया । अत ऊर्ध्वं प्रवक्ष्यामि वेतनस्यानपक्रियाम्
verses.transliteration: dattasyaiṣauditā dharmyā yathāvadanapakriyā | ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi vetanasyānapakriyām
verses.translation: Thus the lawful subtraction of a gift has been fully explained; I will next propound (the law for) the non-payment of wages.
verses.hindi: साइसे वतमानं. तु-यो म्यति पार्थिवः-। .. . नं सित्रकारणाद्वाजा विपुलादा: धनागमात् ।
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the lawful subtraction of a gift has been fully explained; I will next propound (the law for) the non-payment of wages.
verses.science: साइसे वतमानं. तु-यो म्यति पार्थिवः-। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भृतो नार्तो न कुर्याद्यो दर्पात्कर्म यथोदितम् । अनार्तो स दण्ड्यः कृष्णलान्यष्टौ न देयं चास्य वेतनम्
verses.transliteration: bhṛto nārto na kuryādyo darpātkarma yathoditam | anārto sa daṇḍyaḥ kṛṣṇalānyaṣṭau na deyaṃ cāsya vetanam
verses.translation: A hired (servant or workman) who, without being ill, out of pride fails to perform his work according to the agreement, shall be fined eight krishnalas and no wages shall be paid to him.
verses.hindi: ' इस घकार उक्त विधि से चोरों का'निम्रह करने से. राजा इस खुयशं चांहनेवाला राजा छुटेरे मनुष्यों के निभ्नह में क्षंणमाज भी... देरी न क्रे । कुवाच्य कइनेवाले, चोर और मार-पीट करने वालों की अपेक्षा लुटेरों को अधिक अपराधी जानना चाहिए
verses.commentary: Sense: A hired (servant or workman) who, without being ill, out of pride fails to perform his work according to the agreement, shall be fined eight krishnalas and no wages shall be paid to him.
verses.science: ' इस घकार उक्त विधि से चोरों का'निम्रह करने से. राजा इस खुयशं चांहनेवाला राजा छुटेरे मनुष्यों के निभ्नह में क्षंणमाज भी... देरी न क्रे। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: आर्तस्तु कुर्यात्स्वस्थः सन् यथाभाषितमादितः । स दीर्घस्यापि कालस्य तत्लभेतेव वेतनम्
verses.transliteration: ārtastu kuryātsvasthaḥ san yathābhāṣitamāditaḥ | sa dīrghasyāpi kālasya tatlabheteva vetanam
verses.translation: But (if he is really) ill, (and) after recovery performs (his work) according to the original agreement, he shall receive his wages even after (the lapse of) a very long time.
verses.hindi: का नाश होता हो, उस समय द्विजोंकों अख प्रहण करना चाहिए। चिपत्ति में धर्म युद्ध से मारचेवाला पापभागी नहीं, होता । शुरु, बालक, बूढ़ा घेदश ब्राह्मण भी आततायीपन से मारने झव तो , चिना विचार उनके ऊपर प्रहार करे
verses.commentary: Sense: But (if he is really) ill, (and) after recovery performs (his work) according to the original agreement, he shall receive his wages even after (the lapse of) a very long time.
verses.science: का नाश होता हो, उस समय द्विजोंकों अख प्रहण करना चाहिए। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: यथोक्तमार्तः सुस्थो वा यस्तत्कर्म न कारयेत् । न तस्य वेतनं देयमल्पोनस्यापि कर्मणः
verses.transliteration: yathoktamārtaḥ sustho vā yastatkarma na kārayet | na tasya vetanaṃ deyamalponasyāpi karmaṇaḥ
verses.translation: But if he, whether sick or well, does not (perform or) cause to be performed (by others) his work according to his agreement, the wages for that work shall not be given to him, even (if it be only) slightly incomplete.
verses.hindi: येन भूलइरो धर्मः सर्वनाशाय करप्यते
verses.commentary: Sense: But if he, whether sick or well, does not (perform or) cause to be performed (by others) his work according to his agreement, the wages for that work shall not be given to him, even (if it be only) slightly incomplete.
verses.science: येन भूलइरो धर्मः सर्वनाशाय करप्यते। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: एष धर्मोऽखिलेनोक्तो वेतनादानकर्मणः । अत ऊर्ध्वं प्रवक्ष्यामि धर्मं समयभेदिनाम्
verses.transliteration: eṣa dharmo'khilenokto vetanādānakarmaṇaḥ | ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi dharmaṃ samayabhedinām
verses.translation: Thus the law for the non-payment of wages has been completely stated; I will next explain the law concerning men who break an agreement.
verses.hindi: परस्य पतन्या पुरुष संभा योजयन् रहः।
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the law for the non-payment of wages has been completely stated; I will next explain the law concerning men who break an agreement.
verses.science: परस्य पतन्या पुरुष संभा योजयन् रहः। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यो ग्रामदेशसङ्घानां कृत्वा सत्येन संविदम् । विसंवदेन्नरो लोभात्तं राष्ट्राद्विप्रवासयेत्
verses.transliteration: yo grāmadeśasaṅghānāṃ kṛtvā satyena saṃvidam | visaṃvadennaro lobhāttaṃ rāṣṭrādvipravāsayet
verses.translation: If a man belonging to a corporation inhabiting a village or a district, after swearing to an agreement, breaks it through avarice, (the king) shall banish him from his realm,
verses.hindi: -उपचारक्किया केलिः स्पशों भूषणवाससाम्।
verses.commentary: Sense: If a man belonging to a corporation inhabiting a village or a district, after swearing to an agreement, breaks it through avarice, (the king) shall banish him from his realm,
verses.science: -उपचारक्किया केलिः स्पशों भूषणवाससाम्। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: निगृह्य दापयेच्चैनं समयव्यभिचारिणम् । चतुःसुवर्णान् षण्निष्कांश्शतमानं च राजकम्
verses.transliteration: nigṛhya dāpayeccainaṃ samayavyabhicāriṇam | catuḥsuvarṇān ṣaṇniṣkāṃśśatamānaṃ ca rājakam
verses.translation: And having imprisoned such a breaker of an agreement, he shall compel him to pay six nishkas, (each of) four suvarnas, and one satamana of silver.
verses.hindi: शूद्र घाणी के साथ व्यभिचार करे तो मार डालने लायक़ चाहिए! भिक्षुक, भाट, यश में दीक्षित, रसोइया और कारीयर खिया फे साथ वाते विना रोक फर सकते हैं । जिसको निषेध है चह परखी के साथ याते न करे। करनेवाला एक खुवर्ण दरड के
verses.commentary: Sense: And having imprisoned such a breaker of an agreement, he shall compel him to pay six nishkas, (each of) four suvarnas, and one satamana of silver.
verses.science: शूद्र घाणी के साथ व्यभिचार करे तो मार डालने लायक़ चाहिए! भिक्षुक, भाट, यश में दीक्षित, रसोइया और कारीयर खिया फे साथ वाते विना रोक फर सकते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एतद्दण्डविधिं कुर्याद्धार्मिकः पृथिवीपतिः । ग्रामजातिसमूहेषु समयव्यभिचारिणाम्
verses.transliteration: etaddaṇḍavidhiṃ kuryāddhārmikaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ | grāmajātisamūheṣu samayavyabhicāriṇām
verses.translation: A righteous king shall apply this law of fines in villages and castes (gati) to those who break an agreement.
verses.hindi: उत्तमां सेवमानस्तु जघन्यों वधमहीते । - शुल्क ददयात्सेवमानः समामिच्छेत पिता यदि ॥३३ दे ' बध के योग्य हैं । पर चाइनेचाली फे साथ गमन करे और वहं चुदंप सजातीय हो तो वंध योग्य नहीं होतां । उत्तम जाति के पुरुष
verses.commentary: Sense: A righteous king shall apply this law of fines in villages and castes (gati) to those who break an agreement.
verses.science: उत्तमां सेवमानस्तु जघन्यों वधमहीते। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: क्रीत्वा विक्रीय वा किं चिद्यस्यैहानुशयो भवेत् । सोऽन्तर्दशाहात्तद्द्रव्यं दद्याच्चैवाददीत वा
verses.transliteration: krītvā vikrīya vā kiṃ cidyasyaihānuśayo bhavet | so'ntardaśāhāttaddravyaṃ dadyāccaivādadīta vā
verses.translation: If anybody in this (world), after buying or selling anything, repent (of his bargain), he may return or take (back) that chattel within ten days.
verses.hindi: पुमांसं दाइयित्पापं शयने तत्त आयसे १ : जो मजण्य अभिमान और बलात्कार से कन्या को अजञलिरवो से चियाड़े उसको दोनों अज्ललियां करचा' दे कोर छु; सी पक्ष -दूयड . क! समान जाति और सकामा कन्या को ऐूषित करनेवाले की
verses.commentary: Sense: If anybody in this (world), after buying or selling anything, repent (of his bargain), he may return or take (back) that chattel within ten days.
verses.science: पुमांसं दाइयित्पापं शयने तत्त आयसे १ : जो मजण्य अभिमान और बलात्कार से कन्या को अजञलिरवो से चियाड़े उसको दोनों अज्ललियां करचा' दे कोर छु; सी पक्ष -दूयड . क! स…। आहार, निद्रा और इंद्रिय-भार शरीर की स्थिति को सीधे बदलते हैं। यह पंक्ति उस शारीरिक आधार को छोड़कर नहीं चलती।

verses.sanskrit: परेण तु दशाहस्य न दद्यान्नापि दापयेत् । आददानो ददत्चैव राज्ञा दण्ड्यौ शतानि षट्
verses.transliteration: pareṇa tu daśāhasya na dadyānnāpi dāpayet | ādadāno dadatcaiva rājñā daṇḍyau śatāni ṣaṭ
verses.translation: But after (the lapse of) ten days he may neither give nor cause it to be given (back); both he who takes it (back) and he who gives it (back, except by consent) shall be fined by the king six hundred (panas).
verses.hindi: शद्रो गृ्तमगु्तं वा हैजातं वशमावसन् ।
verses.commentary: Sense: But after (the lapse of) ten days he may neither give nor cause it to be given (back); both he who takes it (back) and he who gives it (back, except by consent) shall be fined by the king six hundred (panas).
verses.science: शद्रो गृ्तमगु्तं वा हैजातं वशमावसन्। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यस्तु दोषवतीं कन्यामनाख्याय प्रयच्छति । तस्य कुर्यान्नृपो दण्डं स्वयं षण्णवतिं पणान्
verses.transliteration: yastu doṣavatīṃ kanyāmanākhyāya prayacchati | tasya kuryānnṛpo daṇḍaṃ svayaṃ ṣaṇṇavatiṃ paṇān
verses.translation: But the king himself shall impose a fine of ninety-six panas on him who gives a blemished damsel (to a suitor) without informing (him of the blemish).
verses.hindi: इना दोना यादिप । हीन जाति या चाण्डाली के साथ व्यभिचार चार करे तो उसका अग काव्डालं, सर्वेस्घहरणु करे ॥३७२-२७४॥
verses.commentary: Sense: But the king himself shall impose a fine of ninety-six panas on him who gives a blemished damsel (to a suitor) without informing (him of the blemish).
verses.science: इना दोना यादिप। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अकन्येति तु यः कन्यां ब्रूयाद्द्वेषेण मानवः । स शतं प्राप्नुयाद्दण्डं तस्या दोषमदर्शयन्
verses.transliteration: akanyeti tu yaḥ kanyāṃ brūyāddveṣeṇa mānavaḥ | sa śataṃ prāpnuyāddaṇḍaṃ tasyā doṣamadarśayan
verses.translation: But that man who, out of malice, says of a maiden, 'She is not a maiden,' shall be fined one hundred (panas), if he cannot prove her blemish.
verses.hindi: उसका शिरं गधे के सूत से मुड़वा देय । चेशय और कषत्रिय; यदि. पर हज़ार पण दरड करे । चेही दोनों यदि रक्षित ब्राह्मणी ले गमन” करें, शर की भांति दण्ड पावे अथवा चटाई में लपेंट कर जलषा' पर हज़ार पण दण्ड करे और इच्छाबालां से गमन करे तो पाँच .
verses.commentary: Sense: But that man who, out of malice, says of a maiden, 'She is not a maiden,' shall be fined one hundred (panas), if he cannot prove her blemish.
verses.science: उसका शिरं गधे के सूत से मुड़वा देय। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: पाणिग्रहणिका मन्त्राः कन्यास्वेव प्रतिष्ठिताः । नाकन्यासु क्व चिन्नॄणां लुप्तधर्मक्रिया हि ताः
verses.transliteration: pāṇigrahaṇikā mantrāḥ kanyāsveva pratiṣṭhitāḥ | nākanyāsu kva cinnṝṇāṃ luptadharmakriyā hi tāḥ
verses.translation: The nuptial texts are applied solely to virgins, (and) nowhere among men to females who have lost their virginity, for such (females) are excluded from religious ceremonies.
verses.hindi: '. न आहाणवधाइसूयानधर्मो-विद्यते भुवि । ˆ  ˆ -.:.. ब्राह्मण का, शिर सुड़ा देनाही माणान्त देरड देना है दससे को अआशणान्त दरड का विधान हैं कंसाः सां अपराध ब्राह्मण" ने किया " “हित देश से निकाल देवे । ब्राह्मण बघ से अधिक कोई अधर्म नहीं
verses.commentary: Sense: The nuptial texts are applied solely to virgins, (and) nowhere among men to females who have lost their virginity, for such (females) are excluded from religious ceremonies.
verses.science: '. न आहाणवधाइसूयानधर्मो-विद्यते भुवि। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: पाणिग्रहणिका मन्त्रा नियतं दारलक्षणम् । तेषां निष्ठा तु विज्ञेया विद्वद्भिः सप्तमे पदे
verses.transliteration: pāṇigrahaṇikā mantrā niyataṃ dāralakṣaṇam | teṣāṃ niṣṭhā tu vijñeyā vidvadbhiḥ saptame pade
verses.translation: The nuptial texts are a certain proof (that a maiden has been made a lawful) wife; but the learned should know that they (and the marriage ceremony are complete with the seventh step (of the bride around the sacred fire).
verses.hindi: घश्या और शूद्रा से व्यभिचार करे तो पाँच सौ पण दरड करे। और चःएडालो-भागनसे गमंत करने पर हज़ार पण दण्ड करे॥ ३८३-३८४
verses.commentary: Sense: The nuptial texts are a certain proof (that a maiden has been made a lawful) wife; but the learned should know that they (and the marriage ceremony are complete with the seventh step (of the bride around the sacred fire).
verses.science: घश्या और शूद्रा से व्यभिचार करे तो पाँच सौ पण दरड करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यस्मिन् यस्मिन् कृते कार्ये यस्येहानुशयो भवेत् । तमनेन विधानेन धर्म्ये पथि निवेशयेत्
verses.transliteration: yasmin yasmin kṛte kārye yasyehānuśayo bhavet | tamanena vidhānena dharmye pathi niveśayet
verses.translation: If anybody in this (world) repent of any completed transaction, (the king) shall keep him on the road of rectitude in accordance with the rules given above.
verses.hindi: घतेपां निमहो राज्ञः पञ्चानां विषये स्वके ।
verses.commentary: Sense: If anybody in this (world) repent of any completed transaction, (the king) shall keep him on the road of rectitude in accordance with the rules given above.
verses.science: घतेपां निमहो राज्ञः पञ्चानां विषये स्वके। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पशुषु स्वामिनां चैव पालानां च व्यतिक्रमे । विवादं सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि यथावद्धर्मतत्त्वतः
verses.transliteration: paśuṣu svāmināṃ caiva pālānāṃ ca vyatikrame | vivādaṃ sampravakṣyāmi yathāvaddharmatattvataḥ
verses.translation: I will fully declare in accordance with the true law (the rules concerning) the disputes, (arising) from the transgressions of owners of cattle and of herdsmen.
verses.hindi: “जिस राजा के नगर में न चोर है, न व्यभिचारी हैं, न कुवाच्य कहनेवाले हैं, न लुटेरे हैं, और न मारपीट करनेवाले हैँ घह . करने से राजा का राज्य और यश फैलता है । जो यजमान अपने यजमान को छोड़ दे उन दोनों पर राजा सौ सो पण दरड करे
verses.commentary: Sense: I will fully declare in accordance with the true law (the rules concerning) the disputes, (arising) from the transgressions of owners of cattle and of herdsmen.
verses.science: “जिस राजा के नगर में न चोर है, न व्यभिचारी हैं, न कुवाच्य कहनेवाले हैं, न लुटेरे हैं, और न मारपीट करनेवाले हैँ घह . करने से राजा का राज्य और यश फैलता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दिवा वक्तव्यता पाले रात्रौ स्वामिनि तद्गृहे । योगक्षेमेऽन्यथा चेत्तु पालो वक्तव्यतामियात्
verses.transliteration: divā vaktavyatā pāle rātrau svāmini tadgṛhe | yogakṣeme'nyathā cettu pālo vaktavyatāmiyāt
verses.translation: During the day the responsibility for the safety (of the cattle rests) on the herdsman, during the night on the owner, (provided they are) in his house; (if it be) otherwise, the herdsman will be responsible (for them also during the night).
verses.hindi: धोधी सेमर के चिकने पाट पर धीरे धीरे कपड़े 'घोवे, कपड़ों को चदले, नहँ और न वहुत दिनो तक पड़ा रक्खे। जुलाहा द्श' पल दूत लेकर मांडी के संवच से ग्यारह पल कपड़ा देवे । यदि 'लिळाफ़ करे तो उल पर राजा वारह पण् दण्ड दिलावे । जो पुरुप
verses.commentary: Sense: During the day the responsibility for the safety (of the cattle rests) on the herdsman, during the night on the owner, (provided they are) in his house; (if it be) otherwise, the herdsman will be responsible (for them also during the night).
verses.science: धोधी सेमर के चिकने पाट पर धीरे धीरे कपड़े 'घोवे, कपड़ों को चदले, नहँ और न वहुत दिनो तक पड़ा रक्खे। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: गोपः क्षीरभृतो यस्तु स दुह्याद्दशतो वराम् । गोस्वाम्यनुमते भृत्यः सा स्यात्पालेऽभृते भृतिः
verses.transliteration: gopaḥ kṣīrabhṛto yastu sa duhyāddaśato varām | gosvāmyanumate bhṛtyaḥ sā syātpāle'bhṛte bhṛtiḥ
verses.translation: A hired herdsman who is paid with milk, may milk with the consent of the owner the best (cow) out of ten; such shall be his hire if no (other) wages (are paid).
verses.hindi: राजा अपने देश के जिन प्रसिद्ध चस्तुओं को परदेश मे व्यापारार्थ ज्ञाने से रोके उनको लोभबश कोई लेजाय तो राजा उसका सर्वस्व छीन लेय! चुगीधर से डिपानेवाला, असमय में ख़रीद-बेच करनेवाला, गिनती-तोल में मूठ घोलनेवाला वस्तु
verses.commentary: Sense: A hired herdsman who is paid with milk, may milk with the consent of the owner the best (cow) out of ten; such shall be his hire if no (other) wages (are paid).
verses.science: राजा अपने देश के जिन प्रसिद्ध चस्तुओं को परदेश मे व्यापारार्थ ज्ञाने से रोके उनको लोभबश कोई लेजाय तो राजा उसका सर्वस्व छीन लेय! चुगीधर से डिपानेवाला, असमय मे…। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नष्टं विनष्टं कृमिभिः श्वहतं विषमे मृतम् । हीनं पुरुषकारेण प्रदद्यात्पाल एव तु
verses.transliteration: naṣṭaṃ vinaṣṭaṃ kṛmibhiḥ śvahataṃ viṣame mṛtam | hīnaṃ puruṣakāreṇa pradadyātpāla eva tu
verses.translation: The herdsman alone shall make good (the loss of a beast) strayed, destroyed by worms, killed by dogs or (by falling) into a pit, if he did not duly exert himself (to prevent it).
verses.hindi: दीघाध्वानि यथादेशं यथाकालं तरो भवेत् ।
verses.commentary: Sense: The herdsman alone shall make good (the loss of a beast) strayed, destroyed by worms, killed by dogs or (by falling) into a pit, if he did not duly exert himself (to prevent it).
verses.science: दीघाध्वानि यथादेशं यथाकालं तरो भवेत्। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विघुष्य तु हृतं चौरैर्न पालो दातुमर्हति । यदि देशे च काले च स्वामिनः स्वस्य शंसति
verses.transliteration: vighuṣya tu hṛtaṃ caurairna pālo dātumarhati | yadi deśe ca kāle ca svāminaḥ svasya śaṃsati
verses.translation: But for (an animal) stolen by thieves, though he raised an alarm, the herdsman shall not pay, provided he gives notice to his master at the proper place and time.
verses.hindi: पुल, नदी का महसूल । नदी पार करने में खाली गाड़ी का एक पण, भार सहित मचुष्यो का आजा पण, पछ और खी का चौथाई पण और खाली सचुष्य से पणा आउचाँ साय महसूल लेग्र । मालमरी गाड़ी पार
verses.commentary: Sense: But for (an animal) stolen by thieves, though he raised an alarm, the herdsman shall not pay, provided he gives notice to his master at the proper place and time.
verses.science: पुल, नदी का महसूल। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कर्णौ चर्म च वालांश्च बस्तिं स्नायुं च रोचनाम् । पशुषु स्वामिनां दद्यान् मृतेष्वङ्कानि दर्शयेत्
verses.transliteration: karṇau carma ca vālāṃśca bastiṃ snāyuṃ ca rocanām | paśuṣu svāmināṃ dadyān mṛteṣvaṅkāni darśayet
verses.translation: If cattle die, let him carry to his master their ears, skin, tails, bladders, tendons, and the yellow concrete bile, and let him point out their particular. marks.
verses.hindi: दाशापराधतस्तोये हैविके नास्ति नियहः
verses.commentary: Sense: If cattle die, let him carry to his master their ears, skin, tails, bladders, tendons, and the yellow concrete bile, and let him point out their particular. marks.
verses.science: दाशापराधतस्तोये हैविके नास्ति नियहः। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अङ्कांश्च दर्शयेत्) अजाविके तु संरुद्धे वृकैः पाले त्वनायति । यां प्रसह्य वृको हन्यात्पाले तत्किल्बिषं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: aṅkāṃśca darśayet) ajāvike tu saṃruddhe vṛkaiḥ pāle tvanāyati | yāṃ prasahya vṛko hanyātpāle tatkilbiṣaṃ bhavet
verses.translation: But if goats or sheep are surrounded by wolves and the herdsman does not hasten (to their assistance), lie shall be responsible for any (animal) which a wolf may attack and kill.
verses.hindi: दो महीना से अधिक की गसिणी, वानप्रस्थ, संन्यासी और फे दोप से जो कुछ दानि हो, बद मल्लाह लोग इकट्ठा होकर अपने भाग में से देवें ! यह नौका से नदी पार होने का निय और जल में मल्लाहों के व्यवहार का निर्णय कहा है. । यादे कोई हैवी चि-
verses.commentary: Sense: But if goats or sheep are surrounded by wolves and the herdsman does not hasten (to their assistance), lie shall be responsible for any (animal) which a wolf may attack and kill.
verses.science: दो महीना से अधिक की गसिणी, वानप्रस्थ, संन्यासी और फे दोप से जो कुछ दानि हो, बद मल्लाह लोग इकट्ठा होकर अपने भाग में से देवें ! यह नौका से नदी पार होने का निय…। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: तासां चेदवरुद्धानां चरन्तीनां मिथो वने । यामुत्प्लुत्य वृको हन्यान्न पालस्तत्र किल्बिषी
verses.transliteration: tāsāṃ cedavaruddhānāṃ carantīnāṃ mitho vane | yāmutplutya vṛko hanyānna pālastatra kilbiṣī
verses.translation: But if they, kept in (proper) order, graze together in the forest, and a wolf, suddenly jumping on one of them, kills it, the herdsman shall bear in that case no responsibility.
verses.hindi: कराचे। आर शूद्रा स धजाका खचा कराने आयका स रहित करावे तो उसपर राजा छ सौ पण दरड करे  खरीदे वः. विना के लिएही पेदो किया है। स्वामी से छुड़ाया हुआ भी यद्र दास कर्म को नहीं छोड़ सकता क्याकि वह उसका स्वाभाविक थमे
verses.commentary: Sense: But if they, kept in (proper) order, graze together in the forest, and a wolf, suddenly jumping on one of them, kills it, the herdsman shall bear in that case no responsibility.
verses.science: कराचे। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: धनुःशतं परीहारो ग्रामस्य स्यात्समन्ततः । शम्यापातास्त्रयो वाऽपि त्रिगुणो नगरस्य तु
verses.transliteration: dhanuḥśataṃ parīhāro grāmasya syātsamantataḥ | śamyāpātāstrayo vā'pi triguṇo nagarasya tu
verses.translation: On all sides of a village a space, one hundred dhanus or three samya-throws (in breadth), shall be reserved (for pasture), and thrice (that space) round a town.
verses.hindi: युद सें जीतकर लाया हुआ, सक्त दास, दासीपुत खरीदा हुआ, किसी का दिया हत्या, परपरा से मात और द्रड-शुद्धि के लिए जिसने दासपना किया हो, ये खात प्रकार के दाख होते हैं । भायो, पुत्र और दाल इन तीनों को मेठुते विव कहा है, ये जो
verses.commentary: Sense: On all sides of a village a space, one hundred dhanus or three samya-throws (in breadth), shall be reserved (for pasture), and thrice (that space) round a town.
verses.science: युद सें जीतकर लाया हुआ, सक्त दास, दासीपुत खरीदा हुआ, किसी का दिया हत्या, परपरा से मात और द्रड-शुद्धि के लिए जिसने दासपना किया हो, ये खात प्रकार के दाख होते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्रापरिवृतं धान्यं विहिंस्युः पशवो यदि । न तत्र प्रणयेद्दण्डं नृपतिः पशुरक्षिणाम्
verses.transliteration: tatrāparivṛtaṃ dhānyaṃ vihiṃsyuḥ paśavo yadi | na tatra praṇayeddaṇḍaṃ nṛpatiḥ paśurakṣiṇām
verses.translation: If the cattle do damage to unfenced crops on that (common), the king shall in that case not punish the herdsmen.
verses.hindi: वे अपने कर्म से इरकर ससार को उपद्र्यों से दुखी करेगे। राजा प्रतिदिन आरम्भ किये कार्यों का, सवारियों का, नियत आय-यय, खान और धन-भएडार का अवलोकन करे । इसप्रकार राजा इन सव व्यवहारा का निर्णय करताइआ सब पापों का
verses.commentary: Sense: If the cattle do damage to unfenced crops on that (common), the king shall in that case not punish the herdsmen.
verses.science: वे अपने कर्म से इरकर ससार को उपद्र्यों से दुखी करेगे। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: वृतिं तत्र प्रकुर्वीत यामुष्त्रो न विलोकयेत् । छिद्रं च वारयेत्सर्वं श्वसूकरमुखानुगम्
verses.transliteration: vṛtiṃ tatra prakurvīta yāmuṣtro na vilokayet | chidraṃ ca vārayetsarvaṃ śvasūkaramukhānugam
verses.translation: (The owner of the field) shall make there a hedge over which a camel cannot look, and stop every gap through which a dog or a boar can thrust his head.
verses.hindi: पिता रक्षति कोमारे भता रक्षति योवने। .
verses.commentary: Sense: (The owner of the field) shall make there a hedge over which a camel cannot look, and stop every gap through which a dog or a boar can thrust his head.
verses.science: पिता रक्षति कोमारे भता रक्षति योवने। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पथि क्षेत्रे परिवृते ग्रामान्तीयेऽथ वा पुनः । सपालः शतदण्डार्हो विपालान् वारयेत्पशून्
verses.transliteration: pathi kṣetre parivṛte grāmāntīye'tha vā punaḥ | sapālaḥ śatadaṇḍārho vipālān vārayetpaśūn
verses.translation: (If cattle do mischief) in an enclosed field near a highway or near a village, the herdsman shall be fined one hundred (panas);
verses.hindi: अपने हनातन धमे में स्थित पुरुष और स्त्रियो के संयोग और ' ' वियोग समय के धर्म कहे जाते हैः--   पुरुष को अपनी खियों को कभी स्वतन्त्र न होने देना चाहिए । नाच गान म आसक्क खियों को अपने वशमें रखना चाहिए । वॉर
verses.commentary: Sense: (If cattle do mischief) in an enclosed field near a highway or near a village, the herdsman shall be fined one hundred (panas);
verses.science: अपने हनातन धमे में स्थित पुरुष और स्त्रियो के संयोग और ' ' वियोग समय के धर्म कहे जाते हैः-- पुरुष को अपनी खियों को कभी स्वतन्त्र न होने देना चाहिए। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: क्षेत्रेष्वन्येषु तु पशुः सपादं पणमर्हति । सर्वत्र तु सदो देयः क्षेत्रिकस्यैति धारणा
verses.transliteration: kṣetreṣvanyeṣu tu paśuḥ sapādaṃ paṇamarhati | sarvatra tu sado deyaḥ kṣetrikasyaiti dhāraṇā
verses.translation: (For damage) in other fields (each head of) cattle shall (pay a fine of one (pana) and a quarter, and in all (cases the value of) the crop (destroyed) shall be made good to the owner of the field; that is the settled rule.
verses.hindi: खियों की रक्षा करने से पुरुष अपनी संतान को घर्णसङ्कर 'दोने से घचाता है, अपने चरित्र को निर्दोष रखता है, अपने कुल की मर्यादा बढ़ाता है, अपनी और अपने धर्म कौ रक्षा करता , लेता है। अपनी खो में फिर जन्मता है इसीसे खरी जाया कद"
verses.commentary: Sense: (For damage) in other fields (each head of) cattle shall (pay a fine of one (pana) and a quarter, and in all (cases the value of) the crop (destroyed) shall be made good to the owner of the field; that is the settled rule.
verses.science: खियों की रक्षा करने से पुरुष अपनी संतान को घर्णसङ्कर 'दोने से घचाता है, अपने चरित्र को निर्दोष रखता है, अपने कुल की मर्यादा बढ़ाता है, अपनी और अपने धर्म कौ र…। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: अनिर्दशाहां गां सूतां वृषान् देवपशूंस्तथा । सपालान् वा विपालान् वा न दण्ड्यान् मनुरब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: anirdaśāhāṃ gāṃ sūtāṃ vṛṣān devapaśūṃstathā | sapālān vā vipālān vā na daṇḍyān manurabravīt
verses.translation: But Manu has declared that no fine shall be paid for (damage done by) a cow within ten days after her calving, by bulls and by cattle sacred to the gods, whether they are attended by a herdsman or not.
verses.hindi: अरक्षिता रहे रुद्धाः पुरुषेरातकारिभिः,। व
verses.commentary: Sense: But Manu has declared that no fine shall be paid for (damage done by) a cow within ten days after her calving, by bulls and by cattle sacred to the gods, whether they are attended by a herdsman or not.
verses.science: अरक्षिता रहे रुद्धाः पुरुषेरातकारिभिः,। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: क्षेत्रियस्यात्यये दण्डो भागाद्दशगुणो भवेत् । क्षेत्रिकस्यात्यये ततोऽर्धदण्डो भृत्यानामज्ञानात्क्षेत्रिकस्य तु
verses.transliteration: kṣetriyasyātyaye daṇḍo bhāgāddaśaguṇo bhavet | kṣetrikasyātyaye tato'rdhadaṇḍo bhṛtyānāmajñānātkṣetrikasya tu
verses.translation: If (the crops are destroyed by) the husbandman's (own) fault, the fine shall amount to ten times as much as (the king's) share; but the fine (shall be) only half that amount if (the fault lay) with the servants and the farmer had no knowledge of it.
verses.hindi: घन-सँग्रह, “खर्च, सक्काई, पतिसेवा;  अमै, रसोई आर घरके साल स खरा का लगाव । खश्वास पात्र मङुष्या स चरस रखवास त कराने से रक्षित नहीं होती किन्तु जो अपनी रक्षा पदी कर. चेही खरक्षित होसकती है. मच्चपान, डुजनसर) पति से वियोग, ..
verses.commentary: Sense: If (the crops are destroyed by) the husbandman's (own) fault, the fine shall amount to ten times as much as (the king's) share; but the fine (shall be) only half that amount if (the fault lay) with the servants and the farmer had no knowledge of it.
verses.science: घन-सँग्रह, “खर्च, सक्काई, पतिसेवा; अमै, रसोई आर घरके साल स खरा का लगाव। धीमी श्वास वेगस तंत्रिका को सक्रिय कर भय-प्रतिक्रिया को शांत करती है। यह पंक्ति उसी श्वास और मन के संबंध को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: एतद्विधानमातिष्ठेद्धार्मिकः पृथिवीपतिः । स्वामिनां च पशूनां च पालानां च व्यतिक्रमे
verses.transliteration: etadvidhānamātiṣṭheddhārmikaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ | svāmināṃ ca paśūnāṃ ca pālānāṃ ca vyatikrame
verses.translation: To these rules a righteous king shall keep in (all cases of) transgressions by masters, their cattle, and herdsmen.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0
verses.commentary: Sense: To these rules a righteous king shall keep in (all cases of) transgressions by masters, their cattle, and herdsmen.
verses.science: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सीमां प्रति समुत्पन्ने विवादे ग्रामयोर्द्वयोः । ज्येष्ठे मासि नयेत्सीमां सुप्रकाशेषु सेतुषु
verses.transliteration: sīmāṃ prati samutpanne vivāde grāmayordvayoḥ | jyeṣṭhe māsi nayetsīmāṃ suprakāśeṣu setuṣu
verses.translation: If a dispute has arisen between two villages concerning a boundary, the king shall settle the limits in the month of Gyaishtha, when the landmarks are most distinctly visible.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a dispute has arisen between two villages concerning a boundary, the king shall settle the limits in the month of Gyaishtha, when the landmarks are most distinctly visible.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: सीमावृक्षांश्च कुर्वीत न्यग्रोधाश्वत्थकिंशुकान् । शाल्मलीन् सालतालांश्च क्षीरिणश्चैव पादपान्
verses.transliteration: sīmāvṛkṣāṃśca kurvīta nyagrodhāśvatthakiṃśukān | śālmalīn sālatālāṃśca kṣīriṇaścaiva pādapān
verses.translation: Let him mark the boundaries (by) trees, (e.g.) Nyagrodhas, Asvatthas, Kimsukas, cotton-trees, Salas, Palmyra palms, and trees with milky juice,
verses.commentary: Sense: Let him mark the boundaries (by) trees, (e.g.) Nyagrodhas, Asvatthas, Kimsukas, cotton-trees, Salas, Palmyra palms, and trees with milky juice,

verses.sanskrit: गुल्मान् वेणूंश्च विविधान् शमीवल्लीस्थलानि च । शरान् कुब्जकगुल्मांश्च तथा सीमा न नश्यति
verses.transliteration: gulmān veṇūṃśca vividhān śamīvallīsthalāni ca | śarān kubjakagulmāṃśca tathā sīmā na naśyati
verses.translation: By clustering shrubs, bamboos of different kinds, Samis, creepers and raised mounds, reeds, thickets of Kubgaka; thus the boundary will not be forgotten.
verses.commentary: Sense: By clustering shrubs, bamboos of different kinds, Samis, creepers and raised mounds, reeds, thickets of Kubgaka; thus the boundary will not be forgotten.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: तडागान्युदपानानि वाप्यः प्रस्रवणानि च । सीमासंधिषु कार्याणि देवतायतनानि च
verses.transliteration: taḍāgānyudapānāni vāpyaḥ prasravaṇāni ca | sīmāsaṃdhiṣu kāryāṇi devatāyatanāni ca
verses.translation: Tanks, wells, cisterns, and fountains should be built where boundaries meet, as well as temples,
verses.commentary: Sense: Tanks, wells, cisterns, and fountains should be built where boundaries meet, as well as temples,
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: उपछन्नानि चान्यानि सीमालिङ्गानि कारयेत् । सीमाज्ञाने नृणां वीक्ष्य नित्यं लोके विपर्ययम्
verses.transliteration: upachannāni cānyāni sīmāliṅgāni kārayet | sīmājñāne nṛṇāṃ vīkṣya nityaṃ loke viparyayam
verses.translation: And as he will see that through men's ignorance of the boundaries trespasses constantly occur in the world, let him cause to be made other hidden marks for boundaries,
verses.commentary: Sense: And as he will see that through men's ignorance of the boundaries trespasses constantly occur in the world, let him cause to be made other hidden marks for boundaries,
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: अश्मनोऽस्थीनि गोवालांस्तुषान् भस्म कपालिकाः । करीषमिष्टकाऽङ्गारांश्छर्करा वालुकास्तथा
verses.transliteration: aśmano'sthīni govālāṃstuṣān bhasma kapālikāḥ | karīṣamiṣṭakā'ṅgārāṃścharkarā vālukāstathā
verses.translation: Stones, bones, cow's hair, chaff, ashes, potsherds, dry cowdung, bricks, cinders, pebbles, and sand,
verses.commentary: Sense: Stones, bones, cow's hair, chaff, ashes, potsherds, dry cowdung, bricks, cinders, pebbles, and sand,
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: यानि चैवम्प्रकाराणि कालाद्भूमिर्न भक्षयेत् । तानि संधिषु सीमायामप्रकाशानि कारयेत्
verses.transliteration: yāni caivamprakārāṇi kālādbhūmirna bhakṣayet | tāni saṃdhiṣu sīmāyāmaprakāśāni kārayet
verses.translation: And whatever other things of a similar kind the earth does not corrode even after a long time, those he should cause to be buried where one boundary joins (the other).
verses.commentary: Sense: And whatever other things of a similar kind the earth does not corrode even after a long time, those he should cause to be buried where one boundary joins (the other).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: सीमाया एतैर्लिङ्गैर्नयेत्सीमां राजा विवदमानयोः । पूर्वभुक्त्या च सततमुदकस्यागमेन च
verses.transliteration: sīmāyā etairliṅgairnayetsīmāṃ rājā vivadamānayoḥ | pūrvabhuktyā ca satatamudakasyāgamena ca
verses.translation: By these signs, by long continued possession, and by constantly flowing streams of water the king shall ascertain the boundary (of the land) of two disputing parties.
verses.commentary: Sense: By these signs, by long continued possession, and by constantly flowing streams of water the king shall ascertain the boundary (of the land) of two disputing parties.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: यदि स्ंशय एव स्यात्लिङ्गानामपि दर्शने । साक्षिप्रत्यय एव स्यात्सीमावादविनिर्णयः
verses.transliteration: yadi sṃśaya eva syātliṅgānāmapi darśane | sākṣipratyaya eva syātsīmāvādavinirṇayaḥ
verses.translation: If there be a doubt even on inspection of the marks, the settlement of a dispute regarding boundaries shall depend on witnesses.
verses.commentary: Sense: If there be a doubt even on inspection of the marks, the settlement of a dispute regarding boundaries shall depend on witnesses.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: सीमावादविनिश्चयः ग्रामीयककुलानां च समक्षं सीम्नि साक्षिणः । ग्रामेयक प्रष्टव्याः सीमलिङ्गानि तयोश्चैव विवादिनोः
verses.transliteration: sīmāvādaviniścayaḥ grāmīyakakulānāṃ ca samakṣaṃ sīmni sākṣiṇaḥ | grāmeyaka praṣṭavyāḥ sīmaliṅgāni tayoścaiva vivādinoḥ
verses.translation: The witnesses, (giving evidence) regarding a boundary, shall be examined concerning the landmarks in the presence of the crowd of the villagers and also of the two litigants.
verses.commentary: Sense: The witnesses, (giving evidence) regarding a boundary, shall be examined concerning the landmarks in the presence of the crowd of the villagers and also of the two litigants.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: सीमालिङ्गानि ते पृष्तास्तु यथा ब्रूयुः समस्ताः सीम्नि निश्चयम् । निबध्नीयात्तथा सीमां सर्वांस्तांश्चैव नामतः
verses.transliteration: sīmāliṅgāni te pṛṣtāstu yathā brūyuḥ samastāḥ sīmni niścayam | nibadhnīyāttathā sīmāṃ sarvāṃstāṃścaiva nāmataḥ
verses.translation: As they, being questioned, unanimously decide, even so he shall record the boundary (in writing), together with their names.
verses.commentary: Sense: As they, being questioned, unanimously decide, even so he shall record the boundary (in writing), together with their names.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: शिरोभिस्ते गृहीत्वोर्वीं स्रग्विणो रक्तवाससः । सुकृतैः शापिताः स्वैः स्वैर्नयेयुस्ते समञ्जसम्
verses.transliteration: śirobhiste gṛhītvorvīṃ sragviṇo raktavāsasaḥ | sukṛtaiḥ śāpitāḥ svaiḥ svairnayeyuste samañjasam
verses.translation: Let them, putting earth on their heads, wearing chaplets (of red flowers) and red dresses, being sworn each by (the rewards for) his meritorious deeds, settle (the boundary) in accordance with the truth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let them, putting earth on their heads, wearing chaplets (of red flowers) and red dresses, being sworn each by (the rewards for) his meritorious deeds, settle (the boundary) in accordance with the truth.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: यथोक्तेन नयन्तस्ते पूयन्ते सत्यसाक्षिणः । विपरीतं नयन्तस्तु दाप्याः स्युर्द्विशतं दमम्
verses.transliteration: yathoktena nayantaste pūyante satyasākṣiṇaḥ | viparītaṃ nayantastu dāpyāḥ syurdviśataṃ damam
verses.translation: If they determine (the boundary) in the manner stated, they are guiltless (being) veracious witnesses; but if they determine it unjustly, they shall be compelled to pay a fine of two hundred (panas).
verses.commentary: Sense: If they determine (the boundary) in the manner stated, they are guiltless (being) veracious witnesses; but if they determine it unjustly, they shall be compelled to pay a fine of two hundred (panas).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: साक्ष्यभावे तु चत्वारो ग्रामाः सामन्तवासिनः । ग्रामसीमान्तवासिनः सीमाविनिर्णयं कुर्युः प्रयता राजसंनिधौ
verses.transliteration: sākṣyabhāve tu catvāro grāmāḥ sāmantavāsinaḥ | grāmasīmāntavāsinaḥ sīmāvinirṇayaṃ kuryuḥ prayatā rājasaṃnidhau
verses.translation: On failure of witnesses (from the two villages, men of) the four neighbouring villages, who are pure, shall make (as witnesses) a decision concerning the boundary in the presence of the king.
verses.commentary: Sense: On failure of witnesses (from the two villages, men of) the four neighbouring villages, who are pure, shall make (as witnesses) a decision concerning the boundary in the presence of the king.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0
verses.science: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सामन्तानामभावे तु मौलानां सीम्नि साक्षिणाम् । इमानप्यनुयुञ्जीत पुरुषान् वनगोचरान्
verses.transliteration: sāmantānāmabhāve tu maulānāṃ sīmni sākṣiṇām | imānapyanuyuñjīta puruṣān vanagocarān
verses.translation: On failure of neighbours (who are) original inhabitants (of the country and can be) witnesses with respect to the boundary, (the king) may hear the evidence even of the following inhabitants of the forest.
verses.commentary: Sense: On failure of neighbours (who are) original inhabitants (of the country and can be) witnesses with respect to the boundary, (the king) may hear the evidence even of the following inhabitants of the forest.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: व्याधांशाकुनिकान् गोपान् कैवर्तान् मूलखानकान् । व्यालग्राहानुञ्छवृत्तीनन्यांश्च वनचारिणः
verses.transliteration: vyādhāṃśākunikān gopān kaivartān mūlakhānakān | vyālagrāhānuñchavṛttīnanyāṃśca vanacāriṇaḥ
verses.translation: (Viz.) hunters, fowlers, herdsmen, fishermen, root-diggers, snake-catchers, gleaners, and other foresters.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Viz.) hunters, fowlers, herdsmen, fishermen, root-diggers, snake-catchers, gleaners, and other foresters.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: ते पृष्टास्तु यथा ब्रूयुः सीमासंधिषु लक्षणम् । तत्तथा स्थापयेद्राजा धर्मेण ग्रामयोर्द्वयोः
verses.transliteration: te pṛṣṭāstu yathā brūyuḥ sīmāsaṃdhiṣu lakṣaṇam | tattathā sthāpayedrājā dharmeṇa grāmayordvayoḥ
verses.translation: As they, being examined, declare the marks for the meeting of the boundaries (to be), even so the king shall justly cause them to be fixed between the two villages.
verses.commentary: Sense: As they, being examined, declare the marks for the meeting of the boundaries (to be), even so the king shall justly cause them to be fixed between the two villages.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: क्षेत्रकूपतडागानामारामस्य गृहस्य च । सामन्तप्रत्ययो ज्ञेयः सीमासेतुविनिर्णयः
verses.transliteration: kṣetrakūpataḍāgānāmārāmasya gṛhasya ca | sāmantapratyayo jñeyaḥ sīmāsetuvinirṇayaḥ
verses.translation: The decision concerning the boundary-marks of fields, wells, tanks, of gardens and houses depends upon (the evidence of) the neighbours.
verses.commentary: Sense: The decision concerning the boundary-marks of fields, wells, tanks, of gardens and houses depends upon (the evidence of) the neighbours.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: सामन्ताश्चेत्मृषा ब्रूयुः सेतौ विवादतां नृणाम् । सर्वे पृथक्पृथग्दण्ड्या राज्ञा मध्यमसाहसम्
verses.transliteration: sāmantāścetmṛṣā brūyuḥ setau vivādatāṃ nṛṇām | sarve pṛthakpṛthagdaṇḍyā rājñā madhyamasāhasam
verses.translation: Should the neighbours give false evidence, when men dispute about a boundary-mark, the king shall make each of them pay the middlemost amercement as a fine.
verses.commentary: Sense: Should the neighbours give false evidence, when men dispute about a boundary-mark, the king shall make each of them pay the middlemost amercement as a fine.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: गृहं तडागमारामं क्षेत्रं वा भीषया हरन् । शतानि पञ्च दण्ड्यः स्यादज्ञानाद्द्विशतो दमः
verses.transliteration: gṛhaṃ taḍāgamārāmaṃ kṣetraṃ vā bhīṣayā haran | śatāni pañca daṇḍyaḥ syādajñānāddviśato damaḥ
verses.translation: He who by intimidation possesses himself of a house, a tank, a garden, or a field, shall be fined five hundred (panas); (if he trespassed) through ignorance, the fine (shall be) two hundred (panas).
verses.commentary: Sense: He who by intimidation possesses himself of a house, a tank, a garden, or a field, shall be fined five hundred (panas); (if he trespassed) through ignorance, the fine (shall be) two hundred (panas).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: सीमायामविषह्यायां स्वयं राजैव धर्मवित् । प्रदिशेद्भूमिमेकेषामुपकारादिति स्थितिः
verses.transliteration: sīmāyāmaviṣahyāyāṃ svayaṃ rājaiva dharmavit | pradiśedbhūmimekeṣāmupakārāditi sthitiḥ
verses.translation: If the boundary cannot be ascertained (by any evidence), let a righteous king with (the intention of) benefiting them (all), himself assign (his) land (to each); that is the settled rule.
verses.commentary: Sense: If the boundary cannot be ascertained (by any evidence), let a righteous king with (the intention of) benefiting them (all), himself assign (his) land (to each); that is the settled rule.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: एषोऽखिलेनाभिहितो धर्मः सीमाविनिर्णये । अत ऊर्ध्वं प्रवक्ष्यामि वाक्पारुष्यविनिर्णयम्
verses.transliteration: eṣo'khilenābhihito dharmaḥ sīmāvinirṇaye | ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi vākpāruṣyavinirṇayam
verses.translation: Thus the law for deciding boundary (disputes) has been fully declared, I will next propound the (manner of) deciding (cases of) defamation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the law for deciding boundary (disputes) has been fully declared, I will next propound the (manner of) deciding (cases of) defamation.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: शतं ब्राह्मणमाक्रुश्य क्षत्रियो दण्डमर्हति । वैश्योऽप्यर्धशतं द्वे वा शूद्रस्तु वधमर्हति
verses.transliteration: śataṃ brāhmaṇamākruśya kṣatriyo daṇḍamarhati | vaiśyo'pyardhaśataṃ dve vā śūdrastu vadhamarhati
verses.translation: A Kshatriya, having defamed a Brahmana, shall be fined one hundred (panas); a Vaisya one hundred and fifty or two hundred; a Sudra shall suffer corporal punishment.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Kshatriya, having defamed a Brahmana, shall be fined one hundred (panas); a Vaisya one hundred and fifty or two hundred; a Sudra shall suffer corporal punishment.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चाशद्ब्राह्मणो दण्ड्यः क्षत्रियस्याभिशंसने । वैश्ये स्यादर्धपञ्चाशत्शूद्रे द्वादशको दमः
verses.transliteration: pañcāśadbrāhmaṇo daṇḍyaḥ kṣatriyasyābhiśaṃsane | vaiśye syādardhapañcāśatśūdre dvādaśako damaḥ
verses.translation: A Brahmana shall be fined fifty (panas) for defaming a Kshatriya; in (the case of) a Vaisya the fine shall be twenty-five (panas); in (the case of) a Sudra twelve.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Brahmana shall be fined fifty (panas) for defaming a Kshatriya; in (the case of) a Vaisya the fine shall be twenty-five (panas); in (the case of) a Sudra twelve.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: समवर्णे द्विजातीनां द्वादशैव व्यतिक्रमे । वादेष्ववचनीयेषु तदेव द्विगुणं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: samavarṇe dvijātīnāṃ dvādaśaiva vyatikrame | vādeṣvavacanīyeṣu tadeva dviguṇaṃ bhavet
verses.translation: For offences of twice-born men against those of equal caste (varna, the fine shall be) also twelve (panas); for speeches which ought not to be uttered, that (and every fine shall be) double.
verses.commentary: Sense: For offences of twice-born men against those of equal caste (varna, the fine shall be) also twelve (panas); for speeches which ought not to be uttered, that (and every fine shall be) double.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: एकजातिर्द्विजातींस्तु वाचा दारुणया क्षिपन् । जिह्वायाः प्राप्नुयाच्छेदं जघन्यप्रभवो हि सः
verses.transliteration: ekajātirdvijātīṃstu vācā dāruṇayā kṣipan | jihvāyāḥ prāpnuyācchedaṃ jaghanyaprabhavo hi saḥ
verses.translation: A once-born man (a Sudra), who insults a twice-born man with gross invective, shall have his tongue cut out; for he is of low origin.
verses.commentary: Sense: A once-born man (a Sudra), who insults a twice-born man with gross invective, shall have his tongue cut out; for he is of low origin.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: नामजातिग्रहं त्वेषामभिद्रोहेण कुर्वतः । निक्षेप्योऽयोमयः शङ्कुर्ज्वलन्नास्ये दशाङ्गुलः
verses.transliteration: nāmajātigrahaṃ tveṣāmabhidroheṇa kurvataḥ | nikṣepyo'yomayaḥ śaṅkurjvalannāsye daśāṅgulaḥ
verses.translation: If he mentions the names and castes (gati) of the (twice-born) with contumely, an iron nail, ten fingers long, shall be thrust red-hot into his mouth.
verses.commentary: Sense: If he mentions the names and castes (gati) of the (twice-born) with contumely, an iron nail, ten fingers long, shall be thrust red-hot into his mouth.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: धर्मोपदेशं दर्पेण विप्राणामस्य कुर्वतः । तप्तमासेचयेत्तैलं वक्त्रे श्रोत्रे च पार्थिवः
verses.transliteration: dharmopadeśaṃ darpeṇa viprāṇāmasya kurvataḥ | taptamāsecayettailaṃ vaktre śrotre ca pārthivaḥ
verses.translation: If he arrogantly teaches Brahmanas their duty, the king shall cause hot oil to be poured into his mouth and into his ears.
verses.commentary: Sense: If he arrogantly teaches Brahmanas their duty, the king shall cause hot oil to be poured into his mouth and into his ears.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.transliteration: śrautre śrutaṃ deśaṃ ca jātiṃ ca karma śarīrameva ca | vitathena bruvan darpāddāpyaḥ syāddviśataṃ damam
verses.translation: He who through arrogance makes false statements regarding the learning (of a caste-fellow), his country, his caste (gati), or the rites by which his body was sanctified, shall be compelled to pay a fine of two hundred (panas).

verses.sanskrit: काणं वाऽप्यथ वा खञ्जमन्यं वाऽपि तथाविधम् । तथ्येनापि ब्रुवन् दाप्यो दण्डं कार्षापणावरम्
verses.transliteration: kāṇaṃ vā'pyatha vā khañjamanyaṃ vā'pi tathāvidham | tathyenāpi bruvan dāpyo daṇḍaṃ kārṣāpaṇāvaram
verses.translation: He who even in accordance with the true facts (contemptuously) calls another man one-eyed, lame, or the like (names), shall be fined at least one karshapana.

verses.transliteration: mātaraṃ pitaraṃ jāyāṃ bhrātaraṃ tanayaṃ gurum | ākṣārayaṃśataṃ dāpyaḥ panthānaṃ cādadadguroḥ
verses.translation: He who defames his mother, his father, his wife, his brother, his son, or his teacher, and he who gives not the way to his preceptor, shall be compelled to pay one hundred (panas).

verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇakṣatriyābhyāṃ tu daṇḍaḥ kāryo vijānatā | brāhmaṇe sāhasaḥ pūrvaḥ kṣatriye tveva madhyamaḥ
verses.translation: (For mutual abuse) by a Brahmana and a Kshatriya a fine must be imposed by a discerning (king), on the Brahmana the lowest amercement, but on the Kshatriya the middlemost.

verses.sanskrit: विट् शूद्रयोरेवमेव स्वजातिं प्रति तत्त्वतः । छेदवर्जं प्रणयनं दण्डस्यैति विनिश्चयः
verses.transliteration: viṭ śūdrayorevameva svajātiṃ prati tattvataḥ | chedavarjaṃ praṇayanaṃ daṇḍasyaiti viniścayaḥ
verses.translation: A Vaisya and a Sudra must be punished exactly in the same manner according to their respective castes, but the tongue (of the Sudra) shall not be cut out; that is the decision.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Vaisya and a Sudra must be punished exactly in the same manner according to their respective castes, but the tongue (of the Sudra) shall not be cut out; that is the decision.

verses.sanskrit: एष दण्डविधिः प्रोक्तो वाक्पारुष्यस्य तत्त्वतः । अत ऊर्ध्वं प्रवक्ष्यामि दण्डपारुष्यनिर्णयम्
verses.transliteration: eṣa daṇḍavidhiḥ prokto vākpāruṣyasya tattvataḥ | ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi daṇḍapāruṣyanirṇayam
verses.translation: Thus the rules for punishments (applicable to cases) of defamation have been truly declared; I will next propound the decision (of cases) of assault.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the rules for punishments (applicable to cases) of defamation have been truly declared; I will next propound the decision (of cases) of assault.

verses.transliteration: yena kena cidaṅgena hiṃsyāccetśreṣṭhamantyajaḥ | chettavyaṃ tadtadevāsya tan manoranuśāsanam
verses.translation: With whatever limb a man of a low caste does hurt to (a man of the three) highest (castes), even that limb shall be cut off; that is the teaching of Manu.
verses.commentary: Sense: With whatever limb a man of a low caste does hurt to (a man of the three) highest (castes), even that limb shall be cut off; that is the teaching of Manu.

verses.transliteration: pāṇimudyamya daṇḍaṃ vā pāṇicchedanamarhati | pādena praharan kopātpādacchedanamarhati
verses.translation: He who raises his hand or a stick, shall have his hand cut off; he who in anger kicks with his foot, shall have his foot cut off.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who raises his hand or a stick, shall have his hand cut off; he who in anger kicks with his foot, shall have his foot cut off.

verses.sanskrit: सहासनमभिप्रेप्सुरुत्कृष्टस्यापकृष्टजः । कट्यां कृताङ्को निर्वास्यः स्फिचं वाऽस्यावकर्तयेत्
verses.transliteration: sahāsanamabhiprepsurutkṛṣṭasyāpakṛṣṭajaḥ | kaṭyāṃ kṛtāṅko nirvāsyaḥ sphicaṃ vā'syāvakartayet
verses.translation: A low-caste man who tries to place himself on the same seat with a man of a high caste, shall be branded on his hip and be banished, or (the king) shall cause his buttock to be gashed.
verses.commentary: Sense: A low-caste man who tries to place himself on the same seat with a man of a high caste, shall be branded on his hip and be banished, or (the king) shall cause his buttock to be gashed.

verses.translation: If out of arrogance he spits (on a superior), the king shall cause both his lips to be cut off; if he urines (on him), the penis; if he breaks wind (against him), the anus.

verses.transliteration: keśeṣu gṛhṇato hastau chedayedavicārayan | pādayordāḍhikāyāṃ ca grīvāyāṃ vṛṣaṇeṣu ca
verses.translation: If he lays hold of the hair (of a superior), let the (king) unhesitatingly cut off his hands, likewise (if he takes him) by the feet, the beard, the neck, or the scrotum.

verses.transliteration: tvagbhedakaḥ śataṃ daṇḍyo lohitasya ca darśakaḥ | māṃsabhettā tu ṣaṇniṣkān pravāsyastvasthibhedakaḥ
verses.translation: He who breaks the skin (of an equal) or fetches blood (from him) shall be fined one hundred (panas), he who cuts a muscle six nishkas, he who breaks a bone shall be banished.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who breaks the skin (of an equal) or fetches blood (from him) shall be fined one hundred (panas), he who cuts a muscle six nishkas, he who breaks a bone shall be banished.

verses.sanskrit: वनस्पतीनां सर्वेषामुपभोगो यथा यथा । यथा तथा दमः कार्यो हिंसायामिति धारणा
verses.transliteration: vanaspatīnāṃ sarveṣāmupabhogo yathā yathā | yathā tathā damaḥ kāryo hiṃsāyāmiti dhāraṇā
verses.translation: According to the usefulness of the several (kinds of) trees a fine must be inflicted for injuring them; that is the settled rule.
verses.commentary: Sense: According to the usefulness of the several (kinds of) trees a fine must be inflicted for injuring them; that is the settled rule.

verses.sanskrit: मनुष्याणां पशूनां च दुःखाय प्रहृते सति । यथा यथा महद्दुःखं दण्डं कुर्यात्तथा तथा
verses.transliteration: manuṣyāṇāṃ paśūnāṃ ca duḥkhāya prahṛte sati | yathā yathā mahadduḥkhaṃ daṇḍaṃ kuryāttathā tathā
verses.translation: If a blow is struck against men or animals in order to (give them) pain, (the judge) shall inflict a fine in proportion to the amount of pain (caused).
verses.commentary: Sense: If a blow is struck against men or animals in order to (give them) pain, (the judge) shall inflict a fine in proportion to the amount of pain (caused).

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गावपीडनायां च व्रणशोणितयोस्तथा । प्राणशोनितयोः समुत्थानव्ययं दाप्यः सर्वदण्डमथापि वा
verses.transliteration: aṅgāvapīḍanāyāṃ ca vraṇaśoṇitayostathā | prāṇaśonitayoḥ samutthānavyayaṃ dāpyaḥ sarvadaṇḍamathāpi vā
verses.translation: If a limb is injured, a wound (is caused), or blood (flows, the assailant) shall be made to pay (to the sufferer) the expenses of the cure, or the whole (both the usual amercement and the expenses of the cure as a) fine (to the king).

verses.sanskrit: द्रव्याणि हिंस्याद्यो यस्य ज्ञानतोऽज्ञानतोऽपि वा । स तस्योत्पादयेत्तुष्टिं राज्ञे दद्याच्च तत्समम्
verses.transliteration: dravyāṇi hiṃsyādyo yasya jñānato'jñānato'pi vā | sa tasyotpādayettuṣṭiṃ rājñe dadyācca tatsamam
verses.translation: He who damages the goods of another, be it intentionally or unintentionally, shall give satisfaction to the (owner) and pay to the king a fine equal to the (damage).
verses.commentary: Sense: He who damages the goods of another, be it intentionally or unintentionally, shall give satisfaction to the (owner) and pay to the king a fine equal to the (damage).

verses.sanskrit: चर्मचार्मिकभाण्डेषु काष्ठलोष्टमयेषु । मूल्यात्पञ्चगुणो दण्डः पुष्पमूलफलेषु च
verses.transliteration: carmacārmikabhāṇḍeṣu kāṣṭhaloṣṭamayeṣu | mūlyātpañcaguṇo daṇḍaḥ puṣpamūlaphaleṣu ca
verses.translation: In the case of (damage done to) leather, or to utensils of leather, of wood, or of clay, the fine (shall be) five times their value; likewise in the case of (damage to) flowers, roots, and fruit.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the case of (damage done to) leather, or to utensils of leather, of wood, or of clay, the fine (shall be) five times their value; likewise in the case of (damage to) flowers, roots, and fruit.

verses.sanskrit: यानस्य चैव यातुश्च यानस्वामिन एव च । दशातिवर्तनान्याहुः शेषे दण्डो विधीयते
verses.transliteration: yānasya caiva yātuśca yānasvāmina eva ca | daśātivartanānyāhuḥ śeṣe daṇḍo vidhīyate
verses.translation: They declare with respect to a carriage, its driver and its owner, (that there are) ten cases in which no punishment (for damage done) can be inflicted; in other cases a fine is prescribed.
verses.commentary: Sense: They declare with respect to a carriage, its driver and its owner, (that there are) ten cases in which no punishment (for damage done) can be inflicted; in other cases a fine is prescribed.

verses.sanskrit: छिन्ननास्ये भग्नयुगे तिर्यक्प्रतिमुखागते । अक्षभङ्गे च यानस्य चक्रभङ्गे तथैव च
verses.transliteration: chinnanāsye bhagnayuge tiryakpratimukhāgate | akṣabhaṅge ca yānasya cakrabhaṅge tathaiva ca
verses.translation: When the nose-string is snapped, when the yoke is broken, when the carriage turns sideways or back, when the axle or a wheel is broken,
verses.commentary: Sense: When the nose-string is snapped, when the yoke is broken, when the carriage turns sideways or back, when the axle or a wheel is broken,

verses.sanskrit: छेदने चैव यन्त्राणां योक्त्ररश्म्योस्तथैव च । आक्रन्दे चाप्यपैहीति न दण्डं मनुरब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: chedane caiva yantrāṇāṃ yoktraraśmyostathaiva ca | ākrande cāpyapaihīti na daṇḍaṃ manurabravīt
verses.translation: When the leather-thongs, the rope around the neck or the bridle are broken, and when (the driver) has loudly called out, 'Make way,' Manu has declared (that in all these cases) no punishment (shall be inflicted).
verses.commentary: Sense: When the leather-thongs, the rope around the neck or the bridle are broken, and when (the driver) has loudly called out, 'Make way,' Manu has declared (that in all these cases) no punishment (shall be inflicted).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: यत्रापवर्तते युग्यं वैगुण्यात्प्राजकस्य तु । तत्र स्वामी भवेद्दण्ड्यो हिंसायां द्विशतं दमम्
verses.transliteration: yatrāpavartate yugyaṃ vaiguṇyātprājakasya tu | tatra svāmī bhaveddaṇḍyo hiṃsāyāṃ dviśataṃ damam
verses.translation: But if the cart turns off (the road) through the driver's want of skill, the owner shall be fined, if damage (is done), two hundred (panas).
verses.commentary: Sense: But if the cart turns off (the road) through the driver's want of skill, the owner shall be fined, if damage (is done), two hundred (panas).

verses.sanskrit: प्राजकश्चेद्भवेदाप्तः प्राजको दण्डमर्हति । युग्यस्थाः प्राजकेऽनाप्ते सर्वे दण्ड्याः शतं शतम्
verses.transliteration: prājakaścedbhavedāptaḥ prājako daṇḍamarhati | yugyasthāḥ prājake'nāpte sarve daṇḍyāḥ śataṃ śatam
verses.translation: If the driver is skilful (but negligent), he alone shall be fined; if the driver is unskilful, the occupants of the carriage (also) shall be each fined one hundred (panas).
verses.commentary: Sense: If the driver is skilful (but negligent), he alone shall be fined; if the driver is unskilful, the occupants of the carriage (also) shall be each fined one hundred (panas).

verses.sanskrit: स चेत्तु पथि संरुद्धः पशुभिर्वा रथेन वा । प्रमापयेत्प्राणभृतस्तत्र दण्डोऽविचारितः
verses.transliteration: sa cettu pathi saṃruddhaḥ paśubhirvā rathena vā | pramāpayetprāṇabhṛtastatra daṇḍo'vicāritaḥ
verses.translation: But if he is stopped on his way by cattle or by (another) carriage, and he causes the death of any living being, a fine shall without doubt be imposed.
verses.commentary: Sense: But if he is stopped on his way by cattle or by (another) carriage, and he causes the death of any living being, a fine shall without doubt be imposed.

verses.sanskrit: मनुष्यमारणे क्षिप्रं चौरवत्किल्बिषं भवेत् । प्राणभृत्सु महत्स्वर्धं गोगजोष्ट्रहयादिषु
verses.transliteration: manuṣyamāraṇe kṣipraṃ cauravatkilbiṣaṃ bhavet | prāṇabhṛtsu mahatsvardhaṃ gogajoṣṭrahayādiṣu
verses.translation: If a man is killed, his guilt will be at once the same as (that of) a thief; for large animals such as cows, elephants, camels or horses, half of that.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a man is killed, his guilt will be at once the same as (that of) a thief; for large animals such as cows, elephants, camels or horses, half of that.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: क्षुद्रकाणां पशूनां तु हिंसायां द्विशतो दमः । पञ्चाशत्तु भवेद्दण्डः शुभेषु मृगपक्षिषु
verses.transliteration: kṣudrakāṇāṃ paśūnāṃ tu hiṃsāyāṃ dviśato damaḥ | pañcāśattu bhaveddaṇḍaḥ śubheṣu mṛgapakṣiṣu
verses.translation: For injuring small cattle the fine (shall be) two hundred (panas); the fine for beautiful wild quadrupeds and birds shall amount to fifty (panas).
verses.commentary: Sense: For injuring small cattle the fine (shall be) two hundred (panas); the fine for beautiful wild quadrupeds and birds shall amount to fifty (panas).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: गर्धभाजाविकानां तु दण्डः स्यात्पञ्चमाषिकः । पाञ्चमाषिकः माषिकस्तु भवेद्दण्डः श्वसूकरनिपातने
verses.transliteration: gardhabhājāvikānāṃ tu daṇḍaḥ syātpañcamāṣikaḥ | pāñcamāṣikaḥ māṣikastu bhaveddaṇḍaḥ śvasūkaranipātane
verses.translation: For donkeys, sheep, and goats the fine shall be five mashas; but the punishment for killing a dog or a pig shall be one masha.
verses.commentary: Sense: For donkeys, sheep, and goats the fine shall be five mashas; but the punishment for killing a dog or a pig shall be one masha.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: भार्या पुत्रश्च दासश्च प्रेष्यो भ्रात्रा च सौदरः । प्राप्तापराधास्ताड्याः स्यू रज्ज्वा वेणुदलेन वा
verses.transliteration: bhāryā putraśca dāsaśca preṣyo bhrātrā ca saudaraḥ | prāptāparādhāstāḍyāḥ syū rajjvā veṇudalena vā
verses.translation: A wife, a son, a slave, a pupil, and a (younger) brother of the full blood, who have committed faults, may be beaten with a rope or a split bamboo,
verses.commentary: Sense: A wife, a son, a slave, a pupil, and a (younger) brother of the full blood, who have committed faults, may be beaten with a rope or a split bamboo,
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: पृष्ठतस्तु शरीरस्य नोत्तमाङ्गे कथं चन । अतोऽन्यथा तु प्रहरन् प्राप्तः स्याच्चौरकिल्बिषम्
verses.transliteration: pṛṣṭhatastu śarīrasya nottamāṅge kathaṃ cana | ato'nyathā tu praharan prāptaḥ syāccaurakilbiṣam
verses.translation: But on the back part of the body (only), never on a noble part; he who strikes them otherwise will incur the same guilt as a thief.
verses.commentary: Sense: But on the back part of the body (only), never on a noble part; he who strikes them otherwise will incur the same guilt as a thief.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: एषोऽखिलेनाभिहितो दण्डपारुष्यनिर्णयः । स्तेनस्यातः प्रवक्ष्यामि विधिं दण्डविनिर्णये
verses.transliteration: eṣo'khilenābhihito daṇḍapāruṣyanirṇayaḥ | stenasyātaḥ pravakṣyāmi vidhiṃ daṇḍavinirṇaye
verses.translation: Thus the whole law of assault (and hurt) has been declared completely; I will now explain the rules for the decision (in cases) of theft.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the whole law of assault (and hurt) has been declared completely; I will now explain the rules for the decision (in cases) of theft.

verses.sanskrit: परमं यत्नमातिष्ठेत्स्तेनानां निग्रहे नृपः । स्तेनानां निग्रहादस्य यशो राष्ट्रं च वर्धते
verses.transliteration: paramaṃ yatnamātiṣṭhetstenānāṃ nigrahe nṛpaḥ | stenānāṃ nigrahādasya yaśo rāṣṭraṃ ca vardhate
verses.translation: Let the king exert himself to the utmost to punish thieves; for, if he punishes thieves, his fame grows and his kingdom prospers.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let the king exert himself to the utmost to punish thieves; for, if he punishes thieves, his fame grows and his kingdom prospers.

verses.sanskrit: अभयस्य हि यो दाता स पूज्यः सततं नृपः । सत्त्रं हि वर्धते तस्य सदैवाभयदक्षिणम्
verses.transliteration: abhayasya hi yo dātā sa pūjyaḥ satataṃ nṛpaḥ | sattraṃ hi vardhate tasya sadaivābhayadakṣiṇam
verses.translation: That king, indeed, is ever worthy of honour who ensures the safety (of his subjects); for the sacrificial session (sattra, which he, as it were, performs thereby) ever grows in length, the safety (of his subjects representing) the sacrificial fee.
verses.commentary: Sense: That king, indeed, is ever worthy of honour who ensures the safety (of his subjects); for the sacrificial session (sattra, which he, as it were, performs thereby) ever grows in length, the safety (of his subjects representing) the sacrificial fee.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वतो धर्मषड्भागो राज्ञो भवति रक्षतः । अधर्मादपि षड्भागो भवत्यस्य ह्यरक्षतः
verses.transliteration: sarvato dharmaṣaḍbhāgo rājño bhavati rakṣataḥ | adharmādapi ṣaḍbhāgo bhavatyasya hyarakṣataḥ
verses.translation: A king who (duly) protects (his subjects) receives from each and all the sixth part of their spiritual merit; if he does not protect them, the sixth part of their demerit also (will fall on him).
verses.commentary: Sense: A king who (duly) protects (his subjects) receives from each and all the sixth part of their spiritual merit; if he does not protect them, the sixth part of their demerit also (will fall on him).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0
