verses.sanskrit: यदधीते यद्यजते यद्ददाति यदर्चति । तस्य षड्भागभाग्राजा सम्यग्भवति रक्षणात्
verses.transliteration: yadadhīte yadyajate yaddadāti yadarcati | tasya ṣaḍbhāgabhāgrājā samyagbhavati rakṣaṇāt
verses.translation: Whatever (merit a man gains by) reading the Veda, by sacrificing, by charitable gifts, (or by) worshipping (Gurus and gods), the king obtains a sixth part of that in consequence of his duly protecting (his kingdom).
verses.commentary: Sense: Whatever (merit a man gains by) reading the Veda, by sacrificing, by charitable gifts, (or by) worshipping (Gurus and gods), the king obtains a sixth part of that in consequence of his duly protecting (his kingdom).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: रक्षन् धर्मेण भूतानि राजा वध्यांश्च घातयन् । यजतेऽहरहर्यज्ञैः सहस्रशतदक्षिणैः
verses.transliteration: rakṣan dharmeṇa bhūtāni rājā vadhyāṃśca ghātayan | yajate'haraharyajñaiḥ sahasraśatadakṣiṇaiḥ
verses.translation: A king who protects the created beings in accordance with the sacred law and smites those worthy of corporal punishment, daily offers (as it were) sacrifices at which hundred thousands (are given as) fees.
verses.commentary: Sense: A king who protects the created beings in accordance with the sacred law and smites those worthy of corporal punishment, daily offers (as it were) sacrifices at which hundred thousands (are given as) fees.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: योऽरक्षन् बलिमादत्ते करं शुल्कं च पार्थिवः । प्रतिभागं च दण्डं च स सद्यो नरकं व्रजेत्
verses.transliteration: yo'rakṣan balimādatte karaṃ śulkaṃ ca pārthivaḥ | pratibhāgaṃ ca daṇḍaṃ ca sa sadyo narakaṃ vrajet
verses.translation: A king who does not afford protection, (yet) takes his share in kind, his taxes, tolls and duties, daily presents and fines, will (after death) soon sink into hell.
verses.commentary: Sense: A king who does not afford protection, (yet) takes his share in kind, his taxes, tolls and duties, daily presents and fines, will (after death) soon sink into hell.

verses.sanskrit: अरक्षितारं राजानं बलिषड्भागहारिणम् । अरक्षितारमत्तारं तमाहुः सर्वलोकस्य समग्रमलहारकम्
verses.transliteration: arakṣitāraṃ rājānaṃ baliṣaḍbhāgahāriṇam | arakṣitāramattāraṃ tamāhuḥ sarvalokasya samagramalahārakam
verses.translation: They declare that a king who affords no protection, (yet) receives the sixth part of the produce, takes upon himself all the foulness of his whole people.
verses.commentary: Sense: They declare that a king who affords no protection, (yet) receives the sixth part of the produce, takes upon himself all the foulness of his whole people.

verses.sanskrit: अनपेक्षितमर्यादं नास्तिकं विप्रलुम्पकम् । अनवेक्षितमर्यादं अरक्षितारमत्तारं नृपं विद्यादधोगतिम्
verses.transliteration: anapekṣitamaryādaṃ nāstikaṃ vipralumpakam | anavekṣitamaryādaṃ arakṣitāramattāraṃ nṛpaṃ vidyādadhogatim
verses.translation: Know that a king who heeds not the rules (of the law), who is an atheist, and rapacious, who does not protect (his subjects, but) devours them, will sink low (after death).
verses.commentary: Sense: Know that a king who heeds not the rules (of the law), who is an atheist, and rapacious, who does not protect (his subjects, but) devours them, will sink low (after death).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: अधार्मिकं त्रिभिर्न्यायैर्निगृह्णीयात्प्रयत्नतः । निरोधनेन बन्धेन विविधेन वधेन च
verses.transliteration: adhārmikaṃ tribhirnyāyairnigṛhṇīyātprayatnataḥ | nirodhanena bandhena vividhena vadhena ca
verses.translation: Let him carefully restrain the wicked by three methods,- by imprisonment by putting them in fetters, and by various (kinds of) corporal punishments.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let him carefully restrain the wicked by three methods,- by imprisonment by putting them in fetters, and by various (kinds of) corporal punishments.

verses.sanskrit: निग्रहेण हि पापानां साधूनां सङ्ग्रहेण च । द्विजातय इवैज्याभिः पूयन्ते सततं नृपाः
verses.transliteration: nigraheṇa hi pāpānāṃ sādhūnāṃ saṅgraheṇa ca | dvijātaya ivaijyābhiḥ pūyante satataṃ nṛpāḥ
verses.translation: For by punishing the wicked and by favouring the virtuous, kings are constantly sanctified, just as twice-born men by sacrifices.
verses.commentary: Sense: For by punishing the wicked and by favouring the virtuous, kings are constantly sanctified, just as twice-born men by sacrifices.

verses.sanskrit: क्षन्तव्यं प्रभुणा नित्यं क्षिपतां कार्यिणां नृणाम् । बालवृद्धातुराणां च कुर्वता हितमात्मनः
verses.transliteration: kṣantavyaṃ prabhuṇā nityaṃ kṣipatāṃ kāryiṇāṃ nṛṇām | bālavṛddhāturāṇāṃ ca kurvatā hitamātmanaḥ
verses.translation: A king who desires his own welfare must always forgive litigants, infants, aged and sick men, who inveigh against him.
verses.commentary: Sense: A king who desires his own welfare must always forgive litigants, infants, aged and sick men, who inveigh against him.

verses.sanskrit: यः क्षिप्तो मर्षयत्यार्तैस्तेन स्वर्गे महीयते । यस्त्वैश्वर्यान्न क्षमते नरकं तेन गच्छति
verses.transliteration: yaḥ kṣipto marṣayatyārtaistena svarge mahīyate | yastvaiśvaryānna kṣamate narakaṃ tena gacchati
verses.translation: He who, being abused by men in pain, pardons (them), will in reward of that (act) be exalted in heaven; but he who, (proud) of his kingly state, forgives them not, will for that (reason) sink into hell.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who, being abused by men in pain, pardons (them), will in reward of that (act) be exalted in heaven; but he who, (proud) of his kingly state, forgives them not, will for that (reason) sink into hell.

verses.sanskrit: राजा स्तेनेन गन्तव्यो मुक्तकेशेन धावता । धीमता आचक्षाणेन तत्स्तेयमेवङ्कर्माऽस्मि शाधि माम्
verses.transliteration: rājā stenena gantavyo muktakeśena dhāvatā | dhīmatā ācakṣāṇena tatsteyamevaṅkarmā'smi śādhi mām
verses.translation: A thief shall, running, approach the king, with flying hair, confessing that theft (and saying), 'Thus have I done, punish me;'
verses.commentary: Sense: A thief shall, running, approach the king, with flying hair, confessing that theft (and saying), 'Thus have I done, punish me;'

verses.sanskrit: स्कन्धेनादाय मुसलं लगुडं वाऽपि खादिरम् । मुशलं शक्तिं चोभयतस्तीक्ष्णामायसं दण्डमेव वा
verses.transliteration: skandhenādāya musalaṃ laguḍaṃ vā'pi khādiram | muśalaṃ śaktiṃ cobhayatastīkṣṇāmāyasaṃ daṇḍameva vā
verses.translation: (And he must) carry on his shoulder a pestle, or a club of Khadira wood, or a spear sharp at both ends, or an iron staff.
verses.commentary: Sense: (And he must) carry on his shoulder a pestle, or a club of Khadira wood, or a spear sharp at both ends, or an iron staff.

verses.sanskrit: शासनाद्वा विमोक्षाद्वा स्तेनः स्तेयाद्विमुच्यते । अशासित्वा तु तं राजा स्तेनस्याप्नोति किल्बिषम्
verses.transliteration: śāsanādvā vimokṣādvā stenaḥ steyādvimucyate | aśāsitvā tu taṃ rājā stenasyāpnoti kilbiṣam
verses.translation: Whether he be punished or pardoned, the thief is freed from the (guilt of) theft; but the king, if he punishes not, takes upon himself the guilt of the thief.
verses.commentary: Sense: Whether he be punished or pardoned, the thief is freed from the (guilt of) theft; but the king, if he punishes not, takes upon himself the guilt of the thief.

verses.sanskrit: अन्नादे भ्रूणहा मार्ष्टि पत्यौ भार्याऽपचारिणी । गुरौ शिष्यश्च याज्यश्च स्तेनो राजनि किल्बिषम्
verses.transliteration: annāde bhrūṇahā mārṣṭi patyau bhāryā'pacāriṇī | gurau śiṣyaśca yājyaśca steno rājani kilbiṣam
verses.translation: The killer of a learned Brahmana throws his guilt on him who eats his food, an adulterous wife on her (negligent) husband, a (sinning) pupil or sacrificer on (their negligent) teacher (or priest), a thief on the king (who pardons him).
verses.commentary: Sense: The killer of a learned Brahmana throws his guilt on him who eats his food, an adulterous wife on her (negligent) husband, a (sinning) pupil or sacrificer on (their negligent) teacher (or priest), a thief on the king (who pardons him).

verses.sanskrit: राजभिः कृतदण्डास्तु कृत्वा पापानि मानवाः । राजभिर्धृतदण्डास्तु निर्मलाः स्वर्गमायान्ति सन्तः सुकृतिनो यथा
verses.transliteration: rājabhiḥ kṛtadaṇḍāstu kṛtvā pāpāni mānavāḥ | rājabhirdhṛtadaṇḍāstu nirmalāḥ svargamāyānti santaḥ sukṛtino yathā
verses.translation: But men who have committed crimes and have been punished by the king, go to heaven, being pure like those who performed meritorious deeds.
verses.commentary: Sense: But men who have committed crimes and have been punished by the king, go to heaven, being pure like those who performed meritorious deeds.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: यस्तु रज्जुं घटं कूपाद्धरेद्भिन्द्याच्च यः प्रपाम् । स दण्डं प्राप्नुयान् माषं तच्च तस्मिन् समाहरेत्
verses.transliteration: yastu rajjuṃ ghaṭaṃ kūpāddharedbhindyācca yaḥ prapām | sa daṇḍaṃ prāpnuyān māṣaṃ tacca tasmin samāharet
verses.translation: He who steals the rope or the water-pot from a well, or damages a hut where water is distributed, shall pay one masha as a fine and restore the (article abstracted or damaged) in its (proper place).
verses.commentary: Sense: He who steals the rope or the water-pot from a well, or damages a hut where water is distributed, shall pay one masha as a fine and restore the (article abstracted or damaged) in its (proper place).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: धान्यं दशभ्यः कुम्भेभ्यो हरतोऽभ्यधिकं वधः । शेषेऽप्येकादशगुणं दाप्यस्तस्य च तद्धनम्
verses.transliteration: dhānyaṃ daśabhyaḥ kumbhebhyo harato'bhyadhikaṃ vadhaḥ | śeṣe'pyekādaśaguṇaṃ dāpyastasya ca taddhanam
verses.translation: On him who steals more than ten kumbhas of grain corporal punishment (shall be inflicted); in other cases he shall be fined eleven times as much, and shall pay to the (owner the value of his) property.
verses.commentary: Sense: On him who steals more than ten kumbhas of grain corporal punishment (shall be inflicted); in other cases he shall be fined eleven times as much, and shall pay to the (owner the value of his) property.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: तथा धरिममेयानां शतादभ्यधिके वधः । सुवर्णरजतादीनामुत्तमानां च वाससाम्
verses.transliteration: tathā dharimameyānāṃ śatādabhyadhike vadhaḥ | suvarṇarajatādīnāmuttamānāṃ ca vāsasām
verses.translation: So shall corporal punishment be inflicted for stealing more than a hundred (palas) of articles sold by the weight, (i.e.) of gold, silver, and so forth, and of most excellent clothes.
verses.commentary: Sense: So shall corporal punishment be inflicted for stealing more than a hundred (palas) of articles sold by the weight, (i.e.) of gold, silver, and so forth, and of most excellent clothes.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चाशतस्त्वभ्यधिके हस्तच्छेदनमिष्यते । शेषे त्वेकादशगुणं मूल्याद्दण्डं प्रकल्पयेत्
verses.transliteration: pañcāśatastvabhyadhike hastacchedanamiṣyate | śeṣe tvekādaśaguṇaṃ mūlyāddaṇḍaṃ prakalpayet
verses.translation: For (stealing) more than fifty (palas) it is enacted that the hands (of the offender) shall be cut off; but in other cases, let him inflict a fine of eleven times the value.
verses.commentary: Sense: For (stealing) more than fifty (palas) it is enacted that the hands (of the offender) shall be cut off; but in other cases, let him inflict a fine of eleven times the value.

verses.sanskrit: पुरुषाणां कुलीनानां नारीणां च विशेषतः । मुख्यानां चैव रत्नानां हरणे वधमर्हति
verses.transliteration: puruṣāṇāṃ kulīnānāṃ nārīṇāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ | mukhyānāṃ caiva ratnānāṃ haraṇe vadhamarhati
verses.translation: For stealing men of noble family and especially women and the most precious gems, (the offender) deserves corporal (or capital) punishment.
verses.commentary: Sense: For stealing men of noble family and especially women and the most precious gems, (the offender) deserves corporal (or capital) punishment.

verses.sanskrit: महापशूनां हरणे शस्त्राणामौषधस्य च । कालमासाद्य कार्यं च दण्डं राजा प्रकल्पयेत्
verses.transliteration: mahāpaśūnāṃ haraṇe śastrāṇāmauṣadhasya ca | kālamāsādya kāryaṃ ca daṇḍaṃ rājā prakalpayet
verses.translation: For stealing large animals, weapons, or medicines, let the king fix a punishment, after considering the time and the purpose (for which they were destined).
verses.commentary: Sense: For stealing large animals, weapons, or medicines, let the king fix a punishment, after considering the time and the purpose (for which they were destined).

verses.sanskrit: गोषु ब्राह्मणसंस्थासु छुरिकायाश्च भेदने । खरिकायाश्च पशूनां हरणे चैव सद्यः कार्योऽर्धपादिकः
verses.transliteration: goṣu brāhmaṇasaṃsthāsu churikāyāśca bhedane | kharikāyāśca paśūnāṃ haraṇe caiva sadyaḥ kāryo'rdhapādikaḥ
verses.translation: For (stealing) cows belonging to Brahmanas, piercing (the nostrils of) a barren cow, and for stealing (other) cattle (belonging to Brahmanas, the offender) shall forthwith lose half his feet.
verses.commentary: Sense: For (stealing) cows belonging to Brahmanas, piercing (the nostrils of) a barren cow, and for stealing (other) cattle (belonging to Brahmanas, the offender) shall forthwith lose half his feet.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: सूत्रकार्पासकिण्वानां गोमयस्य गुडस्य च । दध्नः क्षीरस्य तक्रस्य पानीयस्य तृणस्य च
verses.transliteration: sūtrakārpāsakiṇvānāṃ gomayasya guḍasya ca | dadhnaḥ kṣīrasya takrasya pānīyasya tṛṇasya ca
verses.translation: (For stealing) thread, cotton, drugs causing fermentation, cowdung, molasses, sour milk, sweet milk, butter-milk, water, or grass,
verses.commentary: Sense: (For stealing) thread, cotton, drugs causing fermentation, cowdung, molasses, sour milk, sweet milk, butter-milk, water, or grass,

verses.sanskrit: वेणुवैदलभाण्डानां लवणानां तथैव च । मृण्मयानां च हरणे मृदो भस्मन एव च
verses.transliteration: veṇuvaidalabhāṇḍānāṃ lavaṇānāṃ tathaiva ca | mṛṇmayānāṃ ca haraṇe mṛdo bhasmana eva ca
verses.translation: Vessels made of bamboo or other cane, salt of various kinds, earthen (vessels), earth and ashes,
verses.commentary: Sense: Vessels made of bamboo or other cane, salt of various kinds, earthen (vessels), earth and ashes,

verses.sanskrit: मत्स्यानां पक्षिणां चैव तैलस्य च घृतस्य च । मांसस्य मधुनश्चैव यच्चान्यत्पशुसम्भवम्
verses.transliteration: matsyānāṃ pakṣiṇāṃ caiva tailasya ca ghṛtasya ca | māṃsasya madhunaścaiva yaccānyatpaśusambhavam
verses.translation: Fish, birds, oil, clarified butter, meat, honey, and other things that come from beasts,
verses.commentary: Sense: Fish, birds, oil, clarified butter, meat, honey, and other things that come from beasts,

verses.sanskrit: अन्येषां चैवमादीनां मद्यानामोदनस्य च । चैवमादीनामद्यानाम् पक्वान्नानां च सर्वेषां तन्मुल्याद्द्विगुणो दमः
verses.transliteration: anyeṣāṃ caivamādīnāṃ madyānāmodanasya ca | caivamādīnāmadyānām pakvānnānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ tanmulyāddviguṇo damaḥ
verses.translation: Or other things of a similar kind, spirituous liquor, boiled rice, and every kind of cooked food, the fine (shall be) twice the value (of the stolen article).
verses.commentary: Sense: Or other things of a similar kind, spirituous liquor, boiled rice, and every kind of cooked food, the fine (shall be) twice the value (of the stolen article).

verses.sanskrit: पुष्पेषु हरिते धान्ये गुल्मवल्लीनगेषु च । अन्येष्वपरिपूतेषु दण्डः स्यात्पञ्चकृष्णलः
verses.transliteration: puṣpeṣu harite dhānye gulmavallīnageṣu ca | anyeṣvaparipūteṣu daṇḍaḥ syātpañcakṛṣṇalaḥ
verses.translation: For flowers, green corn, shrubs, creepers, trees, and other unhusked (grain) the fine (shall be) five krishnalas.
verses.commentary: Sense: For flowers, green corn, shrubs, creepers, trees, and other unhusked (grain) the fine (shall be) five krishnalas.

verses.sanskrit: परिपूतेषु धान्येषु शाकमूलफलेषु च । निरन्वये शतं दण्डः सान्वयेऽर्धशतं दमः
verses.transliteration: paripūteṣu dhānyeṣu śākamūlaphaleṣu ca | niranvaye śataṃ daṇḍaḥ sānvaye'rdhaśataṃ damaḥ
verses.translation: For husked grain, vegetables, roots, and fruit the fine (shall be) one hundred (panas) if there is no connexion (between the owner and the thief), fifty (panas) if such a connexion exists.
verses.commentary: Sense: For husked grain, vegetables, roots, and fruit the fine (shall be) one hundred (panas) if there is no connexion (between the owner and the thief), fifty (panas) if such a connexion exists.

verses.sanskrit: स्यात्साहसं त्वन्वयवत्प्रसभं कर्म यत्कृतम् । निरन्वयं भवेत्स्तेयं हृत्वाऽपव्ययते च यत्
verses.transliteration: syātsāhasaṃ tvanvayavatprasabhaṃ karma yatkṛtam | niranvayaṃ bhavetsteyaṃ hṛtvā'pavyayate ca yat
verses.translation: An offence (of this description), which is committed in the presence (of the owner) and with violence, will be robbery; if (it is committed) in his absence, it will be theft; likewise if (the possession of) anything is denied after it has been taken.
verses.commentary: Sense: An offence (of this description), which is committed in the presence (of the owner) and with violence, will be robbery; if (it is committed) in his absence, it will be theft; likewise if (the possession of) anything is denied after it has been taken.

verses.sanskrit: यस्त्वेतान्युपकॢप्तानि द्रव्याणि स्तेनयेन्नरः । तमाद्यं दण्डयेद्राजा यश्चाग्निं चोरयेद्गृहात्
verses.transliteration: yastvetānyupakḷptāni dravyāṇi stenayennaraḥ | tamādyaṃ daṇḍayedrājā yaścāgniṃ corayedgṛhāt
verses.translation: On that man who may steal (any of) the above-mentioned articles, when they are prepared for (use), let the king inflict the first (or lowest) amercement; likewise on him who may steal (a sacred) fire out of the room (in which it is kept).
verses.commentary: Sense: On that man who may steal (any of) the above-mentioned articles, when they are prepared for (use), let the king inflict the first (or lowest) amercement; likewise on him who may steal (a sacred) fire out of the room (in which it is kept).

verses.sanskrit: तं शतं येन येन यथाङ्गेन स्तेनो नृषु विचेष्टते । तत्तदेव हरेत्तस्य प्रत्यादेशाय पार्थिवः
verses.transliteration: taṃ śataṃ yena yena yathāṅgena steno nṛṣu viceṣṭate | tattadeva harettasya pratyādeśāya pārthivaḥ
verses.translation: With whatever limb a thief in any way commits (an offence) against men, even of that (the king) shall deprive him in order to prevent (a repetition of the crime).
verses.commentary: Sense: With whatever limb a thief in any way commits (an offence) against men, even of that (the king) shall deprive him in order to prevent (a repetition of the crime).

verses.sanskrit: पिताऽचार्यः सुहृत्माता भार्या पुत्रः पुरोहितः । नादण्ड्यो नाम राज्ञोऽस्ति यः स्वधर्मे न तिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: pitā'cāryaḥ suhṛtmātā bhāryā putraḥ purohitaḥ | nādaṇḍyo nāma rājño'sti yaḥ svadharme na tiṣṭhati
verses.translation: Neither a father, nor a teacher, nor a friend, nor a mother, nor a wife, nor a son, nor a domestic priest must be left unpunished by a king, if they do not keep within their duty.
verses.commentary: Sense: Neither a father, nor a teacher, nor a friend, nor a mother, nor a wife, nor a son, nor a domestic priest must be left unpunished by a king, if they do not keep within their duty.

verses.sanskrit: कार्षापणं भवेद्दण्ड्यो यत्रान्यः प्राकृतो जनः । तत्र राजा भवेद्दण्ड्यः सहस्रमिति धारणा
verses.transliteration: kārṣāpaṇaṃ bhaveddaṇḍyo yatrānyaḥ prākṛto janaḥ | tatra rājā bhaveddaṇḍyaḥ sahasramiti dhāraṇā
verses.translation: Where another common man would be fined one karshapana, the king shall be fined one thousand; that is the settled rule.
verses.commentary: Sense: Where another common man would be fined one karshapana, the king shall be fined one thousand; that is the settled rule.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: अष्टापाद्यं तु शूद्रस्य स्तेये भवति किल्बिषम् । षोडशैव तु वैश्यस्य द्वात्रिंशत्क्षत्रियस्य च
verses.transliteration: aṣṭāpādyaṃ tu śūdrasya steye bhavati kilbiṣam | ṣoḍaśaiva tu vaiśyasya dvātriṃśatkṣatriyasya ca
verses.translation: In (a case of) theft the guilt of a Sudra shall be eightfold, that of a Vaisya sixteenfold, that of a Kshatriya two-and-thirtyfold,
verses.commentary: Sense: In (a case of) theft the guilt of a Sudra shall be eightfold, that of a Vaisya sixteenfold, that of a Kshatriya two-and-thirtyfold,

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणस्य चतुःषष्टिः पूर्णं वाऽपि शतं भवेत् । द्विगुणा वा चतुःषष्टिस्तद्दोषगुणविद्धि सः
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇasya catuḥṣaṣṭiḥ pūrṇaṃ vā'pi śataṃ bhavet | dviguṇā vā catuḥṣaṣṭistaddoṣaguṇaviddhi saḥ
verses.translation: That of a Brahmana sixty-fourfold, or quite a hundredfold, or (even) twice four-and-sixtyfold; (each of them) knowing the nature of the offence.
verses.commentary: Sense: That of a Brahmana sixty-fourfold, or quite a hundredfold, or (even) twice four-and-sixtyfold; (each of them) knowing the nature of the offence.

verses.sanskrit: वानस्पत्यं मूलफलं दार्वग्न्यर्थं तथैव च । तृणं च गोभ्यो ग्रासार्थमस्तेयं मनुरब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: vānaspatyaṃ mūlaphalaṃ dārvagnyarthaṃ tathaiva ca | tṛṇaṃ ca gobhyo grāsārthamasteyaṃ manurabravīt
verses.translation: (The taking of) roots and of fruit from trees, of wood for a (sacrificial) fire, and of grass for feeding cows, Manu has declared (to be) no theft.
verses.commentary: Sense: (The taking of) roots and of fruit from trees, of wood for a (sacrificial) fire, and of grass for feeding cows, Manu has declared (to be) no theft.

verses.sanskrit: योऽदत्तादायिनो हस्तात्लिप्सेत ब्राह्मणो धनम् । याजनाध्यापनेनापि यथा स्तेनस्तथैव सः
verses.transliteration: yo'dattādāyino hastātlipseta brāhmaṇo dhanam | yājanādhyāpanenāpi yathā stenastathaiva saḥ
verses.translation: A Brahmana, seeking to obtain property from a man who took what was not given to him, either by sacrificing for him or by teaching him, is even like a thief.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Brahmana, seeking to obtain property from a man who took what was not given to him, either by sacrificing for him or by teaching him, is even like a thief.

verses.sanskrit: द्विजोऽध्वगः क्षीणवृत्तिर्द्वाविक्षू द्वे च मूलके । आददानः परक्षेत्रात्न दण्डं दातुमर्हति
verses.transliteration: dvijo'dhvagaḥ kṣīṇavṛttirdvāvikṣū dve ca mūlake | ādadānaḥ parakṣetrātna daṇḍaṃ dātumarhati
verses.translation: A twice-born man, who is travelling and whose provisions are exhausted, shall not be fined, if he takes two stalks of sugar-cane or two (esculent) roots from the field of another man.
verses.commentary: Sense: A twice-born man, who is travelling and whose provisions are exhausted, shall not be fined, if he takes two stalks of sugar-cane or two (esculent) roots from the field of another man.

verses.sanskrit: असंदितानां संदाता संदितानां च मोक्षकः । दासाश्वरथहर्ता च प्राप्तः स्याच्चोरकिल्बिषम्
verses.transliteration: asaṃditānāṃ saṃdātā saṃditānāṃ ca mokṣakaḥ | dāsāśvarathahartā ca prāptaḥ syāccorakilbiṣam
verses.translation: He who ties up unbound or sets free tied up (cattle of other men), he who takes a slave, a horse, or a carriage will have incurred the guilt of a thief.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who ties up unbound or sets free tied up (cattle of other men), he who takes a slave, a horse, or a carriage will have incurred the guilt of a thief.

verses.sanskrit: अनेन विधिना राजा कुर्वाणः स्तेननिग्रहम् । यशोऽस्मिन् प्राप्नुयात्लोके प्रेत्य चानुत्तमं सुखम्
verses.transliteration: anena vidhinā rājā kurvāṇaḥ stenanigraham | yaśo'smin prāpnuyātloke pretya cānuttamaṃ sukham
verses.translation: A king who punishes thieves according to these rules, will gain fame in this world and after death unsurpassable bliss.
verses.commentary: Sense: A king who punishes thieves according to these rules, will gain fame in this world and after death unsurpassable bliss.

verses.sanskrit: ऐन्द्रं स्थानमभिप्रेप्सुर्यशश्चाक्षयमव्ययम् । नोपेक्षेत क्षणमपि राजा साहसिकं नरम्
verses.transliteration: aindraṃ sthānamabhiprepsuryaśaścākṣayamavyayam | nopekṣeta kṣaṇamapi rājā sāhasikaṃ naram
verses.translation: A king who desires to gain the throne of Indra and imperishable eternal fame, shall not, even for a moment, neglect (to punish) the man who commits violence.
verses.commentary: Sense: A king who desires to gain the throne of Indra and imperishable eternal fame, shall not, even for a moment, neglect (to punish) the man who commits violence.

verses.sanskrit: वाग्दुष्टात्तस्कराच्चैव दण्डेनैव च हिंसतः । साहसस्य नरः कर्ता विज्ञेयः पापकृत्तमः
verses.transliteration: vāgduṣṭāttaskarāccaiva daṇḍenaiva ca hiṃsataḥ | sāhasasya naraḥ kartā vijñeyaḥ pāpakṛttamaḥ
verses.translation: He who commits violence must be considered as the worst offender, (more wicked) than a defamer, than a thief, and than he who injures (another) with a staff.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who commits violence must be considered as the worst offender, (more wicked) than a defamer, than a thief, and than he who injures (another) with a staff.

verses.sanskrit: साहसे वर्तमानं तु यो मर्षयति पार्थिवः । स विनाशं व्रजत्याशु विद्वेषं चाधिगच्छति
verses.transliteration: sāhase vartamānaṃ tu yo marṣayati pārthivaḥ | sa vināśaṃ vrajatyāśu vidveṣaṃ cādhigacchati
verses.translation: But that king who pardons the perpetrator of violence quickly perishes and incurs hatred.
verses.commentary: Sense: But that king who pardons the perpetrator of violence quickly perishes and incurs hatred.

verses.sanskrit: न मित्रकारणाद्राजा विपुलाद्वा धनागमात् । समुत्सृजेत्साहसिकान् सर्वभूतभयावहान्
verses.transliteration: na mitrakāraṇādrājā vipulādvā dhanāgamāt | samutsṛjetsāhasikān sarvabhūtabhayāvahān
verses.translation: Neither for friendship's sake, nor for the sake of great lucre, must a king let go perpetrators of violence, who cause terror to all creatures.
verses.commentary: Sense: Neither for friendship's sake, nor for the sake of great lucre, must a king let go perpetrators of violence, who cause terror to all creatures.

verses.sanskrit: शस्त्रं द्विजातिभिर्ग्राह्यं धर्मो यत्रोपरुध्यते । द्विजातीनां च वर्णानां विप्लवे कालकारिते
verses.transliteration: śastraṃ dvijātibhirgrāhyaṃ dharmo yatroparudhyate | dvijātīnāṃ ca varṇānāṃ viplave kālakārite
verses.translation: Twice-born men may take up arms when (they are) hindered (in the fulfilment of their duties, when destruction (threatens) the twice-born castes (varna) in (evil) times,
verses.commentary: Sense: Twice-born men may take up arms when (they are) hindered (in the fulfilment of their duties, when destruction (threatens) the twice-born castes (varna) in (evil) times,

verses.sanskrit: आत्मनश्च परित्राणे दक्षिणानां च सङ्गरे । स्त्रीविप्राभ्युपपत्तौ च घ्नन् धर्मेण न दुष्यति
verses.transliteration: ātmanaśca paritrāṇe dakṣiṇānāṃ ca saṅgare | strīviprābhyupapattau ca ghnan dharmeṇa na duṣyati
verses.translation: In their own defence, in a strife for the fees of officiating priests, and in order to protect women and Brahmanas; he who (under such circumstances) kills in the cause of right, commits no sin.
verses.commentary: Sense: In their own defence, in a strife for the fees of officiating priests, and in order to protect women and Brahmanas; he who (under such circumstances) kills in the cause of right, commits no sin.

verses.sanskrit: गुरुं वा बालवृद्धौ वा ब्राह्मणं वा बहुश्रुतम् । आततायिनमायान्तं हन्यादेवाविचारयन्
verses.transliteration: guruṃ vā bālavṛddhau vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā bahuśrutam | ātatāyinamāyāntaṃ hanyādevāvicārayan
verses.translation: One may slay without hesitation an assassin who approaches (with murderous intent), whether (he be one's) teacher, a child or an aged man, or a Brahmana deeply versed in the Vedas.
verses.commentary: Sense: One may slay without hesitation an assassin who approaches (with murderous intent), whether (he be one's) teacher, a child or an aged man, or a Brahmana deeply versed in the Vedas.

verses.transliteration: nātatāyivadhe doṣo hanturbhavati kaścana | prakāśaṃ vā'prakāśaṃ vā manyustaṃ manyumṛcchati
verses.translation: By killing an assassin the slayer incurs no guilt, whether (he does it) publicly or secretly; in that case fury recoils upon fury.
verses.commentary: Sense: By killing an assassin the slayer incurs no guilt, whether (he does it) publicly or secretly; in that case fury recoils upon fury.

verses.transliteration: paradārābhimarśeṣu pravṛttānnṝn mahīpatiḥ | udvejanakarairdaṇḍaiśchinnayitvā pravāsayet
verses.translation: Men who commit adultery with the wives of others, the king shall cause to be marked by punishments which cause terror, and afterwards banish.
verses.commentary: Sense: Men who commit adultery with the wives of others, the king shall cause to be marked by punishments which cause terror, and afterwards banish.

verses.transliteration: cihnayitvā) tatsamuttho hi lokasya jāyate varṇasaṅkaraḥ | yena mūlaharo'dharmaḥ sarvanāśāya kalpate
verses.translation: For by (adultery) is caused a mixture of the castes (varna) among men; thence (follows) sin, which cuts up even the roots and causes the destruction of everything.

verses.sanskrit: परस्य पत्न्या पुरुषः सम्भाषां योजयन् रहः । पूर्वमाक्षारितो दोषैः प्राप्नुयात्पूर्वसाहसम्
verses.transliteration: parasya patnyā puruṣaḥ sambhāṣāṃ yojayan rahaḥ | pūrvamākṣārito doṣaiḥ prāpnuyātpūrvasāhasam
verses.translation: A man formerly accused of (such) offences, who secretly converses with another man's wife, shall pay the first (or lowest) amercement.
verses.commentary: Sense: A man formerly accused of (such) offences, who secretly converses with another man's wife, shall pay the first (or lowest) amercement.

verses.sanskrit: यस्त्वनाक्षारितः पूर्वमभिभाषेत कारणात् । न दोषं प्राप्नुयात्किं चिन्न हि तस्य व्यतिक्रमः
verses.transliteration: yastvanākṣāritaḥ pūrvamabhibhāṣeta kāraṇāt | na doṣaṃ prāpnuyātkiṃ cinna hi tasya vyatikramaḥ
verses.translation: But a man, not before accused, who (thus) speaks with (a woman) for some (reasonable) cause, shall not incur any guilt, since in him there is no transgression.
verses.commentary: Sense: But a man, not before accused, who (thus) speaks with (a woman) for some (reasonable) cause, shall not incur any guilt, since in him there is no transgression.

verses.sanskrit: परस्त्रियं योऽभिवदेत्तीर्थेऽरण्ये वनेऽपि वा । नदीनां वाऽपि सम्भेदे स सङ्ग्रहणमाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: parastriyaṃ yo'bhivadettīrthe'raṇye vane'pi vā | nadīnāṃ vā'pi sambhede sa saṅgrahaṇamāpnuyāt
verses.translation: He who addresses the wife of another man at a Tirtha, outside the village, in a forest, or at the confluence of rivers, suffer (the punishment for) adulterous acts (samgrahana).
verses.commentary: Sense: He who addresses the wife of another man at a Tirtha, outside the village, in a forest, or at the confluence of rivers, suffer (the punishment for) adulterous acts (samgrahana).

verses.sanskrit: उपचारक्रिया केलिः स्पर्शो भूषणवाससाम् । उपकारक्रिया सह खट्वाऽसनं चैव सर्वं सङ्ग्रहणं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: upacārakriyā keliḥ sparśo bhūṣaṇavāsasām | upakārakriyā saha khaṭvā'sanaṃ caiva sarvaṃ saṅgrahaṇaṃ smṛtam
verses.translation: Offering presents (to a woman), romping (with her), touching her ornaments and dress, sitting with her on a bed, all (these acts) are considered adulterous acts (samgrahana).
verses.commentary: Sense: Offering presents (to a woman), romping (with her), touching her ornaments and dress, sitting with her on a bed, all (these acts) are considered adulterous acts (samgrahana).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रियं स्पृशेददेशे यः स्पृष्टो वा मर्षयेत्तया । परस्परस्यानुमते सर्वं सङ्ग्रहणं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: striyaṃ spṛśedadeśe yaḥ spṛṣṭo vā marṣayettayā | parasparasyānumate sarvaṃ saṅgrahaṇaṃ smṛtam
verses.translation: If one touches a woman in a place (which ought) not (to be touched) or allows (oneself to be touched in such a spot), all (such acts done) with mutual consent are declared (to be) adulterous (samgrahana).
verses.commentary: Sense: If one touches a woman in a place (which ought) not (to be touched) or allows (oneself to be touched in such a spot), all (such acts done) with mutual consent are declared (to be) adulterous (samgrahana).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: अब्राह्मणः सङ्ग्रहणे प्राणान्तं दण्डमर्हति । चतुर्णामपि वर्णानां दारा रक्ष्यतमाः सदा
verses.transliteration: abrāhmaṇaḥ saṅgrahaṇe prāṇāntaṃ daṇḍamarhati | caturṇāmapi varṇānāṃ dārā rakṣyatamāḥ sadā
verses.translation: A man who is not a Brahmana ought to suffer death for adultery (samgrahana); for the wives of all the four castes even must always be carefully guarded.
verses.commentary: Sense: A man who is not a Brahmana ought to suffer death for adultery (samgrahana); for the wives of all the four castes even must always be carefully guarded.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: भिक्षुका बन्दिनश्चैव दीक्षिताः कारवस्तथा । सम्भाषणं सह स्त्रीभिः कुर्युरप्रतिवारिताः
verses.transliteration: bhikṣukā bandinaścaiva dīkṣitāḥ kāravastathā | sambhāṣaṇaṃ saha strībhiḥ kuryuraprativāritāḥ
verses.translation: Mendicants, bards, men who have performed the initiatory ceremony of a Vedic sacrifice, and artisans are not prohibited from speaking to married women.
verses.commentary: Sense: Mendicants, bards, men who have performed the initiatory ceremony of a Vedic sacrifice, and artisans are not prohibited from speaking to married women.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: न सम्भाषां परस्त्रीभिः प्रतिषिद्धः समाचरेत् । निषिद्धो भाषमाणस्तु सुवर्णं दण्डमर्हति
verses.transliteration: na sambhāṣāṃ parastrībhiḥ pratiṣiddhaḥ samācaret | niṣiddho bhāṣamāṇastu suvarṇaṃ daṇḍamarhati
verses.translation: Let no man converse with the wives of others after he has been forbidden (to do so); but he who converses (with them), in spite of a prohibition, shall be fined one suvarna.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let no man converse with the wives of others after he has been forbidden (to do so); but he who converses (with them), in spite of a prohibition, shall be fined one suvarna.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0
verses.science: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: नैष चारणदारेषु विधिर्नात्मोपजीविषु । सज्जयन्ति हि ते नारीर्निगूढाश्चारयन्ति च
verses.transliteration: naiṣa cāraṇadāreṣu vidhirnātmopajīviṣu | sajjayanti hi te nārīrnigūḍhāścārayanti ca
verses.translation: This rule does not apply to the wives of actors and singers, nor (of) those who live on (the intrigues of) their own (wives); for such men send their wives (to others) or, concealing themselves, allow them to hold criminal intercourse.
verses.commentary: Sense: This rule does not apply to the wives of actors and singers, nor (of) those who live on (the intrigues of) their own (wives); for such men send their wives (to others) or, concealing themselves, allow them to hold criminal intercourse.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: किं चिदेव तु दाप्यः स्यात्सम्भाषां ताभिराचरन् । प्रैष्यासु चैकभक्तासु रहः प्रव्रजितासु च
verses.transliteration: kiṃ cideva tu dāpyaḥ syātsambhāṣāṃ tābhirācaran | praiṣyāsu caikabhaktāsu rahaḥ pravrajitāsu ca
verses.translation: Yet he who secretly converses with such women, or with female slaves kept by one (master), and with female ascetics, shall be compelled to pay a small fine.
verses.commentary: Sense: Yet he who secretly converses with such women, or with female slaves kept by one (master), and with female ascetics, shall be compelled to pay a small fine.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: प्रेष्यासु योऽकामां दूषयेत्कन्यां स सद्यो वधमर्हति । सकामां दूषयंस्तुल्यो न वधं प्राप्नुयान्नरः
verses.transliteration: preṣyāsu yo'kāmāṃ dūṣayetkanyāṃ sa sadyo vadhamarhati | sakāmāṃ dūṣayaṃstulyo na vadhaṃ prāpnuyānnaraḥ
verses.translation: He who violates an unwilling maiden shall instantly suffer corporal punishment; but a man who enjoys a willing maiden shall not suffer corporal punishment, if (his caste be) the same (as hers).
verses.commentary: Sense: He who violates an unwilling maiden shall instantly suffer corporal punishment; but a man who enjoys a willing maiden shall not suffer corporal punishment, if (his caste be) the same (as hers).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: कन्यां भजन्तीमुत्कृष्टं न किं चिदपि दापयेत् । जघन्यं सेवमानां तु संयतां वासयेद्गृहे
verses.transliteration: kanyāṃ bhajantīmutkṛṣṭaṃ na kiṃ cidapi dāpayet | jaghanyaṃ sevamānāṃ tu saṃyatāṃ vāsayedgṛhe
verses.translation: From a maiden who makes advances to a (man of) high (caste), he shall not take any fine; but her, who courts a (man of) low (caste), let him force to live confined in her house.
verses.commentary: Sense: From a maiden who makes advances to a (man of) high (caste), he shall not take any fine; but her, who courts a (man of) low (caste), let him force to live confined in her house.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0
verses.science: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: उत्तमां सेवमानस्तु जघन्यो वधमर्हति । शुल्कं दद्यात्सेवमानः समामिच्छेत्पिता यदि
verses.transliteration: uttamāṃ sevamānastu jaghanyo vadhamarhati | śulkaṃ dadyātsevamānaḥ samāmicchetpitā yadi
verses.translation: A (man of) low (caste) who makes love to a maiden (of) the highest (caste) shall suffer corporal punishment; he who addresses a maiden (on) equal (caste) shall pay the nuptial fee, if her father desires it.
verses.commentary: Sense: A (man of) low (caste) who makes love to a maiden (of) the highest (caste) shall suffer corporal punishment; he who addresses a maiden (on) equal (caste) shall pay the nuptial fee, if her father desires it.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: अभिषह्य तु यः कन्यां कुर्याद्दर्पेण मानवः । तस्याशु कर्त्ये अङ्गुल्यौ दण्डं चार्हति षट्शतम्
verses.transliteration: abhiṣahya tu yaḥ kanyāṃ kuryāddarpeṇa mānavaḥ | tasyāśu kartye aṅgulyau daṇḍaṃ cārhati ṣaṭśatam
verses.translation: But if any man through insolence forcibly contaminates a maiden, two of his fingers shall be instantly cut off, and he shall pay a fine of six hundred (panas).
verses.commentary: Sense: But if any man through insolence forcibly contaminates a maiden, two of his fingers shall be instantly cut off, and he shall pay a fine of six hundred (panas).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: कर्त्या अङ्गुल्यो सकामां दूषयंस्तुल्यो नाङ्गुलिछेदमाप्नुयात् । द्विशतं तु दमं दाप्यः प्रसङ्गविनिवृत्तये
verses.transliteration: kartyā aṅgulyo sakāmāṃ dūṣayaṃstulyo nāṅgulichedamāpnuyāt | dviśataṃ tu damaṃ dāpyaḥ prasaṅgavinivṛttaye
verses.translation: A man (of) equal (caste) who defiles a willing maiden shall not suffer the amputation of his fingers, but shall pay a fine of two hundred (panas) in order to deter him from a repetition (of the offence).
verses.commentary: Sense: A man (of) equal (caste) who defiles a willing maiden shall not suffer the amputation of his fingers, but shall pay a fine of two hundred (panas) in order to deter him from a repetition (of the offence).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: कन्यैव कन्यां या कुर्यात्तस्याः स्याद्द्विशतो दमः । शुल्कं च द्विगुणं दद्यात्शिफाश्चैवाप्नुयाद्दश
verses.transliteration: kanyaiva kanyāṃ yā kuryāttasyāḥ syāddviśato damaḥ | śulkaṃ ca dviguṇaṃ dadyātśiphāścaivāpnuyāddaśa
verses.translation: A damsel who pollutes (another) damsel must be fined two hundred (panas), pay the double of her (nuptial) fee, and receive ten (lashes with a) rod.
verses.commentary: Sense: A damsel who pollutes (another) damsel must be fined two hundred (panas), pay the double of her (nuptial) fee, and receive ten (lashes with a) rod.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: या तु कन्यां प्रकुर्यात्स्त्री सा सद्यो मौण्ड्यमर्हति । अङ्गुल्योरेव वा छेदं खरेणोद्वहनं तथा
verses.transliteration: yā tu kanyāṃ prakuryātstrī sā sadyo mauṇḍyamarhati | aṅgulyoreva vā chedaṃ khareṇodvahanaṃ tathā
verses.translation: But a woman who pollutes a damsel shall instantly have (her head) shaved or two fingers cut off, and be made to ride (through the town) on a donkey.
verses.commentary: Sense: But a woman who pollutes a damsel shall instantly have (her head) shaved or two fingers cut off, and be made to ride (through the town) on a donkey.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: भर्तारं लङ्घयेद्या तु स्त्री ज्ञातिगुणदर्पिता । तां श्वभिः खादयेद्राजा संस्थाने बहुसंस्थिते
verses.transliteration: bhartāraṃ laṅghayedyā tu strī jñātiguṇadarpitā | tāṃ śvabhiḥ khādayedrājā saṃsthāne bahusaṃsthite
verses.translation: If a wife, proud of the greatness of her relatives or (her own) excellence, violates the duty which she owes to her lord, the king shall cause her to be devoured by dogs in a place frequented by many.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a wife, proud of the greatness of her relatives or (her own) excellence, violates the duty which she owes to her lord, the king shall cause her to be devoured by dogs in a place frequented by many.

verses.sanskrit: पुमांसं दाहयेत्पापं शयने तप्त आयसे । अभ्यादध्युश्च काष्ठानि तत्र दह्येत पापकृत्
verses.transliteration: pumāṃsaṃ dāhayetpāpaṃ śayane tapta āyase | abhyādadhyuśca kāṣṭhāni tatra dahyeta pāpakṛt
verses.translation: Let him cause the male offender to be burnt on a red-hot iron bed; they shall put logs under it, (until) the sinner is burned (to death).
verses.commentary: Sense: Let him cause the male offender to be burnt on a red-hot iron bed; they shall put logs under it, (until) the sinner is burned (to death).

verses.sanskrit: संवत्सराभिशस्तस्य दुष्टस्य द्विगुणो दमः । संवत्सरेऽभिशस्तस्य व्रात्यया सह संवासे चाण्डाल्या तावदेव तु
verses.transliteration: saṃvatsarābhiśastasya duṣṭasya dviguṇo damaḥ | saṃvatsare'bhiśastasya vrātyayā saha saṃvāse cāṇḍālyā tāvadeva tu
verses.translation: On a man (once) convicted, who is (again) accused within a year, a double fine (must be inflicted); even thus (must the fine be doubled) for (repeated) intercourse with a Vratya and a Kandali.
verses.commentary: Sense: On a man (once) convicted, who is (again) accused within a year, a double fine (must be inflicted); even thus (must the fine be doubled) for (repeated) intercourse with a Vratya and a Kandali.

verses.sanskrit: शूद्रो गुप्तमगुप्तं वा द्वैजातं वर्णमावसन् । अगुप्तमङ्गसर्वस्वैर्गुप्तं सर्वेण हीयते
verses.transliteration: śūdro guptamaguptaṃ vā dvaijātaṃ varṇamāvasan | aguptamaṅgasarvasvairguptaṃ sarveṇa hīyate
verses.translation: A Sudra who has intercourse with a woman of a twice-born caste (varna), guarded or unguarded, (shall be punished in the following manner): if she was unguarded, he loses the part (offending) and all his property; if she was guarded, everything (even his life).
verses.commentary: Sense: A Sudra who has intercourse with a woman of a twice-born caste (varna), guarded or unguarded, (shall be punished in the following manner): if she was unguarded, he loses the part (offending) and all his property; if she was guarded, everything (even his life).

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गसर्वस्वी वैश्यः सर्वस्वदण्डः स्यात्संवत्सरनिरोधतः । सहस्रं क्षत्रियो दण्ड्यो मौण्ड्यं मूत्रेण चार्हति
verses.transliteration: aṅgasarvasvī vaiśyaḥ sarvasvadaṇḍaḥ syātsaṃvatsaranirodhataḥ | sahasraṃ kṣatriyo daṇḍyo mauṇḍyaṃ mūtreṇa cārhati
verses.translation: (For intercourse with a guarded Brahmana a Vaisya shall forfeit all his property after imprisonment for a year; a Kshatriya shall be fined one thousand (panas) and be shaved with the urine (of an ass).
verses.commentary: Sense: (For intercourse with a guarded Brahmana a Vaisya shall forfeit all his property after imprisonment for a year; a Kshatriya shall be fined one thousand (panas) and be shaved with the urine (of an ass).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणीं यद्यगुप्तां तु गच्छेतां वैश्यपार्थिवौ । वैश्यं पञ्चशतं कुर्यात्क्षत्रियं तु सहस्रिणम्
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇīṃ yadyaguptāṃ tu gacchetāṃ vaiśyapārthivau | vaiśyaṃ pañcaśataṃ kuryātkṣatriyaṃ tu sahasriṇam
verses.translation: If a Vaisya or a Kshatriya has connexion with an unguarded Brahmana, let him fine the Vaisya five hundred (panas) and the Kshatriya one thousand.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a Vaisya or a Kshatriya has connexion with an unguarded Brahmana, let him fine the Vaisya five hundred (panas) and the Kshatriya one thousand.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: उभावपि तु तावेव ब्राह्मण्या गुप्तया सह । विप्लुतौ शूद्रवद्दण्ड्यौ दग्धव्यौ वा कटाग्निना
verses.transliteration: ubhāvapi tu tāveva brāhmaṇyā guptayā saha | viplutau śūdravaddaṇḍyau dagdhavyau vā kaṭāgninā
verses.translation: But even these two, if they offend with a Brahmani (not only) guarded (but the wife of an eminent man), shall be punished like a Sudra or be burnt in a fire of dry grass.
verses.commentary: Sense: But even these two, if they offend with a Brahmani (not only) guarded (but the wife of an eminent man), shall be punished like a Sudra or be burnt in a fire of dry grass.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रं ब्राह्मणो दण्ड्यो गुप्तां विप्रां बलाद्व्रजन् । शतानि पञ्च दण्ड्यः स्यादिच्छन्त्या सह सङ्गतः
verses.transliteration: sahasraṃ brāhmaṇo daṇḍyo guptāṃ viprāṃ balādvrajan | śatāni pañca daṇḍyaḥ syādicchantyā saha saṅgataḥ
verses.translation: A Brahmana who carnally knows a guarded Brahmani against her will, shall be fined one thousand (panas); but he shall be made to pay five hundred, if he had connexion with a willing one.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Brahmana who carnally knows a guarded Brahmani against her will, shall be fined one thousand (panas); but he shall be made to pay five hundred, if he had connexion with a willing one.

verses.sanskrit: मौण्ड्यं प्राणान्तिकं दण्डो ब्राह्मणस्य विधीयते । प्राणान्तको इतरेषां तु वर्णानां दण्डः प्राणान्तिको भवेत्
verses.transliteration: mauṇḍyaṃ prāṇāntikaṃ daṇḍo brāhmaṇasya vidhīyate | prāṇāntako itareṣāṃ tu varṇānāṃ daṇḍaḥ prāṇāntiko bhavet
verses.translation: Tonsure (of the head) is ordained for a Brahmana (instead of) capital punishment; but (men of) other castes shall suffer capital punishment.
verses.commentary: Sense: Tonsure (of the head) is ordained for a Brahmana (instead of) capital punishment; but (men of) other castes shall suffer capital punishment.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: प्राणान्तको न जातु ब्राह्मणं हन्यात्सर्वपापेष्वपि स्थितम् । राष्ट्रादेनं बहिः कुर्यात्समग्रधनमक्षतम्
verses.transliteration: prāṇāntako na jātu brāhmaṇaṃ hanyātsarvapāpeṣvapi sthitam | rāṣṭrādenaṃ bahiḥ kuryātsamagradhanamakṣatam
verses.translation: Let him never slay a Brahmana, though he have committed all (possible) crimes; let him banish such an (offender), leaving all his property (to him) and (his body) unhurt.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let him never slay a Brahmana, though he have committed all (possible) crimes; let him banish such an (offender), leaving all his property (to him) and (his body) unhurt.

verses.sanskrit: न ब्राह्मणवधाद्भूयानधर्मो विद्यते भुवि । तस्मादस्य वधं राजा मनसाऽपि न चिन्तयेत्
verses.transliteration: na brāhmaṇavadhādbhūyānadharmo vidyate bhuvi | tasmādasya vadhaṃ rājā manasā'pi na cintayet
verses.translation: No greater crime is known on earth than slaying a Brahmana; a king, therefore, must not even conceive in his mind the thought of killing a Brahmana.
verses.commentary: Sense: No greater crime is known on earth than slaying a Brahmana; a king, therefore, must not even conceive in his mind the thought of killing a Brahmana.

verses.sanskrit: वैश्यश्चेत्क्षत्रियां गुप्तां वैश्यां वा क्षत्रियो व्रजेत् । यो ब्राह्मण्यामगुप्तायां तावुभौ दण्डमर्हतः
verses.transliteration: vaiśyaścetkṣatriyāṃ guptāṃ vaiśyāṃ vā kṣatriyo vrajet | yo brāhmaṇyāmaguptāyāṃ tāvubhau daṇḍamarhataḥ
verses.translation: If a Vaisya approaches a guarded female of the Kshatriya caste, or a Kshatriya a (guarded) Vaisya woman, they both deserve the same punishment as in the case of an unguarded Brahmana female.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a Vaisya approaches a guarded female of the Kshatriya caste, or a Kshatriya a (guarded) Vaisya woman, they both deserve the same punishment as in the case of an unguarded Brahmana female.

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रं ब्राह्मणो दण्डं दाप्यो गुप्ते तु ते व्रजन् । शूद्रायां क्षत्रियविशोः साहस्रो वै भवेद्दमः
verses.transliteration: sahasraṃ brāhmaṇo daṇḍaṃ dāpyo gupte tu te vrajan | śūdrāyāṃ kṣatriyaviśoḥ sāhasro vai bhaveddamaḥ
verses.translation: A Brahmana shall be compelled to pay a fine of one thousand (panas) if he has intercourse with guarded (females of) those two (castes); for (offending with) a (guarded) Sudra female a fine of one thousand (panas shall be inflicted) on a Kshatriya or a Vaisya.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Brahmana shall be compelled to pay a fine of one thousand (panas) if he has intercourse with guarded (females of) those two (castes); for (offending with) a (guarded) Sudra female a fine of one thousand (panas shall be inflicted) on a Kshatriya or a Vaisya.

verses.sanskrit: शूद्राया क्षत्रियायामगुप्तायां वैश्ये पञ्चशतं दमः । मूत्रेण मौण्ड्यमिच्छेत्तु क्षत्रियो दण्डमेव वा
verses.transliteration: śūdrāyā kṣatriyāyāmaguptāyāṃ vaiśye pañcaśataṃ damaḥ | mūtreṇa mauṇḍyamicchettu kṣatriyo daṇḍameva vā
verses.translation: For (intercourse with) an unguarded Kshatriya a fine of five hundred (panas shall fall) on a Vaisya; but (for the same offence) a Kshatriya shall be shaved with the urine (of a donkey) or (pay) the same fine.
verses.commentary: Sense: For (intercourse with) an unguarded Kshatriya a fine of five hundred (panas shall fall) on a Vaisya; but (for the same offence) a Kshatriya shall be shaved with the urine (of a donkey) or (pay) the same fine.

verses.sanskrit: ऋच्छेत्तु अगुप्ते क्षत्रियावैश्ये शूद्रां वा ब्राह्मणो व्रजन् । शतानि पञ्च दण्ड्यः स्यात्सहस्रं त्वन्त्यजस्त्रियम्
verses.transliteration: ṛcchettu agupte kṣatriyāvaiśye śūdrāṃ vā brāhmaṇo vrajan | śatāni pañca daṇḍyaḥ syātsahasraṃ tvantyajastriyam
verses.translation: A Brahmana who approaches unguarded females (of the) Kshatriya or Vaisya (castes), or a Sudra female, shall be fined five hundred (panas); but (for intercourse with) a female (of the) lowest (castes), one thousand.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Brahmana who approaches unguarded females (of the) Kshatriya or Vaisya (castes), or a Sudra female, shall be fined five hundred (panas); but (for intercourse with) a female (of the) lowest (castes), one thousand.

verses.sanskrit: यस्य स्तेनः पुरे नास्ति नान्यस्त्रीगो न दुष्टवाक् । न साहसिकदण्डघ्नो स राजा शक्रलोकभाक्
verses.transliteration: yasya stenaḥ pure nāsti nānyastrīgo na duṣṭavāk | na sāhasikadaṇḍaghno sa rājā śakralokabhāk
verses.translation: That king in whose town lives no thief, no adulterer, no defamer, no man guilty of violence, and no committer of assaults, attains the world of Sakra (Indra).
verses.commentary: Sense: That king in whose town lives no thief, no adulterer, no defamer, no man guilty of violence, and no committer of assaults, attains the world of Sakra (Indra).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: एतेषां निग्रहो राज्ञः पञ्चानां विषये स्वके । सांराज्यकृत्सजात्येषु लोके चैव यशस्करः
verses.transliteration: eteṣāṃ nigraho rājñaḥ pañcānāṃ viṣaye svake | sāṃrājyakṛtsajātyeṣu loke caiva yaśaskaraḥ
verses.translation: The suppression of those five in his dominions secures to a king paramount sovereignty among his peers and fame in the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: The suppression of those five in his dominions secures to a king paramount sovereignty among his peers and fame in the world.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: ऋत्विजं यस्त्यजेद्याज्यो याज्यं चर्त्विक्त्यजेद्यदि । शक्तं कर्मण्यदुष्टं च तयोर्दण्डः शतं शतम्
verses.transliteration: ṛtvijaṃ yastyajedyājyo yājyaṃ cartviktyajedyadi | śaktaṃ karmaṇyaduṣṭaṃ ca tayordaṇḍaḥ śataṃ śatam
verses.translation: A sacrificer who forsakes an officiating priest, and an officiating priest who forsakes a sacrificer, (each being) able to perform his work and not contaminated (by grievous crimes), must each be fined one hundred (panas).
verses.commentary: Sense: A sacrificer who forsakes an officiating priest, and an officiating priest who forsakes a sacrificer, (each being) able to perform his work and not contaminated (by grievous crimes), must each be fined one hundred (panas).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: न माता न पिता न स्त्री न पुत्रस्त्यागमर्हति । त्यजन्नपतितानेतान् राज्ञा दण्ड्यः शतानि षट्
verses.transliteration: na mātā na pitā na strī na putrastyāgamarhati | tyajannapatitānetān rājñā daṇḍyaḥ śatāni ṣaṭ
verses.translation: Neither a mother, nor a father, nor a wife, nor a son shall be cast off; he who casts them off, unless guilty of a crime causing loss of caste, shall be fined six hundred (panas).
verses.commentary: Sense: Neither a mother, nor a father, nor a wife, nor a son shall be cast off; he who casts them off, unless guilty of a crime causing loss of caste, shall be fined six hundred (panas).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: आश्रमेषु द्विजातीनां कार्ये विवदतां मिथः । न विब्रूयान्नृपो धर्मं चिकीर्षन् हितमात्मनः
verses.transliteration: āśrameṣu dvijātīnāṃ kārye vivadatāṃ mithaḥ | na vibrūyānnṛpo dharmaṃ cikīrṣan hitamātmanaḥ
verses.translation: If twice-born men dispute among each other concerning the duty of the orders, a king who desires his own welfare should not (hastily) decide (what is) the law.
verses.commentary: Sense: If twice-born men dispute among each other concerning the duty of the orders, a king who desires his own welfare should not (hastily) decide (what is) the law.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: यथार्हमेतानभ्यर्च्य ब्राह्मणैः सह पार्थिवः । सान्त्वेन प्रशमय्यादौ स्वधर्मं प्रतिपादयेत्
verses.transliteration: yathārhametānabhyarcya brāhmaṇaiḥ saha pārthivaḥ | sāntvena praśamayyādau svadharmaṃ pratipādayet
verses.translation: Having shown them due honor, he should, with (the assistance of) Brahmanas, first soothe them by gentle (speech) and afterwards teach them their duty.
verses.commentary: Sense: Having shown them due honor, he should, with (the assistance of) Brahmanas, first soothe them by gentle (speech) and afterwards teach them their duty.

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिवेश्यानुवेश्यौ च कल्याणे विंशतिद्विजे । अर्हावभोजयन् विप्रो दण्डमर्हति माषकम्
verses.transliteration: prativeśyānuveśyau ca kalyāṇe viṃśatidvije | arhāvabhojayan vipro daṇḍamarhati māṣakam
verses.translation: A Brahmana who does not invite his next neighbour and his neighbour next but one, (though) both (he) worthy (of the honour), to a festival at which twenty Brahmanas are entertained, is liable to a fine of one masha.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Brahmana who does not invite his next neighbour and his neighbour next but one, (though) both (he) worthy (of the honour), to a festival at which twenty Brahmanas are entertained, is liable to a fine of one masha.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: श्रोत्रियः श्रोत्रियं साधुं भूतिकृत्येष्वभोजयन् । तदन्नं द्विगुणं दाप्यो हिरण्यं चैव माषकम्
verses.transliteration: śrotriyaḥ śrotriyaṃ sādhuṃ bhūtikṛtyeṣvabhojayan | tadannaṃ dviguṇaṃ dāpyo hiraṇyaṃ caiva māṣakam
verses.translation: A Srotriya who does not entertain a virtuous Srotriya at auspicious festive rites, shall be made to pay him twice (the value of) the meal and a masha of gold (as a fine to the king).
verses.commentary: Sense: A Srotriya who does not entertain a virtuous Srotriya at auspicious festive rites, shall be made to pay him twice (the value of) the meal and a masha of gold (as a fine to the king).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: हैरण्यं अन्धो जडः पीठसर्पी सप्तत्या स्थविरश्च यः । श्रोत्रियेषूपकुर्वंश्च न दाप्याः केन चित्करम्
verses.transliteration: hairaṇyaṃ andho jaḍaḥ pīṭhasarpī saptatyā sthaviraśca yaḥ | śrotriyeṣūpakurvaṃśca na dāpyāḥ kena citkaram
verses.translation: A blind man, an idiot, (a cripple) who moves with the help of a board, a man full seventy years old, and he who confers benefits on Srotriyas, shall not be compelled by any (king) to pay a tax.
verses.commentary: Sense: A blind man, an idiot, (a cripple) who moves with the help of a board, a man full seventy years old, and he who confers benefits on Srotriyas, shall not be compelled by any (king) to pay a tax.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: श्रोत्रियं व्याधितार्तौ च बालवृद्धावकिञ्चनम् । महाकुलीनमार्यं च राजा सम्पूजयेत्सदा
verses.transliteration: śrotriyaṃ vyādhitārtau ca bālavṛddhāvakiñcanam | mahākulīnamāryaṃ ca rājā sampūjayetsadā
verses.translation: Let the king always treat kindly a Srotriya, a sick or distressed man, an infant and an aged or indigent man, a man of high birth, and an honourable man (Arya).
verses.commentary: Sense: Let the king always treat kindly a Srotriya, a sick or distressed man, an infant and an aged or indigent man, a man of high birth, and an honourable man (Arya).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: शाल्मलीफलके श्लक्ष्णे नेनिज्यान्नेजकः शनैः । न च वासांसि वासोभिर्निर्हरेन्न च वासयेत्
verses.transliteration: śālmalīphalake ślakṣṇe nenijyānnejakaḥ śanaiḥ | na ca vāsāṃsi vāsobhirnirharenna ca vāsayet
verses.translation: A washerman shall wash (the clothes of his employers) gently on a smooth board of Salmaliwood he shall not return the clothes (of one person) for those (of another), nor allow anybody (but the owner) to wear them.
verses.commentary: Sense: A washerman shall wash (the clothes of his employers) gently on a smooth board of Salmaliwood he shall not return the clothes (of one person) for those (of another), nor allow anybody (but the owner) to wear them.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: तन्तुवायो दशपलं दद्यादेकपलाधिकम् । अतोऽन्यथा वर्तमानो दाप्यो द्वादशकं दमम्
verses.transliteration: tantuvāyo daśapalaṃ dadyādekapalādhikam | ato'nyathā vartamāno dāpyo dvādaśakaṃ damam
verses.translation: A weaver (who has received) ten palas (of thread), shall return (cloth weighing) one pala more; he who acts differently shall be compelled to pay a fine of twelve (panas).
verses.commentary: Sense: A weaver (who has received) ten palas (of thread), shall return (cloth weighing) one pala more; he who acts differently shall be compelled to pay a fine of twelve (panas).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0
verses.science: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शुल्कस्थानेषु कुशलाः सर्वपण्यविचक्षणाः । कुर्युरर्घं यथापण्यं ततो विंशं नृपो हरेत्
verses.transliteration: śulkasthāneṣu kuśalāḥ sarvapaṇyavicakṣaṇāḥ | kuryurarghaṃ yathāpaṇyaṃ tato viṃśaṃ nṛpo haret
verses.translation: Let the king take one-twentieth of that (amount) which men, well acquainted with the settlement of tolls and duties (and) skilful in (estimating the value of) all kinds of merchandise, may fix as the value for each saleable commodity.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let the king take one-twentieth of that (amount) which men, well acquainted with the settlement of tolls and duties (and) skilful in (estimating the value of) all kinds of merchandise, may fix as the value for each saleable commodity.

verses.sanskrit: राज्ञः प्रख्यातभाण्डानि प्रतिषिद्धानि यानि च । ताणि निर्हरतो लोभात्सर्वहारं हरेन्नृपः
verses.transliteration: rājñaḥ prakhyātabhāṇḍāni pratiṣiddhāni yāni ca | tāṇi nirharato lobhātsarvahāraṃ harennṛpaḥ
verses.translation: Let the king confiscate the whole property of (a trader) who out of greed exports goods of which the king has a monopoly or (the export of which is) forbidden.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let the king confiscate the whole property of (a trader) who out of greed exports goods of which the king has a monopoly or (the export of which is) forbidden.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: शुल्कस्थानं परिहरन्नकाले क्रयविक्रयी । मिथ्यावादी च सङ्ख्याने दाप्योऽष्टगुणमत्ययम्
verses.transliteration: śulkasthānaṃ pariharannakāle krayavikrayī | mithyāvādī ca saṅkhyāne dāpyo'ṣṭaguṇamatyayam
verses.translation: He who avoids a custom-house (or a toll), he who buys or sells at an improper time, or he who makes a false statement in enumerating (his goods), shall be fined eight times (the amount of duty) which he tried to evade.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who avoids a custom-house (or a toll), he who buys or sells at an improper time, or he who makes a false statement in enumerating (his goods), shall be fined eight times (the amount of duty) which he tried to evade.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: आगमं निर्गमं स्थानं तथा वृद्धिक्षयावुभौ । विचार्य सर्वपण्यानां कारयेत्क्रयविक्रयौ
verses.transliteration: āgamaṃ nirgamaṃ sthānaṃ tathā vṛddhikṣayāvubhau | vicārya sarvapaṇyānāṃ kārayetkrayavikrayau
verses.translation: Let (the king) fix (the rates for) the purchase and sale of all marketable goods, having (duly) considered whence they come, whither they go, how long they have been kept, the (probable) profit and the (probable) outlay.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let (the king) fix (the rates for) the purchase and sale of all marketable goods, having (duly) considered whence they come, whither they go, how long they have been kept, the (probable) profit and the (probable) outlay.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चरात्रे पञ्चरात्रे पक्षे पक्षेऽथ वा गते । कुर्वीत चैषां प्रत्यक्षमर्घसंस्थापनं नृपः
verses.transliteration: pañcarātre pañcarātre pakṣe pakṣe'tha vā gate | kurvīta caiṣāṃ pratyakṣamarghasaṃsthāpanaṃ nṛpaḥ
verses.translation: Once in five nights, or at the close of each fortnight, let the king publicly settle the prices for the (merchants).
verses.commentary: Sense: Once in five nights, or at the close of each fortnight, let the king publicly settle the prices for the (merchants).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: तुलामानं प्रतीमानं सर्वं च स्यात्सुलक्षितम् । षट्सु षट्सु च मासेषु पुनरेव परीक्षयेत्
verses.transliteration: tulāmānaṃ pratīmānaṃ sarvaṃ ca syātsulakṣitam | ṣaṭsu ṣaṭsu ca māseṣu punareva parīkṣayet
verses.translation: All weights and measures must be duly marked, and once in six months let him re-examine them.
verses.commentary: Sense: All weights and measures must be duly marked, and once in six months let him re-examine them.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: पणं यानं तरे दाप्यं पौरुषोऽर्धपणं तरे । पादं पशुश्च योषित्च पादार्धं रिक्तकः पुमान्
verses.transliteration: paṇaṃ yānaṃ tare dāpyaṃ pauruṣo'rdhapaṇaṃ tare | pādaṃ paśuśca yoṣitca pādārdhaṃ riktakaḥ pumān
verses.translation: At a ferry an (empty) cart shall be made to pay one pana, a man's (load) half a pana, an animal and a woman one quarter of a (pana), an unloaded man one-half of a quarter.
verses.commentary: Sense: At a ferry an (empty) cart shall be made to pay one pana, a man's (load) half a pana, an animal and a woman one quarter of a (pana), an unloaded man one-half of a quarter.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: पादे भाण्डपूर्णानि यानानि तार्यं दाप्यानि सारतः । रिक्तभाण्डानि यत्किं चित्पुमांसश्चपरिच्छदाः
verses.transliteration: pāde bhāṇḍapūrṇāni yānāni tāryaṃ dāpyāni sārataḥ | riktabhāṇḍāni yatkiṃ citpumāṃsaścaparicchadāḥ
verses.translation: Carts (laden) with vessels full (of merchandise) shall be made to pay toll at a ferry according to the value (of the goods), empty vessels and men without luggage some trifle.
verses.commentary: Sense: Carts (laden) with vessels full (of merchandise) shall be made to pay toll at a ferry according to the value (of the goods), empty vessels and men without luggage some trifle.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: दीर्घाध्वनि यथादेशं यथाकालं तरो भवेत् । नदीतीरेषु तद्विद्यात्समुद्रे नास्ति लक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: dīrghādhvani yathādeśaṃ yathākālaṃ taro bhavet | nadītīreṣu tadvidyātsamudre nāsti lakṣaṇam
verses.translation: For a long passage the boat-hire must be proportioned to the places and times; know that this (rule refers) to (passages along) the banks of rivers; at sea there is no settled (freight).
verses.commentary: Sense: For a long passage the boat-hire must be proportioned to the places and times; know that this (rule refers) to (passages along) the banks of rivers; at sea there is no settled (freight).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: गर्भिणी तु द्विमासादिस्तथा प्रव्रजितो मुनिः । ब्राह्मणा लिङ्गिनश्चैव न दाप्यास्तारिकं तरे
verses.transliteration: garbhiṇī tu dvimāsādistathā pravrajito muniḥ | brāhmaṇā liṅginaścaiva na dāpyāstārikaṃ tare
verses.translation: But a woman who has been pregnant two months or more, an ascetic, a hermit in the forest, and Brahmanas who are students of the Veda, shall not be made to pay toll at a ferry.
verses.commentary: Sense: But a woman who has been pregnant two months or more, an ascetic, a hermit in the forest, and Brahmanas who are students of the Veda, shall not be made to pay toll at a ferry.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: यन्नावि किं चिद्दाशानां विशीर्येतापराधतः । तद्दाशैरेव दातव्यं समागम्य स्वतोऽंशतः
verses.transliteration: yannāvi kiṃ ciddāśānāṃ viśīryetāparādhataḥ | taddāśaireva dātavyaṃ samāgamya svato'ṃśataḥ
verses.translation: Whatever may be damaged in a boat by the fault of the boatmen, that shall be made good by the boatmen collectively, (each paying) his share.
verses.commentary: Sense: Whatever may be damaged in a boat by the fault of the boatmen, that shall be made good by the boatmen collectively, (each paying) his share.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: एष नौयायिनामुक्तो व्यवहारस्य निर्णयः । दाशापराधतस्तोये दैविके नास्ति निग्रहः
verses.transliteration: eṣa nauyāyināmukto vyavahārasya nirṇayaḥ | dāśāparādhatastoye daivike nāsti nigrahaḥ
verses.translation: This decision in suits (brought) by passengers (holds good only) in case the boatmen are culpably negligent on the water; in the case of (an accident) caused by (the will of) the gods, no fine can be (inflicted on them).
verses.commentary: Sense: This decision in suits (brought) by passengers (holds good only) in case the boatmen are culpably negligent on the water; in the case of (an accident) caused by (the will of) the gods, no fine can be (inflicted on them).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: वाणिज्यं कारयेद्वैश्यं कुसीदं कृषिमेव च । पशूनां रक्षणं चैव दास्यं शूद्रं द्विजन्मनाम्
verses.transliteration: vāṇijyaṃ kārayedvaiśyaṃ kusīdaṃ kṛṣimeva ca | paśūnāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ caiva dāsyaṃ śūdraṃ dvijanmanām
verses.translation: (The king) should order a Vaisya to trade, to lend money, to cultivate the land, or to tend cattle, and a Sudra to serve the twice-born castes
verses.commentary: Sense: (The king) should order a Vaisya to trade, to lend money, to cultivate the land, or to tend cattle, and a Sudra to serve the twice-born castes
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0
verses.science: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: क्षत्रियं चैव वैश्यं च ब्राह्मणो वृत्तिकर्शितौ । बिभृयादानृशंस्येन स्वानि कर्माणि कारयेत्
verses.transliteration: kṣatriyaṃ caiva vaiśyaṃ ca brāhmaṇo vṛttikarśitau | bibhṛyādānṛśaṃsyena svāni karmāṇi kārayet
verses.translation: (Some wealthy) Brahmana shall compassionately support both a Kshatriya and a Vaisya, if they are distressed for a livelihood, employing them on work (which is suitable for) their (castes).
verses.commentary: Sense: (Some wealthy) Brahmana shall compassionately support both a Kshatriya and a Vaisya, if they are distressed for a livelihood, employing them on work (which is suitable for) their (castes).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0
verses.science: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: दास्यं तु कारयन्लोभाद्ब्राह्मणः संस्कृतान् द्विजान् । अनिच्छतः प्राभवत्याद्राज्ञा दण्ड्यः शतानि षट्
verses.transliteration: dāsyaṃ tu kārayanlobhādbrāhmaṇaḥ saṃskṛtān dvijān | anicchataḥ prābhavatyādrājñā daṇḍyaḥ śatāni ṣaṭ
verses.translation: But a Brahmana who, because he is powerful, out of greed makes initiated (men of the) twice-born (castes) against their will do the work of slaves, shall be fined by the king six hundred (panas).
verses.commentary: Sense: But a Brahmana who, because he is powerful, out of greed makes initiated (men of the) twice-born (castes) against their will do the work of slaves, shall be fined by the king six hundred (panas).

verses.sanskrit: शूद्रं तु कारयेद्दास्यं क्रीतमक्रीतमेव वा । दास्यायैव हि सृष्टोऽसौ ब्राह्मणस्य स्वयम्भुवा
verses.transliteration: śūdraṃ tu kārayeddāsyaṃ krītamakrītameva vā | dāsyāyaiva hi sṛṣṭo'sau brāhmaṇasya svayambhuvā
verses.translation: But a Sudra, whether bought or unbought, he may compel to do servile work; for he was created by the Self-existent (Svayambhu) to be the slave of a Brahmana.
verses.commentary: Sense: But a Sudra, whether bought or unbought, he may compel to do servile work; for he was created by the Self-existent (Svayambhu) to be the slave of a Brahmana.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: न स्वामिना निसृष्टोऽपि शूद्रो दास्याद्विमुच्यते । निसर्गजं हि तत्तस्य कस्तस्मात्तदपोहति
verses.transliteration: na svāminā nisṛṣṭo'pi śūdro dāsyādvimucyate | nisargajaṃ hi tattasya kastasmāttadapohati
verses.translation: A Sudra, though emancipated by his master, is not released from servitude; since that is innate in him, who can set him free from it?
verses.commentary: Sense: A Sudra, though emancipated by his master, is not released from servitude; since that is innate in him, who can set him free from it?
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: ध्वजाहृतो भक्तदासो गृहजः क्रीतदत्त्रिमौ । पैत्रिको दण्डदासश्च सप्तैते दासयोनयः
verses.transliteration: dhvajāhṛto bhaktadāso gṛhajaḥ krītadattrimau | paitriko daṇḍadāsaśca saptaite dāsayonayaḥ
verses.translation: There are slaves of seven kinds, (viz.) he who is made a captive under a standard, he who serves for his daily food, he who is born in the house, he who is bought and he who is given, he who is inherited from ancestors, and he who is enslaved by way of punishment.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are slaves of seven kinds, (viz.) he who is made a captive under a standard, he who serves for his daily food, he who is born in the house, he who is bought and he who is given, he who is inherited from ancestors, and he who is enslaved by way of punishment.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: भार्या पुत्रश्च दासश्च त्रय एवाधनाः स्मृताः । यत्ते समधिगच्छन्ति यस्य ते तस्य तद्धनम्
verses.transliteration: bhāryā putraśca dāsaśca traya evādhanāḥ smṛtāḥ | yatte samadhigacchanti yasya te tasya taddhanam
verses.translation: A wife, a son, and a slave, these three are declared to have no property; the wealth which they earn is (acquired) for him to whom they belong.
verses.commentary: Sense: A wife, a son, and a slave, these three are declared to have no property; the wealth which they earn is (acquired) for him to whom they belong.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: विस्रब्धं ब्राह्मणः शूद्राद्द्रव्योपादानमाचरेत् । न हि तस्यास्ति किं चित्स्वं भर्तृहार्यधनो हि सः
verses.transliteration: visrabdhaṃ brāhmaṇaḥ śūdrāddravyopādānamācaret | na hi tasyāsti kiṃ citsvaṃ bhartṛhāryadhano hi saḥ
verses.translation: A Brahmana may confidently seize the goods of (his) Sudra (slave); for, as that (slave) can have no property, his master may take his possessions.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Brahmana may confidently seize the goods of (his) Sudra (slave); for, as that (slave) can have no property, his master may take his possessions.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: वैश्यशूद्रौ प्रयत्नेन स्वानि कर्माणि कारयेत् । तौ हि च्युतौ स्वकर्मभ्यः क्षोभयेतामिदं जगत्
verses.transliteration: vaiśyaśūdrau prayatnena svāni karmāṇi kārayet | tau hi cyutau svakarmabhyaḥ kṣobhayetāmidaṃ jagat
verses.translation: (The king) should carefully compel Vaisyas and Sudra to perform the work (prescribed) for them; for if these two (castes) swerved from their duties, they would throw this (whole) world into confusion.
verses.commentary: Sense: (The king) should carefully compel Vaisyas and Sudra to perform the work (prescribed) for them; for if these two (castes) swerved from their duties, they would throw this (whole) world into confusion.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: अहन्यहन्यवेक्षेत कर्मान्तान् वाहनानि च । आयव्ययौ च नियतावाकरान् कोशमेव च
verses.transliteration: ahanyahanyavekṣeta karmāntān vāhanāni ca | āyavyayau ca niyatāvākarān kośameva ca
verses.translation: Let him daily look after the completion of his undertakings, his beasts of burden, and carriages, (the collection of) his revenues and the disbursements, his mines and his treasury.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let him daily look after the completion of his undertakings, his beasts of burden, and carriages, (the collection of) his revenues and the disbursements, his mines and his treasury.
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0

verses.sanskrit: एवं सर्वानिमान् राजा व्यवहारान् समापयन् । व्यपोह्य किल्बिषं सर्वं प्राप्नोति परमां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ sarvānimān rājā vyavahārān samāpayan | vyapohya kilbiṣaṃ sarvaṃ prāpnoti paramāṃ gatim
verses.translation: A king who thus brings to a conclusion. all the legal business enumerated above, and removes all sin, reaches the highest state (of bliss).
verses.commentary: Sense: A king who thus brings to a conclusion. all the legal business enumerated above, and removes all sin, reaches the highest state (of bliss).
verses.hindi: परमं यज्ञमातिहेसपुरुषो रक्षणं प्रति ॥ १ ६-॥ शय्यासनमलङ्कारं कासं कोधमनाजेवम्। 0
