verses.sanskrit: ज्ञातिसम्बन्धिभिस्त्वेते त्यक्तव्याः कृतलक्षणाः । निर्दया निर्नमस्कारास्तन् मनोरनुशासनम्
verses.transliteration: jñātisambandhibhistvete tyaktavyāḥ kṛtalakṣaṇāḥ | nirdayā nirnamaskārāstan manoranuśāsanam
verses.translation: Such (persons) who have been branded with (indelible) marks must be cast off by their paternal and maternal relations, and receive neither compassion nor a salutation; that is the teaching of Manu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Such (persons) who have been branded with (indelible) marks must be cast off by their paternal and maternal relations, and receive neither compassion nor a salutation; that is the teaching of Manu.

verses.transliteration: prāyaścittaṃ tu kurvāṇāḥ sarvavarṇā yathoditam | pūrve varṇā yathoditam nāṅkyā rājñā lalāṭe syurdāpyāstūttamasāhasam
verses.translation: But (men of) all castes who perform the prescribed penances, must not be branded on the forehead by the king, but shall be made to pay the highest amercement.
verses.commentary: Sense: But (men of) all castes who perform the prescribed penances, must not be branded on the forehead by the king, but shall be made to pay the highest amercement.

verses.sanskrit: आगःसु ब्राह्मणस्यैव कार्यो मध्यमसाहसः । विवास्यो वा भवेद्राष्ट्रात्सद्रव्यः सपरिच्छदः
verses.transliteration: āgaḥsu brāhmaṇasyaiva kāryo madhyamasāhasaḥ | vivāsyo vā bhavedrāṣṭrātsadravyaḥ saparicchadaḥ
verses.translation: For (such) offences the middlemost amercement shall be inflicted on a Brahmana, or he may be banished from the realm, keeping his money and his chattels.
verses.commentary: Sense: For (such) offences the middlemost amercement shall be inflicted on a Brahmana, or he may be banished from the realm, keeping his money and his chattels.

verses.sanskrit: इतरे कृतवन्तस्तु पापान्येतान्यकामतः । सर्वस्वहारमर्हन्ति कामतस्तु प्रवासनम्
verses.transliteration: itare kṛtavantastu pāpānyetānyakāmataḥ | sarvasvahāramarhanti kāmatastu pravāsanam
verses.translation: But (men of) other (castes), who have unintentionally committed such crimes, ought to be deprived of their whole property; if (they committed them) intentionally, they shall be banished.
verses.commentary: Sense: But (men of) other (castes), who have unintentionally committed such crimes, ought to be deprived of their whole property; if (they committed them) intentionally, they shall be banished.

verses.sanskrit: नाददीत नृपः साधुर्महापातकिनो धनम् । आददानस्तु तत्लोभात्तेन दोषेण लिप्यते
verses.transliteration: nādadīta nṛpaḥ sādhurmahāpātakino dhanam | ādadānastu tatlobhāttena doṣeṇa lipyate
verses.translation: A virtuous king must not take for himself the property of a man guilty of mortal sin; but if he takes it out of greed, he is tainted by that guilt (of the offender).
verses.commentary: Sense: A virtuous king must not take for himself the property of a man guilty of mortal sin; but if he takes it out of greed, he is tainted by that guilt (of the offender).

verses.sanskrit: अप्सु प्रवेश्य तं दण्डं वरुणायोपपादयेत् । श्रुतवृत्तोपपन्ने वा ब्राह्मणे प्रतिपादयेत्
verses.transliteration: apsu praveśya taṃ daṇḍaṃ varuṇāyopapādayet | śrutavṛttopapanne vā brāhmaṇe pratipādayet
verses.translation: Having thrown such a fine into the water, let him offer it to Varuna, or let him bestow it on a learned and virtuous Brahmana.
verses.commentary: Sense: Having thrown such a fine into the water, let him offer it to Varuna, or let him bestow it on a learned and virtuous Brahmana.

verses.sanskrit: ईशो दण्डस्य वरुणो राज्ञां दण्डधरो हि सः । ईशः सर्वस्य जगतो ब्राह्मणो वेदपारगः
verses.transliteration: īśo daṇḍasya varuṇo rājñāṃ daṇḍadharo hi saḥ | īśaḥ sarvasya jagato brāhmaṇo vedapāragaḥ
verses.translation: Varuna is the lord of punishment, for he holds the sceptre even over kings; a Brahmana who has learnt the whole Veda is the lord of the whole world.
verses.commentary: Sense: Varuna is the lord of punishment, for he holds the sceptre even over kings; a Brahmana who has learnt the whole Veda is the lord of the whole world.

verses.sanskrit: यत्र वर्जयते राजा पापकृद्भ्यो धनागमम् । तत्र कालेन जायन्ते मानवा दीर्घजीविनः
verses.transliteration: yatra varjayate rājā pāpakṛdbhyo dhanāgamam | tatra kālena jāyante mānavā dīrghajīvinaḥ
verses.translation: In that (country), where the king avoids taking the property of (mortal) sinners, men are born in (due) time (and are) long-lived,
verses.commentary: Sense: In that (country), where the king avoids taking the property of (mortal) sinners, men are born in (due) time (and are) long-lived,

verses.sanskrit: निष्पद्यन्ते च सस्यानि यथोप्तानि विशां पृथक् । बालाश्च न प्रमीयन्ते विकृतं च न जायते
verses.transliteration: niṣpadyante ca sasyāni yathoptāni viśāṃ pṛthak | bālāśca na pramīyante vikṛtaṃ ca na jāyate
verses.translation: And the crops of the husbandmen spring up, each as it was sown, and the children die not, and no misshaped (offspring) is born.
verses.commentary: Sense: And the crops of the husbandmen spring up, each as it was sown, and the children die not, and no misshaped (offspring) is born.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणान् बाधमानं तु कामादवरवर्णजम् । हन्याच्चित्रैर्वधोपायैरुद्वेजनकरैर्नृपः
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇān bādhamānaṃ tu kāmādavaravarṇajam | hanyāccitrairvadhopāyairudvejanakarairnṛpaḥ
verses.translation: But the king shall inflict on a base-born (Sudra), who intentionally gives pain to Brahmanas, various (kinds of) corporal punishment which cause terror.
verses.commentary: Sense: But the king shall inflict on a base-born (Sudra), who intentionally gives pain to Brahmanas, various (kinds of) corporal punishment which cause terror.

verses.sanskrit: यावानवध्यस्य वधे तावान् वध्यस्य मोक्षणे । अधर्मो नृपतेर्दृष्टो धर्मस्तु विनियच्छतः
verses.transliteration: yāvānavadhyasya vadhe tāvān vadhyasya mokṣaṇe | adharmo nṛpaterdṛṣṭo dharmastu viniyacchataḥ
verses.translation: When a king punishes an innocent (man), his guilt is considered as great as when he sets free a guilty man; but (he acquires) merit when he punishes (justly).
verses.commentary: Sense: When a king punishes an innocent (man), his guilt is considered as great as when he sets free a guilty man; but (he acquires) merit when he punishes (justly).

verses.sanskrit: उदितोऽयं विस्तरशो मिथो विवदमानयोः । अष्टादशसु मार्गेषु व्यवहारस्य निर्णयः
verses.transliteration: udito'yaṃ vistaraśo mitho vivadamānayoḥ | aṣṭādaśasu mārgeṣu vyavahārasya nirṇayaḥ
verses.translation: Thus the (manner of) deciding suits (falling) under the eighteen titles, between two litigant parties, has been declared at length.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the (manner of) deciding suits (falling) under the eighteen titles, between two litigant parties, has been declared at length.

verses.sanskrit: एवं धर्म्याणि कार्याणि सम्यक्कुर्वन् महीपतिः । देशानलब्धान्लिप्सेत लब्धांश्च परिपालयेत्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ dharmyāṇi kāryāṇi samyakkurvan mahīpatiḥ | deśānalabdhānlipseta labdhāṃśca paripālayet
verses.translation: A king who thus duly fulfils his duties in accordance with justice, may seek to gain countries which he has not yet gained, and shall duly protect them when he has gained them.
verses.commentary: Sense: A king who thus duly fulfils his duties in accordance with justice, may seek to gain countries which he has not yet gained, and shall duly protect them when he has gained them.

verses.sanskrit: सम्यग्निविष्टदेशस्तु कृतदुर्गश्च शास्त्रतः । कण्टकोद्धरणे नित्यमातिष्ठेद्यत्नमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: samyagniviṣṭadeśastu kṛtadurgaśca śāstrataḥ | kaṇṭakoddharaṇe nityamātiṣṭhedyatnamuttamam
verses.translation: Having duly settled his country, and having built forts in accordance with the Institutes, he shall use his utmost exertions to remove (those men who are nocuous like) thorns.
verses.commentary: Sense: Having duly settled his country, and having built forts in accordance with the Institutes, he shall use his utmost exertions to remove (those men who are nocuous like) thorns.

verses.sanskrit: रक्षनादार्यवृत्तानां कण्टकानां च शोधनात् । नरेन्द्रास्त्रिदिवं यान्ति प्रजापालनतत्पराः
verses.transliteration: rakṣanādāryavṛttānāṃ kaṇṭakānāṃ ca śodhanāt | narendrāstridivaṃ yānti prajāpālanatatparāḥ
verses.translation: By protecting those who live as (becomes) Aryans and by removing the thorns, kings, solely intent on guarding their subjects, reach heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: By protecting those who live as (becomes) Aryans and by removing the thorns, kings, solely intent on guarding their subjects, reach heaven.

verses.sanskrit: अशासंस्तस्करान् यस्तु बलिं गृह्णाति पार्थिवः । तस्य प्रक्षुभ्यते राष्ट्रं स्वर्गाच्च परिहीयते
verses.transliteration: aśāsaṃstaskarān yastu baliṃ gṛhṇāti pārthivaḥ | tasya prakṣubhyate rāṣṭraṃ svargācca parihīyate
verses.translation: The realm of that king who takes his share in kind, though he does not punish thieves, (will be) disturbed and he (will) lose heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: The realm of that king who takes his share in kind, though he does not punish thieves, (will be) disturbed and he (will) lose heaven.

verses.sanskrit: निर्भयं तु भवेद्यस्य राष्ट्रं बाहुबलाश्रितम् । तस्य तद्वर्धते नित्यं सिच्यमान इव द्रुमः
verses.transliteration: nirbhayaṃ tu bhavedyasya rāṣṭraṃ bāhubalāśritam | tasya tadvardhate nityaṃ sicyamāna iva drumaḥ
verses.translation: But if his kingdom be secure, protected by the strength of his arm, it will constantly flourish like a (well)- watered tree.
verses.commentary: Sense: But if his kingdom be secure, protected by the strength of his arm, it will constantly flourish like a (well)- watered tree.

verses.sanskrit: द्विविधांस्तस्करान् विद्यात्परद्रव्यापहारकान् । प्रकाशांश्चाप्रकाशांश्च चारचक्षुर्महीपतिः
verses.transliteration: dvividhāṃstaskarān vidyātparadravyāpahārakān | prakāśāṃścāprakāśāṃśca cāracakṣurmahīpatiḥ
verses.translation: Let the king who sees (everything) through his spies, discover the two sorts of thieves who deprive others of their property, both those who (show themselves) openly and those who (lie) concealed.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let the king who sees (everything) through his spies, discover the two sorts of thieves who deprive others of their property, both those who (show themselves) openly and those who (lie) concealed.

verses.sanskrit: प्रकाशवञ्चकास्तेषां नानापण्योपजीविनः । प्रच्छन्नवञ्चकास्त्वेते ये स्तेनाटविकादयः
verses.transliteration: prakāśavañcakāsteṣāṃ nānāpaṇyopajīvinaḥ | pracchannavañcakāstvete ye stenāṭavikādayaḥ
verses.translation: Among them, the open rogues (are those) who subsist by (cheating in the sale of) various marketable commodities, but the concealed rogues are burglars, robbers in forests, and so forth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Among them, the open rogues (are those) who subsist by (cheating in the sale of) various marketable commodities, but the concealed rogues are burglars, robbers in forests, and so forth.

verses.sanskrit: उत्कोचकाश्चोपधिका वञ्चकाः कितवास्तथा । मङ्गलादेशवृत्ताश्च भद्राश्चैक्षणिकैः सह
verses.transliteration: utkocakāścopadhikā vañcakāḥ kitavāstathā | maṅgalādeśavṛttāśca bhadrāścaikṣaṇikaiḥ saha
verses.translation: Those who take bribes, cheats and rogues, gamblers, those who live by teaching (the performance of) auspicious ceremonies, sanctimonious hypocrites, and fortune-tellers,

verses.sanskrit: भद्रप्रेक्षणिकैः सह असम्यक्कारिणश्चैव महामात्राश्चिकित्सकाः । शिल्पोपचारयुक्ताश्च निपुणाः पण्ययोषितः
verses.transliteration: bhadraprekṣaṇikaiḥ saha asamyakkāriṇaścaiva mahāmātrāścikitsakāḥ | śilpopacārayuktāśca nipuṇāḥ paṇyayoṣitaḥ
verses.translation: Officials of high rank and physicians who act improperly, men living by showing their proficiency in arts, and clever harlots,
verses.commentary: Sense: Officials of high rank and physicians who act improperly, men living by showing their proficiency in arts, and clever harlots,

verses.sanskrit: एवमादीन् विजानीयात्प्रकाशांल्लोककण्टकान् । एवमाद्यान् निगूढचारिणश्चान्याननार्यानार्यलिङ्गिनः
verses.transliteration: evamādīn vijānīyātprakāśāṃllokakaṇṭakān | evamādyān nigūḍhacāriṇaścānyānanāryānāryaliṅginaḥ
verses.translation: These and the like who show themselves openly, as well as others who walk in disguise (such as) non-Aryans who wear the marks of Aryans, he should know to be thorns (in the side of his people).
verses.commentary: Sense: These and the like who show themselves openly, as well as others who walk in disguise (such as) non-Aryans who wear the marks of Aryans, he should know to be thorns (in the side of his people).

verses.sanskrit: तान् विदित्वा सुचरितैर्गूढैस्तत्कर्मकारिभिः । चारैश्चानेकसंस्थानैः प्रोत्साद्य वशमानयेत्
verses.transliteration: tān viditvā sucaritairgūḍhaistatkarmakāribhiḥ | cāraiścānekasaṃsthānaiḥ protsādya vaśamānayet
verses.translation: Having detected them by means of trustworthy persons, who, disguising themselves, (pretend) to follow the same occupations and by means of spies, wearing various disguises, he must cause them to be instigated (to commit offences), and bring them into his power.
verses.commentary: Sense: Having detected them by means of trustworthy persons, who, disguising themselves, (pretend) to follow the same occupations and by means of spies, wearing various disguises, he must cause them to be instigated (to commit offences), and bring them into his power.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां दोषानभिख्याप्य स्वे स्वे कर्मणि तत्त्वतः । कुर्वीत शासनं राजा सम्यक्सारापराधतः
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ doṣānabhikhyāpya sve sve karmaṇi tattvataḥ | kurvīta śāsanaṃ rājā samyaksārāparādhataḥ
verses.translation: Then having caused the crimes, which they committed by their several actions, to be proclaimed in accordance with the facts, the king shall duly punish them according to their strength and their crimes.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then having caused the crimes, which they committed by their several actions, to be proclaimed in accordance with the facts, the king shall duly punish them according to their strength and their crimes.

verses.sanskrit: न हि दण्डादृते शक्यः कर्तुं पापविनिग्रहः । स्तेनानां पापबुद्धीनां निभृतं चरतां क्षितौ
verses.transliteration: na hi daṇḍādṛte śakyaḥ kartuṃ pāpavinigrahaḥ | stenānāṃ pāpabuddhīnāṃ nibhṛtaṃ caratāṃ kṣitau
verses.translation: For the wickedness of evil-minded thieves, who secretly prowl over this earth, cannot be restrained except by punishment.
verses.commentary: Sense: For the wickedness of evil-minded thieves, who secretly prowl over this earth, cannot be restrained except by punishment.

verses.sanskrit: सभाप्रपाऽपूपशालावेशमद्यान्नविक्रयाः । चतुष्पथांश्चैत्यवृक्षाः समाजाः प्रेक्षणानि च
verses.transliteration: sabhāprapā'pūpaśālāveśamadyānnavikrayāḥ | catuṣpathāṃścaityavṛkṣāḥ samājāḥ prekṣaṇāni ca
verses.translation: Assembly-houses, houses where water is distributed or cakes are sold, brothels, taverns and victualler's shops, cross-roads, well-known trees, festive assemblies, and play-houses and concert-rooms,

verses.transliteration: jīrṇodyānānyaraṇyāni kārukāveśanāni ca | śūnyāni cāpyagārāṇi vanānyupavanāni ca
verses.translation: Old gardens, forests, the shops of artisans, empty dwellings, natural and artificial groves,
verses.commentary: Sense: Old gardens, forests, the shops of artisans, empty dwellings, natural and artificial groves,

verses.sanskrit: एवंविधान्नृपो देशान् गुल्मैः स्थावरजङ्गमैः । तस्करप्रतिषेधार्थं चारैश्चाप्यनुचारयेत्
verses.transliteration: evaṃvidhānnṛpo deśān gulmaiḥ sthāvarajaṅgamaiḥ | taskarapratiṣedhārthaṃ cāraiścāpyanucārayet
verses.translation: These and the like places the king shall cause to be guarded by companies of soldiers, both stationary and patrolling, and by spies, in order to keep away thieves.
verses.commentary: Sense: These and the like places the king shall cause to be guarded by companies of soldiers, both stationary and patrolling, and by spies, in order to keep away thieves.

verses.sanskrit: तत्सहायैरनुगतैर्नानाकर्मप्रवेदिभिः । विद्यादुत्सादयेच्चैव निपुणैः पूर्वतस्करैः
verses.transliteration: tatsahāyairanugatairnānākarmapravedibhiḥ | vidyādutsādayeccaiva nipuṇaiḥ pūrvataskaraiḥ
verses.translation: By the means of clever reformed thieves, who associate with such (rogues), follow them and know their various machinations, he must detect and destroy them.
verses.commentary: Sense: By the means of clever reformed thieves, who associate with such (rogues), follow them and know their various machinations, he must detect and destroy them.

verses.sanskrit: भक्ष्यभोज्योपदेशैश्च ब्राह्मणानां च दर्शनैः । शौर्यकर्मापदेशैश्च कुर्युस्तेषां समागमम्
verses.transliteration: bhakṣyabhojyopadeśaiśca brāhmaṇānāṃ ca darśanaiḥ | śauryakarmāpadeśaiśca kuryusteṣāṃ samāgamam
verses.translation: Under the pretext of (offering them) various dainties, of introducing them to Brahmanas, and on the pretence of (showing them) feats of strength, the (spies) must make them meet (the officers of justice).
verses.commentary: Sense: Under the pretext of (offering them) various dainties, of introducing them to Brahmanas, and on the pretence of (showing them) feats of strength, the (spies) must make them meet (the officers of justice).

verses.sanskrit: ये तत्र नोपसर्पेयुर्मूलप्रणिहिताश्च ये । तान् प्रसह्य नृपो हन्यात्समित्रज्ञातिबान्धवान्
verses.transliteration: ye tatra nopasarpeyurmūlapraṇihitāśca ye | tān prasahya nṛpo hanyātsamitrajñātibāndhavān
verses.translation: Those among them who do not come, and those who suspect the old (thieves employed by the king), the king shall attack by force and slay together with their friends, blood relations, and connexions.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those among them who do not come, and those who suspect the old (thieves employed by the king), the king shall attack by force and slay together with their friends, blood relations, and connexions.

verses.sanskrit: न होढेन विना चौरं घातयेद्धार्मिको नृपः । सहोढं सोपकरणं घातयेदविचारयन्
verses.transliteration: na hoḍhena vinā cauraṃ ghātayeddhārmiko nṛpaḥ | sahoḍhaṃ sopakaraṇaṃ ghātayedavicārayan
verses.translation: A just king shall not cause a thief to be put to death, (unless taken) with the stolen goods (in his possession); him who (is taken) with the stolen goods and the implements (of burglary), he may, without hesitation, cause to be slain.
verses.commentary: Sense: A just king shall not cause a thief to be put to death, (unless taken) with the stolen goods (in his possession); him who (is taken) with the stolen goods and the implements (of burglary), he may, without hesitation, cause to be slain.

verses.sanskrit: ग्रामेष्वपि च ये के चिच्चौराणां भक्तदायकाः । भाण्डावकाशदाश्चैव सर्वांस्तानपि घातयेत्
verses.transliteration: grāmeṣvapi ca ye ke ciccaurāṇāṃ bhaktadāyakāḥ | bhāṇḍāvakāśadāścaiva sarvāṃstānapi ghātayet
verses.translation: All those also who in villages give food to thieves or grant them room for (concealing their implements), he shall cause to be put to death.
verses.commentary: Sense: All those also who in villages give food to thieves or grant them room for (concealing their implements), he shall cause to be put to death.

verses.sanskrit: राष्ट्रेषु रक्षाधिकृतान् सामन्तांश्चैव चोदितान् । अभ्याघातेषु मध्यस्थाञ् शिष्याच्चौरानिव द्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: rāṣṭreṣu rakṣādhikṛtān sāmantāṃścaiva coditān | abhyāghāteṣu madhyasthāñ śiṣyāccaurāniva drutam
verses.translation: Those who are appointed to guard provinces and his vassals who have been ordered (to help), he shall speedily punish like thieves, (if they remain) inactive in attacks (by robbers).
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who are appointed to guard provinces and his vassals who have been ordered (to help), he shall speedily punish like thieves, (if they remain) inactive in attacks (by robbers).

verses.sanskrit: यश्चापि धर्मसमयात्प्रच्युतो धर्मजीवनः । दण्डेनैव तमप्योषेत्स्वकाद्धर्माधि विच्युतम्
verses.transliteration: yaścāpi dharmasamayātpracyuto dharmajīvanaḥ | daṇḍenaiva tamapyoṣetsvakāddharmādhi vicyutam
verses.translation: Moreover if (a man), who subsists by (the fulfilment of) the law, departs from the established rule of the law, the (king) shall severely punish him by a fine, (because he) violated his duty.
verses.commentary: Sense: Moreover if (a man), who subsists by (the fulfilment of) the law, departs from the established rule of the law, the (king) shall severely punish him by a fine, (because he) violated his duty.

verses.sanskrit: ग्रामघाते हिताभङ्गे पथि मोषाभिदर्शने । शक्तितो नाभिधावन्तो निर्वास्याः सपरिच्छदाः
verses.transliteration: grāmaghāte hitābhaṅge pathi moṣābhidarśane | śaktito nābhidhāvanto nirvāsyāḥ saparicchadāḥ
verses.translation: Those who do not give assistance according to their ability when a village is being plundered, a dyke is being destroyed, or a highway robbery committed, shall be banished with their goods and chattels.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who do not give assistance according to their ability when a village is being plundered, a dyke is being destroyed, or a highway robbery committed, shall be banished with their goods and chattels.

verses.sanskrit: राज्ञः कोशापहर्तॄंश्च प्रतिकूलेषु च स्थितान् । प्रातिकूल्येष्ववस्थितान् घातयेद्विविधैर्दण्डैररीणां चोपजापकान्
verses.transliteration: rājñaḥ kośāpahartṝṃśca pratikūleṣu ca sthitān | prātikūlyeṣvavasthitān ghātayedvividhairdaṇḍairarīṇāṃ copajāpakān
verses.translation: On those who rob the king's treasury and those who persevere in opposing (his commands), he shall inflict various kinds of capital punishment, likewise on those who conspire with his enemies.
verses.commentary: Sense: On those who rob the king's treasury and those who persevere in opposing (his commands), he shall inflict various kinds of capital punishment, likewise on those who conspire with his enemies.

verses.sanskrit: संधिं छित्त्वा तु ये चौर्यं रात्रौ कुर्वन्ति तस्कराः । संधिं भित्त्वा) तेषां छित्त्वा नृपो हस्तौ तीक्ष्णे शूले निवेशयेत्
verses.transliteration: saṃdhiṃ chittvā tu ye cauryaṃ rātrau kurvanti taskarāḥ | saṃdhiṃ bhittvā) teṣāṃ chittvā nṛpo hastau tīkṣṇe śūle niveśayet
verses.translation: But the king shall cut off the hands of those robbers who, breaking into houses, commit thefts at night, and cause them to be impaled on a pointed stake.
verses.commentary: Sense: But the king shall cut off the hands of those robbers who, breaking into houses, commit thefts at night, and cause them to be impaled on a pointed stake.

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गुलीर्ग्रन्थिभेदस्य छेदयेत्प्रथमे ग्रहे । द्वितीये हस्तचरणौ तृतीये वधमर्हति
verses.transliteration: aṅgulīrgranthibhedasya chedayetprathame grahe | dvitīye hastacaraṇau tṛtīye vadhamarhati
verses.translation: On the first conviction, let him cause two fingers of a cut-purse to be amputated; on the second, one hand and one foot; on the third, he shall suffer death.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the first conviction, let him cause two fingers of a cut-purse to be amputated; on the second, one hand and one foot; on the third, he shall suffer death.

verses.transliteration: agnidān bhaktadāṃścaiva tathā śastrāvakāśadān | saṃnidhātṝṃśca moṣasya hanyāccauramiveśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Those who give (to thieves) fire, food, arms, or shelter, and receivers of stolen goods, the ruler shall punish like thieves.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who give (to thieves) fire, food, arms, or shelter, and receivers of stolen goods, the ruler shall punish like thieves.

verses.sanskrit: तडागभेदकं हन्यादप्सु शुद्धवधेन वा । यद्वाऽपि प्रतिसंस्कुर्याद्दाप्यस्तूत्तमसाहसम्

verses.translation: Him who breaks (the dam of) a tank he shall slay (by drowning him) in water or by (some other) (mode of) capital punishment; or the offender may repair the (damage), but shall be made to pay the highest amercement.

verses.transliteration: koṣṭhāgārāyudhāgāradevatāgārabhedakān | hastyaśvarathahartṝṃśca hanyādevāvicārayan
verses.translation: Those who break into a (royal) storehouse, an armoury, or a temple, and those who steal elephants, horses, or chariots, he shall slay without hesitation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who break into a (royal) storehouse, an armoury, or a temple, and those who steal elephants, horses, or chariots, he shall slay without hesitation.

verses.sanskrit: यस्तु पूर्वनिविष्टस्य तडागस्योदकं हरेत् । आगमं वाऽप्यपां भिन्द्यात्स दाप्यः पूर्वसाहसम्
verses.transliteration: yastu pūrvaniviṣṭasya taḍāgasyodakaṃ haret | āgamaṃ vā'pyapāṃ bhindyātsa dāpyaḥ pūrvasāhasam
verses.translation: But he who shall take away the water of a tank, made in ancient times, or shall cut off the supply of water, must be made to pay the first (or lowest) amercement.
verses.commentary: Sense: But he who shall take away the water of a tank, made in ancient times, or shall cut off the supply of water, must be made to pay the first (or lowest) amercement.

verses.sanskrit: समुत्सृजेद्राजमार्गे यस्त्वमेध्यमनापदि । स द्वौ कार्षापणौ दद्यादमेध्यं चाशु शोधयेत्
verses.transliteration: samutsṛjedrājamārge yastvamedhyamanāpadi | sa dvau kārṣāpaṇau dadyādamedhyaṃ cāśu śodhayet
verses.translation: But he who, except in a case of extreme necessity, drops filth on the king's high-road, shall pay two karshapanas and immediately remove (that) filth.
verses.commentary: Sense: But he who, except in a case of extreme necessity, drops filth on the king's high-road, shall pay two karshapanas and immediately remove (that) filth.

verses.sanskrit: आपद्गतोऽथ वा वृद्धा गर्भिणी बाल एव वा । परिभाषणमर्हन्ति तच्च शोध्यमिति स्थितिः
verses.transliteration: āpadgato'tha vā vṛddhā garbhiṇī bāla eva vā | paribhāṣaṇamarhanti tacca śodhyamiti sthitiḥ
verses.translation: But a person in urgent necessity, an aged man, a pregnant woman, or a child, shall be reprimanded and clean the (place); that is a settled rule.
verses.commentary: Sense: But a person in urgent necessity, an aged man, a pregnant woman, or a child, shall be reprimanded and clean the (place); that is a settled rule.

verses.sanskrit: चिकित्सकानां सर्वेषां मिथ्याप्रचरतां दमः । अमानुषेषु प्रथमो मानुषेषु तु मध्यमः
verses.transliteration: cikitsakānāṃ sarveṣāṃ mithyāpracaratāṃ damaḥ | amānuṣeṣu prathamo mānuṣeṣu tu madhyamaḥ
verses.translation: All physicians who treat (their patients) wrongly (shall pay) a fine; in the case of animals, the first (or lowest); in the case of human beings, the middlemost (amercement).
verses.commentary: Sense: All physicians who treat (their patients) wrongly (shall pay) a fine; in the case of animals, the first (or lowest); in the case of human beings, the middlemost (amercement).

verses.sanskrit: सङ्क्रमध्वजयष्टीनां प्रतिमानां च भेदकः । प्रतिकुर्याच्च तत्सर्वं पञ्च दद्यात्शतानि च

verses.translation: He who destroys a bridge, the flag (of a temple or royal palace), a pole, or images, shall repair the whole (damage) and pay five hundred (panas).

verses.transliteration: adūṣitānāṃ dravyāṇāṃ dūṣaṇe bhedane tathā | maṇīnāmapavedhe ca daṇḍaḥ prathamasāhasaḥ
verses.translation: For adulterating unadulterated commodities, and for breaking gems or for improperly boring (them), the fine is the first (or lowest) amercement.
verses.commentary: Sense: For adulterating unadulterated commodities, and for breaking gems or for improperly boring (them), the fine is the first (or lowest) amercement.

verses.sanskrit: समैर्हि विषमं यस्तु चरेद्वै मूल्यतोऽपि वा । समाप्नुयाद्दमं पूर्वं नरो मध्यममेव वा
verses.transliteration: samairhi viṣamaṃ yastu caredvai mūlyato'pi vā | samāpnuyāddamaṃ pūrvaṃ naro madhyamameva vā
verses.translation: But that man who behaves dishonestly to honest (customers) or cheats in his prices, shall be fined in the first or in the middlemost amercement.
verses.commentary: Sense: But that man who behaves dishonestly to honest (customers) or cheats in his prices, shall be fined in the first or in the middlemost amercement.

verses.sanskrit: बन्धनानि च सर्वाणि राजा मार्गे निवेशयेत् । राजमार्गे दुःखिता यत्र दृश्येरन् विकृताः पापकारिणः
verses.transliteration: bandhanāni ca sarvāṇi rājā mārge niveśayet | rājamārge duḥkhitā yatra dṛśyeran vikṛtāḥ pāpakāriṇaḥ
verses.translation: Let him place all prisons near a high-road, where the suffering and disfigured offenders can be seen.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let him place all prisons near a high-road, where the suffering and disfigured offenders can be seen.

verses.sanskrit: प्राकारस्य च भेत्तारं परिखाणां च पूरकम् । द्वाराणां चैव भङ्क्तारं क्षिप्रमेव प्रवासयेत्
verses.transliteration: prākārasya ca bhettāraṃ parikhāṇāṃ ca pūrakam | dvārāṇāṃ caiva bhaṅktāraṃ kṣiprameva pravāsayet
verses.translation: Him who destroys the wall (of a town), or fills up the ditch (round a town), or breaks a (town)- gate, he shall instantly banish.
verses.commentary: Sense: Him who destroys the wall (of a town), or fills up the ditch (round a town), or breaks a (town)- gate, he shall instantly banish.

verses.sanskrit: अभिचारेषु सर्वेषु कर्तव्यो द्विशतो दमः । मूलकर्मणि चानाप्तेः कृत्यासु विविधासु च
verses.transliteration: abhicāreṣu sarveṣu kartavyo dviśato damaḥ | mūlakarmaṇi cānāpteḥ kṛtyāsu vividhāsu ca
verses.translation: For all incantations intended to destroy life, for magic rites with roots (practised by persons) not related (to him against whom they are directed), and for various kinds of sorcery, a fine of two hundred (panas) shall be inflicted.

verses.sanskrit: चानाप्तैः अबीजविक्रयी चैव बीजोत्कृष्टा तथैव च । मर्यादाभेदकश्चैव विकृतं प्राप्नुयाद्वधम्
verses.transliteration: cānāptaiḥ abījavikrayī caiva bījotkṛṣṭā tathaiva ca | maryādābhedakaścaiva vikṛtaṃ prāpnuyādvadham
verses.translation: He who sells (for seed-corn that which is) not seed-corn, he who takes up seed (already sown), and he who destroys a boundary (-mark), shall be punished by mutilation.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who sells (for seed-corn that which is) not seed-corn, he who takes up seed (already sown), and he who destroys a boundary (-mark), shall be punished by mutilation.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वकण्टकपापिष्ठं हेमकारं तु पार्थिवः । प्रवर्तमानमन्याये छेदयेत्लवशः क्षुरैः
verses.transliteration: sarvakaṇṭakapāpiṣṭhaṃ hemakāraṃ tu pārthivaḥ | pravartamānamanyāye chedayetlavaśaḥ kṣuraiḥ
verses.translation: But the king shall cause a goldsmith who behaves dishonestly, the most nocuous of all the thorns, to be cut to pieces with razors.
verses.commentary: Sense: But the king shall cause a goldsmith who behaves dishonestly, the most nocuous of all the thorns, to be cut to pieces with razors.

verses.sanskrit: छेदयेत्खण्डशः क्षुरैः सीताद्रव्यापहरणे शस्त्राणामौषधस्य च । कालमासाद्य कार्यं च राजा दण्डं प्रकल्पयेत्
verses.transliteration: chedayetkhaṇḍaśaḥ kṣuraiḥ sītādravyāpaharaṇe śastrāṇāmauṣadhasya ca | kālamāsādya kāryaṃ ca rājā daṇḍaṃ prakalpayet
verses.translation: For the theft of agricultural implements, of arms and of medicines, let the king award punishment, taking into account the time (of the offence) and the use (of the object).
verses.commentary: Sense: For the theft of agricultural implements, of arms and of medicines, let the king award punishment, taking into account the time (of the offence) and the use (of the object).

verses.sanskrit: स्वाम्य्ऽमात्यौ पुरं राष्ट्रं कोशदण्डौ सुहृत्तथा । सप्त प्रकृतयो ह्येताः सप्ताङ्गं राज्यमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: svāmy'mātyau puraṃ rāṣṭraṃ kośadaṇḍau suhṛttathā | sapta prakṛtayo hyetāḥ saptāṅgaṃ rājyamucyate
verses.translation: The king and his minister, his capital, his realm, his treasury, his army, and his ally are the seven constituent parts (of a kingdom); (hence) a kingdom is said to have seven limbs (anga).
verses.commentary: Sense: The king and his minister, his capital, his realm, his treasury, his army, and his ally are the seven constituent parts (of a kingdom); (hence) a kingdom is said to have seven limbs (anga).

verses.sanskrit: सप्तानां प्रकृतीनां तु राज्यस्यासां यथाक्रमम् । पूर्वं पूर्वं गुरुतरं जानीयाद्व्यसनं महत्
verses.transliteration: saptānāṃ prakṛtīnāṃ tu rājyasyāsāṃ yathākramam | pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ gurutaraṃ jānīyādvyasanaṃ mahat
verses.translation: But let him know (that) among these seven constituent parts of a kingdom (which have been enumerated) in due order, each earlier (named) is more important and (its destruction) the greater calamity.
verses.commentary: Sense: But let him know (that) among these seven constituent parts of a kingdom (which have been enumerated) in due order, each earlier (named) is more important and (its destruction) the greater calamity.

verses.sanskrit: सप्ताङ्गस्यैह राज्यस्य विष्टब्धस्य त्रिदण्डवत् । अन्योन्यगुणवैशेष्यात्न किं चिदतिरिच्यते
verses.transliteration: saptāṅgasyaiha rājyasya viṣṭabdhasya tridaṇḍavat | anyonyaguṇavaiśeṣyātna kiṃ cidatiricyate
verses.translation: Yet in a kingdom containing seven constituent parts, which is upheld like the triple staff (of an ascetic), there is no (single part) more important (than the others), by reason of the importance of the qualities of each for the others.
verses.commentary: Sense: Yet in a kingdom containing seven constituent parts, which is upheld like the triple staff (of an ascetic), there is no (single part) more important (than the others), by reason of the importance of the qualities of each for the others.

verses.sanskrit: तेषु तेषु तु कृत्येषु तत्तदङ्गं विशिष्यते । येन यत्साध्यते कार्यं तत्तस्मिंश्रेष्ठमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: teṣu teṣu tu kṛtyeṣu tattadaṅgaṃ viśiṣyate | yena yatsādhyate kāryaṃ tattasmiṃśreṣṭhamucyate
verses.translation: For each part is particularly qualified for (the accomplishment of) certain objects, (and thus) each is declared to be the most important for that particular purpose which is effected by its means.
verses.commentary: Sense: For each part is particularly qualified for (the accomplishment of) certain objects, (and thus) each is declared to be the most important for that particular purpose which is effected by its means.

verses.sanskrit: चारेणोत्साहयोगेन क्रिययैव च कर्मणाम् । स्वशक्तिं परशक्तिं च नित्यं विद्यान्महीपतिः
verses.transliteration: cāreṇotsāhayogena kriyayaiva ca karmaṇām | svaśaktiṃ paraśaktiṃ ca nityaṃ vidyānmahīpatiḥ
verses.translation: By spies, by a (pretended) display of energy, and by carrying out (various) undertakings, let the king constantly ascertain his own and his enemy's strength;
verses.commentary: Sense: By spies, by a (pretended) display of energy, and by carrying out (various) undertakings, let the king constantly ascertain his own and his enemy's strength;

verses.sanskrit: विद्यात्परात्मनोः पीडनानि च सर्वाणि व्यसनानि तथैव च । आरभेत ततः कार्यं सञ्चिन्त्य गुरुलाघवम्
verses.transliteration: vidyātparātmanoḥ pīḍanāni ca sarvāṇi vyasanāni tathaiva ca | ārabheta tataḥ kāryaṃ sañcintya gurulāghavam
verses.translation: Moreover, all calamities and vices; afterwards, when he has fully considered their relative importance, let him begin his operations.
verses.commentary: Sense: Moreover, all calamities and vices; afterwards, when he has fully considered their relative importance, let him begin his operations.

verses.sanskrit: आरभेतैव कर्माणि श्रान्तः श्रान्तः पुनः पुनः । कर्माण्यारभमाणं हि पुरुषं श्रीर्निषेवते
verses.transliteration: ārabhetaiva karmāṇi śrāntaḥ śrāntaḥ punaḥ punaḥ | karmāṇyārabhamāṇaṃ hi puruṣaṃ śrīrniṣevate
verses.translation: (Though he be) ever so much tired (by repeated failures), let him begin his operations again and again; for fortune greatly favours the man who (strenuously) exerts himself in his undertakings.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Though he be) ever so much tired (by repeated failures), let him begin his operations again and again; for fortune greatly favours the man who (strenuously) exerts himself in his undertakings.

verses.sanskrit: कृतं त्रेतायुगं चैव द्वापरं कलिरेव च । राज्ञो वृत्तानि सर्वाणि राजा हि युगमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: kṛtaṃ tretāyugaṃ caiva dvāparaṃ kalireva ca | rājño vṛttāni sarvāṇi rājā hi yugamucyate
verses.translation: The various ways in which a king behaves (resemble) the Krita, Treta, Dvapara, and Kali ages; hence the king is identified with the ages (of the world).
verses.commentary: Sense: The various ways in which a king behaves (resemble) the Krita, Treta, Dvapara, and Kali ages; hence the king is identified with the ages (of the world).

verses.sanskrit: कलिः प्रसुप्तो भवति स जाग्रद्द्वापरं युगम् । कर्मस्वभ्युद्यतस्त्रेता विचरंस्तु कृतं युगम्
verses.transliteration: kaliḥ prasupto bhavati sa jāgraddvāparaṃ yugam | karmasvabhyudyatastretā vicaraṃstu kṛtaṃ yugam
verses.translation: Sleeping he represents the Kali (or iron age), waking the Dvapara (or brazen) age, ready to act the Treta (or silver age), but moving (actively) the Krita (or golden) age.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sleeping he represents the Kali (or iron age), waking the Dvapara (or brazen) age, ready to act the Treta (or silver age), but moving (actively) the Krita (or golden) age.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रस्यार्कस्य वायोश्च यमस्य वरुणस्य च । चन्द्रस्याग्नेः पृथिव्याश्च तेजोवृत्तं नृपश्चरेत्
verses.transliteration: indrasyārkasya vāyośca yamasya varuṇasya ca | candrasyāgneḥ pṛthivyāśca tejovṛttaṃ nṛpaścaret
verses.translation: Let the king emulate the energetic action of Indra, of the Sun, of the Wind, of Yama, of Varuna, of the Moon, of the Fire, and of the Earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let the king emulate the energetic action of Indra, of the Sun, of the Wind, of Yama, of Varuna, of the Moon, of the Fire, and of the Earth.

verses.sanskrit: वार्षिकांश्चतुरो मासान् यथेन्द्रोऽभिप्रवर्षति । तथाऽभिवर्षेत्स्वं राष्ट्रं कामैरिन्द्रव्रतं चरन्
verses.transliteration: vārṣikāṃścaturo māsān yathendro'bhipravarṣati | tathā'bhivarṣetsvaṃ rāṣṭraṃ kāmairindravrataṃ caran
verses.translation: As Indra sends copious rain during the four months of the rainy season, even so let the king, taking upon himself the office of Indra, shower benefits on his kingdom.
verses.commentary: Sense: As Indra sends copious rain during the four months of the rainy season, even so let the king, taking upon himself the office of Indra, shower benefits on his kingdom.

verses.sanskrit: अष्टौ मासान् यथाऽदित्यस्तोयं हरति रश्मिभिः । तथा हरेत्करं राष्ट्रात्नित्यमर्कव्रतं हि तत्
verses.transliteration: aṣṭau māsān yathā'dityastoyaṃ harati raśmibhiḥ | tathā haretkaraṃ rāṣṭrātnityamarkavrataṃ hi tat
verses.translation: As the Sun during eight months (imperceptibly) draws up the water with his rays, even so let him gradually draw his taxes from his kingdom; for that is the office in which he resembles the Sun.
verses.commentary: Sense: As the Sun during eight months (imperceptibly) draws up the water with his rays, even so let him gradually draw his taxes from his kingdom; for that is the office in which he resembles the Sun.
verses.hindi: गले के अच्छे-युरे .का हाल, देशों में पदार्थो का भाव, गुण आदि । समय मे खरीद, बेचने मै मुनाफा आदि और पशुओं के चढ्ने की, रीति वैश्य जाना करे । नौकरोंकी नौकरी का परिमाण; अनेक भाषा, माल ठीक, रहने की विधि, खरीदते, बेचने का ढंग

verses.sanskrit: प्रविश्य सर्वभूतानि यथा चरति मारुतः । तथा चारैः प्रवेष्टव्यं व्रतमेतधि मारुतम्
verses.transliteration: praviśya sarvabhūtāni yathā carati mārutaḥ | tathā cāraiḥ praveṣṭavyaṃ vratametadhi mārutam
verses.translation: As the Wind moves (everywhere), entering (in the shape of the vital air) all created beings, even so let him penetrate (everywhere) through his spies; that is the office in which he resembles the Wind.
verses.commentary: Sense: As the Wind moves (everywhere), entering (in the shape of the vital air) all created beings, even so let him penetrate (everywhere) through his spies; that is the office in which he resembles the Wind.

verses.sanskrit: यथा यमः प्रियद्वेष्यौ प्राप्ते काले नियच्छति । तथा राज्ञा नियन्तव्याः प्रजास्तधि यमव्रतम्
verses.transliteration: yathā yamaḥ priyadveṣyau prāpte kāle niyacchati | tathā rājñā niyantavyāḥ prajāstadhi yamavratam
verses.translation: As Yama at the appointed time subjects to his rule both friends and foes, even so all subjects must be controlled by the king; that is the office in which he resembles Yama.
verses.commentary: Sense: As Yama at the appointed time subjects to his rule both friends and foes, even so all subjects must be controlled by the king; that is the office in which he resembles Yama.

verses.sanskrit: वरुणेन यथा पाशैर्बद्ध एवाभिदृश्यते । तथा पापान्निगृह्णीयाद्व्रतमेतधि वारुणम्
verses.transliteration: varuṇena yathā pāśairbaddha evābhidṛśyate | tathā pāpānnigṛhṇīyādvratametadhi vāruṇam
verses.translation: As (a sinner) is seen bound with ropes by Varuna, even so let him punish the wicked; that is his office in which he resembles Varuna.
verses.commentary: Sense: As (a sinner) is seen bound with ropes by Varuna, even so let him punish the wicked; that is his office in which he resembles Varuna.

verses.sanskrit: परिपूर्णं यथा चन्द्रं दृष्ट्वा हृष्यन्ति मानवाः । तथा प्रकृतयो यस्मिन् स चान्द्रव्रतिको नृपः
verses.transliteration: paripūrṇaṃ yathā candraṃ dṛṣṭvā hṛṣyanti mānavāḥ | tathā prakṛtayo yasmin sa cāndravratiko nṛpaḥ
verses.translation: He is a king, taking upon himself the office of the Moon, whose (appearance) his subjects (greet with as great joy) as men feel on seeing the full moon.
verses.commentary: Sense: He is a king, taking upon himself the office of the Moon, whose (appearance) his subjects (greet with as great joy) as men feel on seeing the full moon.

verses.sanskrit: प्रतापयुक्तस्तेजस्वी नित्यं स्यात्पापकर्मसु । दुष्टसामन्तहिंस्रश्च तदाग्नेयं व्रतं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: pratāpayuktastejasvī nityaṃ syātpāpakarmasu | duṣṭasāmantahiṃsraśca tadāgneyaṃ vrataṃ smṛtam
verses.translation: (If) he is ardent in wrath against criminals and endowed with brilliant energy, and destroys wicked vassals, then his character is said (to resemble) that of Fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: (If) he is ardent in wrath against criminals and endowed with brilliant energy, and destroys wicked vassals, then his character is said (to resemble) that of Fire.

verses.sanskrit: यथा सर्वाणि भूतानि धरा धारयते समम् । तथा सर्वाणि भूतानि बिभ्रतः पार्थिवं व्रतम्
verses.transliteration: yathā sarvāṇi bhūtāni dharā dhārayate samam | tathā sarvāṇi bhūtāni bibhrataḥ pārthivaṃ vratam
verses.translation: As the Earth supports all created beings equally, thus (a king) who supports all his subjects, (takes upon himself) the office of the Earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: As the Earth supports all created beings equally, thus (a king) who supports all his subjects, (takes upon himself) the office of the Earth.

verses.sanskrit: एतैरुपायैरन्यैश्च युक्तो नित्यमतन्द्रितः । स्तेनान् राजा निगृह्णीयात्स्वराष्ट्रे पर एव च
verses.transliteration: etairupāyairanyaiśca yukto nityamatandritaḥ | stenān rājā nigṛhṇīyātsvarāṣṭre para eva ca
verses.translation: Employing these and other means, the king shall, ever untired, restrain thieves both in his own dominions and in (those of) others.
verses.commentary: Sense: Employing these and other means, the king shall, ever untired, restrain thieves both in his own dominions and in (those of) others.

verses.sanskrit: परामप्यापदं प्राप्तो ब्राह्मणान्न प्रकोपयेत् । ते ह्येनं कुपिता हन्युः सद्यः सबलवाहनम्
verses.transliteration: parāmapyāpadaṃ prāpto brāhmaṇānna prakopayet | te hyenaṃ kupitā hanyuḥ sadyaḥ sabalavāhanam
verses.translation: Let him not, though fallen into the deepest distress, provoke Brahmanas to anger; for they, when angered, could instantly destroy him together with his army and his vehicles.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let him not, though fallen into the deepest distress, provoke Brahmanas to anger; for they, when angered, could instantly destroy him together with his army and his vehicles.

verses.sanskrit: यैः कृतः सर्वभक्ष्योऽग्निरपेयश्च महोदधिः । सर्वभक्षो क्षयी चाप्यायितः सोमः को न नश्येत्प्रकोप्य तान्
verses.transliteration: yaiḥ kṛtaḥ sarvabhakṣyo'gnirapeyaśca mahodadhiḥ | sarvabhakṣo kṣayī cāpyāyitaḥ somaḥ ko na naśyetprakopya tān
verses.translation: Who could escape destruction, when he provokes to anger those (men), by whom the fire was made to consume all things, by whom the (water of the) ocean was made undrinkable, and by whom the moon was made to wane and to increase again?
verses.commentary: Sense: Who could escape destruction, when he provokes to anger those (men), by whom the fire was made to consume all things, by whom the (water of the) ocean was made undrinkable, and by whom the moon was made to wane and to increase again?

verses.sanskrit: लोकानन्यान् सृजेयुर्ये लोकपालांश्च कोपिताः । देवान् कुर्युरदेवांश्च कः क्षिण्वंस्तान् समृध्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: lokānanyān sṛjeyurye lokapālāṃśca kopitāḥ | devān kuryuradevāṃśca kaḥ kṣiṇvaṃstān samṛdhnuyāt
verses.translation: Who could prosper, while he injures those (men) who provoked to anger, could create other worlds and other guardians of the world, and deprive the gods of their divine station?
verses.commentary: Sense: Who could prosper, while he injures those (men) who provoked to anger, could create other worlds and other guardians of the world, and deprive the gods of their divine station?

verses.sanskrit: यानुपाश्रित्य तिष्ठन्ति लोका देवाश्च सर्वदा । ब्रह्म चैव धनं येषां को हिंस्यात्ताञ्जिजीविषुः
verses.transliteration: yānupāśritya tiṣṭhanti lokā devāśca sarvadā | brahma caiva dhanaṃ yeṣāṃ ko hiṃsyāttāñjijīviṣuḥ
verses.translation: What man, desirous of life, would injure them to whose support the (three) worlds and the gods ever owe their existence, and whose wealth is the Veda?
verses.commentary: Sense: What man, desirous of life, would injure them to whose support the (three) worlds and the gods ever owe their existence, and whose wealth is the Veda?

verses.sanskrit: अविद्वांश्चैव विद्वांश्च ब्राह्मणो दैवतं महत् । प्रणीतश्चाप्रणीतश्च यथाऽग्निर्दैवतं महत्
verses.transliteration: avidvāṃścaiva vidvāṃśca brāhmaṇo daivataṃ mahat | praṇītaścāpraṇītaśca yathā'gnirdaivataṃ mahat
verses.translation: A Brahmana, be he ignorant or learned, is a great divinity, just as the fire, whether carried forth (for the performance of a burnt-oblation) or not carried forth, is a great divinity.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Brahmana, be he ignorant or learned, is a great divinity, just as the fire, whether carried forth (for the performance of a burnt-oblation) or not carried forth, is a great divinity.

verses.sanskrit: श्मशानेष्वपि तेजस्वी पावको नैव दुष्यति । हूयमानश्च यज्ञेषु भूय एवाभिवर्धते
verses.transliteration: śmaśāneṣvapi tejasvī pāvako naiva duṣyati | hūyamānaśca yajñeṣu bhūya evābhivardhate
verses.translation: The brilliant fire is not contaminated even in burial-places, and, when presented with oblations (of butter) at sacrifices, it again increases mightily.
verses.commentary: Sense: The brilliant fire is not contaminated even in burial-places, and, when presented with oblations (of butter) at sacrifices, it again increases mightily.

verses.sanskrit: एवं यद्यप्यनिष्टेषु वर्तन्ते सर्वकर्मसु । सर्वथा ब्राह्मणाः पूज्याः परमं दैवतं हि तत्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ yadyapyaniṣṭeṣu vartante sarvakarmasu | sarvathā brāhmaṇāḥ pūjyāḥ paramaṃ daivataṃ hi tat
verses.translation: Thus, though Brahmanas employ themselves in all (sorts of) mean occupations, they must be honoured in every way; for (each of) them is a very great deity.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, though Brahmanas employ themselves in all (sorts of) mean occupations, they must be honoured in every way; for (each of) them is a very great deity.
verses.hindi: गले के अच्छे-युरे .का हाल, देशों में पदार्थो का भाव, गुण आदि । समय मे खरीद, बेचने मै मुनाफा आदि और पशुओं के चढ्ने की, रीति वैश्य जाना करे । नौकरोंकी नौकरी का परिमाण; अनेक भाषा, माल ठीक, रहने की विधि, खरीदते, बेचने का ढंग

verses.sanskrit: क्षत्रस्यातिप्रवृद्धस्य ब्राह्मणान् प्रति सर्वशः । ब्रह्मैव संनियन्तृ स्यात्क्षत्रं हि ब्रह्मसम्भवम्
verses.transliteration: kṣatrasyātipravṛddhasya brāhmaṇān prati sarvaśaḥ | brahmaiva saṃniyantṛ syātkṣatraṃ hi brahmasambhavam
verses.translation: When the Kshatriyas become in any way overbearing towards the Brahmanas, the Brahmanas themselves shall duly restrain them; for the Kshatriyas sprang from the Brahmanas.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the Kshatriyas become in any way overbearing towards the Brahmanas, the Brahmanas themselves shall duly restrain them; for the Kshatriyas sprang from the Brahmanas.
verses.hindi: गले के अच्छे-युरे .का हाल, देशों में पदार्थो का भाव, गुण आदि । समय मे खरीद, बेचने मै मुनाफा आदि और पशुओं के चढ्ने की, रीति वैश्य जाना करे । नौकरोंकी नौकरी का परिमाण; अनेक भाषा, माल ठीक, रहने की विधि, खरीदते, बेचने का ढंग

verses.sanskrit: अद्भ्योऽग्निर्ब्रह्मतः क्षत्रमश्मनो लोहमुत्थितम् । तेषां सर्वत्रगं तेजः स्वासु योनिषु शाम्यति
verses.transliteration: adbhyo'gnirbrahmataḥ kṣatramaśmano lohamutthitam | teṣāṃ sarvatragaṃ tejaḥ svāsu yoniṣu śāmyati
verses.translation: Fire sprang from water, Kshatriyas from Brahmanas, iron from stone; the all-penetrating force of those (three) has no effect on that whence they were produced.
verses.commentary: Sense: Fire sprang from water, Kshatriyas from Brahmanas, iron from stone; the all-penetrating force of those (three) has no effect on that whence they were produced.

verses.sanskrit: नाब्रह्म क्षत्रं ऋध्नोति नाक्षत्रं ब्रह्म वर्धते । ब्रह्म क्षत्रं च सम्पृक्तमिह चामुत्र वर्धते
verses.transliteration: nābrahma kṣatraṃ ṛdhnoti nākṣatraṃ brahma vardhate | brahma kṣatraṃ ca sampṛktamiha cāmutra vardhate
verses.translation: Kshatriyas prosper not without Brahmanas, Brahmanas prosper not without Kshatriyas; Brahmanas and Kshatriyas, being closely united, prosper in this (world) and in the next.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kshatriyas prosper not without Brahmanas, Brahmanas prosper not without Kshatriyas; Brahmanas and Kshatriyas, being closely united, prosper in this (world) and in the next.

verses.sanskrit: दत्त्वा धनं तु विप्रेभ्यः सर्वदण्डसमुत्थितम् । पुत्रे राज्यं समासृज्य कुर्वीत प्रायणं रणे
verses.transliteration: dattvā dhanaṃ tu viprebhyaḥ sarvadaṇḍasamutthitam | putre rājyaṃ samāsṛjya kurvīta prāyaṇaṃ raṇe
verses.translation: But (a king who feels his end drawing nigh) shall bestow all his wealth, accumulated from fines, on Brahmanas, make over his kingdom to his son, and then seek death in battle.
verses.commentary: Sense: But (a king who feels his end drawing nigh) shall bestow all his wealth, accumulated from fines, on Brahmanas, make over his kingdom to his son, and then seek death in battle.

verses.sanskrit: समासाद्य एवं चरन् सदा युक्तो राजधर्मेषु पार्थिवः । हितेषु चैव लोकस्य सर्वान् भृत्यान्नियोजयेत्
verses.transliteration: samāsādya evaṃ caran sadā yukto rājadharmeṣu pārthivaḥ | hiteṣu caiva lokasya sarvān bhṛtyānniyojayet
verses.translation: Thus conducting himself (and) ever intent on (discharging) his royal duties, a king shall order all his servants (to work) for the good of his people.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus conducting himself (and) ever intent on (discharging) his royal duties, a king shall order all his servants (to work) for the good of his people.

verses.sanskrit: हितेषु चैव लोकेभ्यः एषोऽखिलः कर्मविधिरुक्तो राज्ञः सनातनः । इमं कर्मविधिं विद्यात्क्रमशो वैश्यशूद्रयोः
verses.transliteration: hiteṣu caiva lokebhyaḥ eṣo'khilaḥ karmavidhirukto rājñaḥ sanātanaḥ | imaṃ karmavidhiṃ vidyātkramaśo vaiśyaśūdrayoḥ
verses.translation: Thus the eternal law concerning the duties of a king has been fully declared; know that the following rules apply in (due) order to the duties of Vaisyas and Sudras.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the eternal law concerning the duties of a king has been fully declared; know that the following rules apply in (due) order to the duties of Vaisyas and Sudras.

verses.sanskrit: वैश्यस्तु कृतसंस्कारः कृत्वा दारपरिग्रहम् । वार्तायां नित्ययुक्तः स्यात्पशूनां चैव रक्षणे
verses.transliteration: vaiśyastu kṛtasaṃskāraḥ kṛtvā dāraparigraham | vārtāyāṃ nityayuktaḥ syātpaśūnāṃ caiva rakṣaṇe
verses.translation: After a Vaisya has received the sacraments and has taken a wife, he shall be always attentive to the business whereby he may subsist and to (that of) tending cattle.
verses.commentary: Sense: After a Vaisya has received the sacraments and has taken a wife, he shall be always attentive to the business whereby he may subsist and to (that of) tending cattle.

verses.sanskrit: प्रजापतिर्हि वैश्याय सृष्ट्वा परिददे पशून् । ब्राह्मणाय च राज्ञे च सर्वाः परिददे प्रजाः
verses.transliteration: prajāpatirhi vaiśyāya sṛṣṭvā paridade paśūn | brāhmaṇāya ca rājñe ca sarvāḥ paridade prajāḥ
verses.translation: For when the Lord of creatures (Pragapati) created cattle, he made them over to the Vaisya; to the Brahmana, and to the king he entrusted all created beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: For when the Lord of creatures (Pragapati) created cattle, he made them over to the Vaisya; to the Brahmana, and to the king he entrusted all created beings.

verses.sanskrit: न च वैश्यस्य कामः स्यान्न रक्षेयं पशूनिति । वैश्ये चेच्छति नान्येन रक्षितव्याः कथं चन
verses.transliteration: na ca vaiśyasya kāmaḥ syānna rakṣeyaṃ paśūniti | vaiśye cecchati nānyena rakṣitavyāḥ kathaṃ cana
verses.translation: A Vaisya must never (conceive this) wish, I will not keep cattle; and if a Vaisya is willing (to keep them), they must never be kept by (men of) other (castes).
verses.commentary: Sense: A Vaisya must never (conceive this) wish, I will not keep cattle; and if a Vaisya is willing (to keep them), they must never be kept by (men of) other (castes).
verses.hindi: गले के अच्छे-युरे .का हाल, देशों में पदार्थो का भाव, गुण आदि । समय मे खरीद, बेचने मै मुनाफा आदि और पशुओं के चढ्ने की, रीति वैश्य जाना करे । नौकरोंकी नौकरी का परिमाण; अनेक भाषा, माल ठीक, रहने की विधि, खरीदते, बेचने का ढंग

verses.sanskrit: मणिमुक्ताप्रवालानां लोहानां तान्तवस्य च । गन्धानां च रसानां च विद्यादर्घबलाबलम्
verses.transliteration: maṇimuktāpravālānāṃ lohānāṃ tāntavasya ca | gandhānāṃ ca rasānāṃ ca vidyādarghabalābalam
verses.translation: (A Vaisya) must know the respective value of gems, of pearls, of coral, of metals, of (cloth) made of thread, of perfumes, and of condiments.
verses.commentary: Sense: (A Vaisya) must know the respective value of gems, of pearls, of coral, of metals, of (cloth) made of thread, of perfumes, and of condiments.
verses.hindi: गले के अच्छे-युरे .का हाल, देशों में पदार्थो का भाव, गुण आदि । समय मे खरीद, बेचने मै मुनाफा आदि और पशुओं के चढ्ने की, रीति वैश्य जाना करे । नौकरोंकी नौकरी का परिमाण; अनेक भाषा, माल ठीक, रहने की विधि, खरीदते, बेचने का ढंग

verses.sanskrit: बीजानामुप्तिविद्च स्यात्क्षेत्रदोषगुणस्य च । मानयोगं च जानीयात्तुलायोगांश्च सर्वशः
verses.transliteration: bījānāmuptividca syātkṣetradoṣaguṇasya ca | mānayogaṃ ca jānīyāttulāyogāṃśca sarvaśaḥ
verses.translation: He must be acquainted with the (manner of) sowing of seeds, and of the good and bad qualities of fields, and he must perfectly know all measures and weights.
verses.commentary: Sense: He must be acquainted with the (manner of) sowing of seeds, and of the good and bad qualities of fields, and he must perfectly know all measures and weights.
verses.hindi: गले के अच्छे-युरे .का हाल, देशों में पदार्थो का भाव, गुण आदि । समय मे खरीद, बेचने मै मुनाफा आदि और पशुओं के चढ्ने की, रीति वैश्य जाना करे । नौकरोंकी नौकरी का परिमाण; अनेक भाषा, माल ठीक, रहने की विधि, खरीदते, बेचने का ढंग

verses.sanskrit: सारासारं च भाण्डानां देशानां च गुणागुणान् । लाभालाभं च पण्यानां पशूनां परिवर्धनम्
verses.transliteration: sārāsāraṃ ca bhāṇḍānāṃ deśānāṃ ca guṇāguṇān | lābhālābhaṃ ca paṇyānāṃ paśūnāṃ parivardhanam
verses.translation: Moreover, the excellence and defects of commodities, the advantages and disadvantages of (different) countries, the (probable) profit and loss on merchandise, and the means of properly rearing cattle.
verses.commentary: Sense: Moreover, the excellence and defects of commodities, the advantages and disadvantages of (different) countries, the (probable) profit and loss on merchandise, and the means of properly rearing cattle.
verses.hindi: गले के अच्छे-युरे .का हाल, देशों में पदार्थो का भाव, गुण आदि । समय मे खरीद, बेचने मै मुनाफा आदि और पशुओं के चढ्ने की, रीति वैश्य जाना करे । नौकरोंकी नौकरी का परिमाण; अनेक भाषा, माल ठीक, रहने की विधि, खरीदते, बेचने का ढंग

verses.sanskrit: भृत्यानां च भृतिं विद्याद्भाषाश्च विविधा नृणाम् । द्रव्याणां स्थानयोगांश्च क्रयविक्रयमेव च
verses.transliteration: bhṛtyānāṃ ca bhṛtiṃ vidyādbhāṣāśca vividhā nṛṇām | dravyāṇāṃ sthānayogāṃśca krayavikrayameva ca
verses.translation: He must be acquainted with the (proper), wages of servants, with the various languages of men, with the manner of keeping goods, and (the rules of) purchase and sale.
verses.commentary: Sense: He must be acquainted with the (proper), wages of servants, with the various languages of men, with the manner of keeping goods, and (the rules of) purchase and sale.
verses.hindi: गले के अच्छे-युरे .का हाल, देशों में पदार्थो का भाव, गुण आदि । समय मे खरीद, बेचने मै मुनाफा आदि और पशुओं के चढ्ने की, रीति वैश्य जाना करे । नौकरोंकी नौकरी का परिमाण; अनेक भाषा, माल ठीक, रहने की विधि, खरीदते, बेचने का ढंग

verses.sanskrit: धर्मेण च द्रव्यवृद्धावातिष्ठेद्यत्नमुत्तमम् । दद्याच्च सर्वभूतानामन्नमेव प्रयत्नतः
verses.transliteration: dharmeṇa ca dravyavṛddhāvātiṣṭhedyatnamuttamam | dadyācca sarvabhūtānāmannameva prayatnataḥ
verses.translation: Let him exert himself to the utmost in order to increase his property in a righteous manner, and let him zealously give food to all created beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let him exert himself to the utmost in order to increase his property in a righteous manner, and let him zealously give food to all created beings.
verses.hindi: गले के अच्छे-युरे .का हाल, देशों में पदार्थो का भाव, गुण आदि । समय मे खरीद, बेचने मै मुनाफा आदि और पशुओं के चढ्ने की, रीति वैश्य जाना करे । नौकरोंकी नौकरी का परिमाण; अनेक भाषा, माल ठीक, रहने की विधि, खरीदते, बेचने का ढंग

verses.sanskrit: विप्राणां वेदविदुषां गृहस्थानां यशस्विनाम् । शुश्रूषैव तु शूद्रस्य धर्मो नैश्रेयसः परः
verses.transliteration: viprāṇāṃ vedaviduṣāṃ gṛhasthānāṃ yaśasvinām | śuśrūṣaiva tu śūdrasya dharmo naiśreyasaḥ paraḥ
verses.translation: But to serve Brahmanas (who are) learned in the Vedas, householders, and famous (for virtue) is the highest duty of a Sudra, which leads to beatitude.
verses.commentary: Sense: But to serve Brahmanas (who are) learned in the Vedas, householders, and famous (for virtue) is the highest duty of a Sudra, which leads to beatitude.
verses.hindi: गले के अच्छे-युरे .का हाल, देशों में पदार्थो का भाव, गुण आदि । समय मे खरीद, बेचने मै मुनाफा आदि और पशुओं के चढ्ने की, रीति वैश्य जाना करे । नौकरोंकी नौकरी का परिमाण; अनेक भाषा, माल ठीक, रहने की विधि, खरीदते, बेचने का ढंग

verses.sanskrit: परम् शुचिरुत्कृष्टशुश्रूषुर्मृदुवागनहङ्कृतः । ब्राह्मणाद्याश्रयो नित्यमुत्कृष्टां जातिमश्नुते
verses.transliteration: param śucirutkṛṣṭaśuśrūṣurmṛduvāganahaṅkṛtaḥ | brāhmaṇādyāśrayo nityamutkṛṣṭāṃ jātimaśnute
verses.translation: (A Sudra who is) pure, the servant of his betters, gentle in his speech, and free from pride, and always seeks a refuge with Brahmanas, attains (in his next life) a higher caste.
verses.commentary: Sense: (A Sudra who is) pure, the servant of his betters, gentle in his speech, and free from pride, and always seeks a refuge with Brahmanas, attains (in his next life) a higher caste.
verses.hindi: गले के अच्छे-युरे .का हाल, देशों में पदार्थो का भाव, गुण आदि । समय मे खरीद, बेचने मै मुनाफा आदि और पशुओं के चढ्ने की, रीति वैश्य जाना करे । नौकरोंकी नौकरी का परिमाण; अनेक भाषा, माल ठीक, रहने की विधि, खरीदते, बेचने का ढंग
