verses.sanskrit: अकामतस्तु राजन्यं विनिपात्य द्विजोत्तमः । वृषभैकसहस्रा गा दद्यात्सुचरितव्रतः
verses.transliteration: akāmatastu rājanyaṃ vinipātya dvijottamaḥ | vṛṣabhaikasahasrā gā dadyātsucaritavrataḥ
verses.translation: One fourth (of the penance) for the murder of a Brahmana is prescribed (as expiation) for (intentionally) killing a Kshatriya, one-eighth for killing a Vaisya; know that it is one-sixteenth for killing a virtuous Sudra.
verses.hindi: यथेवेका तथा सर्वा न पातव्या शिजात्तमेः
verses.commentary: Sense: One fourth (of the penance) for the murder of a Brahmana is prescribed (as expiation) for (intentionally) killing a Kshatriya, one-eighth for killing a Vaisya; know that it is one-sixteenth for killing a virtuous Sudra.
verses.science: यथेवेका तथा सर्वा न पातव्या शिजात्तमेः। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: त्र्यब्दं चरेद्वा नियतो जटी ब्रह्महनो व्रतम् । वसन् दूरतरे ग्रामाद्वृक्षमूलनिकेतनः
verses.transliteration: tryabdaṃ caredvā niyato jaṭī brahmahano vratam | vasan dūratare grāmādvṛkṣamūlaniketanaḥ
verses.translation: But if a Brahmana unintentionally kills a Kshatriya, he shall give, in order to purify himself, one thousand cows and a bull;
verses.hindi: उसले शरीर जलजाने पर पाप से छुटता है अथवा गोमूज, जल, गौ का दूध, घी, गोवर का रख इनमें किसी पदार्थ को आग के झुवाक़िक् लाल करके मरणान्त पिया करे। या अन्नकण या तिलं की खली एक साल तक रात में एक वार खाय । कम्बल शोढकरा
verses.commentary: Sense: But if a Brahmana unintentionally kills a Kshatriya, he shall give, in order to purify himself, one thousand cows and a bull;
verses.science: उसले शरीर जलजाने पर पाप से छुटता है अथवा गोमूज, जल, गौ का दूध, घी, गोवर का रख इनमें किसी पदार्थ को आग के झुवाक़िक् लाल करके मरणान्त पिया करे। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: एतदेव चरेदब्दं प्रायश्चित्तं द्विजोत्तमः । प्रमाप्य वैश्यं वृत्तस्थं दद्याच्चैकशतं गवाम्
verses.transliteration: etadeva caredabdaṃ prāyaścittaṃ dvijottamaḥ | pramāpya vaiśyaṃ vṛttasthaṃ dadyāccaikaśataṃ gavām
verses.translation: Or he may perform the penance prescribed for the murderer of a Brahmana during three years, controlling himself, wearing his hair in braids, staying far away from the village, and dwelling at the root of a tree.
verses.hindi: क शरार मे रहनंबाला चंद््षान एकवार ही सच से गल जाताह सांता डच का परायाश्च कहा जायया ॥ ६५-६६ ॥
verses.commentary: Sense: Or he may perform the penance prescribed for the murderer of a Brahmana during three years, controlling himself, wearing his hair in braids, staying far away from the village, and dwelling at the root of a tree.
verses.science: क शरार मे रहनंबाला चंद््षान एकवार ही सच से गल जाताह सांता डच का परायाश्च कहा जायया ॥ ६५-६६ ॥। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दद्याद्वैकशतं गवाम् एतदेव व्रतं कृत्स्नं षण्मासांशूद्रहा चरेत्) । वृषभेकादशा वाऽपि दद्याद्विप्राय गाः सिताः
verses.transliteration: dadyādvaikaśataṃ gavām etadeva vrataṃ kṛtsnaṃ ṣaṇmāsāṃśūdrahā caret) | vṛṣabhekādaśā vā'pi dadyādviprāya gāḥ sitāḥ
verses.translation: A Brahmana who has slain a virtuous Vaisya, shall perform the same penance during one year, or he may give one hundred cows and one (bull).
verses.hindi: उपपातकिनंस्लेवसेभिनोनाविधैमैतैः
verses.commentary: Sense: A Brahmana who has slain a virtuous Vaisya, shall perform the same penance during one year, or he may give one hundred cows and one (bull).
verses.science: उपपातकिनंस्लेवसेभिनोनाविधैमैतैः। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मार्जारनकुलौ हत्वा चाषं मण्डूकमेव च । श्वगोधौलूककाकांश्च शूद्रहत्याव्रतं चरेत्
verses.transliteration: mārjāranakulau hatvā cāṣaṃ maṇḍūkameva ca | śvagodhaulūkakākāṃśca śūdrahatyāvrataṃ caret
verses.translation: He who has slain a Sudra, shall perform that whole penance during six months, or he may also give ten white cows and one bull to a Brahmana.
verses.hindi: शुरुपल्लीयामी अपने पाप को कहकर लोहे की जलती हुई शय्या पर सोचे! या लोह की चनी खी सूति जलती इदको रि पट कर भरने से पाप शुद्ध होता है। अथवा खुदी अपने" ग्रोर अणडकोशा को. काटकर. अज्ञलि में रखकर मरण -तक
verses.commentary: Sense: He who has slain a Sudra, shall perform that whole penance during six months, or he may also give ten white cows and one bull to a Brahmana.
verses.science: शुरुपल्लीयामी अपने पाप को कहकर लोहे की जलती हुई शय्या पर सोचे! या लोह की चनी खी सूति जलती इदको रि पट कर भरने से पाप शुद्ध होता है। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: पयः पिबेत्त्रिरात्रं वा योजनं वाऽध्वनो व्रजेत् । उपस्पृशेत्स्रवन्त्यां वा सूक्तं वाऽब्।दैवतं जपेत्
verses.transliteration: payaḥ pibettrirātraṃ vā yojanaṃ vā'dhvano vrajet | upaspṛśetsravantyāṃ vā sūktaṃ vā'b|daivataṃ japet
verses.translation: Having killed a cat, an ichneumon, a blue jay, a frog, a dog, an iguana, an owl, or a crow, he shall perform the penance for the murder of a Sudra;
verses.hindi: चतुथकालमश्नीयादक्षारखवणं मितम्!
verses.commentary: Sense: Having killed a cat, an ichneumon, a blue jay, a frog, a dog, an iguana, an owl, or a crow, he shall perform the penance for the murder of a Sudra;
verses.science: चतुथकालमश्नीयादक्षारखवणं मितम्!। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अभ्रिं कार्ष्णायसीं दद्यात्सर्पं हत्वा द्विजोत्तमः । पलालभारकं षण्ढे सैसकं चैकमाषकम्
verses.transliteration: abhriṃ kārṣṇāyasīṃ dadyātsarpaṃ hatvā dvijottamaḥ | palālabhārakaṃ ṣaṇḍhe saisakaṃ caikamāṣakam
verses.translation: Or he may drink milk during three days, or walk one hundred yoganas, or bathe in a river, or mutter the hymn addressed to the Waters.
verses.hindi: उपपातकों का प्रायश्चित । गोवध करनेवाला मुण्डन कराकर, गोचर्म ओढ़कर -एक मास गोगोष्ठमे रहे और जॉकी लपसी चारे । दो मास तक गोसूच से ' स्नान करे, जितेन्द्रिय रहें, चोथे काल ( दुसरे दिन सायंकाल)
verses.commentary: Sense: Or he may drink milk during three days, or walk one hundred yoganas, or bathe in a river, or mutter the hymn addressed to the Waters.
verses.science: उपपातकों का प्रायश्चित। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: घृतकुम्भं वराहे तु तिलद्रोणं तु तित्तिरौ । शुके द्विहायनं वत्सं क्रौञ्चं हत्वा त्रिहायनम्
verses.transliteration: ghṛtakumbhaṃ varāhe tu tiladroṇaṃ tu tittirau | śuke dvihāyanaṃ vatsaṃ krauñcaṃ hatvā trihāyanam
verses.translation: For killing a snake, a Brahmana shall give a spade of black iron, for a eunuch a load of straw and a masha of lead;
verses.hindi: अनेन विधिना यस्तु गोन्नो गामनुगच्छति । स गोहत्याकृतं पापं त्रिसिमासेव्यपोहति
verses.commentary: Sense: For killing a snake, a Brahmana shall give a spade of black iron, for a eunuch a load of straw and a masha of lead;
verses.science: अनेन विधिना यस्तु गोन्नो गामनुगच्छति। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: हत्वा हंसं बलाकां च बकं बर्हिणमेव च । वानरं श्येनभासौ च स्पर्शयेद्ब्राह्मणाय गाम्
verses.transliteration: hatvā haṃsaṃ balākāṃ ca bakaṃ barhiṇameva ca | vānaraṃ śyenabhāsau ca sparśayedbrāhmaṇāya gām
verses.translation: For a boar a pot of clarified butter, for a partridge a drona of sesamum-grains, for a parrot a calf two years old, for a crane (a calf) three years old.
verses.hindi: बृपभेकादशा गाशच दद्यात्सुचरितब्रतः ।
verses.commentary: Sense: For a boar a pot of clarified butter, for a partridge a drona of sesamum-grains, for a parrot a calf two years old, for a crane (a calf) three years old.
verses.science: बृपभेकादशा गाशच दद्यात्सुचरितब्रतः। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वासो दद्याधयं हत्वा पञ्च नीलान् वृषान् गजम् । अजमेषावनड्वाहं खरं हत्वैकहायनम्
verses.transliteration: vāso dadyādhayaṃ hatvā pañca nīlān vṛṣān gajam | ajameṣāvanaḍvāhaṃ kharaṃ hatvaikahāyanam
verses.translation: If he has killed a Hamsa, a Balaka, a heron, a peacock, a monkey, a falcon, or a Bhasa, he shall give a cow to a Brahmana.
verses.hindi: रोगी, चोर, वाघ के भय से व्याकुल गिर्रीहुई कीचड़ में फेसी हुई गी को सब उपायों से मुक्त करे। धूप मै; धो में, शोत में और आंधी चलने पर यथाशक्कि गौ की रक्षा करे फिर अपनी रक्षा करे । अपने था दूसरे के घर में, खेत में, खीरिदान में चरती गौ
verses.commentary: Sense: If he has killed a Hamsa, a Balaka, a heron, a peacock, a monkey, a falcon, or a Bhasa, he shall give a cow to a Brahmana.
verses.science: रोगी, चोर, वाघ के भय से व्याकुल गिर्रीहुई कीचड़ में फेसी हुई गी को सब उपायों से मुक्त करे। आहार, निद्रा और इंद्रिय-भार शरीर की स्थिति को सीधे बदलते हैं। यह पंक्ति उस शारीरिक आधार को छोड़कर नहीं चलती।

verses.sanskrit: क्रव्यादांस्तु मृगान् हत्वा धेनुं दद्यात्पयस्विनीम् । अक्रव्यादान् वत्सतरीमुष्ट्रं हत्वा तु कृष्णलम्
verses.transliteration: kravyādāṃstu mṛgān hatvā dhenuṃ dadyātpayasvinīm | akravyādān vatsatarīmuṣṭraṃ hatvā tu kṛṣṇalam
verses.translation: For killing a horse, he shall give a garment, for (killing) an elephant, five black bulls, for (killing) a goat, or a sheep, a draught-ox, for killing a donkey, (a calf) one year old;
verses.hindi: अबकीयी को छोड़कर दूसरे उपपातकी द्विज अपनी शुद्धि के खण्डित करनेवाला अवकीर्णी होता है । बह रात को काने गंध पर चढ़कर चौराहा में जाकर पाकयज्ञ के विधान से मिऋति देवता का यज्ञ करे। अग्नि में बिधि से होम करके 'स मा सि-
verses.commentary: Sense: For killing a horse, he shall give a garment, for (killing) an elephant, five black bulls, for (killing) a goat, or a sheep, a draught-ox, for killing a donkey, (a calf) one year old;
verses.science: अबकीयी को छोड़कर दूसरे उपपातकी द्विज अपनी शुद्धि के खण्डित करनेवाला अवकीर्णी होता है। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: जीनकार्मुकबस्तावीन् पृथग्दद्याद्विशुद्धये । चतुर्णामपि वर्णानां नारीर्हत्वाऽनवस्थिताः
verses.transliteration: jīnakārmukabastāvīn pṛthagdadyādviśuddhaye | caturṇāmapi varṇānāṃ nārīrhatvā'navasthitāḥ
verses.translation: But for killing carnivorous wild beasts, he shall give a milch-cow, for (killing) wild beasts that are not carnivorous, a heifer, for killing a camel, one krishnala.
verses.hindi: मारुतं पुरुहूतं च गुरु पावकसेव च । चतुरो त्रतिनोऽभ्येति बाह्म तेजोऽवकीशिनः
verses.commentary: Sense: But for killing carnivorous wild beasts, he shall give a milch-cow, for (killing) wild beasts that are not carnivorous, a heifer, for killing a camel, one krishnala.
verses.science: मारुतं पुरुहूतं च गुरु पावकसेव च। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दानेन वधनिर्णेकं सर्पादीनामशक्नुवन् । एकैकशश्चरेत्कृच्छ्रं द्विजः पापापनुत्तये
verses.transliteration: dānena vadhanirṇekaṃ sarpādīnāmaśaknuvan | ekaikaśaścaretkṛcchraṃ dvijaḥ pāpāpanuttaye
verses.translation: For killing adulterous women of the four castes, he must give, in order to purify himself, respectively a leathern bag, a bow, a goat, or a sheep.
verses.hindi: मलिनीकरणीयेषु तृतः स्याच्यावकेरूयहम्
verses.commentary: Sense: For killing adulterous women of the four castes, he must give, in order to purify himself, respectively a leathern bag, a bow, a goat, or a sheep.
verses.science: मलिनीकरणीयेषु तृतः स्याच्यावकेरूयहम्। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अस्थिमतां तु सत्त्वानां सहस्रस्य प्रमापणे । पूर्णे चानस्यनस्थ्नां तु शूद्रहत्याव्रतं चरेत्
verses.transliteration: asthimatāṃ tu sattvānāṃ sahasrasya pramāpaṇe | pūrṇe cānasyanasthnāṃ tu śūdrahatyāvrataṃ caret
verses.translation: A twice-born man, who is unable to atone by gifts for the slaughter of a serpent and the other (creatures mentioned), shall perform for each of them, a Krikkhra (penance) in order to remove his guilt.
verses.hindi: यह पम्प रयादियों का मत है  बतभङ्ग से उसका तेज वायु, ६ । इस अतभङ् फा पाप लगे तो गधे का चमड़ा ओढ़कर अपना फर्म फर गोर सान घरा से भीख मांगे और उस भिक्षा से एक याय भे।अमलियाद फोर । ओर तीन वार स्वात करे! इस प्रकार
verses.commentary: Sense: A twice-born man, who is unable to atone by gifts for the slaughter of a serpent and the other (creatures mentioned), shall perform for each of them, a Krikkhra (penance) in order to remove his guilt.
verses.science: यह पम्प रयादियों का मत है बतभङ्ग से उसका तेज वायु, ६। धीमी श्वास वेगस तंत्रिका को सक्रिय कर भय-प्रतिक्रिया को शांत करती है। यह पंक्ति उसी श्वास और मन के संबंध को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: किं चिदेव तु विप्राय दद्यादस्थिमतां वधे । अनस्थ्नां चैव हिंसायां प्राणायामेन शुध्यति
verses.transliteration: kiṃ cideva tu viprāya dadyādasthimatāṃ vadhe | anasthnāṃ caiva hiṃsāyāṃ prāṇāyāmena śudhyati
verses.translation: But for destroying one thousand (small) animals that have bones, or a whole cart-load of boneless (animals), he shall perform the penance (prescribed) for the murder of a Sudra.
verses.hindi: वपसैकादशा वापि दद्यादिप्राय गाः सिताः,
verses.commentary: Sense: But for destroying one thousand (small) animals that have bones, or a whole cart-load of boneless (animals), he shall perform the penance (prescribed) for the murder of a Sudra.
verses.science: वपसैकादशा वापि दद्यादिप्राय गाः सिताः,। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: फलदानां तु वृक्षाणां छेदने जप्यमृच्शतम् । गुल्मवल्लीलतानां च पुष्पितानां च वीरुधाम्
verses.transliteration: phaladānāṃ tu vṛkṣāṇāṃ chedane japyamṛcśatam | gulmavallīlatānāṃ ca puṣpitānāṃ ca vīrudhām
verses.translation: But for killing (small) animals which have bones, he should give some trifle to a Brahmana; if he injures boneless (animals), he becomes pure by a suppressing his breath (pranayama).
verses.hindi: माजीरनकुलो हरवा चाषं सण्डकसेव च ।
verses.commentary: Sense: But for killing (small) animals which have bones, he should give some trifle to a Brahmana; if he injures boneless (animals), he becomes pure by a suppressing his breath (pranayama).
verses.science: माजीरनकुलो हरवा चाषं सण्डकसेव च। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अन्नाद्यजानां सत्त्वानां रसजानां च सर्वशः । फलपुष्पोद्भवानां च घृतप्राशो विशोधनम्
verses.transliteration: annādyajānāṃ sattvānāṃ rasajānāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ | phalapuṣpodbhavānāṃ ca ghṛtaprāśo viśodhanam
verses.translation: For cutting fruit-trees, shrubs, creepers, lianas, or flowering plants, one hundred Rikas must be muttered.
verses.hindi: पलालभारकं षण्डे सेसकश्चैकमावकम्
verses.commentary: Sense: For cutting fruit-trees, shrubs, creepers, lianas, or flowering plants, one hundred Rikas must be muttered.
verses.science: पलालभारकं षण्डे सेसकश्चैकमावकम्। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कृष्तजानामोषधीनां जातानां च स्वयं वने । वृथालम्भेऽनुगच्छेद्गां दिनमेकं पयोव्रतः
verses.transliteration: kṛṣtajānāmoṣadhīnāṃ jātānāṃ ca svayaṃ vane | vṛthālambhe'nugacchedgāṃ dinamekaṃ payovrataḥ
verses.translation: (For destroying) any kind of creature, bred in food, in condiments, in fruit, or in flowers, the expiation is to eat clarified butter.
verses.hindi: हत्वा हसँ वलाका च वर्क बर्हिणमेव च । अथवा चह पुरुष आम से दूर दक्ष के नौचे जटा रखकर एक जान म सदाचारी वेश्य के वध म॑ भी जानना चाहिए । और एकसौ गौ का दान करना चाहिए ।शद्धवध में भी यही सब घायड्चित्त
verses.commentary: Sense: (For destroying) any kind of creature, bred in food, in condiments, in fruit, or in flowers, the expiation is to eat clarified butter.
verses.science: हत्वा हसँ वलाका च वर्क बर्हिणमेव च। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: एतैर्व्रतैरपोह्यं स्यादेनो हिंसासमुद्भवम् । ज्ञानाज्ञानकृतं कृत्स्नं शृणुतानाद्यभक्षणे
verses.transliteration: etairvratairapohyaṃ syādeno hiṃsāsamudbhavam | jñānājñānakṛtaṃ kṛtsnaṃ śṛṇutānādyabhakṣaṇe
verses.translation: If a man destroys for no good purpose plants produced by cultivation, or such as spontaneously spring up in the forest, he shall attend a cow during one day, subsisting on milk alone.
verses.hindi: घोडे की हत्या में वस, हाथी की हत्या मैं पांच नीले वैल, बकरा! ओर मेढ़ा के लिए सांड और गर्दभ के बघ मै एक वर्ष का बछुडा दान करे। मांसाहारी पशुओं की हत्या स दृध देनेवाली गौ, मांस न खामेवाले पशुओं की हिसा में बछुड़ी और ऊंट की हिंसा में
verses.commentary: Sense: If a man destroys for no good purpose plants produced by cultivation, or such as spontaneously spring up in the forest, he shall attend a cow during one day, subsisting on milk alone.
verses.science: घोडे की हत्या में वस, हाथी की हत्या मैं पांच नीले वैल, बकरा! ओर मेढ़ा के लिए सांड और गर्दभ के बघ मै एक वर्ष का बछुडा दान करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अज्ञानाद्वारुणीं पीत्वा संस्कारेणैव शुध्यति । मतिपूर्वमनिर्देश्यं प्राणान्तिकमिति स्थितिः
verses.transliteration: ajñānādvāruṇīṃ pītvā saṃskāreṇaiva śudhyati | matipūrvamanirdeśyaṃ prāṇāntikamiti sthitiḥ
verses.translation: The guilt incurred intentionally or unintentionally by injuring (created beings) can be removed by means of these penances; hear (now, how) all (sins) committed by partaking of forbidden food (or drink, can be expiated).
verses.hindi: चारों वर्ण की व्यामिचारिणो खिया का हत्या होने पर कमसे मगचर्म, धनुष, वकरा ओर मेढे का दान करे ।.पूर्व कहे इए आदि के प्रायश्चितों को न करसके तो पक पक छच्छु बत करे हजार हड्डीबाले' जीघों की हत्या और विना हड्डीवाले गाड़ी भर
verses.commentary: Sense: The guilt incurred intentionally or unintentionally by injuring (created beings) can be removed by means of these penances; hear (now, how) all (sins) committed by partaking of forbidden food (or drink, can be expiated).
verses.science: चारों वर्ण की व्यामिचारिणो खिया का हत्या होने पर कमसे मगचर्म, धनुष, वकरा ओर मेढे का दान करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अपः सुराभाजनस्था मद्यभाण्डस्थितास्तथा । पञ्चरात्रं पिबेत्पीत्वा शङ्खपुष्पीशृतं पयः
verses.transliteration: apaḥ surābhājanasthā madyabhāṇḍasthitāstathā | pañcarātraṃ pibetpītvā śaṅkhapuṣpīśṛtaṃ payaḥ
verses.translation: He who drinks unintentionally (the spirituous liquor, called) Varuni, becomes pure by being initiated (again); (even for drinking it) intentionally (a penance) destructive to life must not be imposed; that is a settled rule.
verses.hindi: एक दिन दूध पीकर यो के पीछे फिरे  जान या अजान में हिसा का धायाश्चत्त खुनो ॥ १४५-१४६ ॥ ,  अज्ञानादारुणी पीला संस्कारेणेव शुध्यति।
verses.commentary: Sense: He who drinks unintentionally (the spirituous liquor, called) Varuni, becomes pure by being initiated (again); (even for drinking it) intentionally (a penance) destructive to life must not be imposed; that is a settled rule.
verses.science: एक दिन दूध पीकर यो के पीछे फिरे जान या अजान में हिसा का धायाश्चत्त खुनो ॥ १४५-१४६ ॥ , अज्ञानादारुणी पीला संस्कारेणेव शुध्यति। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स्पृष्ट्वा दत्त्वा च मदिरां विधिवत्प्रतिगृह्य च । शूद्रोच्छिष्टाश्च पीत्वाऽपः कुशवारि पिबेत्त्र्यहम्
verses.transliteration: spṛṣṭvā dattvā ca madirāṃ vidhivatpratigṛhya ca | śūdrocchiṣṭāśca pītvā'paḥ kuśavāri pibettryaham
verses.translation: He who has drunk water which has stood in a vessel used for keeping (the spirituous liquor, called) Sura, or other intoxicating drinks, shall drink during five (days and) nights (nothing but) milk in which the Sankhapushpi (plant) has been boiled.
verses.hindi: निवतेन्पे द्विजातीनां पुनः संस्कार कमीशि
verses.commentary: Sense: He who has drunk water which has stood in a vessel used for keeping (the spirituous liquor, called) Sura, or other intoxicating drinks, shall drink during five (days and) nights (nothing but) milk in which the Sankhapushpi (plant) has been boiled.
verses.science: निवतेन्पे द्विजातीनां पुनः संस्कार कमीशि। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणस्तु सुरापस्य गन्धमाघ्राय सोमपः । प्राणानप्सु त्रिरायम्य घृतं प्राश्य विशुध्यति
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇastu surāpasya gandhamāghrāya somapaḥ | prāṇānapsu trirāyamya ghṛtaṃ prāśya viśudhyati
verses.translation: He who has touched spirituous liquor, has given it away, or received it in accordance with the rule, or has drunk water left by a Sudra, shall drink during three days water in which Kusa-grass has been boiled.
verses.hindi: धजान में मयपान से संस्कार से शुद्धि होती है । जानकर पीने मयादा है) जिसने खुण शरोर गय फे पात्र का जल पिया हो बह पाँच दिन डु फा फाढ़ा पिये । मद्य छूकर, देसर थोर विधि मे प्रहता करके और शूद्र का जूंठा जल पीकर, तीन दिन
verses.commentary: Sense: He who has touched spirituous liquor, has given it away, or received it in accordance with the rule, or has drunk water left by a Sudra, shall drink during three days water in which Kusa-grass has been boiled.
verses.science: धजान में मयपान से संस्कार से शुद्धि होती है। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: अज्ञानात्प्राश्य विण्मूत्रं सुरासंस्पृष्टमेव च । पुनः संस्कारमर्हन्ति त्रयो वर्णा द्विजातयः
verses.transliteration: ajñānātprāśya viṇmūtraṃ surāsaṃspṛṣṭameva ca | punaḥ saṃskāramarhanti trayo varṇā dvijātayaḥ
verses.translation: But when a Brahmana who has partaken of Soma-juice, has smelt the odour exhaled by a drinker of Sura, he becomes pure by thrice suppressing his breath in water, and eating clarified butter.
verses.hindi: शुप्काशि झुकता मा भौमानि निच
verses.commentary: Sense: But when a Brahmana who has partaken of Soma-juice, has smelt the odour exhaled by a drinker of Sura, he becomes pure by thrice suppressing his breath in water, and eating clarified butter.
verses.science: शुप्काशि झुकता मा भौमानि निच। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वपनं मेखला दण्डो भैक्षचर्या व्रतानि च । भैक्ष्यचर्या निवर्तन्ते द्विजातीनां पुनःसंस्कारकर्मणि
verses.transliteration: vapanaṃ mekhalā daṇḍo bhaikṣacaryā vratāni ca | bhaikṣyacaryā nivartante dvijātīnāṃ punaḥsaṃskārakarmaṇi
verses.translation: (Men of) the three twice-born castes who have unintentionally swallowed ordure or urine, or anything that has touched Sura, must be initiated again.
verses.hindi: क्रव्यादसकरोहूएएं कुछुटानां च अक्षशे। नरकाकखशर्णा च तपतकझ्ृच्छ विशोधनभ
verses.commentary: Sense: (Men of) the three twice-born castes who have unintentionally swallowed ordure or urine, or anything that has touched Sura, must be initiated again.
verses.science: क्रव्यादसकरोहूएएं कुछुटानां च अक्षशे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अभोज्यानां तु भुक्त्वाऽन्नं स्त्रीशूद्रोच्छिष्टमेव च । जग्ध्वा मांसमभक्ष्यं च सप्तरात्रं यवान् पिबेत्
verses.transliteration: abhojyānāṃ tu bhuktvā'nnaṃ strīśūdrocchiṣṭameva ca | jagdhvā māṃsamabhakṣyaṃ ca saptarātraṃ yavān pibet
verses.translation: The tonsure, (wearing) the sacred girdle, (carrying) a staff, going to beg, and the vows (incumbent on a student), are omitted on the second initiation of twice-born men.
verses.hindi: मासिकान्न त योए्नीयादसमावतेकोी विजः । -स त्रीएयहान्युयवसेदेकाह चोदके वसेत्
verses.commentary: Sense: The tonsure, (wearing) the sacred girdle, (carrying) a staff, going to beg, and the vows (incumbent on a student), are omitted on the second initiation of twice-born men.
verses.science: मासिकान्न त योए्नीयादसमावतेकोी विजः। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शुक्तानि च कषायांश्च पीत्वा मेध्यान्यपि द्विजः । तावद्भवत्यप्रयतो यावत्तन्न व्रजत्यधः
verses.transliteration: śuktāni ca kaṣāyāṃśca pītvā medhyānyapi dvijaḥ | tāvadbhavatyaprayato yāvattanna vrajatyadhaḥ
verses.translation: But he who has eaten the food of men, whose food must not be eaten, or the leavings of women and Sudras, or forbidden flesh, shall drink barley (-gruel) during seven (days and) nights.
verses.hindi: मांख खाकर खात रात जब की लपसी खावे  सिरका आदि. नही होता। गाँव का सुत्र, गधा, ऊंट, सियार, चानर ओर  सांस जमीन के फूल, अज्ञात और कसाईख़ान का मांस खाकर ' सदुष्य,काआ और भधेःका मांस खाने से आजाय तो तत्तकच्छु
verses.commentary: Sense: But he who has eaten the food of men, whose food must not be eaten, or the leavings of women and Sudras, or forbidden flesh, shall drink barley (-gruel) during seven (days and) nights.
verses.science: मांख खाकर खात रात जब की लपसी खावे सिरका आदि. नही होता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विड्वराहखरोष्ट्राणां गोमायोः कपिकाकयोः । प्राश्य मूत्रपुरीषाणि द्विजश्चान्द्रायणं चरेत्
verses.transliteration: viḍvarāhakharoṣṭrāṇāṃ gomāyoḥ kapikākayoḥ | prāśya mūtrapurīṣāṇi dvijaścāndrāyaṇaṃ caret
verses.translation: A twice-born man who has drunk (fluids that have turned) sour, or astringent decoctions, becomes, though (these substances may) not (be specially) forbidden, impure until they have been digested.
verses.hindi: अयः कांस्योपलानां च द्वादशाहं कणान्नता
verses.commentary: Sense: A twice-born man who has drunk (fluids that have turned) sour, or astringent decoctions, becomes, though (these substances may) not (be specially) forbidden, impure until they have been digested.
verses.science: अयः कांस्योपलानां च द्वादशाहं कणान्नता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शुष्काणि भुक्त्वा मांसानि भौमानि कवकानि च । अज्ञातं चैव सूनास्थमेतदेव व्रतं चरेत्
verses.transliteration: śuṣkāṇi bhuktvā māṃsāni bhaumāni kavakāni ca | ajñātaṃ caiva sūnāsthametadeva vrataṃ caret
verses.translation: A twice-born man, who has swallowed the urine or ordure of a village pig, of a donkey, of a camel, of a jackal, of a monkey, or of a crow, shall perform a lunar penance.
verses.hindi: अपनी युद्धि चाहनेवाला पुरुष श्रमाउ्य अन्न न खाय और श्रतान से खाया हुआ घमन करदे। थह न करसके तो शीध प्रकार की विधि कही । अव चोरी कें पाप को नाश -करनेवाले अतो को सुनो । प्राह्मण यदि -जानकर अपने सजातीय के घर से
verses.commentary: Sense: A twice-born man, who has swallowed the urine or ordure of a village pig, of a donkey, of a camel, of a jackal, of a monkey, or of a crow, shall perform a lunar penance.
verses.science: अपनी युद्धि चाहनेवाला पुरुष श्रमाउ्य अन्न न खाय और श्रतान से खाया हुआ घमन करदे। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: क्रव्यादसूकरोष्ट्राणां कुक्कुटानां च भक्षणे । नरकाकखराणां च तप्तकृच्छ्रं विशोधनम्
verses.transliteration: kravyādasūkaroṣṭrāṇāṃ kukkuṭānāṃ ca bhakṣaṇe | narakākakharāṇāṃ ca taptakṛcchraṃ viśodhanam
verses.translation: He who has eaten dried meat, mushrooms growing on the ground, or (meat, the nature of) which is unknown, (or) such as had been kept in a slaughter-house, shall perform the same penance.
verses.hindi: ' कपास, रेशस, ऊन दो. और एक खुर के पशु, पंक्षी; सुगन्ध ' द्रब्य, औषध, रस्ली की चोरी करने पर तीन दिन पानी पीकरं बितावे । द्विजो को इन जतों से.चोरी के पाप को.दूर करेना 'चां- हिए। अयस्या की के गमन. का पाप इन बतो से दुर करेः-सेंगी
verses.commentary: Sense: He who has eaten dried meat, mushrooms growing on the ground, or (meat, the nature of) which is unknown, (or) such as had been kept in a slaughter-house, shall perform the same penance.
verses.science: ' कपास, रेशस, ऊन दो. और एक खुर के पशु, पंक्षी; सुगन्ध ' द्रब्य, औषध, रस्ली की चोरी करने पर तीन दिन पानी पीकरं बितावे। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: मासिकान्नं तु योऽश्नीयादसमावर्तको द्विजः । स त्रीण्यहान्युपवसेदेकाहं चोदके वसेत्
verses.transliteration: māsikānnaṃ tu yo'śnīyādasamāvartako dvijaḥ | sa trīṇyahānyupavasedekāhaṃ codake vaset
verses.translation: The atonement for partaking of (the meat of) carnivorous animals, of pigs, of camels, of cocks, of crows, of donkeys, and of human flesh, is a Tapta Krikkhra (penance).
verses.hindi: सडुच तु समासेव्य पुसे योषिति वा द्विजः । अमाजुपी योनि, रजस्वला और जल में चीयेपात करके सान्व- पन घत करे । दिज को पुरुष, खो, वैलयाड़ी में; जल में और दिन में, मैथुन करके चञ्ज सहित स्वान करना चाहिए । आहण
verses.commentary: Sense: The atonement for partaking of (the meat of) carnivorous animals, of pigs, of camels, of cocks, of crows, of donkeys, and of human flesh, is a Tapta Krikkhra (penance).
verses.science: सडुच तु समासेव्य पुसे योषिति वा द्विजः। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मचारी तु योऽश्नीयान् मधु मांसं कथं चन । व्रतचारी तु स कृत्वा प्राकृतं कृच्छ्रं व्रतशेषं समापयेत्
verses.transliteration: brahmacārī tu yo'śnīyān madhu māṃsaṃ kathaṃ cana | vratacārī tu sa kṛtvā prākṛtaṃ kṛcchraṃ vrataśeṣaṃ samāpayet
verses.translation: If a twice-born man, who has not returned (home from his teacher's house), eats food, given at a monthly (Sraddha,) he shall fast during three days and pass one day (standing) in water.
verses.hindi: को उसका पति पक घर में बन्द करे और जो गमन में प्रायक्षित्त है. वही उससे फरवाचे  के वहकाने पर फिर भी वह बिगड़ जावे तो कराचे । एक रात यांडाखी के साथ
verses.commentary: Sense: If a twice-born man, who has not returned (home from his teacher's house), eats food, given at a monthly (Sraddha,) he shall fast during three days and pass one day (standing) in water.
verses.science: को उसका पति पक घर में बन्द करे और जो गमन में प्रायक्षित्त है. वही उससे फरवाचे के वहकाने पर फिर भी वह बिगड़ जावे तो कराचे। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: बिडालकाकाखूच्छिष्टं जग्ध्वा श्वनकुलस्य च । केशकीटावपन्नं च पिबेद्ब्रह्मसुवर्चलाम्
verses.transliteration: biḍālakākākhūcchiṣṭaṃ jagdhvā śvanakulasya ca | keśakīṭāvapannaṃ ca pibedbrahmasuvarcalām
verses.translation: But a student who on any occasion eats honey or meat, shall perform an ordinary Krikkhra (penance), and afterwards complete his vow (of studentship).
verses.hindi: पक वपे तक पतितो के साथ एक सबारी वा आसन पर घेठने " से और पक पक्कि में. भोजन करने से उनको यज्ञकभ कराने, चेद पढ़ाने ओर चिवाददसस्वन्ध करने से पतित होजाता है। जो मनुष्य इन पतितों के साथ जो संस्थ करता है बह उस संसर्ग की. शु
verses.commentary: Sense: But a student who on any occasion eats honey or meat, shall perform an ordinary Krikkhra (penance), and afterwards complete his vow (of studentship).
verses.science: पक वपे तक पतितो के साथ एक सबारी वा आसन पर घेठने " से और पक पक्कि में. भोजन करने से उनको यज्ञकभ कराने, चेद पढ़ाने ओर चिवाददसस्वन्ध करने से पतित होजाता है। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अभोज्यमन्नं नात्तव्यमात्मनः शुद्धिमिच्छता । अज्ञानभुक्तं तूत्तार्यं शोध्यं वाऽप्याशु शोधनैः
verses.transliteration: abhojyamannaṃ nāttavyamātmanaḥ śuddhimicchatā | ajñānabhuktaṃ tūttāryaṃ śodhyaṃ vā'pyāśu śodhanaiḥ
verses.translation: He who eats what is left by a cat, by a crow, by a mouse (or rat), by a dog, or by an ichneumon, or (food) into which a hair or an insect has fallen, shall drink (a decoction of) the Brahmasuvarkala (plant).
verses.hindi: सपिण्ड उनके साथ वोल-चाल उठना-वैठना छोड़ है । पिता फे धन में उसको साथ न दें ओर लौकिक व्यवहार भी न करे। पतित की ज्येष्ठता और उसके भाग का धव जाता रहता है। इसलिये यह भाग छोटों में जो शुणी हो उसको देना चाहिये ।
verses.commentary: Sense: He who eats what is left by a cat, by a crow, by a mouse (or rat), by a dog, or by an ichneumon, or (food) into which a hair or an insect has fallen, shall drink (a decoction of) the Brahmasuvarkala (plant).
verses.science: सपिण्ड उनके साथ वोल-चाल उठना-वैठना छोड़ है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एषोऽनाद्यादनस्योक्तो व्रतानां विविधो विधिः । स्तेयदोषापहर्तॄणां व्रतानां श्रूयतां विधिः
verses.transliteration: eṣo'nādyādanasyokto vratānāṃ vividho vidhiḥ | steyadoṣāpahartṝṇāṃ vratānāṃ śrūyatāṃ vidhiḥ
verses.translation: He who desires to be pure, must not eat forbidden food, and must vomit up such as he has eaten unintentionally, or quickly atone for it by (various) means of purification.
verses.hindi: प्रायश्वित्त न करनेदाले पातकिया के साथ दान आदि का निन्दा भी न करे । वालहत्यावाले, कूतघ, शरणागत को मारने तोसी उसका संसर्ग न करे । जिन द्विजं का शाखोक्क समय में यङ्ञापचात न इुआ हा उचका तान प्राजापत्य बत कराकर विधि
verses.commentary: Sense: He who desires to be pure, must not eat forbidden food, and must vomit up such as he has eaten unintentionally, or quickly atone for it by (various) means of purification.
verses.science: प्रायश्वित्त न करनेदाले पातकिया के साथ दान आदि का निन्दा भी न करे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: धान्यान्नधनचौर्याणि कृत्वा कामाद्द्विजोत्तमः । स्वजातीयगृहादेव कृच्छ्राब्देन विशुध्यति
verses.transliteration: dhānyānnadhanacauryāṇi kṛtvā kāmāddvijottamaḥ | svajātīyagṛhādeva kṛcchrābdena viśudhyati
verses.translation: The various rules respecting penances for eating forbidden food have been thus declared; hear now the law of those penances which remove the guilt of theft.
verses.hindi: -सासँ गोठे पयः पीत्वा मुच्यते,सखतियहात्
verses.commentary: Sense: The various rules respecting penances for eating forbidden food have been thus declared; hear now the law of those penances which remove the guilt of theft.
verses.science: -सासँ गोठे पयः पीत्वा मुच्यते,सखतियहात्। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मनुष्याणां तु हरणे स्त्रीणां क्षेत्रगृहस्य च । कूपवापीजलानां च शुद्धिश्चान्द्रायणं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: manuṣyāṇāṃ tu haraṇe strīṇāṃ kṣetragṛhasya ca | kūpavāpījalānāṃ ca śuddhiścāndrāyaṇaṃ smṛtam
verses.translation: The chief of the twice-born, having voluntarily stolen (valuable) property, grain, or cooked food, from the house of a caste-fellow, is purified by performing Krikkhra (penances) during a whole year.
verses.hindi: संवत्सरं यवीहारस्तत्पापमपसेधति
verses.commentary: Sense: The chief of the twice-born, having voluntarily stolen (valuable) property, grain, or cooked food, from the house of a caste-fellow, is purified by performing Krikkhra (penances) during a whole year.
verses.science: संवत्सरं यवीहारस्तत्पापमपसेधति। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: द्रव्याणामल्पसाराणां स्तेयं कृत्वाऽन्यवेश्मतः । कृत्वाऽन्यवेश्मनि चरेत्सांतपनं कृच्छ्रं तन्निर्यात्यात्मशुद्धये
verses.transliteration: dravyāṇāmalpasārāṇāṃ steyaṃ kṛtvā'nyaveśmataḥ | kṛtvā'nyaveśmani caretsāṃtapanaṃ kṛcchraṃ tanniryātyātmaśuddhaye
verses.translation: The lunar penance has been declared to be the expiation for stealing men and women, and (for wrongfully appropriating) a field, a house, or the water of wells and cisterns.
verses.hindi: जो आहास निदित कमो से धन कमाते हैं वे उसको छोड़ने और जप करके एक महीना गोष्ठ में हुग्घाहार करके, बुरे दान लेने के पाप से छूरता है। उस 'उपचास से कृश, गो से श्राए विनीत ” माहाण से पूछे कि है सौम्य ! “ क्या तू हमारे समान रहने की
verses.commentary: Sense: The lunar penance has been declared to be the expiation for stealing men and women, and (for wrongfully appropriating) a field, a house, or the water of wells and cisterns.
verses.science: जो आहास निदित कमो से धन कमाते हैं वे उसको छोड़ने और जप करके एक महीना गोष्ठ में हुग्घाहार करके, बुरे दान लेने के पाप से छूरता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: भक्ष्यभोज्यापहरणे यानशय्याऽऽसनस्य च । पुष्पमूलफलानां च पञ्चगव्यं विशोधनम्
verses.transliteration: bhakṣyabhojyāpaharaṇe yānaśayyā''sanasya ca | puṣpamūlaphalānāṃ ca pañcagavyaṃ viśodhanam
verses.translation: He who has stolen objects of small value from the house of another man, shall, after restoring the (stolen article), perform a Samtapana Krikkhra for his purification.
verses.hindi: उपटूयानं समार्य खरयानं तु कामतः ।
verses.commentary: Sense: He who has stolen objects of small value from the house of another man, shall, after restoring the (stolen article), perform a Samtapana Krikkhra for his purification.
verses.science: उपटूयानं समार्य खरयानं तु कामतः। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तृणकाष्ठद्रुमाणां च शुष्कान्नस्य गुडस्य च । चेलचर्मामिषाणां च त्रिरात्रं स्यादभोजनम्
verses.transliteration: tṛṇakāṣṭhadrumāṇāṃ ca śuṣkānnasya guḍasya ca | celacarmāmiṣāṇāṃ ca trirātraṃ syādabhojanam
verses.translation: (To swallow) the five products of the cow (pankagavya) is the atonement for stealing eatables of various kinds, a vehicle, a bed, a seat, flowers, roots, or fruit.
verses.hindi: वेदोदितानां नित्यानां कर्मणां समतिक्रमे ।
verses.commentary: Sense: (To swallow) the five products of the cow (pankagavya) is the atonement for stealing eatables of various kinds, a vehicle, a bed, a seat, flowers, roots, or fruit.
verses.science: वेदोदितानां नित्यानां कर्मणां समतिक्रमे। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: चैलचर्मामिक्षाणां मणिमुक्ताप्रवालानां ताम्रस्य रजतस्य च । अयः।कांस्यौपलानां च द्वादशाहं कणान्नता
verses.transliteration: cailacarmāmikṣāṇāṃ maṇimuktāpravālānāṃ tāmrasya rajatasya ca | ayaḥ|kāṃsyaupalānāṃ ca dvādaśāhaṃ kaṇānnatā
verses.translation: Fasting during three (days and) nights shall be (the penance for stealing) grass, wood, trees, dry food, molasses, clothes, leather, and meat.
verses.hindi: एक मास तक दो दिन के वाद तीसरे दिन सायंकाल--को भोजन, वेद्स॑हिता का पाठ और साकल मन्चौ से होम, पंक्लि- वाह्य.को शुद्ध करता है। घ्राण जानकर ऊंट या चथे की सवारी में बैठे या नंगा. होकर स्नान करे तो प्राणायाम से शुद्ध, होता .
verses.commentary: Sense: Fasting during three (days and) nights shall be (the penance for stealing) grass, wood, trees, dry food, molasses, clothes, leather, and meat.
verses.science: एक मास तक दो दिन के वाद तीसरे दिन सायंकाल--को भोजन, वेद्स॑हिता का पाठ और साकल मन्चौ से होम, पंक्लि- वाह्य.को शुद्ध करता है। धीमी श्वास वेगस तंत्रिका को सक्रिय कर भय-प्रतिक्रिया को शांत करती है। यह पंक्ति उसी श्वास और मन के संबंध को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: कार्पासकीटजोर्णानां द्विशफेकशफस्य च । द्वेशफेकखुरस्य च पक्षिगन्धौषधीनां च रज्ज्वाश्चैव त्र्यहं पयः
verses.transliteration: kārpāsakīṭajorṇānāṃ dviśaphekaśaphasya ca | dveśaphekakhurasya ca pakṣigandhauṣadhīnāṃ ca rajjvāścaiva tryahaṃ payaḥ
verses.translation: To subsist during twelve days on (uncooked) grains (is the penance for stealing) gems, pearls, coral, copper, silver, iron, brass, or stone.
verses.hindi: चराको नास छृच्छोभ्ये सवपापापनोदनः
verses.commentary: Sense: To subsist during twelve days on (uncooked) grains (is the penance for stealing) gems, pearls, coral, copper, silver, iron, brass, or stone.
verses.science: चराको नास छृच्छोभ्ये सवपापापनोदनः। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एतैर्व्रतैरपोहेत पापं स्तेयकृतं द्विजः । अगम्यागमनीयं तु व्रतैरेभिरपानुदेत्
verses.transliteration: etairvratairapoheta pāpaṃ steyakṛtaṃ dvijaḥ | agamyāgamanīyaṃ tu vratairebhirapānudet
verses.translation: (For stealing) cotton, silk, wool, an animal with cloven hoofs, or one with uncloven hoofs, a bird, perfumes, medicinal herbs, or a rope (the penance is to subsist) during three days (on) milk.
verses.hindi: करे । जिन दोपों का आयश्चिच नहीं कदा है उनका शक्ति ओर पाप नष्ट करता है उन देवर्षि और पितरों के सेवित उपायों को तुम से कहता है. । माजापत्य-जत करनेचाला द्विज तान दिन प्रात काल और तीन दिन साथकाल और तीन दिन विना मांगा खन्न
verses.commentary: Sense: (For stealing) cotton, silk, wool, an animal with cloven hoofs, or one with uncloven hoofs, a bird, perfumes, medicinal herbs, or a rope (the penance is to subsist) during three days (on) milk.
verses.science: करे। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: गुरुतल्पव्रतं कुर्याद्रेतः सिक्त्वा स्वयोनिषु । सख्युः पुत्रस्य च स्त्रीषु कुमारीष्वन्त्यजासु च
verses.transliteration: gurutalpavrataṃ kuryādretaḥ siktvā svayoniṣu | sakhyuḥ putrasya ca strīṣu kumārīṣvantyajāsu ca
verses.translation: By means of these penances, a twice-born man may remove the guilt of theft; but the guilt of approaching women who ought not to be approached (agamya), he may expiate by (the following) penances.
verses.hindi: यथा यथा नरो धर्म स्वयं कल्वानुभाषते।  तथा तथा लचेवाहिस्तेवाधर्मेण मुच्यते
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of these penances, a twice-born man may remove the guilt of theft; but the guilt of approaching women who ought not to be approached (agamya), he may expiate by (the following) penances.
verses.science: यथा यथा नरो धर्म स्वयं कल्वानुभाषते। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: पैतृस्वसेयीं भगिनीं स्वस्रीयां मातुरेव च । मातुश्च भ्रातुस्तनयां गत्वा चान्द्रायणं चरेत्
verses.transliteration: paitṛsvaseyīṃ bhaginīṃ svasrīyāṃ mātureva ca | mātuśca bhrātustanayāṃ gatvā cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret
verses.translation: He who has had sexual intercourse with sisters by the same mother, with the wives of a friend, or of a son, with unmarried maidens, and with females of the lowest castes, shall perform the penance, prescribed for the violation of a Guru's bed.
verses.hindi: मनोवाइसतिसिलित्य शुर्भ कसे समावरेत्
verses.commentary: Sense: He who has had sexual intercourse with sisters by the same mother, with the wives of a friend, or of a son, with unmarried maidens, and with females of the lowest castes, shall perform the penance, prescribed for the violation of a Guru's bed.
verses.science: मनोवाइसतिसिलित्य शुर्भ कसे समावरेत्। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: भ्रातुराप्तस्य गत्वा एतास्तिस्रस्तु भार्यार्थे नोपयच्छेत्तु बुद्धिमान् । ज्ञातित्वेनानुपेयास्ताः पतति ह्युपयन्नधः
verses.transliteration: bhrāturāptasya gatvā etāstisrastu bhāryārthe nopayacchettu buddhimān | jñātitvenānupeyāstāḥ patati hyupayannadhaḥ
verses.translation: He who has approached the daughter of his father's sister, (who is almost equal to) a sister, (the daughter) of his mother's sister, or of his mother's full brother, shall perform a lunar penance.
verses.hindi: आसन पर उडा बैठा करे, अशकक हो तो भूमि पर सोवि और ब्रह्मचारी, अती, शुरु, देवता और डिजोका पूजक होखे । नित्य यथाशक्ति गायनी ओर अघमपेणादि पवित्र सच्चा का जप करे । जप आर होस कराकर शुद्ध करें । पाप करनेवाला पाप प्रकट
verses.commentary: Sense: He who has approached the daughter of his father's sister, (who is almost equal to) a sister, (the daughter) of his mother's sister, or of his mother's full brother, shall perform a lunar penance.
verses.science: आसन पर उडा बैठा करे, अशकक हो तो भूमि पर सोवि और ब्रह्मचारी, अती, शुरु, देवता और डिजोका पूजक होखे। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: अमानुषीषू पुरुष उदक्यायामयोनिषु । रेतः सिक्त्वा जले चैव कृच्छ्रं सांतपनं चरेत्
verses.transliteration: amānuṣīṣū puruṣa udakyāyāmayoniṣu | retaḥ siktvā jale caiva kṛcchraṃ sāṃtapanaṃ caret
verses.translation: A wise man should not take as his wife any of these three; they must not be wedded because they are (Sapinda-) relatives, he who marries (one of them), sinks low.
verses.hindi: महापाताकियश्चेव शेषाश्वाकार्यकारिशः । ज्ञानकर वा व ज्ञानकर निंदित कर्म करके उससे छुटकारा चाइनेचाला फिर दूसरा पापकर्म न करे; पापी के मन मै यदि आायखित्त से संतोष न हो तो अबतक सन्तोष हो तबतक तप
verses.commentary: Sense: A wise man should not take as his wife any of these three; they must not be wedded because they are (Sapinda-) relatives, he who marries (one of them), sinks low.
verses.science: महापाताकियश्चेव शेषाश्वाकार्यकारिशः। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: मैथुनं तु समासेव्य पुंसि योषिति वा द्विजः । गोयानेऽप्सु दिवा चैव सवासाः स्नानमाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: maithunaṃ tu samāsevya puṃsi yoṣiti vā dvijaḥ | goyāne'psu divā caiva savāsāḥ snānamācaret
verses.translation: A man who has committed a bestial crime, or an unnatural crime with a female, or has had intercourse in water, or with a menstruating woman, shall perform a Samtapana Krikkhra.
verses.hindi: से स्वर को जाते हैं। मझुष्य मन, वाणी और शारीर खे जो कुड पाप करते है उन सव को तपोधन ऋषि तप से शीघ्र ही भस्म हैं और कामनाओं को पूणे करते हैँ। तपोवल से ही प्रजापति ने - इस शाख को रचाथा और ऋषियों ने वेद भी तप से पाया था!
verses.commentary: Sense: A man who has committed a bestial crime, or an unnatural crime with a female, or has had intercourse in water, or with a menstruating woman, shall perform a Samtapana Krikkhra.
verses.science: से स्वर को जाते हैं। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: चण्डालान्त्यस्त्रियो गत्वा भुक्त्वा च प्रतिगृह्य च । पतत्यज्ञानतो विप्रो ज्ञानात्साम्यं तु गच्छति
verses.transliteration: caṇḍālāntyastriyo gatvā bhuktvā ca pratigṛhya ca | patatyajñānato vipro jñānātsāmyaṃ tu gacchati
verses.translation: A twice-born man who commits an unnatural offence with a male, or has intercourse with a female in a cart drawn by oxen, in water, or in the day-time, shall bathe, dressed in his clothes.
verses.hindi: अपि भ्रूणहणं मासासुनन्त्यहरहः कृता;
verses.commentary: Sense: A twice-born man who commits an unnatural offence with a male, or has intercourse with a female in a cart drawn by oxen, in water, or in the day-time, shall bathe, dressed in his clothes.
verses.science: अपि भ्रूणहणं मासासुनन्त्यहरहः कृता;। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विप्रदुष्टां स्त्रियं भर्ता निरुन्ध्यादेकवेश्मनि । यत्पुंसः परदारेषु तच्चैनां चारयेद्व्रतम्
verses.transliteration: vipraduṣṭāṃ striyaṃ bhartā nirundhyādekaveśmani | yatpuṃsaḥ paradāreṣu taccaināṃ cārayedvratam
verses.translation: A Brahmana who unintentionally approaches a woman of the Kandala or of (any other) very low caste, who eats (the food of such persons) and accepts (presents from them) becomes an outcast; but (if he does it) intentionally, he becomes their equal.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार पापों का यथाविधि प्रायश्चितत कहा गया है. का पाठ करने से सुरापान दीष से मुक्त होजाता ९ । ॥ अस्या मस्य० ' इत्यादि ऋचा के सक और ' शिवसेकरुप० !: त्यां े सूकर के पाठ 'से, खुबरीचोरी फे पाप से तुरंत छ जाता है
verses.commentary: Sense: A Brahmana who unintentionally approaches a woman of the Kandala or of (any other) very low caste, who eats (the food of such persons) and accepts (presents from them) becomes an outcast; but (if he does it) intentionally, he becomes their equal.
verses.science: इस प्रकार पापों का यथाविधि प्रायश्चितत कहा गया है. का पाठ करने से सुरापान दीष से मुक्त होजाता ९। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सा चेत्पुनः प्रदुष्येत्तु सदृशेनोपमन्त्रिता । सदृशेनोपयन्त्रिता कृच्छ्रं चान्द्रायणं चैव तदस्याः पावनं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: sā cetpunaḥ praduṣyettu sadṛśenopamantritā | sadṛśenopayantritā kṛcchraṃ cāndrāyaṇaṃ caiva tadasyāḥ pāvanaṃ smṛtam
verses.translation: An exceedingly corrupt wife let her husband confine to one apartment, and compel her to perform the penance which is prescribed for males in cases of adultery.
verses.hindi: सहापातकसंचुकोऽनुगच्छेद्गाः समाहितः ।
verses.commentary: Sense: An exceedingly corrupt wife let her husband confine to one apartment, and compel her to perform the penance which is prescribed for males in cases of adultery.
verses.science: सहापातकसंचुकोऽनुगच्छेद्गाः समाहितः। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यत्करोत्येकरात्रेण वृषलीसेवनाद्द्विजः । तद्भैक्षभुज्जपन्नित्यं त्रिभिर्वर्षैर्व्यपोहति
verses.transliteration: yatkarotyekarātreṇa vṛṣalīsevanāddvijaḥ | tadbhaikṣabhujjapannityaṃ tribhirvarṣairvyapohati
verses.translation: If, being solicited by a man (of) equal (caste), she (afterwards) is again unfaithful, then a Krikkhra and a lunar penance are prescribed as the means of purifying her.
verses.hindi: -सुच्यते पातकेः सवैः पराकैः शोविताश्चिभिः
verses.commentary: Sense: If, being solicited by a man (of) equal (caste), she (afterwards) is again unfaithful, then a Krikkhra and a lunar penance are prescribed as the means of purifying her.
verses.science: -सुच्यते पातकेः सवैः पराकैः शोविताश्चिभिः। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एषा पापकृतामुक्ता चतुर्णामपि निष्कृतिः । पतितैः सम्प्रयुक्तानामिमाः शृणुत निष्कृतीः
verses.transliteration: eṣā pāpakṛtāmuktā caturṇāmapi niṣkṛtiḥ | patitaiḥ samprayuktānāmimāḥ śṛṇuta niṣkṛtīḥ
verses.translation: The sin which a twice-born man commits by dallying one night with a Vrishali, he removes in three years, by subsisting on alms and daily muttering (sacred texts).
verses.hindi: अधिक पाप करनेवाला नदी में स्वान करके ' सोमा रुद्रा ऋचाओंका एक मास तक नित्य पाउ करे तो शुद्ध होता है। “ऋचा का-नित्य पाठ करे ओर जल में सत्त-सूच डालनेवाला एक भास तक भोख मांगकर निर्वाह करे । द्विज, ' देवकतस्थ० ”
verses.commentary: Sense: The sin which a twice-born man commits by dallying one night with a Vrishali, he removes in three years, by subsisting on alms and daily muttering (sacred texts).
verses.science: अधिक पाप करनेवाला नदी में स्वान करके ' सोमा रुद्रा ऋचाओंका एक मास तक नित्य पाउ करे तो शुद्ध होता है। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: संवत्सरेण पतति पतितेन सहाचरन् । याजनाध्यापनाद्यौनान्न तु यानासनाशनात्
verses.transliteration: saṃvatsareṇa patati patitena sahācaran | yājanādhyāpanādyaunānna tu yānāsanāśanāt
verses.translation: The atonement (to be performed) by sinners (of) four (kinds) even, has been thus declared; hear now the penances for those who have intercourse with outcasts.
verses.hindi: जैले: यक्षा. का"राजाः अश्वमेध ,लब पापो:का 'नाशक्तःहे, चेस - भोजन. करे .तो;भी उसको' पातक नहीं लगता ।.जो  द्विज, सावः; . घावी; से, ऋफ्सहिता या यजुःसंहिता. अथवा; सामसंदितां-की .. ब्राह्मण-उपनिषदों  के सहित तीन बार (वृत्तिः करे तो! सब.
verses.commentary: Sense: The atonement (to be performed) by sinners (of) four (kinds) even, has been thus declared; hear now the penances for those who have intercourse with outcasts.
verses.science: जैले: यक्षा. का"राजाः अश्वमेध ,लब पापो:का 'नाशक्तःहे, चेस - भोजन. करे .तो;भी उसको' पातक नहीं लगता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यो येन पतितेनैषां संसर्गं याति मानवः । स तस्यैव व्रतं कुर्यात्तत्संसर्गविशुद्धये
verses.transliteration: yo yena patitenaiṣāṃ saṃsargaṃ yāti mānavaḥ | sa tasyaiva vrataṃ kuryāttatsaṃsargaviśuddhaye
verses.translation: He who associates with an outcast, himself becomes an outcast after a year, not by sacrificing for him, teaching him, or forming a matrimonial alliance with him, but by using the same carriage or seat, or by eating with him.
verses.hindi: स तानुवाच धर्मात्मा सहर्षीन सोनवो थृगुः। .
verses.commentary: Sense: He who associates with an outcast, himself becomes an outcast after a year, not by sacrificing for him, teaching him, or forming a matrimonial alliance with him, but by using the same carriage or seat, or by eating with him.
verses.science: स तानुवाच धर्मात्मा सहर्षीन सोनवो थृगुः। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: पतितस्योदकं कार्यं सपिण्डैर्बान्धवैर्बहिः । निन्दितेऽहनि सायाह्ने ज्ञातिर्त्विग्गुरुसंनिधौ
verses.transliteration: patitasyodakaṃ kāryaṃ sapiṇḍairbāndhavairbahiḥ | nindite'hani sāyāhne jñātirtviggurusaṃnidhau
verses.translation: He who associates with any one of those outcasts, must perform, in order to atone for (such) intercourse, the penance prescribed for that (sinner).
verses.hindi: कर्सजा गतयो नृणासुत्तमाधसमध्यमाः
verses.commentary: Sense: He who associates with any one of those outcasts, must perform, in order to atone for (such) intercourse, the penance prescribed for that (sinner).
verses.science: कर्सजा गतयो नृणासुत्तमाधसमध्यमाः। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दासी घटमपां पूर्णं पर्यस्येत्प्रेतवत्पदा । अहोरात्रमुपासीरन्नशौचं बान्धवैः सह
verses.transliteration: dāsī ghaṭamapāṃ pūrṇaṃ paryasyetpretavatpadā | ahorātramupāsīrannaśaucaṃ bāndhavaiḥ saha
verses.translation: The Sapindas and Samanodakas of an outcast must offer (a libation of) water (to him, as if he were dead), outside (the village), on an inauspicious day, in the evening and in the presence of the relatives, officiating priests, and teachers.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.commentary: Sense: The Sapindas and Samanodakas of an outcast must offer (a libation of) water (to him, as if he were dead), outside (the village), on an inauspicious day, in the evening and in the presence of the relatives, officiating priests, and teachers.
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: निवर्तेरंश्च तस्मात्तु सम्भाषणसहासने । दायाद्यस्य प्रदानं च यात्रा चैव हि लौकिकी
verses.transliteration: nivarteraṃśca tasmāttu sambhāṣaṇasahāsane | dāyādyasya pradānaṃ ca yātrā caiva hi laukikī
verses.translation: A female slave shall upset with her foot a pot filled with water, as if it were for a dead person; (his Sapindas) as well as the Samanodakas shall be impure for a day and a night;
verses.commentary: Sense: A female slave shall upset with her foot a pot filled with water, as if it were for a dead person; (his Sapindas) as well as the Samanodakas shall be impure for a day and a night;
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ज्येष्ठता च निवर्तेत ज्येष्ठावाप्यं च यद्धनम् । यद्वसु ज्येष्ठांशं प्राप्नुयाच्चास्य यवीयान् गुणतोऽधिकः
verses.transliteration: jyeṣṭhatā ca nivarteta jyeṣṭhāvāpyaṃ ca yaddhanam | yadvasu jyeṣṭhāṃśaṃ prāpnuyāccāsya yavīyān guṇato'dhikaḥ
verses.translation: But thenceforward it shall be forbidden to converse with him, to sit with him, to give him a share of the inheritance, and to hold with him such intercourse as is usual among men;
verses.commentary: Sense: But thenceforward it shall be forbidden to converse with him, to sit with him, to give him a share of the inheritance, and to hold with him such intercourse as is usual among men;
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रायश्चित्ते तु चरिते पूर्णकुम्भमपां नवम् । तेनैव सार्धं प्रास्येयुः स्नात्वा पुण्ये जलाशये
verses.transliteration: prāyaścitte tu carite pūrṇakumbhamapāṃ navam | tenaiva sārdhaṃ prāsyeyuḥ snātvā puṇye jalāśaye
verses.translation: And (if he be the eldest) his right of primogeniture shall be withheld and the additional share, due to the eldest son; and his stead a younger brother, excelling in virtue, shall obtain the share of the eldest.
verses.commentary: Sense: And (if he be the eldest) his right of primogeniture shall be withheld and the additional share, due to the eldest son; and his stead a younger brother, excelling in virtue, shall obtain the share of the eldest.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स त्वप्सु तं घटं प्रास्य प्रविश्य भवनं स्वकम् । सर्वाणि ज्ञातिकार्याणि यथापूर्वं समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: sa tvapsu taṃ ghaṭaṃ prāsya praviśya bhavanaṃ svakam | sarvāṇi jñātikāryāṇi yathāpūrvaṃ samācaret
verses.translation: But when he has performed his penance, they shall bathe with him in a holy pool and throw down a new pot, filled with water.
verses.commentary: Sense: But when he has performed his penance, they shall bathe with him in a holy pool and throw down a new pot, filled with water.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एतदेव विधिं कुर्याद्योषित्सु पतितास्वपि । एतमेव विधिं वस्त्रान्नपानं देयं तु वसेयुश्च गृहान्तिके
verses.transliteration: etadeva vidhiṃ kuryādyoṣitsu patitāsvapi | etameva vidhiṃ vastrānnapānaṃ deyaṃ tu vaseyuśca gṛhāntike
verses.translation: But he shall throw that pot into water, enter his house and perform, as before, all the duties incumbent on a relative.
verses.commentary: Sense: But he shall throw that pot into water, enter his house and perform, as before, all the duties incumbent on a relative.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एनस्विभिरनिर्णिक्तैर्नार्थं किं चित्सहाचरेत् । कृतनिर्णेजनांश्चैव न जुगुप्सेत कर्हि चित्
verses.transliteration: enasvibhiranirṇiktairnārthaṃ kiṃ citsahācaret | kṛtanirṇejanāṃścaiva na jugupseta karhi cit
verses.translation: Let him follow the same rule in the case of female outcasts; but clothes, food, and drink shall be given to them, and they shall live close to the (family-) house.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let him follow the same rule in the case of female outcasts; but clothes, food, and drink shall be given to them, and they shall live close to the (family-) house.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कृतनिर्णेजनांश्चैतान् बालघ्नांश्च कृतघ्नांश्च विशुद्धानपि धर्मतः । शरणागतहन्तॄंश्च स्त्रीहन्तॄंश्च न संवसेत्
verses.transliteration: kṛtanirṇejanāṃścaitān bālaghnāṃśca kṛtaghnāṃśca viśuddhānapi dharmataḥ | śaraṇāgatahantṝṃśca strīhantṝṃśca na saṃvaset
verses.translation: Let him not transact any business with unpurified sinners; but let him in no way reproach those who have made atonement.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let him not transact any business with unpurified sinners; but let him in no way reproach those who have made atonement.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: येषां द्विजानां सावित्री नानूच्येत यथाविधि । तांश्चारयित्वा त्रीन् कृच्छ्रान् यथाविध्योपनाययेत्
verses.transliteration: yeṣāṃ dvijānāṃ sāvitrī nānūcyeta yathāvidhi | tāṃścārayitvā trīn kṛcchrān yathāvidhyopanāyayet
verses.translation: Let him not dwell together with the murderers of children, with those who have returned evil for good, and with the slayers of suppliants for protection or of women, though they may have been purified according to the sacred law.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let him not dwell together with the murderers of children, with those who have returned evil for good, and with the slayers of suppliants for protection or of women, though they may have been purified according to the sacred law.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रायश्चित्तं चिकीर्षन्ति विकर्मस्थास्तु ये द्विजाः । ब्रह्मणा च परित्यक्तास्तेषामप्येतदादिशेत्
verses.transliteration: prāyaścittaṃ cikīrṣanti vikarmasthāstu ye dvijāḥ | brahmaṇā ca parityaktāsteṣāmapyetadādiśet
verses.translation: Those twice-born men who may not have been taught the Savitri (at the time) prescribed by the rule, he shall cause to perform three Krikkhra (penances) and afterwards initiate them in accordance with the law.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those twice-born men who may not have been taught the Savitri (at the time) prescribed by the rule, he shall cause to perform three Krikkhra (penances) and afterwards initiate them in accordance with the law.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यद्गर्हितेनार्जयन्ति कर्मणा ब्राह्मणा धनम् । तस्योत्सर्गेण शुध्यन्ति जप्येन तपसैव च
verses.transliteration: yadgarhitenārjayanti karmaṇā brāhmaṇā dhanam | tasyotsargeṇa śudhyanti japyena tapasaiva ca
verses.translation: Let him prescribe the same (expiation) when twice-born men, who follow forbidden occupations or have neglected (to learn) the Veda, desire to perform a penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let him prescribe the same (expiation) when twice-born men, who follow forbidden occupations or have neglected (to learn) the Veda, desire to perform a penance.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: जपित्वा त्रीणि सावित्र्याः सहस्राणि समाहितः । मासं गोष्ठे पयः पीत्वा मुच्यतेऽसत्प्रतिग्रहात्
verses.transliteration: japitvā trīṇi sāvitryāḥ sahasrāṇi samāhitaḥ | māsaṃ goṣṭhe payaḥ pītvā mucyate'satpratigrahāt
verses.translation: If Brahmanas acquire property by a reprehensible action, they become pure by relinquishing it, muttering prayers, and (performing) austerities.
verses.commentary: Sense: If Brahmanas acquire property by a reprehensible action, they become pure by relinquishing it, muttering prayers, and (performing) austerities.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: उपवासकृशं तं तु गोव्रजात्पुनरागतम् । प्रणतं प्रति पृच्छेयुः साम्यं सौम्यैच्छसीति किम्
verses.transliteration: upavāsakṛśaṃ taṃ tu govrajātpunarāgatam | praṇataṃ prati pṛccheyuḥ sāmyaṃ saumyaicchasīti kim
verses.translation: By muttering with a concentrated mind the Savitri three thousand times, (dwelling) for a month in a cow-house, (and) subsisting on milk, (a man) is freed from (the guilt of) accepting presents from a wicked man.
verses.commentary: Sense: By muttering with a concentrated mind the Savitri three thousand times, (dwelling) for a month in a cow-house, (and) subsisting on milk, (a man) is freed from (the guilt of) accepting presents from a wicked man.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सत्यमुक्त्वा तु विप्रेषु विकिरेद्यवसं गवाम् । गोभिः प्रवर्तिते तीर्थे कुर्युस्तस्य परिग्रहम्
verses.transliteration: satyamuktvā tu vipreṣu vikiredyavasaṃ gavām | gobhiḥ pravartite tīrthe kuryustasya parigraham
verses.translation: But when he returns from the cow-house, emaciated with his fast, and reverently salutes, (the Brahmanas) shall ask him, 'Friend, dost thou desire to become our equal?'
verses.commentary: Sense: But when he returns from the cow-house, emaciated with his fast, and reverently salutes, (the Brahmanas) shall ask him, 'Friend, dost thou desire to become our equal?'
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: व्रात्यानां याजनं कृत्वा परेषामन्त्यकर्म च । अभिचारमहीनं च त्रिभिः कृच्छ्रैर्व्यपोहति
verses.transliteration: vrātyānāṃ yājanaṃ kṛtvā pareṣāmantyakarma ca | abhicāramahīnaṃ ca tribhiḥ kṛcchrairvyapohati
verses.translation: If he answers to the Brahmanas, 'Forsooth, (I will not offend again), 'he shall scatter (some) grass for the cows; if the cows hallow that place (by eating the grass) the (Brahmana) shall re-admit him (into their community).
verses.commentary: Sense: If he answers to the Brahmanas, 'Forsooth, (I will not offend again), 'he shall scatter (some) grass for the cows; if the cows hallow that place (by eating the grass) the (Brahmana) shall re-admit him (into their community).
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शरणागतं परित्यज्य वेदं विप्लाव्य च द्विजः । संवत्सरं यवाहारस्तत्पापमपसेधति
verses.transliteration: śaraṇāgataṃ parityajya vedaṃ viplāvya ca dvijaḥ | saṃvatsaraṃ yavāhārastatpāpamapasedhati
verses.translation: He who has sacrificed for Vratyas, or has performed the obsequies of strangers, or a magic sacrifice (intended to destroy life) or an Ahina sacrifice, removes (his guilt) by three Krikkhra (penances).
verses.commentary: Sense: He who has sacrificed for Vratyas, or has performed the obsequies of strangers, or a magic sacrifice (intended to destroy life) or an Ahina sacrifice, removes (his guilt) by three Krikkhra (penances).
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्वशृगालखरैर्दष्टो ग्राम्यैः क्रव्याद्भिरेव च । नराश्वोष्ट्रवराहैश्च प्राणायामेन शुध्यति
verses.transliteration: śvaśṛgālakharairdaṣṭo grāmyaiḥ kravyādbhireva ca | narāśvoṣṭravarāhaiśca prāṇāyāmena śudhyati
verses.translation: A twice-born man who has cast off a suppliant for protection, or has (improperly) divulged the Veda, atones for his offence, if he subsists during a year on barley.
verses.commentary: Sense: A twice-born man who has cast off a suppliant for protection, or has (improperly) divulged the Veda, atones for his offence, if he subsists during a year on barley.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: षष्ठान्नकालता मासं संहिताजप एव वा । होमाश्च सकला नित्यमपाङ्क्त्यानां विशोधनम्
verses.transliteration: ṣaṣṭhānnakālatā māsaṃ saṃhitājapa eva vā | homāśca sakalā nityamapāṅktyānāṃ viśodhanam
verses.translation: He who has been bitten by a dog, a jackal, or a donkey, by a tame carnivorous animal, by a man, a horse, a camel, or a (village-) pig, becomes pure by suppressing his breath (Pranayama).
verses.commentary: Sense: He who has been bitten by a dog, a jackal, or a donkey, by a tame carnivorous animal, by a man, a horse, a camel, or a (village-) pig, becomes pure by suppressing his breath (Pranayama).
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: होमाश्च शाकला उष्ट्रयानं समारुह्य खरयानं तु कामतः । स्नात्वा तु विप्रो दिग्वासाः प्राणायामेन शुध्यति
verses.transliteration: homāśca śākalā uṣṭrayānaṃ samāruhya kharayānaṃ tu kāmataḥ | snātvā tu vipro digvāsāḥ prāṇāyāmena śudhyati
verses.translation: To eat during a month at each sixth mealtime (only), to recite the Samhita (of a Veda), and (to perform) daily the Sakala oblations, are the means of purifying those excluded from society at repasts (Apanktya).
verses.commentary: Sense: To eat during a month at each sixth mealtime (only), to recite the Samhita (of a Veda), and (to perform) daily the Sakala oblations, are the means of purifying those excluded from society at repasts (Apanktya).
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विनाऽद्भिरप्सु वाऽप्यार्तः शारीरं संनिषेव्य च । सचैलो बहिराप्लुत्य गामालभ्य विशुध्यति
verses.transliteration: vinā'dbhirapsu vā'pyārtaḥ śārīraṃ saṃniṣevya ca | sacailo bahirāplutya gāmālabhya viśudhyati
verses.translation: A Brahmana who voluntarily rode in a carriage drawn by camels or by asses, and he who bathed naked, become pure by suppressing his breath (Pranayama).
verses.commentary: Sense: A Brahmana who voluntarily rode in a carriage drawn by camels or by asses, and he who bathed naked, become pure by suppressing his breath (Pranayama).
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वेदोदितानां नित्यानां कर्मणां समतिक्रमे । स्नातकव्रतलोपे च प्रायश्चित्तमभोजनम्
verses.transliteration: vedoditānāṃ nityānāṃ karmaṇāṃ samatikrame | snātakavratalope ca prāyaścittamabhojanam
verses.translation: He who has relieved the necessities of nature, being greatly pressed, either without (using) water or in water, becomes pure by bathing outside (the village) in his clothes and by touching a cow.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who has relieved the necessities of nature, being greatly pressed, either without (using) water or in water, becomes pure by bathing outside (the village) in his clothes and by touching a cow.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: हुङ्कारं ब्राह्मणस्योक्त्वा त्वङ्कारं च गरीयसः । स्नात्वाऽनश्नन्नहः शेषमभिवाद्य प्रसादयेत्
verses.transliteration: huṅkāraṃ brāhmaṇasyoktvā tvaṅkāraṃ ca garīyasaḥ | snātvā'naśnannahaḥ śeṣamabhivādya prasādayet
verses.translation: Fasting is the penance for omitting the daily rites prescribed by the Veda and for neglecting the special duties of a Snataka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Fasting is the penance for omitting the daily rites prescribed by the Veda and for neglecting the special duties of a Snataka.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ताडयित्वा तृणेनापि कण्ठे वाऽबध्य वाससा । विवादे वा विनिर्जित्य प्रणिपत्य प्रसादयेत्
verses.transliteration: tāḍayitvā tṛṇenāpi kaṇṭhe vā'badhya vāsasā | vivāde vā vinirjitya praṇipatya prasādayet
verses.translation: He who has said 'Hum' to a Brahmana, or has addressed one of his betters with 'Thou,' shall bathe, fast during the remaining part of the day, and appease (the person offended) by a reverential salutation.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who has said 'Hum' to a Brahmana, or has addressed one of his betters with 'Thou,' shall bathe, fast during the remaining part of the day, and appease (the person offended) by a reverential salutation.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अवगूर्य त्वब्दशतं सहस्रमभिहत्य च । जिघांसया ब्राह्मणस्य नरकं प्रतिपद्यते
verses.transliteration: avagūrya tvabdaśataṃ sahasramabhihatya ca | jighāṃsayā brāhmaṇasya narakaṃ pratipadyate
verses.translation: He who has struck (a Brahmana) even with a blade of grass, tied him by the neck with a cloth, or conquered him in an altercation, shall appease him by a prostration.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who has struck (a Brahmana) even with a blade of grass, tied him by the neck with a cloth, or conquered him in an altercation, shall appease him by a prostration.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शोणितं यावतः पांसून् सङ्गृह्णाति महीतले । तावन्त्यब्दसहस्राणि तत्कर्ता नरके वसेत्
verses.transliteration: śoṇitaṃ yāvataḥ pāṃsūn saṅgṛhṇāti mahītale | tāvantyabdasahasrāṇi tatkartā narake vaset
verses.translation: But he who, intending to hurt a Brahmana, has threatened (him with a stick and the like) shall remain in hell during a hundred years; he who (actually) struck him, during one thousand years.
verses.commentary: Sense: But he who, intending to hurt a Brahmana, has threatened (him with a stick and the like) shall remain in hell during a hundred years; he who (actually) struck him, during one thousand years.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नरके व्रजेत् अवगूर्य चरेत्कृच्छ्रमतिकृच्छ्रं निपातने । कृच्छ्रातिकृच्छ्रौ कुर्वीत विप्रस्योत्पाद्य शोणितम्
verses.transliteration: narake vrajet avagūrya caretkṛcchramatikṛcchraṃ nipātane | kṛcchrātikṛcchrau kurvīta viprasyotpādya śoṇitam
verses.translation: As many particles of dust as the blood of a Brahmana causes to coagulate, for so many thousand years shall the shedder of that (blood) remain in hell.
verses.commentary: Sense: As many particles of dust as the blood of a Brahmana causes to coagulate, for so many thousand years shall the shedder of that (blood) remain in hell.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अनुक्तनिष्कृतीनां तु पापानामपनुत्तये । शक्तिं चावेक्ष्य पापं च प्रायश्चित्तं प्रकल्पयेत्
verses.transliteration: anuktaniṣkṛtīnāṃ tu pāpānāmapanuttaye | śaktiṃ cāvekṣya pāpaṃ ca prāyaścittaṃ prakalpayet
verses.translation: For threatening a Brahmana, (the offender) shall perform a Krikkhra, for striking him an Atikrikkhra, for shedding his blood a Krikkhra and an Atikrikkhra.
verses.commentary: Sense: For threatening a Brahmana, (the offender) shall perform a Krikkhra, for striking him an Atikrikkhra, for shedding his blood a Krikkhra and an Atikrikkhra.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यैरभ्युपायैरेनांसि मानवो व्यपकर्षति । तान् वोऽभ्युपायान् वक्ष्यामि देवर्षिपितृसेवितान्
verses.transliteration: yairabhyupāyairenāṃsi mānavo vyapakarṣati | tān vo'bhyupāyān vakṣyāmi devarṣipitṛsevitān
verses.translation: For the expiation of offences for which no atonement has been prescribed, let him fix a penance after considering (the offender's) strength and the (nature of the) offence.
verses.commentary: Sense: For the expiation of offences for which no atonement has been prescribed, let him fix a penance after considering (the offender's) strength and the (nature of the) offence.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: त्र्यहं प्रातस्त्र्यहं सायं त्र्यहमद्यादयाचितम् । त्र्यहं परं च नाश्नीयात्प्राजापत्यं चरन् द्विजः
verses.transliteration: tryahaṃ prātastryahaṃ sāyaṃ tryahamadyādayācitam | tryahaṃ paraṃ ca nāśnīyātprājāpatyaṃ caran dvijaḥ
verses.translation: I will (now) describe to you those means, adopted by the gods, the sages, and the manes, through which a man may remove his sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: I will (now) describe to you those means, adopted by the gods, the sages, and the manes, through which a man may remove his sins.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: गोमूत्रं गोमयं क्षीरं दधि सर्पिः कुशोदकम् । एकरात्रोपवासश्च कृच्छ्रं सांतपनं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi sarpiḥ kuśodakam | ekarātropavāsaśca kṛcchraṃ sāṃtapanaṃ smṛtam
verses.translation: A twice-born man who performs (the Krikkhra penance), revealed by Pragapati, shall eat during three days in the morning (only), during (the next) three days in the evening (only), during the (following) three days (food given) unasked, and shall fast during another period of three days.
verses.wordMeaning: A twice-born man who performs (the Krikkhra penance), revealed by Pragapati, shall eat during three days in the morning (only), during (the next) three days in the evening (only), during the (following) three days (food given) unasked,…
verses.commentary: Sense: A twice-born man who performs (the Krikkhra penance), revealed by Pragapati, shall eat during three days in the morning (only), during (the next) three days in the evening (only), during the (following) three days (food given) unasked,…
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एकैकं ग्रासमश्नीयात्त्र्यहाणि त्रीणि पूर्ववत् । त्र्यहं चोपवसेदन्त्यमतिकृच्छ्रं चरन् द्विजः
verses.transliteration: ekaikaṃ grāsamaśnīyāttryahāṇi trīṇi pūrvavat | tryahaṃ copavasedantyamatikṛcchraṃ caran dvijaḥ
verses.translation: (Subsisting on) the urine of cows, cowdung, milk, sour milk, clarified butter, and a decoction of Kusa-grass, and fasting during one (day and) night, (that is) called a Samtapana Krikkhra.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Subsisting on) the urine of cows, cowdung, milk, sour milk, clarified butter, and a decoction of Kusa-grass, and fasting during one (day and) night, (that is) called a Samtapana Krikkhra.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तप्तकृच्छ्रं चरन् विप्रो जलक्षीरघृतानिलान् । प्रतित्र्यहं पिबेदुष्णान् सकृत्स्नायी समाहितः
verses.transliteration: taptakṛcchraṃ caran vipro jalakṣīraghṛtānilān | pratitryahaṃ pibeduṣṇān sakṛtsnāyī samāhitaḥ
verses.translation: A twice-born man who performs an Atikrikkhra (penance), must take his food during three periods of three days in the manner described above, (but) one mouthful only at each meal, and fast during the last three days.
verses.commentary: Sense: A twice-born man who performs an Atikrikkhra (penance), must take his food during three periods of three days in the manner described above, (but) one mouthful only at each meal, and fast during the last three days.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यतात्मनोऽप्रमत्तस्य द्वादशाहमभोजनम् । पराको नाम कृच्छ्रोऽयं सर्वपापापनोदनः
verses.transliteration: yatātmano'pramattasya dvādaśāhamabhojanam | parāko nāma kṛcchro'yaṃ sarvapāpāpanodanaḥ
verses.translation: A Brahmana who performs a Taptakrikkhra (penance) must drink hot water, hot milk, hot clarified butter and (inhale) hot air, each during three days, and bathe once with a concentrated mind.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Brahmana who performs a Taptakrikkhra (penance) must drink hot water, hot milk, hot clarified butter and (inhale) hot air, each during three days, and bathe once with a concentrated mind.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एकैकं ह्रासयेत्पिण्डं कृष्णे शुक्ले च वर्धयेत् । उपस्पृशंस्त्रिषवणमेतत्चाण्ड्रायणं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: ekaikaṃ hrāsayetpiṇḍaṃ kṛṣṇe śukle ca vardhayet | upaspṛśaṃstriṣavaṇametatcāṇḍrāyaṇaṃ smṛtam
verses.translation: A fast for twelve days by a man who controls himself and commits no mistakes, is called a Paraka Krikkhra, which removes all guilt.
verses.commentary: Sense: A fast for twelve days by a man who controls himself and commits no mistakes, is called a Paraka Krikkhra, which removes all guilt.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एतमेव विधिं कृत्स्नमाचरेद्यवमध्यमे । शुक्लपक्षादिनियतश्चरंश्चान्द्रायणं व्रतम्
verses.transliteration: etameva vidhiṃ kṛtsnamācaredyavamadhyame | śuklapakṣādiniyataścaraṃścāndrāyaṇaṃ vratam
