verses.transliteration: bahūn varṣagaṇān ghorānnarakān prāpya tatkṣayāt | saṃsārān pratipadyante mahāpātakinastvimān
verses.translation: Those who committed mortal sins (mahapataka), having passed during large numbers of years through dreadful hells, obtain, after the expiration of (that term of punishment), the following births.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who committed mortal sins (mahapataka), having passed during large numbers of years through dreadful hells, obtain, after the expiration of (that term of punishment), the following births.

verses.translation: The slayer of a Brahmana enters the womb of a dog, a pig, an ass, a camel, a cow, a goat, a sheep, a deer, a bird, a Kandala, and a Pukkasa.

verses.transliteration: kṛmikīṭapataṅgānāṃ viḍbhujāṃ caiva pakṣiṇām | hiṃsrāṇāṃ caiva sattvānāṃ surāpo brāhmaṇo vrajet
verses.translation: A Brahmana who drinks (the spirituous liquor called) Sura shall enter (the bodies) of small and large insects, of moths, of birds, feeding on ordure, and of destructive beasts.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Brahmana who drinks (the spirituous liquor called) Sura shall enter (the bodies) of small and large insects, of moths, of birds, feeding on ordure, and of destructive beasts.

verses.sanskrit: लूताऽहिसरटानां च तिरश्चां चाम्बुचारिणाम् । हिंस्राणां च पिशाचानां स्तेनो विप्रः सहस्रशः
verses.transliteration: lūtā'hisaraṭānāṃ ca tiraścāṃ cāmbucāriṇām | hiṃsrāṇāṃ ca piśācānāṃ steno vipraḥ sahasraśaḥ
verses.translation: A Brahmana who steals (the gold of a Brahmana shall pass) a thousand times (through the bodies) of spiders, snakes and lizards, of aquatic animals and of destructive Pisakas.

verses.sanskrit: तृणगुल्मलतानां च क्रव्यादां दंष्ट्रिणामपि । क्रूरकर्मकृतां चैव शतशो गुरुतल्पगः
verses.transliteration: tṛṇagulmalatānāṃ ca kravyādāṃ daṃṣṭriṇāmapi | krūrakarmakṛtāṃ caiva śataśo gurutalpagaḥ
verses.translation: The violator of a Guru's bed (enters) a hundred times (the forms) of grasses, shrubs, and creepers, likewise of carnivorous (animals) and of (beasts) with fangs and of those doing cruel deeds.

verses.sanskrit: हिंस्रा भवन्ति क्रव्यादाः कृमयोऽमेध्यभक्षिणः । परस्परादिनः स्तेनाः प्रेत्यान्त्यस्त्रीनिषेविणः
verses.transliteration: hiṃsrā bhavanti kravyādāḥ kṛmayo'medhyabhakṣiṇaḥ | parasparādinaḥ stenāḥ pretyāntyastrīniṣeviṇaḥ
verses.translation: Men who delight in doing hurt (become) carnivorous (animals); those who eat forbidden food, worms; thieves, creatures consuming their own kind; those who have intercourse with women of the lowest castes, Pretas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Men who delight in doing hurt (become) carnivorous (animals); those who eat forbidden food, worms; thieves, creatures consuming their own kind; those who have intercourse with women of the lowest castes, Pretas.

verses.sanskrit: संयोगं पतितैर्गत्वा परस्यैव च योषितम् । अपहृत्य च विप्रस्वं भवति ब्रह्मराक्षसः
verses.transliteration: saṃyogaṃ patitairgatvā parasyaiva ca yoṣitam | apahṛtya ca viprasvaṃ bhavati brahmarākṣasaḥ
verses.translation: He who has associated with outcasts, he who has approached the wives of other men, and he who has stolen the property of a Brahmana become Brahmarakshasas.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who has associated with outcasts, he who has approached the wives of other men, and he who has stolen the property of a Brahmana become Brahmarakshasas.

verses.sanskrit: मणिमुक्ताप्रवालानि हृत्वा लोभेन मानवः । विविधाणि च रत्नानि जायते हेमकर्तृषु
verses.transliteration: maṇimuktāpravālāni hṛtvā lobhena mānavaḥ | vividhāṇi ca ratnāni jāyate hemakartṛṣu
verses.translation: A man who out of greed has stolen gems, pearls or coral, or any of the many other kinds of precious things, is born among the goldsmiths.
verses.commentary: Sense: A man who out of greed has stolen gems, pearls or coral, or any of the many other kinds of precious things, is born among the goldsmiths.

verses.sanskrit: धान्यं हृत्वा भवत्याखुः कांस्यं हंसो जलं प्लवः । मधु दंशः पयः काको रसं श्वा नकुलो घृतम्
verses.transliteration: dhānyaṃ hṛtvā bhavatyākhuḥ kāṃsyaṃ haṃso jalaṃ plavaḥ | madhu daṃśaḥ payaḥ kāko rasaṃ śvā nakulo ghṛtam
verses.translation: For stealing grain (a man) becomes a rat, for stealing yellow metal a Hamsa, for stealing water a Plava, for stealing honey a stinging insect, for stealing milk a crow, for stealing condiments a dog, for stealing clarified butter an ichneumon;

verses.sanskrit: मांसं गृध्रो वपां मद्गुस्तैलं तैलपकः खगः । चीरीवाकस्तु लवणं बलाका शकुनिर्दधि
verses.transliteration: māṃsaṃ gṛdhro vapāṃ madgustailaṃ tailapakaḥ khagaḥ | cīrīvākastu lavaṇaṃ balākā śakunirdadhi
verses.translation: For stealing meat a vulture, for stealing fat a cormorant, for stealing oil a winged animal (of the kind called) Tailapaka, for stealing salt a cricket, for stealing sour milk a bird (of the kind called) Balaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: For stealing meat a vulture, for stealing fat a cormorant, for stealing oil a winged animal (of the kind called) Tailapaka, for stealing salt a cricket, for stealing sour milk a bird (of the kind called) Balaka.

verses.transliteration: kauśeyaṃ tittirirhṛtvā kṣaumaṃ hṛtvā tu darduraḥ | kārpāsatāntavaṃ krauñco godhā gāṃ vāggudo guḍam
verses.translation: For stealing silk a partridge, for stealing linen a frog, for stealing cotton-cloth a crane, for stealing a cow an iguana, for stealing molasses a flying-fox;
verses.commentary: Sense: For stealing silk a partridge, for stealing linen a frog, for stealing cotton-cloth a crane, for stealing a cow an iguana, for stealing molasses a flying-fox;

verses.sanskrit: छुच्छुन्दरिः शुभान् गन्धान् पत्रशाकं तु बर्हिणः । छुच्छुन्दरीः श्वावित्कृतान्नं विविधमकृतान्नं तु शल्यकः
verses.transliteration: chucchundariḥ śubhān gandhān patraśākaṃ tu barhiṇaḥ | chucchundarīḥ śvāvitkṛtānnaṃ vividhamakṛtānnaṃ tu śalyakaḥ
verses.translation: For stealing fine perfumes a musk-rat, for stealing vegetables consisting of leaves a peacock, for stealing cooked food of various kinds a porcupine, for stealing uncooked food a hedgehog.
verses.commentary: Sense: For stealing fine perfumes a musk-rat, for stealing vegetables consisting of leaves a peacock, for stealing cooked food of various kinds a porcupine, for stealing uncooked food a hedgehog.

verses.sanskrit: बको भवति हृत्वाऽग्निं गृहकारी ह्युपस्करम् । रक्तानि हृत्वा वासांसि जायते जीवजीवकः
verses.transliteration: bako bhavati hṛtvā'gniṃ gṛhakārī hyupaskaram | raktāni hṛtvā vāsāṃsi jāyate jīvajīvakaḥ
verses.translation: For stealing fire he becomes a heron, for stealing household-utensils a mason-wasp, for stealing dyed clothes a francolin-partridge;
verses.commentary: Sense: For stealing fire he becomes a heron, for stealing household-utensils a mason-wasp, for stealing dyed clothes a francolin-partridge;

verses.sanskrit: वृको मृगैभं व्याघ्रोऽश्वं फलमूलं तु मर्कटः । स्त्रीं ऋक्षः स्तोकको वारि यानान्युष्ट्रः पशूनजः
verses.transliteration: vṛko mṛgaibhaṃ vyāghro'śvaṃ phalamūlaṃ tu markaṭaḥ | strīṃ ṛkṣaḥ stokako vāri yānānyuṣṭraḥ paśūnajaḥ
verses.translation: For stealing a deer or an elephant a wolf, for stealing a horse a tiger, for stealing fruit and roots a monkey, for stealing a woman a bear, for stealing water a black-white cuckoo, for stealing vehicles a camel, for stealing cattle a he-goat.
verses.commentary: Sense: For stealing a deer or an elephant a wolf, for stealing a horse a tiger, for stealing fruit and roots a monkey, for stealing a woman a bear, for stealing water a black-white cuckoo, for stealing vehicles a camel, for stealing cattle a he-goat.

verses.sanskrit: यद्वा तद्वा परद्रव्यमपहृत्य बलान्नरः । अवश्यं याति तिर्यक्त्वं जग्ध्वा चैवाहुतं हविः
verses.transliteration: yadvā tadvā paradravyamapahṛtya balānnaraḥ | avaśyaṃ yāti tiryaktvaṃ jagdhvā caivāhutaṃ haviḥ
verses.translation: That man who has forcibly taken away any kind of property belonging to another, or who has eaten sacrificial food (of) which (no portion) had been offered, inevitably becomes an animal.
verses.commentary: Sense: That man who has forcibly taken away any kind of property belonging to another, or who has eaten sacrificial food (of) which (no portion) had been offered, inevitably becomes an animal.

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रियोऽप्येतेन कल्पेन हृत्वा दोषमवाप्नुयुः । एतेषामेव जन्तूनां भार्यात्वमुपयान्ति ताः
verses.transliteration: striyo'pyetena kalpena hṛtvā doṣamavāpnuyuḥ | eteṣāmeva jantūnāṃ bhāryātvamupayānti tāḥ
verses.translation: Women, also, who in like manner have committed a theft, shall incur guilt; they will become the females of those same creatures (which have been enumerated above).
verses.commentary: Sense: Women, also, who in like manner have committed a theft, shall incur guilt; they will become the females of those same creatures (which have been enumerated above).

verses.transliteration: svebhyaḥ svebhyastu karmabhyaścyutā varṇā hyanāpadi | pāpān saṃsṛtya saṃsārān preṣyatāṃ yānti śatruṣu
verses.translation: But (men of the four) castes who have relinquished without the pressure of necessity their proper occupations, will become the servants of Dasyus, after migrating into despicable bodies.
verses.commentary: Sense: But (men of the four) castes who have relinquished without the pressure of necessity their proper occupations, will become the servants of Dasyus, after migrating into despicable bodies.

verses.sanskrit: यान्ति दस्युषु वान्ताश्युल्कामुखः प्रेतो विप्रो धर्मात्स्वकाच्च्युतः । अमेध्यकुणपाशी च क्षत्रियः कटपूतनः
verses.transliteration: yānti dasyuṣu vāntāśyulkāmukhaḥ preto vipro dharmātsvakāccyutaḥ | amedhyakuṇapāśī ca kṣatriyaḥ kaṭapūtanaḥ
verses.translation: A Brahmana who has fallen off from his duty (becomes) an Ulkamukha Preta, who feeds on what has been vomited; and a Kshatriya, a Kataputana (Preta), who eats impure substances and corpses.

verses.sanskrit: कूटपूतनः मैत्राक्षज्योतिकः प्रेतो वैश्यो भवति पूयभुक् । मैत्राक्षिज्योतिकः चैलाशकश्च भवति शूद्रो धर्मात्स्वकाच्च्युतः
verses.transliteration: kūṭapūtanaḥ maitrākṣajyotikaḥ preto vaiśyo bhavati pūyabhuk | maitrākṣijyotikaḥ cailāśakaśca bhavati śūdro dharmātsvakāccyutaḥ
verses.translation: A Vaisya who has fallen off from his duty becomes a Maitrakshagyotika Preta, who feeds on pus; and a Sudra, a Kailasaka (Preta, who feeds on moths).
verses.commentary: Sense: A Vaisya who has fallen off from his duty becomes a Maitrakshagyotika Preta, who feeds on pus; and a Sudra, a Kailasaka (Preta, who feeds on moths).

verses.sanskrit: यथा यथा निषेवन्ते विषयान् विषयात्मकाः । तथा तथा कुशलता तेषां तेषूपजायते
verses.transliteration: yathā yathā niṣevante viṣayān viṣayātmakāḥ | tathā tathā kuśalatā teṣāṃ teṣūpajāyate
verses.translation: In proportion as sensual men indulge in sensual pleasures, in that same proportion their taste for them grows.
verses.commentary: Sense: In proportion as sensual men indulge in sensual pleasures, in that same proportion their taste for them grows.

verses.sanskrit: तेऽभ्यासात्कर्मणां तेषां पापानामल्पबुद्धयः । सम्प्राप्नुवन्ति दुःखानि तासु तास्विह योनिषु
verses.transliteration: te'bhyāsātkarmaṇāṃ teṣāṃ pāpānāmalpabuddhayaḥ | samprāpnuvanti duḥkhāni tāsu tāsviha yoniṣu
verses.translation: By repeating their sinful acts those men of small understanding suffer pain here (below) in various births;
verses.commentary: Sense: By repeating their sinful acts those men of small understanding suffer pain here (below) in various births;

verses.translation: (The torture of) being tossed about in dreadful hells, Tamisra and the rest, (that of) the Forest with sword-leaved trees and the like, and (that of) being bound and mangled;

verses.translation: And births in the wombs (of) despicable (beings) which cause constant misery, and afflictions from cold and heat and terrors of various kinds,

verses.transliteration: asakṛdgarbhavāseṣu vāsaṃ janma ca dāruṇam | bandhanāni ca kāṣṭhāni parapreṣyatvameva ca
verses.translation: The (pain of) repeatedly lying in various wombs and agonizing births, imprisonment in fetters hard to bear, and the misery of being enslaved by others,

verses.translation: And separations from their relatives and dear ones, and the (pain of) dwelling together with the wicked, (labour in) gaining wealth and its loss, (trouble in) making friends and (the appearance of) enemies,

verses.sanskrit: जरां चैवाप्रतीकारां व्याधिभिश्चोपपीडनम् । क्लेशांश्च विविधांस्तांस्तान् मृत्युमेव च दुर्जयम्
verses.transliteration: jarāṃ caivāpratīkārāṃ vyādhibhiścopapīḍanam | kleśāṃśca vividhāṃstāṃstān mṛtyumeva ca durjayam
verses.translation: Old age against which there is no remedy, the pangs of diseases, afflictions of many various kinds, and (finally) unconquerable death.
verses.commentary: Sense: Old age against which there is no remedy, the pangs of diseases, afflictions of many various kinds, and (finally) unconquerable death.

verses.transliteration: yādṛśena tu bhāvena yadyatkarma niṣevate | tādṛśena śarīreṇa tattatphalamupāśnute
verses.translation: But with whatever disposition of mind (a man) forms any act, he reaps its result in a (future) body endowed with the same quality.
verses.commentary: Sense: But with whatever disposition of mind (a man) forms any act, he reaps its result in a (future) body endowed with the same quality.

verses.translation: All the results, proceeding from actions, have been thus pointed out; learn (next) those acts which secure supreme bliss to a Brahmana.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the results, proceeding from actions, have been thus pointed out; learn (next) those acts which secure supreme bliss to a Brahmana.

verses.translation: Studying the Veda, (practising) austerities, (the acquisition of true) knowledge, the subjugation of the organs, abstention from doing injury, and serving the Guru are the best means for attaining supreme bliss.

verses.translation: (If you ask) whether among all these virtuous actions, (performed) here below, (there be) one which has been declared more efficacious (than the rest) for securing supreme happiness to man,

verses.translation: For in the performance of the acts prescribed by the Veda all those (others) are fully comprised, (each) in its turn in the several rules for the rites.

verses.transliteration: iha cāmutra vā kāmyaṃ pravṛttaṃ karma kīrtyate | niṣkāmaṃ jñātapūrvaṃ tu nivṛttamupadiśyate
verses.translation: Acts which secure (the fulfilment of) wishes in this world or in the next are called pravritta (such as cause a continuation of mundane existence); but acts performed without any desire (for a reward), preceded by (the acquisition) of (true) knowledge, are declared to be nivritta (such as cause the cessation of mundane existence).

verses.translation: He who sedulously performs acts leading to future births (pravritta) becomes equal to the gods; but he who is intent on the performance of those causing the cessation (of existence, nivritta) indeed, passes beyond (the reach of) the five elements.

verses.translation: He who sacrifices to the Self (alone), equally recognising the Self in all created beings and all created beings in the Self, becomes (independent like) an autocrat and self-luminous.

verses.translation: After giving up even the above-mentioned sacrificial rites, a Brahmana should exert himself in (acquiring) the knowledge of the Soul, in extinguishing his passions, and in studying the Veda.

verses.translation: For that secures the attainment of the object of existence, especially in the case of a Brahmana, because by attaining that, not otherwise, a twice-born man has gained all his ends.

verses.translation: All those traditions (smriti) and those despicable systems of philosophy, which are not based on the Veda, produce no reward after death; for they are declared to be founded on Darkness.

verses.transliteration: utpadyante cyavante ca yānyato'nyāni kāni cit | utpadyante vinaśyanti tānyarvākkālikatayā niṣphalānyanṛtāni ca
verses.translation: All those (doctrines), differing from the (Veda), which spring up and (soon) perish, are worthless and false, because they are of modern date.
verses.commentary: Sense: All those (doctrines), differing from the (Veda), which spring up and (soon) perish, are worthless and false, because they are of modern date.

verses.transliteration: cāturvarṇyaṃ trayo lokāścatvāraścāśramāḥ pṛthak | bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ ca sarvaṃ vedātprasidhyati
verses.translation: The four castes, the three worlds, the four orders, the past, the present, and the future are all severally known by means of the Veda.

verses.transliteration: bhūtaṃ bhavadbhaviṣyaṃ ca śabdaḥ sparśaśca rūpaṃ ca raso gandhaśca pañcamaḥ | vedādeva prasūyante prasūtirguṇakarmataḥ
verses.translation: Sound, touch, colour, taste, and fifthly smell are known through the Veda alone, (their) production (is) through the (Vedic rites, which in this respect are) secondary acts.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sound, touch, colour, taste, and fifthly smell are known through the Veda alone, (their) production (is) through the (Vedic rites, which in this respect are) secondary acts.

verses.translation: The eternal lore of the Veda upholds all created beings; hence I hold that to be supreme, which is the means of (securing happiness to) these creatures.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eternal lore of the Veda upholds all created beings; hence I hold that to be supreme, which is the means of (securing happiness to) these creatures.

verses.translation: Command of armies, royal authority, the office of a judge, and sovereignty over the whole world he (only) deserves who knows the Veda-science.

verses.sanskrit: यथा जातबलो वह्निर्दहत्यार्द्रानपि द्रुमान् । तथा दहति वेदज्ञः कर्मजं दोषमात्मनः
verses.transliteration: yathā jātabalo vahnirdahatyārdrānapi drumān | tathā dahati vedajñaḥ karmajaṃ doṣamātmanaḥ
verses.translation: As a fire that has gained strength consumes even trees full of sap, even so he who knows the Veda burns out the taint of his soul which arises from (evil) acts.
verses.hindi: यत्तु हुःखसमायुक्गमप्रीतिकरमा्मनः।
verses.commentary: Sense: As a fire that has gained strength consumes even trees full of sap, even so he who knows the Veda burns out the taint of his soul which arises from (evil) acts.
verses.science: यत्तु हुःखसमायुक्गमप्रीतिकरमा्मनः। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: वेदशास्त्रार्थतत्त्वज्ञो यत्र तत्राश्रमे वसन् । इहैव लोके तिष्ठन् स ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते
verses.transliteration: vedaśāstrārthatattvajño yatra tatrāśrame vasan | ihaiva loke tiṣṭhan sa brahmabhūyāya kalpate
verses.translation: In whatever order (a man) who knows the true meaning of the Veda-science may dwell, he becomes even while abiding in this world, fit for the union with Brahman.
verses.hindi: मन से विचार करके पुरुष की सदा धर्म में मर टिकांना चा हिप। सत्य, :रज आरे तम ये तीनों आत्मा: प्रकति के गुणे हि : में जो गुण जव देह मै अधिक होता है तव, उस माजा को. पने भाव का कर डालवा हे। वस्ठे कोःघार्स्तविके झन सल
verses.commentary: Sense: In whatever order (a man) who knows the true meaning of the Veda-science may dwell, he becomes even while abiding in this world, fit for the union with Brahman.
verses.science: मन से विचार करके पुरुष की सदा धर्म में मर टिकांना चा हिप। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अज्ञेभ्यो ग्रन्थिनः श्रेष्ठा ग्रन्थिभ्यो धारिणो वराः । धारिभ्यो ज्ञानिनः श्रेष्ठा ज्ञानिभ्यो व्यवसायिनः
verses.transliteration: ajñebhyo granthinaḥ śreṣṭhā granthibhyo dhāriṇo varāḥ | dhāribhyo jñāninaḥ śreṣṭhā jñānibhyo vyavasāyinaḥ
verses.translation: (Even forgetful) students of the (sacred) books are more distinguished than the ignorant, those who remember them surpass the (forgetful) students, those who possess a knowledge (of the meaning) are more distinguished than those who (only) remember (the words), men who follow (the teaching of the texts) surpass those who (merely) know (their meaning).
verses.hindi: में रुचि होना, दि बै सुण के काम हैं। आरम्भ में रुचि होना, फिर धेय, बुरे कासा में फॅसना और विषयः भाग ये रजोगुण के काम हैं । लोभ, नींद, अधीरता, करता, नास्तिकता, अनाचार, मांगने को आदत और भमाद ये तमो-
verses.wordMeaning: (Even forgetful) students of the (sacred) books are more distinguished than the ignorant, those who remember them surpass the (forgetful) students, those who possess a knowledge (of the meaning) are more distinguished than those who (only) remember (the words),…
verses.commentary: Sense: (Even forgetful) students of the (sacred) books are more distinguished than the ignorant, those who remember them surpass the (forgetful) students, those who possess a knowledge (of the meaning) are more distinguished than those who (only) remember (the words),…
verses.science: में रुचि होना, दि बै सुण के काम हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तपो विद्या च विप्रस्य निःश्रेयसकरं परम् । तपसा किल्बिषं हन्ति विद्ययाऽमृतमश्नुते
verses.transliteration: tapo vidyā ca viprasya niḥśreyasakaraṃ param | tapasā kilbiṣaṃ hanti vidyayā'mṛtamaśnute
verses.translation: Austerity and sacred learning are the best means by which a Brahmana secures supreme bliss; by austerities he destroys guilt, by sacred learning he obtains the cessation of (births and) deaths.
verses.hindi: त्रिविधा त्रिविधैषा तु विज्ञेया गोणिकी गातः।
verses.commentary: Sense: Austerity and sacred learning are the best means by which a Brahmana secures supreme bliss; by austerities he destroys guilt, by sacred learning he obtains the cessation of (births and) deaths.
verses.science: त्रिविधा त्रिविधैषा तु विज्ञेया गोणिकी गातः। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्यक्षं चानुमानं च शास्त्रं च विविधाऽऽगमम् । त्रयं सुविदितं कार्यं धर्मशुद्धिमभीप्सता
verses.transliteration: pratyakṣaṃ cānumānaṃ ca śāstraṃ ca vividhā''gamam | trayaṃ suviditaṃ kāryaṃ dharmaśuddhimabhīpsatā
verses.translation: The three (kinds of evidence), perception, inference, and the (sacred) Institutes which comprise the tradition (of) many (schools), must be fully understood by him who desires perfect correctness with respect to the sacred law.
verses.hindi: इन-गुणों में जिस शुण से जीव जिन जिन गरियो कोपाहा ' साव, रजोगुणी मचुष्यत्व और तमोगुणी पक्षीपनको पाते है“ ० यह तीस प्रकार की गति है । सत्त्व, रज और .तम इन तीन यणो" " खे होनेवाली मति, कम और विद्या के अनुसार; उत्तम-मध्यम-्झ-. .
verses.commentary: Sense: The three (kinds of evidence), perception, inference, and the (sacred) Institutes which comprise the tradition (of) many (schools), must be fully understood by him who desires perfect correctness with respect to the sacred law.
verses.science: इन-गुणों में जिस शुण से जीव जिन जिन गरियो कोपाहा ' साव, रजोगुणी मचुष्यत्व और तमोगुणी पक्षीपनको पाते है“ ० यह तीस प्रकार की गति है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आर्षं धर्मोपदेशं च वेदशास्त्राविरोधिना । यस्तर्केणानुसंधत्ते स धर्मं वेद नैतरः
verses.transliteration: ārṣaṃ dharmopadeśaṃ ca vedaśāstrāvirodhinā | yastarkeṇānusaṃdhatte sa dharmaṃ veda naitaraḥ
verses.translation: He alone, and no other man, knows the sacred law, who explores the (utterances) of the sages and the body of the laws, by (modes of) reasoning, not repugnant to the Veda-lore.
verses.hindi: पायान् संयान्ति संसारानविद्वांसो नराधमाः ॥ ५२.॥ यां यां योनिं तु जीवोऽयं येन येनेह कर्मणा ।
verses.commentary: Sense: He alone, and no other man, knows the sacred law, who explores the (utterances) of the sages and the body of the laws, by (modes of) reasoning, not repugnant to the Veda-lore.
verses.science: पायान् संयान्ति संसारानविद्वांसो नराधमाः ॥ ५२.॥ यां यां योनिं तु जीवोऽयं येन येनेह कर्मणा। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: नैःश्रेयसमिदं कर्म यथोदितमशेषतः । मानवस्यास्य शास्त्रस्य रहस्यमुपदिश्यते
verses.transliteration: naiḥśreyasamidaṃ karma yathoditamaśeṣataḥ | mānavasyāsya śāstrasya rahasyamupadiśyate
verses.translation: Thus the acts which secure supreme bliss have been exactly and fully described; (now) the secret portion of these Institutes, proclaimed by Manu, will be taught.
verses.hindi: प्रकार मन, बाणी और शरीर के तोन प्रकार के कमो से होने साली, तरिशुणमयी, उत्तम-मध्यम-अधम तीन प्रकार की सब आ- लोक मै यह जीव जिस जिस कर्म से जिस जिस योनि में जन्म लेता है, उन सब को क्रम से खनो-महापातको पुरुष बहुत
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the acts which secure supreme bliss have been exactly and fully described; (now) the secret portion of these Institutes, proclaimed by Manu, will be taught.
verses.science: प्रकार मन, बाणी और शरीर के तोन प्रकार के कमो से होने साली, तरिशुणमयी, उत्तम-मध्यम-अधम तीन प्रकार की सब आ- लोक मै यह जीव जिस जिस कर्म से जिस जिस योनि में जन्म…। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: उपदेक्ष्यते अनाम्नातेषु धर्मेषु कथं स्यादिति चेद्भवेत् । यं शिष्टा ब्राह्मणा ब्रूयुः स धर्मः स्यादशङ्कितः
verses.transliteration: upadekṣyate anāmnāteṣu dharmeṣu kathaṃ syāditi cedbhavet | yaṃ śiṣṭā brāhmaṇā brūyuḥ sa dharmaḥ syādaśaṅkitaḥ
verses.translation: If it be asked how it should be with respect to (points of) the law which have not been (specially) mentioned, (the answer is), 'that which Brahmanas (who are) Sishtas propound, shall doubtlessly have legal (force).'
verses.hindi: मधु देशः पयः काको रसं श्वा नकुलो घृतम्
verses.commentary: Sense: If it be asked how it should be with respect to (points of) the law which have not been (specially) mentioned, (the answer is), 'that which Brahmanas (who are) Sishtas propound, shall doubtlessly have legal (force).'
verses.science: मधु देशः पयः काको रसं श्वा नकुलो घृतम्। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: धर्मेणाधिगतो यैस्तु वेदः सपरिबृंहणः । ते शिष्टा ब्राह्मणा ज्ञेयाः श्रुतिप्रत्यक्षहेतवः
verses.transliteration: dharmeṇādhigato yaistu vedaḥ saparibṛṃhaṇaḥ | te śiṣṭā brāhmaṇā jñeyāḥ śrutipratyakṣahetavaḥ
verses.translation: Those Brahmanas must be considered as Sishtas who, in accordance with the sacred law, have studied the Veda together with its appendages, and are able to adduce proofs perceptible by the senses from the revealed texts.
verses.hindi: मैंढ़ा, सग, पक्षी, चारडाल और पुकस की जाति में, जन्मता. है । मद्यपान'करनेवाला ब्राह्मण कमि, कोडा, पतंग, मेला खानेवाले पक्षी और हिलक प्राणियों की जाति से जन्मता. है । सोना चुरानेवाला ब्राह्मण मकड़ी, सांप, गिरगट, जलजर पक्षी, हिसक
verses.commentary: Sense: Those Brahmanas must be considered as Sishtas who, in accordance with the sacred law, have studied the Veda together with its appendages, and are able to adduce proofs perceptible by the senses from the revealed texts.
verses.science: मैंढ़ा, सग, पक्षी, चारडाल और पुकस की जाति में, जन्मता. है। धीमी श्वास वेगस तंत्रिका को सक्रिय कर भय-प्रतिक्रिया को शांत करती है। यह पंक्ति उसी श्वास और मन के संबंध को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: दशावरा वा परिषद्यं धर्मं परिकल्पयेत् । त्र्य्ऽवरा वाऽपि वृत्तस्था तं धर्मं न विचालयेत्
verses.transliteration: daśāvarā vā pariṣadyaṃ dharmaṃ parikalpayet | try'varā vā'pi vṛttasthā taṃ dharmaṃ na vicālayet
verses.translation: Whatever an assembly, consisting either of at least ten, or of at least three persons who follow their prescribed occupations, declares to be law, the legal (force of) that one must not dispute.
verses.hindi: वृको शृगेसं व्याघ्ोऽरवं फलसूल तु लकर । है
verses.commentary: Sense: Whatever an assembly, consisting either of at least ten, or of at least three persons who follow their prescribed occupations, declares to be law, the legal (force of) that one must not dispute.
verses.science: वृको शृगेसं व्याघ्ोऽरवं फलसूल तु लकर। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: त्रैविद्यो हेतुकस्तर्की नैरुक्तो धर्मपाठकः । त्रयश्चाश्रमिणः पूर्वे परिषत्स्याद्दशावरा
verses.transliteration: traividyo hetukastarkī nairukto dharmapāṭhakaḥ | trayaścāśramiṇaḥ pūrve pariṣatsyāddaśāvarā
verses.translation: Three persons who each know one of the three principal Vedas, a logician, a Mimamsaka, one who knows the Nirukta, one who recites (the Institutes of) the sacred law, and three men belonging to the first three orders shall constitute a (legal) assembly, consisting of at least ten members.
verses.hindi: माल चुराने से गीध, चरवी" चुराने से जलकाक, तेल की... चोरी से. तैलपक पक्षी, लोन चुराने से झौगुर और: दही की. चोरी से वलाका पक्षी होता हे। रेशम चुराने, से तीतर, अलसी: के कपड़ों की चोरी से मेंढक, कपास वसर: चुराने से सारख; ..
verses.wordMeaning: Three persons who each know one of the three principal Vedas, a logician, a Mimamsaka, one who knows the Nirukta, one who recites (the Institutes of) the sacred law, and three men belonging to the first three orders shall constitute a (legal) assembly,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Three persons who each know one of the three principal Vedas, a logician, a Mimamsaka, one who knows the Nirukta, one who recites (the Institutes of) the sacred law, and three men belonging to the first three orders shall constitute a (legal) assembly,…
verses.science: माल चुराने से गीध, चरवी" चुराने से जलकाक, तेल की... चोरी से. तैलपक पक्षी, लोन चुराने से झौगुर और: दही की. चोरी से वलाका पक्षी होता हे। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: ऋग्वेदविद्यजुर्विद्च सामवेदविदेव च । त्र्य्ऽवरा परिषद्ज्ञेया धर्मसंशयनिर्णये
verses.transliteration: ṛgvedavidyajurvidca sāmavedavideva ca | try'varā pariṣadjñeyā dharmasaṃśayanirṇaye
verses.translation: One who knows the Rig-veda, one who knows the Yagur-veda, and one who knows the Sama-veda, shall be known (to form) an assembly consisting of at least three members (and competent) to decide doubtful points of law.
verses.hindi: तासिल्लादिपु चोग्रेषु नरकेषु विवतेनम् ।..
verses.commentary: Sense: One who knows the Rig-veda, one who knows the Yagur-veda, and one who knows the Sama-veda, shall be known (to form) an assembly consisting of at least three members (and competent) to decide doubtful points of law.
verses.science: तासिल्लादिपु चोग्रेषु नरकेषु विवतेनम्। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एकोऽपि वेदविद्धर्मं यं व्यवस्येद्द्विजोत्तमः । स विज्ञेयः परो धर्मो नाज्ञानामुदितोऽयुतैः
verses.transliteration: eko'pi vedaviddharmaṃ yaṃ vyavasyeddvijottamaḥ | sa vijñeyaḥ paro dharmo nājñānāmudito'yutaiḥ
verses.translation: Even that which one Brahmana versed in the Veda declares to be law, must be considered (to have) supreme legal (force, but) not that which is proclaimed by myriads of ignorant men.
verses.hindi: ' है और शद चेलाशक मेत होकर, कपड़े की जूँ खाता है । वि- , चयासक्क पुरुप जैसे जैसे विषयों का सेवन करते है, पैसे पैसे . उनमें उनकी कुशलता हो जाती है वे निर्दमुेद्धि उन पाप कमों के यार यार करने से यहां अनेक योनियो में जन्म लेकर दुःख
verses.commentary: Sense: Even that which one Brahmana versed in the Veda declares to be law, must be considered (to have) supreme legal (force, but) not that which is proclaimed by myriads of ignorant men.
verses.science: ' है और शद चेलाशक मेत होकर, कपड़े की जूँ खाता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अव्रतानाममन्त्राणां जातिमात्रोपजीविनाम् । सहस्रशः समेतानां परिषत्त्वं न विद्यते
verses.transliteration: avratānāmamantrāṇāṃ jātimātropajīvinām | sahasraśaḥ sametānāṃ pariṣattvaṃ na vidyate
verses.translation: Even if thousands of Brahmanas, who have not fulfilled their sacred duties, are unacquainted with the Veda, and subsist only by the name of their caste, meet, they cannot (form) an assembly (for settling the sacred law).
verses.hindi: यादृशेन त भावेन: यद्यत्कर्म निषेवते । नैश्वेयलकर कसे विन्रस्येदं  निवोघतं
verses.commentary: Sense: Even if thousands of Brahmanas, who have not fulfilled their sacred duties, are unacquainted with the Veda, and subsist only by the name of their caste, meet, they cannot (form) an assembly (for settling the sacred law).
verses.science: यादृशेन त भावेन: यद्यत्कर्म निषेवते। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: यं वदन्ति तमोभूता मूर्खा धर्ममतद्विदः । तत्पापं शतधा भूत्वा तद्वक्तॄननुगच्छति
verses.transliteration: yaṃ vadanti tamobhūtā mūrkhā dharmamatadvidaḥ | tatpāpaṃ śatadhā bhūtvā tadvaktṝnanugacchati
verses.translation: The sin of him whom dunces, incarnations of Darkness, and unacquainted with the law, instruct (in his duty), falls, increased a hundredfold, on those who propound it.
verses.hindi: आहिँसा गुरुसेवा च नेशश्षेयसंकर परम् ॥ ८३-॥ किचिच्छेयस्करतरं कसो पुरुष प्रति
verses.commentary: Sense: The sin of him whom dunces, incarnations of Darkness, and unacquainted with the law, instruct (in his duty), falls, increased a hundredfold, on those who propound it.
verses.science: आहिँसा गुरुसेवा च नेशश्षेयसंकर परम् ॥ ८३-॥ किचिच्छेयस्करतरं कसो पुरुष प्रति। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एतद्वोऽभिहितं सर्वं निःश्रेयसकरं परम् । अस्मादप्रच्युतो विप्रः प्राप्नोति परमां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: etadvo'bhihitaṃ sarvaṃ niḥśreyasakaraṃ param | asmādapracyuto vipraḥ prāpnoti paramāṃ gatim
verses.translation: All that which is most efficacious for securing supreme bliss has been thus declared to you; a Brahmana who does not fall off from that obtains the most excellent state.
verses.hindi: « वान्धवो का वियोग, छुजेनों का सहवास, दुःख से घन पाना;  घन का नाश, कठिनता से मित्र पांना ओर शत्रुओं ले वेर भाव... होता है  जिसका उपाय न हो सके ऐसा बुढ़ापा आता है, ' : व्यांधिया से कष्ट, चानामरंकार के हुःख और दुजेय मरण होता.
verses.commentary: Sense: All that which is most efficacious for securing supreme bliss has been thus declared to you; a Brahmana who does not fall off from that obtains the most excellent state.
verses.science: « वान्धवो का वियोग, छुजेनों का सहवास, दुःख से घन पाना; घन का नाश, कठिनता से मित्र पांना ओर शत्रुओं ले वेर भाव... होता है जिसका उपाय न हो सके ऐसा बुढ़ापा आता…। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं स भगवान् देवो लोकानां हितकाम्यया । धर्मस्य परमं गुह्यं ममेदं सर्वमुक्तवान्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ sa bhagavān devo lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā | dharmasya paramaṃ guhyaṃ mamedaṃ sarvamuktavān
verses.translation: Thus did that worshipful deity disclose to me, through a desire of benefiting mankind, this whole most excellent secret of the sacred law.
verses.hindi: वैदिक कमो में अपर कही सब क्रियाओं का अन्तर्भाव होता देक कर्म होते हँ । इसलोक के आर परलोक के सुख की कामना नेचूक्त कहलाता है  प्रचुत्त कमे के करने से देवताओं की समता र निदृत्त कसे करने से पञ्चसूतो को उलांघ कर मोक्ष
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus did that worshipful deity disclose to me, through a desire of benefiting mankind, this whole most excellent secret of the sacred law.
verses.science: वैदिक कमो में अपर कही सब क्रियाओं का अन्तर्भाव होता देक कर्म होते हँ। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वमात्मनि सम्पश्येत्सत्चासत्च समाहितः । सर्वं ह्यात्मनि सम्पश्यन्नाधर्मे कुरुते मनः
verses.transliteration: sarvamātmani sampaśyetsatcāsatca samāhitaḥ | sarvaṃ hyātmani sampaśyannādharme kurute manaḥ
verses.translation: Let (every Brahmana), concentrating his mind, fully recognise in the Self all things, both the real and the unreal, for he who recognises the universe in the Self, does not give his heart to unrighteousness.
verses.hindi: वेदादेद सूयन्ते प्रसूतिगुशकर्सतः
verses.commentary: Sense: Let (every Brahmana), concentrating his mind, fully recognise in the Self all things, both the real and the unreal, for he who recognises the universe in the Self, does not give his heart to unrighteousness.
verses.science: वेदादेद सूयन्ते प्रसूतिगुशकर्सतः। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आत्मैव देवताः सर्वाः सर्वमात्मन्यवस्थितम् । आत्मा हि जनयत्येषां कर्मयोगं शरीरिणाम्
verses.transliteration: ātmaiva devatāḥ sarvāḥ sarvamātmanyavasthitam | ātmā hi janayatyeṣāṃ karmayogaṃ śarīriṇām
verses.translation: The Self alone is the multitude of the gods, the universe rests on the Self; for the Self produces the connexion of these embodied (spirits) with actions.
verses.hindi: सर्वलोकाधिपत्यं च वेदशात्रविदहति
verses.commentary: Sense: The Self alone is the multitude of the gods, the universe rests on the Self; for the Self produces the connexion of these embodied (spirits) with actions.
verses.science: सर्वलोकाधिपत्यं च वेदशात्रविदहति। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: खं संनिवेशयेत्खेषु चेष्टनस्पर्शनेऽनिलम् । पक्तिदृष्ट्योः परं तेजः स्नेहेऽपो गां च मूर्तिषु
verses.transliteration: khaṃ saṃniveśayetkheṣu ceṣṭanasparśane'nilam | paktidṛṣṭyoḥ paraṃ tejaḥ snehe'po gāṃ ca mūrtiṣu
verses.translation: Let him meditate on the ether as identical with the cavities (of the body), on the wind as identical with the organs of motions and of touch, on the most excellent light as the same with his digestive organs and his sight, on water as the same with the (corporeal) fluids, on the earth as the same with the solid parts (of his body);
verses.hindi: सो सूति वेदमूलक नहीं हें, जो वेदिक देवन्यधादि को झूठा घतलानेवाले यन्य, उन सबको तिष्फल ओर नरकगति देनेवाले हैं और थोड़े समय मे नष्ट होजाते है । वे आधुनिक होनेसे निष्फल से हैं। सनातन वेद यज्ञादि से चराचर बिश्व का धारण और पाः
verses.wordMeaning: Let him meditate on the ether as identical with the cavities (of the body), on the wind as identical with the organs of motions and of touch, on the most excellent light as the same with his digestive organs and his sight, on water as the same with the (corporeal) fluids,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Let him meditate on the ether as identical with the cavities (of the body), on the wind as identical with the organs of motions and of touch, on the most excellent light as the same with his digestive organs and his sight, on water as the same with the (corporeal) fluids,…
verses.science: सो सूति वेदमूलक नहीं हें, जो वेदिक देवन्यधादि को झूठा घतलानेवाले यन्य, उन सबको तिष्फल ओर नरकगति देनेवाले हैं और थोड़े समय मे नष्ट होजाते है। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: मनसीन्दुं दिशः श्रोत्रे क्रान्ते विष्णुं बले हरम् । वाच्यग्निं मित्रमुत्सर्गे प्रजने च प्रजापतिम्
verses.transliteration: manasīnduṃ diśaḥ śrotre krānte viṣṇuṃ bale haram | vācyagniṃ mitramutsarge prajane ca prajāpatim
verses.translation: On the moon as one with the internal organ, on the quarters of the horizon as one with his sense of hearing, on Vishnu as one with his (power of) motion, on Hara as the same with his strength, on Agni (Fire) as identical with his speech, on Mitra as identical with his excretions, and on Pragapati as one with his organ of generation.
verses.hindi: आफ धर्मोपदेश च वेदशास्राऽविरोधिना ।  यस्तकेणानुसंधस्ते स धर्म वेद नेतरः
verses.wordMeaning: On the moon as one with the internal organ, on the quarters of the horizon as one with his sense of hearing, on Vishnu as one with his (power of) motion, on Hara as the same with his strength, on Agni (Fire) as identical with his speech,…
verses.commentary: Sense: On the moon as one with the internal organ, on the quarters of the horizon as one with his sense of hearing, on Vishnu as one with his (power of) motion, on Hara as the same with his strength, on Agni (Fire) as identical with his speech,…
verses.science: आफ धर्मोपदेश च वेदशास्राऽविरोधिना। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रशासितारं सर्वेषामणीयांसमणोरपि । रुक्माभं स्वप्नधीगम्यं विद्यात्तं पुरुषं परम्
verses.transliteration: praśāsitāraṃ sarveṣāmaṇīyāṃsamaṇorapi | rukmābhaṃ svapnadhīgamyaṃ vidyāttaṃ puruṣaṃ param
verses.translation: Let him know the supreme Male (Purusha, to be) the sovereign ruler of them all, smaller even than small, bright like gold, and perceptible by the intellect (only when) in (a state of) sleep (-like abstraction).
verses.hindi: नेःभ्रेयसमिदं कर्म यथोदितमशेषतः । .
verses.commentary: Sense: Let him know the supreme Male (Purusha, to be) the sovereign ruler of them all, smaller even than small, bright like gold, and perceptible by the intellect (only when) in (a state of) sleep (-like abstraction).
verses.science: नेःभ्रेयसमिदं कर्म यथोदितमशेषतः। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: एतमेके वदन्त्यग्निं मनुमन्ये प्रजापतिम् । इन्द्रमेके परे प्राणमपरे ब्रह्म शाश्वतम्
verses.transliteration: etameke vadantyagniṃ manumanye prajāpatim | indrameke pare prāṇamapare brahma śāśvatam
verses.translation: Some call him Agni (Fire), others Manu, the Lord of creatures, others Indra, others the vital air, and again others eternal Brahman.
verses.hindi: कारी है। घाण तप खे पाप नाश करता है और ब्रह्मविद्या भांति जाने। जो वेद और घर्मशासत्र का चेद् के अनुकूल तके से विचार करता है वह धर्म को जानता है, दूसरा नहीं जा- नता । इस प्रकार मोक्ष देनेवाले सघ कम कहे गये है  अब इस
verses.commentary: Sense: Some call him Agni (Fire), others Manu, the Lord of creatures, others Indra, others the vital air, and again others eternal Brahman.
verses.science: कारी है। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: एष सर्वाणि भूतानि पञ्चभिर्व्याप्य मूर्तिभिः । जन्मवृद्धिक्षयैर्नित्यं संसारयति चक्रवत्
verses.transliteration: eṣa sarvāṇi bhūtāni pañcabhirvyāpya mūrtibhiḥ | janmavṛddhikṣayairnityaṃ saṃsārayati cakravat
verses.translation: He pervades all created beings in the five forms, and constantly makes them, by means of birth, growth and decay, revolve like the wheels (of a chariot).
verses.hindi: उववरा परिषश्लेया धर्मसंशयानिर्णये
verses.commentary: Sense: He pervades all created beings in the five forms, and constantly makes them, by means of birth, growth and decay, revolve like the wheels (of a chariot).
verses.science: उववरा परिषश्लेया धर्मसंशयानिर्णये। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं यः सर्वभूतेषु पश्यत्यात्मानमात्मना । स सर्वसमतामेत्य ब्रह्माभ्येति परं पदम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ yaḥ sarvabhūteṣu paśyatyātmānamātmanā | sa sarvasamatāmetya brahmābhyeti paraṃ padam
verses.translation: He who thus recognises the Self through the Self in all created beings, becomes equal (-minded) towards all, and enters the highest state, Brahman.
verses.hindi: एतद्टोऽमिहितं सर्व निःभेयसकरं परम् एवं स भगवान् देवो लोकानां हितकाम्यया।
verses.commentary: Sense: He who thus recognises the Self through the Self in all created beings, becomes equal (-minded) towards all, and enters the highest state, Brahman.
verses.science: एतद्टोऽमिहितं सर्व निःभेयसकरं परम् एवं स भगवान् देवो लोकानां हितकाम्यया। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्येतन् मानवं शास्त्रं भृगुप्रोक्तं पठन् द्विजः । भवत्याचारवान्नित्यं यथेष्टां प्राप्नुयाद्गतिम्
verses.transliteration: ityetan mānavaṃ śāstraṃ bhṛguproktaṃ paṭhan dvijaḥ | bhavatyācāravānnityaṃ yatheṣṭāṃ prāpnuyādgatim
verses.translation: A twice-born man who recites these Institutes, revealed by Manu, will be always virtuous in conduct, and will reach whatever condition he desires.
verses.hindi: ताना वेद का घाता वेदालुकूल शास्रेश) मौमांसादि तको का भै सन्देह पहने पर निर्रीय करने के लिए तीनों वेद के शाता, कम . से कम तीन ब्राह्मणों को अधिष्ठाचा करना चाहिए। एक भी वेद राह्मण जिसको शरम कहे उसको थमे जानि । पर दश हज्ञार मूर्खा
verses.commentary: Sense: A twice-born man who recites these Institutes, revealed by Manu, will be always virtuous in conduct, and will reach whatever condition he desires.
verses.science: ताना वेद का घाता वेदालुकूल शास्रेश) मौमांसादि तको का भै सन्देह पहने पर निर्रीय करने के लिए तीनों वेद के शाता, कम . से कम तीन ब्राह्मणों को अधिष्ठाचा करना चाहिए। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।
